column1: Well done, Herr General.  You have decisively defeated what was once called the best army in the world!  Continue on, General, all the way to the coast!
column2: 干得好，将军阁下。你决定性地击败了曾号称世界最强的军队！继续前进，将军，一直打到海边！

column1: Luckily for me you are being sent with your 1st SS PanzerKorps, via train, to Normandy.
column2: 算我走运，你将率你的党卫军第1装甲军乘火车开赴诺曼底(Normandy)。

column1: Now you are CinC West's problem.

column1: Vienna fell to the Russians. The Der Führer regiment was sent to Prague for a (successful) rescue mission of the entrapped garrison forces, the Deutschland regiment clashed with American forces near St Poelten Austria and the rest of the division was sent to Dresden.
column2: 维也纳(Vienna)已落入俄军之手。元首(Der Führer)团被派往布拉格(Prague)，执行解救被围守军的任务（并获成功）；德意志(Deutschland)团在奥地利圣珀尔滕(St Poelten)附近与美军交火；该师其余部队则被派往德累斯顿(Dresden)。

column1: General, If it was up to me I would have you replaced!
column2: 将军，要是由我说了算，我早就把你换掉了！

column1: However, I can only make recommendations where the SS is concerned.
column2: 不过，涉及到党卫军，我只能提建议。

column2: 你失败了，伤亡惨重，美军在盖塔尔(El Guettar)取得了胜利。

column1: We must order the complete retreat!
column2: 我们必须下令全面撤退！

column1: Postwar mistrust between the Allied Powers leads to hostilities. The Soviets attack U.S. and British forces near Dessau, attempting to drive towards Halle, Sangerhausen and Halberstadt.
column2: 战后盟国之间的猜忌演变为敌对行动。苏军在德绍(Dessau)附近进攻美英军队，试图向哈勒(Halle)、桑格豪森(Sangerhausen)与哈尔伯施塔特(Halberstadt)推进。

column1: Herr General, you not only defeated the enemy, but also took their starting positions !!! Unfortunately down south the 3rd and 4th Ukainian Fronts have crossed the Romanian border.
column2: 将军阁下，你不仅击败了敌人，还夺取了他们的出发阵地！！！可惜在南面，乌克兰第3方面军与第4方面军已越过罗马尼亚边境。
康涅狄格州空军国民警卫队

column1: Well that was a nasty surprise!  You survived that counterattack but we must move quickly now against Dunkirk.
column2: 这可真是个讨厌的意外！你顶住了那次反击，但我们现在必须迅速行动，对付敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)。

column1: Herr General, your thrust to Strasbourg will be used as a textbook example of offensive maneuver. This lightning blow, you have changed the course of the war in the west. Outstanding.
column2: 将军阁下，你向斯特拉斯堡的突击将被用作进攻机动的教科书范例。这一闪电般的打击，你改变了西线的战争进程。卓越。

column2: 第101空降师在二战中的荣誉

column1: Great work Bob!! Under difficult conditions your Regiment has secured the southern exits and allowed the passage of the Utah Beach assault force onto clear ground.
column2: 干得漂亮，鲍勃！！在艰难条件下，你的团守住了南面的出口，使犹他海滩(Utah Beach)登陆部队得以通过，进入开阔地。

column1: The allies have been stopped you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
column2: 盟军挡住了你，我们未能达成预定目标。我们明白，这确实非常艰难，而且你手里的部队太少了。

column1: Hitler has decided II SS Panzer Corps is needed to deal with the anticipated Soviet diversionary attacks south of the Belgorod-Kharkov sector.
column2: 希特勒已决定，需要动用党卫军第2装甲军，以应对预计在别尔哥罗德(Belgorod)—哈尔科夫(Kharkov)地段以南发起的苏军牵制性进攻。

column1: Source: 'New evidence suggests that the Germans may have been closer to victory at Kursk than previously recognized' by George M. Nipe, Jr.
column2: 资料来源：George M. Nipe, Jr.《新证据表明，德军在库尔斯克距胜利可能比此前认为的更近》。

column2: 普罗霍罗夫卡(Prokhorovka)这一场景受到 Jorge Gabitto 的库尔斯克(Kursk)战役的影响。

column1: Well Herr General, those Poles put up quite a fight.  Nevertheless, they were no match for your PanzerKorps.
column2: 将军阁下，那些波兰人打得相当顽强。尽管如此，他们仍不是你装甲军的对手。

column1: Next, Herr General, you get the prize, Warszawa!
column2: 接下来，将军阁下，大奖归你——华沙(Warszawa)！

column1: Though our attack was well timed and resulted in complete surprise of the enemy, your performance was not of the highest caliber, Herr General.  Although you were successful, we expected more from you.
column2: 尽管我们的进攻时机得当、达成了对敌的完全突然性，但你的表现并非上乘，将军阁下。你虽然成功了，我们对你的期望却更高。

column1: You have succeeded in your mission where many others would have failed.  However, the Western Allies have been able to evacuate a majority of their troops and sink most of our surface fleet.
column2: 你在许多人都做不到的地方完成了任务。然而，西线盟军得以撤走了大部分部队，还击沉了我们大部分水面舰艇。

column1: Herr General, Ternopil' is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。

column1: A good performance, to be sure. Kyiv has fallen; the Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And now, Moscow is threatened.
column2: 确实是一场出色的表现。基辅(Kyiv)已经陷落；布尔什维克各集团军已被切断，救援无望。而现在，莫斯科也受到威胁。

column1: Herr General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await our attack.  Your presence is requested else where leave this rabble to us and we'll end this war.
column2: 将军阁下，敌人打得英勇，但这并没有挡住你。而现在，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着我们去进攻。别处需要你去——把这群乌合之众交给我们，我们会结束这场战争。

column1: Superb performance, Herr General!  You have again broken the Soviet's back with your tenacity and skill!  Your troops have earned a well-deserved rest!
column2: 干得精彩，将军阁下！你再次以坚韧与技艺打断了苏军的脊梁！你的部队赢得了一次当之无愧的休整！

column1: Herr General, the Allies are holding Aachen and they are using it as a communications and supply center.  This objective is critical to our winter offensive we have been planning.  Capture it so we may drive them back to the coast!
column2: 将军阁下，盟军据守着亚琛(Aachen)，把它当作通信与补给中心。这一目标对我们筹划已久的冬季攻势至关重要。拿下它，我们就能把他们赶回海边！

column1: Herr General, we have an excellent opportunity to deliver a crushing blow to the enemy, here, north of Strasbourg. As you can see, the advance of the American Third Army has left this sector of their front inadequately defended. If you can knife through to Strasbourg, the Americans and British will be forced to halt their drive on the Fatherland. Good luck!
column2: 将军阁下，我们有一个绝佳的机会给敌人一记重击——就在这里，斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)以北。如你所见，美军第3集团军的推进已使该段防线防御空虚。你若能如利刃般直插斯特拉斯堡，美英两国就不得不停止向本土推进。祝好运！

column1: Please accept the highest praises from the Allied High Command.
column2: 请接受盟军最高统帅部(Allied High Command)的最高赞誉。
哈士奇行动 - 第2部分

column1: After 4 days of fighting, Goering decided to force the Dutch in Rotterdam to surrender by bombing the city. When Generalleutnant Schmidt (9th PzDiv) reached an agreement on the terms of surrender of Rotterdam with it's Dutch commander, it was too late to recall all bombers and Rotterdam city center got hit very hard. The same day, Dutch General Winkelman decided to have all equipment destroyed in preparation for the overall Dutch surrender.
column2: 经过4天战斗，戈林决定以轰炸城市的方式迫使鹿特丹的荷兰人投降。当施密特中将（第9装甲师）与鹿特丹的荷军指挥官就投降条款达成一致时，已来不及召回所有轰炸机，鹿特丹市中心遭到重创。同一天，荷兰温克尔曼将军决定销毁所有装备，为荷兰全军投降做准备。

column1: On that May 14th 1940 General Student was hit in the head by a bullet from an SS sniper in Rotterdam. You and your SS friends are very lucky he survived.
column2: 1940年5月14日那天，施图登特将军在鹿特丹被一名党卫军狙击手的子弹击中头部。他和你们这些党卫军朋友非常走运，他活了下来。

column1: A properly planned amphibious assault, supported by massive naval gunfire, was difficult if not impossible to repel. At Salerno, the Germans, who didn't know this, almost crushed the beachhead and might have done so with just slightly better luck.
column2: 一次计划周密的登陆作战，在强大舰炮火力支援下，即使并非不可能，也很难被击退。在萨莱诺(Salerno)，不知道这一点的德军几乎碾碎了滩头阵地，若是运气稍好一点，他们或许就能成功。
维堡—普里莫尔斯克公路
维堡—索洛维约夫卡公路

column1: Good work Bob, it seems your men are almost ready for the big one!!
column2: 干得好，鲍勃，看来你的部下已经差不多准备好打大仗了！！

column1: Although you failed to secure the southern exits the capture of the northern exits by the 502nd has prevented complete disaster. Be aware though that you have lost favour with Headquarters and you may find replacements and supplies harder to come by!!!
column2: 尽管你未能守住南面的出口，但第502团夺取北面出口，避免了彻底的灾难。不过你要明白，你已经失去了司令部的信任，补充兵员与补给恐怕会越来越难弄到！！！

column2: 你能比英国第8集团军做得更好吗？

column2: 从现在起，你将处于防御态势。

column1: Panzer Division Kempf fought more battles with the Poles at Rozan, Lomza, Kliczym and Modlin. The division was disbanded after the Polish campaign at a farewell parade near Neidenburg at October 7th 1939.
column2: 肯普夫装甲师又在罗赞、沃姆扎、克莱奇姆和莫德林与波兰人打了几仗。波兰战役结束后，该师于1939年10月7日在奈登堡附近的告别阅兵式上解散。

column1: Note: REDUX campaigns have different victory conditions settings based on the nr of hexes rather than on the nr of turns. As a result you can win a scenario despite your unability to conquer all VH's. A victory might seem easier but...
column2: 注意：REDUX 战役的胜利条件设置不同，是以格数而非回合数为依据。因此，即使你未能攻占全部 VH，也可能赢得场景。胜利看似更容易，但……

column1: The Kharkov scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. Slight modifications were made: deployment hexes, supply hexes and prestige management.
column2: 哈尔科夫场景及其所用地图由 Hannes Gruber 制作。为使其适配本战役，仅作了轻微修改：部署格、补给格与威望管理。

column1: The Zitadelle scenario is influenced by Jorge Gabitto's Kursk campaign.
column2: 「堡垒」场景受 Jorge Gabitto 的库尔斯克战役启发。

column1: Herr General, You defeated the Tank Armies that formed the last Russian reserves in this sector. If it wasn't for Hitler, we could drive on to Kursk and accomplish all of our goals.
column2: 将军阁下，你击败了构成俄国人在此段最后预备队的各坦克集团军。若不是希特勒，我们本可继续向库尔斯克推进，完成所有目标。

column1: After receiving the news of the Allied invasion of Sicily, as well as reports of impeding Soviet attacks on the Mius River and at Izyum, Hitler decided to cancel Operation Zitadelle. Unfortunately, we will not be able to completely finish of the Russian armor with the 3 Panzer divisions we kept in reserve.
column2: 接到盟军入侵西西里的消息，以及苏军即将在米乌斯河和伊久姆发起进攻的报告后，希特勒决定取消「堡垒」行动。遗憾的是，我们无法用留在预备队的3个装甲师将俄军装甲部队彻底歼灭。

column1: Congratulations Herr General. The American beachhead has been annihilated. Unfortunately the British and Canadians have broken through our lines near Caen. This has forced us to retreat in order to escape from getting surrounded. Our retreat allowed US forces that remained in the Cherbourg area to outflank us in the Coutance area. Your mission is to push West to the shore in order to restore the front line and cut off the US divisions that have broken through.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。美军滩头阵地已被肃清。遗憾的是，英军和加军在卡昂附近突破了我军防线，迫使我们后撤以免被合围。我军的后撤又让留在瑟堡地区的美军得以在库唐斯一带迂回到我们侧后。你的任务是向西推进到海岸，以恢复战线并切断已突破的美军各师。

column1: East of here the Brits have broken through near Caen and again our troops are at risk of being surrounded. Retreat East towards Falaise.
column2: 在此以东，英军在卡昂附近突破了防线，我军再度面临被合围的危险。向东撤退，往法莱斯方向。

column1: There are many more Commanding Generals more than willing to take your place!
column2: 还有很多指挥官巴不得来接替你的位置！

column1: General, you only achieved a marginal victory.  This is unsatisfactory!  Either you must improve or you will be transferred to U-Boat Commander School.
column2: 将军，你只取得了一场险胜。这不能令人满意！你要么有所改进，要么就被调到潜艇指挥官学校去。

column1: They are always looking for potential submariners...
column2: 他们一直在物色有潜力的潜艇兵……

column1: There are many more Commanding General's more than willing to take your place!
column2: 还有很多指挥官巴不得来接替你的位置！

column1: You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the fiasco you perpetrated in Finland.  However, your previous performance merits another opportunity.  Do not fail us again.
column2: 你在芬兰酿成惨败后还能逃脱被俘，算你走运。不过，你以往的表现值得再给一次机会。别再让我们失望了。

column1: Well Herr General, Those Russians put up a stiff fight for Zhytomyr, but they were no match for your PanzerKorps.
column2: 将军阁下，那些俄国人为日托米尔(Zhytomyr)打得顽强，但他们不是你装甲军的对手。
我们下一个目标就是向基辅(Kyiv)推进！

column1: Kyiv has been captured, and your SS PanzerKorps has earned a well-deserved rest.  Take some leave, Herr General Berlin is wonderful this time of year!
column2: 基辅已被攻占，你的党卫军装甲军赢得了一次当之无愧的休整。去休个假吧，将军阁下，这个时节的柏林美极了！

column1: This is a bitter defeat. Heavy snows are now falling.  We are forced to fight a winter war in the depths of Russia!
column2: 这是一场痛苦的失败。如今大雪纷飞。我们被迫在俄罗斯腹地打一场冬季战争！

column1: You are requested in Berlin at once!
Perhaps you will be better at politics than at generalship and be able to save your miserable life.
column2: 也许你搞政治会比带兵强，还能保住你那条可怜的命。

column1: Herr General, with your failure at Kursk, we are forced to remain on the defensive.
column2: 将军阁下，由于你在库尔斯克(Kursk)的失败，我们被迫转入防御。

column1: Your PanzerKorps has been ordered to the rear to refit and prepare for future action.
column2: 你的装甲军已奉命撤往后方整补，为日后的行动做准备。

column1: Thanks to you they will be needed!
column2: 多亏了你，他们才会派上用场！

column1: Now you must go with your 1st SS PanzerKorps, via train, to Normandy and stop the Allies.
column2: 现在你必须率你的党卫军第1装甲军乘火车开赴诺曼底(Normandy)，挡住盟军。

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain.  The Allies are advancing on all fronts.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你那些优秀部队的牺牲都白费了。盟军正在所有战线上推进。

column1: Herr General, the Allies are in disarray!  Seize Antwerpen and end this war!
column2: 将军阁下，盟军一片混乱！夺取安特卫普(Antwerpen)，结束这场战争！

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a complete victory !!! The Western Allies are in disarray !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了彻底的胜利！！！西方盟军一片混乱！！！
摩泽尔-莱茵运河（不可通行）

column1: It looks as if your Division won't be needed in the Pacific theatre after all so let your men relax and enjoy their time in Austria.
column2: 看来你的师终究不会派往太平洋战区了，那就让你的部下放松一下，好好享受在奥地利的时光吧。

column1: I'm impressed. Boy, you really earned your pay. The Krauts never knew what hit them. Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you!
column2: 我刮目相看了。小子，你这薪水挣得真不亏。那些德国佬到死都不知道是什么打中了他们。是啊，多亏了你，我们的处境真不错！

column1: The End Of The Afrika Korps

column2: 哈士奇行动 - 第1部分

column1: Great! Once again you howed that our faith in you was justified. Headquarters is overjoyed by your success.
column2: 太好了！你再一次证明我们对你的信任没有错。司令部为你的成功欣喜若狂。

column1: A Kamfgruppe of your division will stay on the Eastern front until June 1st, but you are ordered to move to France to prepare the reorganization of Das Reich into a Panzer-Grenadier division.
column2: 你师的一个战斗群将留在东线直到6月1日，但你奉命调往法国，为「帝国」师改编为装甲掷弹兵师做准备。

column1: The German "trade space for time" strategy seems quite successful. They are exploiting very well the terrain conditions to delay our advance while putting up the Gustav Line. Commander, if you are able to wipe out soon enough the enemy positions before the Garigliano and Rapido rivers we may have a chance to break the Gustav Line by the end of the year. Let's see if you can do it.
column2: 德军的「以空间换时间」策略看来相当成功。他们很善于利用地形迟滞我军推进，同时构筑古斯塔夫防线。指挥官，如果你能及时肃清加里利亚诺河(Garigliano)与拉皮多河(Rapido)一线的敌军阵地，我们或许有机会在年底前突破古斯塔夫防线。就看你的了。

column1: Commander, to have come so far at such cost, and then to have failed is utterly galling. I have no doubt that you tried your best, but sadly, a try is not good enough.
column2: 指挥官，付出如此代价走到这一步，却功败垂成，实在令人恼恨。我不怀疑你已经尽了全力，但遗憾的是，尽力还不够。

column1: Your Division will now be returned to England for some much needed R&R and refitting. Enjoy your break Bob because we will be calling on your veterans again soon I'm sure.
column2: 你的师现在将调回英格兰，进行急需的休整与整补。好好享受假期吧，鲍勃，因为我敢肯定，很快我们又会请你的老兵出马。

column1: For now rest up and await further orders.
column2: 现在先休整，等候进一步的命令。

column1: Your men shall be withdrawn to France for a deserved rest.
column2: 你的部下将撤往法国，获得他们应得的休整。

column1: Good work in getting to Bastogne and digging-in.
column2: 干得好，你们到达了巴斯托涅(Bastogne)并构筑了工事。

column1: For now rest and await further orders.
column2: 现在休整，等候进一步的命令。

column1: Now its time to look to the East.
column2: 现在该把目光转向东方了。

column1: When Guderian's and Hoth's troops closed the encirclement around Smolensk, the fate of 100,000 Russians was sealed. The Bolsheviks also lost 2000 tanks and 2000 guns in the Smolensk encirclement.
column2: 当古德里安和霍特的部队合拢对斯摩棱斯克的包围时，10万俄国人的命运已成定局。布尔什维克还在斯摩棱斯克包围圈中损失了2000辆坦克和2000门火炮。

column1: You have successfully beaten off the Russian relieve attempt. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the rasputitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
column2: 你成功击退了俄国人的解围企图。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道「泥泞季」——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

column1: Prepare your forces for a move to the Eastern front. The Bolsheviks have started a winter offensive that must be stopped by the complete SS Panzer Corps.
column2: 让你的部队做好调往东线的准备。布尔什维克发动了冬季攻势，必须由整个党卫军装甲军将其遏止。

column1: - The French scuttled most (73 ships) of their fleet. Only few would be salvaged and used by the Axis.
column2: - 法国人凿沉了他们舰队的大部分（73艘）。只有少数被打捞起来供轴心国使用。

column1: - SS Panzer-Grenadier Divisions LSSAH, Das Reich and Totenkopf - forming the SS Panzer Corps - were sent to the Eastern front to stop the Russians advancing after their victory at Stalingrad.
column2: - 党卫军装甲掷弹兵师（警卫旗队、「帝国」和「骷髅」）组成党卫军装甲军，被派往东线，以阻止俄国人在斯大林格勒胜利后的推进。

column1: Resistance activity stopped for weeks after June 11th as a response to very hard German reprisals at Tulle (triggered by the murder and mutilation of garrison members by the Resistance) and Oradour (inexplicable killing of villagers after a German officer got abducted).
column2: 6月11日之后，抵抗活动停歇了数周，这是对德军在图勒（起因是抵抗组织杀害并肢解了守军成员）和奥拉杜尔（一名德军军官遭绑架后村民被莫名杀害）实施极严厉报复的回应。

column1: The complete division reached Normandy about 20th June and was kept in reserve for more than a week.
column2: 全师于 6 月 20 日前后抵达诺曼底(Normandy)，并作为预备队保留了一周多。

column1: The misery around us screams to high heaven. Refugees and soldiers from the broken German armies look helplessly at the bombers flying continuously overhead. It is useless to take cover from the bursting shells and bombs. Kurt Meyer
column2: 「我们周围的惨状直冲云霄。溃败德军中的难民和士兵无助地望着头顶不停飞过的轰炸机。在爆炸的炮弹和炸弹面前躲藏毫无用处。」库尔特·迈尔

column1: Prepare your forces for another attack.
column2: 让你的部队准备好再次进攻。

column1: The Axis never found themselves in a position to assault Malta.
column2: 轴心国从未具备进攻马耳他的条件。

column1: This is completely unacceptable. The Germans have backed down, and even Britain will soon fall without the spy's information.... dismissed.
column2: 这完全不能接受。德国人已经退让，而没有那名间谍的情报，就连英国也很快会陷落……解散。

column1: Assuming the German forces could get across the English Channel, the Germans would have to isolate London from the British interior by taking control of the territory near Windsor.  The British could be expected to pour every possible reinforcement into the battle for London.
column2: 假设德军能够渡过英吉利海峡(English Channel)，他们就得控制温莎(Windsor)附近的地区，把伦敦与英国内陆隔离开来。可以预料，英国人会把一切可能的增援都投入伦敦之战。

column1: You decide the outcome of the Winter War.
column2: 冬季战争的结局由你决定。

column1: Excellent Comrade, Chicago City is ours, and our advance inside America is unstopable.
column2: 好极了，同志，芝加哥市已归我们所有，我们在美国境内的推进不可阻挡。

column1: Exit deployment screen and select the Allied naval transport boat, it must be adjacent to a land hex in order to deploy ground units. The entire core units can be deployed from 1 naval transport ship by deploying one or more units ("deploy forces" button), exiting the deployment screen, moving these units, and repeating as necessary. Of course the path must be cleared of any enemy Navy. You don't have to deploy all your units at the very 1st turn, you can wait.
column2: 退出部署界面并选中盟军的海上运输船，它必须与陆地格相邻才能部署地面部队。整个核心部队可以只靠 1 艘海上运输船部署——部署一个或多个单位（「部署部队」按钮），退出部署界面，移动这些单位，然后按需重复。当然，航路必须先清除敌方海军。你不必在第 1 回合就把所有单位都部署出来，可以等。
欢迎来到巴塞罗那(Barcelona)，将军。

column1: All of Europe is watching you, Herr General.
column2: 全欧洲都在注视着你，将军阁下。
欢迎来到塞维利亚(Sevilla)，将军。

column1: Your task is to lead your SS Panzer Divisions through these mountains and capture the airbase and town of Sevilla.
column2: 你的任务是率你的党卫军装甲师穿过这些山地，夺取塞维利亚(Sevilla)的机场与城镇。

column1: This is an extremely important transportation and communication center, if you can capture it and destroy the army defending it, you will have achieved a great victory.
column2: 这是一个极其重要的交通与通信中心；你若能夺取它并消灭守军，便是取得了一场重大胜利。

column1: Herr General, your narrow victory has shown that already you have gained some experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new pro-German government in Spain may prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
column2: 将军阁下，你的险胜表明，你已在这种新型战争中积累了一些经验。此外，西班牙新成立的亲德政府或许会在未来岁月中成为有用的盟友。

column1: Well done, Herr General.  You will be recommended for the Knight's Cross after your outstanding performance!
column2: 干得好，将军阁下。凭你这次出色的表现，你将获荐骑士铁十字勋章！

column1: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations.
column2: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望。

column1: The Poles are in utter confusion and have already sued for terms.
column2: 波兰人已陷入极度混乱，并已求和。

column1: This part of the war is over!
column2: 这场战争的这个阶段结束了！

column1: The General Staff is very impressed!
column2: 总参谋部印象极为深刻！

column1: General, you have captured the Polish capital and their forces are in disarray.  We expect surrender at any moment.  Well done.
column2: 将军，你已夺取波兰首都，其部队一片混乱。我们预计他们随时会投降。干得好。

column1: Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have escaped encirclement and already have begun to counterattack.
column2: 你的失败令人无法理解。敌军各集团军已逃出合围，并且已经开始反击。

column1: If the situation were not so desperate, I would shoot you myself!
column2: 要不是局势如此绝望，我会亲手枪毙你！

column1: Superb work, Herr General!  Thanks to your rapid advance across the Meuse, the Allies are in complete disarray.  You have demonstrated the superiority of our tactics over what was once called the world's best army.  We must now push rapidly to the shores of the English Channel and complete the defeat of our enemies.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军阁下！多亏你迅速渡过默兹河，盟军已彻底陷入混乱。你证明了我们的战术优于那支曾号称世界最强的军队。我们现在必须迅速推进到英吉利海峡岸边，完成对敌人的击败。

column1: Herr General, Ternopil' is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
column2: 将军阁下，捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。我相信你会干得非常出色。

column1: Herr General, Kyiv is an extremely important tactical objective.  We are placing its capture in your hands; we have the greatest confidence in you.
column2: 将军阁下，基辅(Kyiv)是一个极其重要的战术目标。我们把它交到你手上；我们对你抱有最大的信心。

column1: Herr General, Well done!  You handled that counterattack splendidly.
column2: 将军阁下，干得好！你那次反击处理得极为出色。

column1: Brilliant, Herr General.  Your PanzerKorps is invincible.  Resupply and attack towards Kursk before the Soviets can recover!
column2: 精彩，将军阁下。你的装甲军所向无敌。补充给养，趁苏军还没缓过劲来就向库尔斯克(Kursk)进攻！

column1: Incredible, Herr General, simply incredible.  The Allies are falling back.  However, we have another task for you...
column2: 难以置信，将军阁下，简直难以置信。盟军正在后退。不过，我们还有另一项任务交给你……

column1: Herr General, you have allowed enemy troops to remain on the sacred soil of the Fatherland.
column2: 将军阁下，你竟让敌军留在了祖国神圣的土地上。

column1: Your failure will have implications for our winter counterattack.
column2: 你的失败将影响我们的冬季反击。

column1: The Americans and British have pushed us back across the Rhine. We no longer have the strength to halt them. All that is left for the fatherland is defeat and disgrace. But you have already experienced that. Haven't you, Herr General?
column2: 美军和英军已把我们赶回莱茵河对岸。我们再也没有力量阻止他们。留给祖国的只剩失败与耻辱。可你早已体会过这一切了，不是吗，将军阁下？

column1: Herr General, your capture of Liege has changed the course of the war in the west. Take advantage of this at once and procced with your next objective.
column2: 将军阁下，你夺取列日(Liege)已经改变了西线战争的进程。立刻利用这一形势，继续执行你的下一个目标。

column1: Strock: Herr General or better ex-Herr General war it is a tough business.You should try another occupation.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下——或者该说，前将军阁下——战争可是门苦差事。你该换个行当试试。

column1: All right, commander, a job well done! Now prepare to take hold of what remains of Morocco!
column2: 好，指挥官，干得漂亮！现在准备好拿下摩洛哥(Morocco)剩下的地方！
恭喜夺取贝希特斯加登(Berchtesgaden)！！！

column1: Commander, it seems that the Krauts really do not like to be cornered in Tunisia. Both Von Arnim and Rommel armies have just started an offensive aimed at our positions in south-west Tunisia. It will be tough for our boys who still lack a decent battle experience. Try your best to stop the Rommel forces that are to attack El Guettar and then Gafsa, my young leader, but pay attention for the powerful armoured units on the way.
column2: 指挥官，看来那些德国佬真的不喜欢在突尼斯(Tunisia)被逼到墙角。冯·阿尼姆(von Arnim)与隆美尔两支部队刚刚发起攻势，目标是我们位于突尼斯西南的阵地。我们的小伙子们还缺乏像样的战斗经验，这会很艰难。我的年轻指挥官，尽力挡住将要进攻盖塔尔(El Guettar)、随后进攻加夫萨(Gafsa)的隆美尔部队，但要留意沿途那些强大的装甲单位。
努瓦尔盐沼(Sebkret en Noual)：盐湖
盖塔尔盐沼(Chott el Guettar)：盐湖

column1: You did it commander! Even if with a lot of casualties, we got what we came for, and you've done a fine job for us.
column2: 你做到了，指挥官！尽管伤亡很大，我们拿到了想要的东西，你为我们干得很出色。
塞拉特角 : 崎岖地形
加尔梅拉赫湖 : 海洋

column1: General, western and southern Sicily are totally under our control, but the Krauts have put up a stubborn defence trying to avoid us to reach the Messina Strait. While the British are fighting to seize Catania, on the eastern side of the front, our task is to break the enemy positions along the western path of the island, forcing the Axis to evacuate Sicily. Expect a very well entrenched enemy and heavy air defence resistance. Let's jump to the Strait!
column2: 将军，西西里(Sicily)西部与南部已完全在我们控制之下，但那些德国佬顽抗不退，力图阻止我们抵达墨西拿海峡(Messina Strait)。英军正在战线东侧争夺卡塔尼亚(Catania)，而我们的任务是突破该岛西路的敌军阵地，迫使轴心国撤出西西里。要有准备：敌人构筑了坚固工事，防空抵抗也很强。让我们直扑海峡！

column1: The fighting on the beaches of Salerno was tough, but your boys really showed their stuff. Good, very good, commander.
column2: 萨莱诺(Salerno)海滩上的战斗很艰苦，但你那些小伙子真露了一手。好，很好，指挥官。

column1: This operation was a snafu from the start, commander. The United States Army doesn't have the time or the patience to put up with such ineptitude. Do me a personal favor and get outta here!
column2: 这次行动从一开始就一团糟，指挥官。美国陆军没有时间、也没有耐心容忍这样的无能。帮我个私人忙：滚出去吧！
学生行动 1940年5月 胜利

column1: The Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina managed to escape to England, but the Dutch capitulated after a few days of fighting. Congratulations.
column2: 荷兰政府和威廉明娜女王成功逃往英格兰，但荷兰人在几天战斗后即告投降。恭喜。
皮耶迪蒙特圣杰尔马诺

column1: Now it's time for Phase II.  We must finish up this assault before the British can rest their beaten army.  One final push south to Medinine and Tunisia will be ours.
column2: 现在该进入第二阶段了。我们必须在英国人让那支败军休整之前结束这次进攻。最后向南推一把，打到梅德宁(Medinine)，突尼斯(Tunisia)就归我们了。

column1: The Germans attack the flank of the Russians spearheads heading West.
column2: 德军向正在西进的俄军先头部队侧翼发起攻击。

column1: Herr General, we have the opportunity of hitting the Russians as they move imprudently towards the west.  Do not fail us here Herr General !!!
column2: 将军阁下，我们有机会趁俄国人轻率西进之机打击他们。在这里可别让我们失望，将军阁下！！！

column1: Note: You have to take your victory hexes plus any victory hex that you lose.
column2: 注意：你必须夺取你的胜利格，再加上你丢失的任何胜利格。

column1: The Western Allies touch European soil at Salerno. The Axis powers try to throw them into the sea.
column2: 西方盟军在萨莱诺(Salerno)踏上欧洲土地。轴心国力图把他们赶下海。

column1: Herr General the Western Allies have landed on Salerno. You have to throw them into the sea before our Italian Allies will capitulate!!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军已在萨莱诺(Salerno)登陆。你必须在我们的意大利盟友投降之前把他们赶下海！！！

column1: Marshall Zhukov Belorussian fronts have broken the German defenses at Seelow and are about to take Berlin. The Germans counterattack to hold the Russians off.
column2: 朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的白俄罗斯方面军已突破塞洛(Seelow)的德军防线，即将攻取柏林。德军发起反击，以挡住俄军。

column1: Herr General : Marshall Zhukov Belorussian Fronts have broken our defenses in Seelow Heights.  The Russians are about to take Berlin. You are the only one who can stop them !!!  Good luck !!!
column2: 将军阁下：朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的白俄罗斯方面军已突破我们在塞洛高地(Seelow Heights)的防线。俄国人即将攻取柏林。只有你能挡住他们！！！祝好运！！！

column1: Great work to you and your regiment Bob!!! Under the most difficult of conditions we have gained a toehold on the continent.
column2: 你和你的团干得漂亮，鲍勃！！！在最艰难的条件下，我们在欧洲大陆上站住了脚。

column1: Great stuff Bob!! Congratulations to you and your Regiment. The 101st Division has captured the strategically important town of Carentan and now we can link with the assault force coming inland from Omaha Beach.
column2: 干得好，鲍勃！！祝贺你和你的团。第101师已夺取战略要地卡朗唐(Carentan)，现在我们可以与从奥马哈海滩(Omaha Beach)向内陆推进的登陆部队会合了。
泰格尔-滕珀尔霍夫机场

column1: So far so good Bob!! Your division has taken it's objectives all except the canal bridge at Son which the enemy blew before we could take it. Hopefully the Engineers can get a makeshift bridge across to allow the advance of the 30th Corps to continue.
column2: 目前一切顺利，鲍勃！！你的师已夺取全部目标，只有松镇(Son)的运河桥除外——敌人在我们得手之前就把它炸了。但愿工兵能架起一座临时桥梁，好让第30军继续推进。

column1: The 82nd has 2 of their three bridges secure and will launch an attack on the northern Nijmegan bridge tomorrow.
column2: 第82师的三座桥已有两座确保无虞，明天将对奈梅亨(Nijmegan)北面的那座桥发起攻击。

column1: The British ran into heavy resistance north of Arnhem and haven't yet reached the city but will be bulstered by a second paradrop tomorrow.
column2: 英军在阿纳姆(Arnhem)以北遭遇顽强抵抗，尚未抵达该城，但明天将有第二次伞降增援他们。

column1: Your division has held it's objectives and fought off several counter-attacks, well done to you and your men.
column2: 你的师守住了目标，并击退了数次反击，你和你的部下干得好。

column1: The 82nd has taken the Nijmegan bridge and the way to Arnhem is clear.
column2: 第82师已夺取奈梅亨(Nijmegan)大桥，通往阿纳姆(Arnhem)的道路已经打开。

column1: The British are hanging on and will be saved by the 30th Corps when they arrive.
column2: 英军仍在苦撑，等第30军赶到就能得救。

column1: Although you held open the road, the British 1st Airborne Division was devastated at Arnhem. The battle has not been declared a total failure, but we doubt the Airborne Divisions will be used in this capacity again in this war.
column2: 尽管你保住了通道畅通，英国第1空降师还是在阿纳姆(Arnhem)遭到重创。此战尚未被宣布为彻底失败，但我们怀疑这场战争中空降师不会再被这样使用了。

column1: Congratulations to you and your men Bob!! The northern front line has been held and we are in a good position to strike a blow to the heart of the Third Reich.
column2: 祝贺你和你的部下，鲍勃！！北面战线已守住，我们处于有利态势，可以向第三帝国的心脏挥出一击。

column1: The Germans are on the run now!!

column1: The British offensive has been stopped fortunately. However, we must withdraw our units to safer positions.
column2: 幸好英军的攻势已被挡住。不过，我们必须把部队撤到更安全的位置。

column1: This is a disaster, now we must make a retreat to Tunis to avoid the complete destruction of the Deutsches Afrikakorps...
column2: 这是一场灾难，现在我们只能撤往突尼斯，以免德意志非洲军全军覆没……

column1: The Soviets have been driven onto the island of Crete.  Finish them off and make the Mediterranean ours!
column2: 苏军已被赶进克里特岛(Crete)。把他们彻底解决，让地中海归我们所有！

column1: A costly victory Herr General. Continue your advance towards Moscow.

column1: General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you. And now the last Bolshevist reserves await your attack. Defeat them! And end this war!
column2: 将军，敌人英勇作战，但这并未挡住你。现在布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你进攻。击败他们！结束这场战争！

column1: The last Russian reserves have succeeded in recapturing Moscow. Gather your forces once more and throw them out again.
column2: 俄国人最后的预备队成功夺回了莫斯科。再次集结你的部队，把他们再赶出去。

column1: Capturing Moscow this Winter has now become impossible. Fortunately you were able to conduct an orderly retreat. Your request to relieve your forces is denied. SS Reich is needed to prevent a Russian breakthrough.
column2: 今冬拿下莫斯科已不可能。所幸你得以有序撤退。你请求让部队撤下来休整被驳回。「帝国」师需要留下来阻止俄国人突破。

column1: The threat of our armies in Southern Russia being encircled has been countered. We destroyed or severely damadged 4 Soviet Armies and regained most of the territory lost in January. Prepare your troops for a Summer offensive near Kursk.
column2: 我军在南俄被合围的威胁已被化解。我们歼灭或重创了4个苏军集团军，并夺回了1月丢失的大部分领土。让你的部队为库尔斯克附近的夏季攻势做好准备。

column1: Even with limited forces you achieved your objectives. The frontline opposite the American troops has been restored.
column2: 即便兵力有限，你仍达成了目标。面对美军的战线已经恢复。
巴拉顿湖攻势 1945年3月 辉煌胜利

column1: Your forces have repelled the attack on Vienna and have struck a severe blow to the enemy. The Russians - tired of the war and unable to cope with long supply lines - have gotten in comparable difficulties on other fronts. This situation is forcing Stalin to negotiate a peace settlement. This will allow us to direct forces to the west to fight the Western Allies.
column2: 你的部队击退了敌人对维也纳的进攻，并给了敌人沉重打击。俄国人——厌倦战争、又无法应付漫长的补给线——在其他战线也陷入了类似的困境。这一局面正迫使斯大林谈判和平解决。这将使我们能把兵力调往西线，与西方盟国作战。

column1: Your forces have repelled the attack on Vienna and have struck a severe blow to the enemy. The Russians - tired of the war and unable to cope with long supply lines - have gotten in comparable difficulties on other fronts. This situation is forcing Stalin to negotiate a peace settlement. This will bring peace to Europe and will save our country. You performed wonderfully General.
column2: 你的部队击退了敌人对维也纳的进攻，并给了敌人沉重打击。俄国人——厌倦战争、又无法应付漫长的补给线——在其他战线也陷入了类似的困境。这一局面正迫使斯大林谈判和平解决。这将为欧洲带来和平，也将拯救我们的国家。你干得非常出色，将军。

column1: Our division has now been fully redrawn from Russia to Montauban/Toulouse in France and is renamed to SS Panzer Division "Das Reich". Our main concern is the large number of fresh troops (9000) in Das Reich - we even had to accept conscripts to fill our ranks.
column2: 我们师现已全部从俄罗斯调往法国的蒙托邦(Montauban)/图卢兹(Toulouse)，并改称党卫军「帝国」(Das Reich)装甲师。我们最担心的是「帝国」师里大量新兵(9000)——我们甚至不得不接受征召兵来填补编制。

column1: The Allies landed in Normandy June 6 1944, 2 days ago. Yesterday preparations were made to come to march readiness. Today we are moving out. First stop is the Limoges-Tulle area. We will travel there in two columns. Be aware of partisan attacks. Resistance activity has increased considerably over the last few days throughout France.
column2: 两天前，也就是1944年6月6日，盟军在诺曼底登陆。昨天已做好行军准备。今天我们就要开拔。第一站是利摩日-图勒地区。我们将分两路纵队前往。提防游击队袭击。过去几天，全法国的抵抗活动已明显加剧。

column1: Unterfeldwebel Hardegen (Alpha Company Platoon Leader): Sir, these Bolsheviks are evil! I saw pregnant women hanging by their feet in the Soviet prison. Their noses, ears, arms - anything that stuck out - were slit. Some had their hearts cut out. Little boys and girls were nailed to the wall and butchered. For the love of God, Sir, we have to stop this. Quickly!
column2: 中士哈德根（A 连排长）：长官，这些布尔什维克是恶魔！我在苏联监狱里看到孕妇被倒吊着。她们的鼻子、耳朵、手臂——任何突出的部位——都被割开了。有些人的心脏被挖了出来。小男孩和小女孩被钉在墙上宰杀。看在上帝份上，阁下，我们必须制止这一切。快！

column1: The position of the Greek First Army, still fighting in Albania, was seriously jeopardized by the rapid advance of the XL Panzer Corps via Florina and by the British withdrawal to positions behind the Aliakmon. The Greek command therefore had to come to grips with the necessity of withdrawing southward from Albania. However, it was not until 13 April that the first Greek elements began to withdraw toward the Pindus Mountains. On the next day an advance detachment of the 73d Infantry Division encountered Greek troops withdrawing from Albania across the Pindus Mountains into the area west of Kastoria. Heavy fighting took place on that and the following day, especially at Kastoria Pass, where the Germans blocked the Greek withdrawal, which by then extended to the entire Albanian front, with the Italians in hesitant pursuit.
column2: 仍在阿尔巴尼亚(Albania)作战的希腊第1集团军，其处境因第40装甲军经弗洛里纳(Florina)的快速推进，以及英军撤往阿利亚克蒙(Aliakmon)河后方阵地而严重恶化。因此希腊统帅部不得不面对从阿尔巴尼亚向南撤退的必要性。然而，直到 4 月 13 日，首批希腊部队才开始向品都斯山脉(Pindus Mountains)撤退。次日，第73步兵师的一支先遣支队遇到了正从阿尔巴尼亚越过品都斯山脉、撤入卡斯托里亚(Kastoria)以西地区的希腊部队。当天及随后一天发生了激战，尤其是在卡斯托里亚山口，德军在那里阻断了希腊人的撤退——此时撤退已扩展到整个阿尔巴尼亚战线，而意大利人则迟疑地尾随追击。

column1: On 19 April the Leibstandarte which had meanwhile reached Grevena was ordered to advance southeastward in the direction of Yannina to cut off the Greeks' route of withdrawal to the south and complete their encirclement.
column2: 4 月 19 日，此时已抵达格雷韦纳(Grevena)的警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)奉命向东南方向的约阿尼纳(Yannina)推进，以切断希腊人向南的撤退路线，完成对他们的合围。

column1: The Soviets attempt to break the German siege of Leningrad.
column2: 苏军试图打破德军对列宁格勒(Leningrad)的围困。

column1: We have completed the Italian Campaign.  Italy is once again a part of the German empire.
column2: 我们已完成意大利战役。意大利再次成为德意志帝国的一部分。

column1: Although you have achieved a victory, the British have delayed you long enough to strengthen their defenses in Lebanon.  You can not waste any more time.  You must finish the British off.
column2: 尽管你取得了一场胜利，英国人却把你拖得够久，足以加强他们在黎巴嫩(Lebanon)的防御。你不能再浪费时间了。你必须把英国人彻底解决。

column1: I will give you one more chance to prove yourself. Do not dissapoint us again.
column2: 我再给你一次证明自己的机会。不要再让我们失望。

column1: Turkey is almost free again from the Soviets.  The enemy has retreated up the coast to Ari Burnu.
column2: 土耳其(Turkey)几乎再次摆脱了苏军。敌人已沿海岸退往阿里角(Ari Burnu)。

column1: Now that Libya is secured we can prepare for the Egyptian offensive.
column2: 利比亚(Libya)既已确保，我们就可以为埃及攻势做准备。

column1: With the British on the run there is no time to rest.  We must press the attack and drive the British out of Tunisia before they have time to entrench themselves in their poorly constructed defenses.
column2: 英军正在溃逃，没有时间休整。我们必须加紧进攻，在英军来得及在他们那些粗劣的防御工事里站稳脚跟前，把他们赶出突尼斯(Tunisia)。

column1: You succeeded in destroying the entrenched Soviet Bunker Artillery but allowed the remnants of the enemy army to escape to Tobruk which will contain the strongest defenses you have encountered yet.
column2: 你成功摧毁了据守工事的苏军碉堡炮兵，却让敌军残余逃往托布鲁克(Tobruk)——那里的防御将是你迄今遇到的最强的。

column1: The Americans have retreated up the coast; for now.  Prepare your defenses for an expected counterattack.
column2: 美军已沿海岸后撤；至少眼下如此。做好防御准备，迎接预料中的反击。

column1: No time to rest.  You need to finish the Egyptian offensive while the Americans continue to retreat.
column2: 没有时间休整。趁美军继续后撤，你必须打完这场埃及攻势。

column1: Hypothetical German-Italian invasion of the British controlled island of Malta.
column2: 德意对英属马耳他岛的假想入侵。

column1: Sitting astride the sea lanes between Italy and Libya, the British-held island of Malta proved a major nuisance to Italian efforts to push supply convoys across the Mediterranean Sea.  The German plan (Operation Hercules) put its faith in airborne landings.  German and Italian paratroopers would secure the most important points, and reinforcements would then come over the beaches to finish off the island's garrison.
column2: 英属马耳他岛横亘在意大利与利比亚之间的航路上，对意大利运送补给船队横渡地中海的努力构成重大麻烦。德方的计划（「海格力斯」行动）把希望寄托在空降登陆上。德国和意大利伞兵将夺取最重要的要点，随后增援将从海滩上陆，肃清该岛守军。

column2: 这是游戏中最小的一张地图，并把一场海上冲突作为战斗的一部分。

column1: have asked for you by name.

The Civil War in Spain provided a testing ground for the German Wehrmacht, as well as the Soviet and Italian armies. In the battle of Guadalajara, northwest of Madrid, both sides committed some of their best units as the Nationalists tried to cut off Madrid, still held by the Republic despite repeated attacks.
column2: 西班牙内战为德国国防军以及苏联和意大利军队提供了试验场。在马德里(Madrid)西北的瓜达拉哈拉(Guadalajara)之战中，双方都投入了一些最精锐的部队——国民军试图切断马德里，而共和国虽屡遭进攻，仍守住了这座城市。

column1: Ah, Commander! Welcome. Let us get down to the matter at hand. One of our spies was recently captured deep in Soviet territory. He has vital information which is crucial to the war effort. One of our commando teams was able to rescue him, but is now encircled by Soviet troops. Lead your men in and rescue them before the Soviets can recapture them. On a more pleasant note, the Germans have joined us in the fight against communism after the success of the Polish operation.
column2: 啊，指挥官！欢迎。我们谈正事吧。我们的一名间谍最近在苏联腹地被捕。他掌握着对战事至关重要的情报。我们的一支突击队成功把他救了出来，但现在被苏军包围了。率你的人进去，在苏军重新抓住他们之前把他们救出来。说件更令人愉快的事：波兰行动成功之后，德国人也加入了我们对抗共产主义的战斗。

column1: Good morning, general, You've made quite wise decision turning to our side. The Reich appreciates your courage. You and your soldiers can now fight alongside us against communism.
column2: 早上好，将军。你倒向我们这一边，是相当明智的决定。帝国赞赏你的勇气。你和你的士兵现在可以与我们并肩对抗共产主义。

column1: Now we get to go on to the offensive!
column2: 现在该轮到我们进攻了！

column1: The terrain up there suits his tanks just fine.

column1: Exit deployment screen and select the German "minensuchboot", they must be adjacent to a land hex in order to deploy ground units. The entire core units can be deployed from 1 naval transport ship by deploying one or more units ("deploy forces" button), exiting the deployment screen, moving these units, and repeating as necessary. Of course the path must be cleared of any enemy Navy. You don't have to deploy all your units at the very 1st turn, you can wait.
column2: 退出部署界面并选中德军的「扫雷艇」，它们必须与陆地格相邻才能部署地面部队。整个核心部队可以只靠 1 艘海上运输船部署——部署一个或多个单位（「部署部队」按钮），退出部署界面，移动这些单位，然后按需重复。当然，航路必须先清除敌方海军。你不必在第 1 回合就把所有单位都部署出来，可以等。

column1: You have to move your air transport units where you want (and hope that AI has no AD units close), then where and when you want (you don't have to use your paratroops at the very 1st turn, you can wait) you deploy the paratroops (play by the rule, don't deploy other unit types).
column2: 你得把空中运输单位移动到你想去的地方（并指望 AI 附近没有防空单位），然后在你想去的地方、你想的时机——你不必在第 1 回合就使用伞兵，可以等——投放伞兵（按规则游玩，不要投放其他类型的单位）。

column1: In the winter of 1939, Finland was invaded by the Soviet Union.  The Finns, although vastly outnumbered, were determined to defend their country.  The Soviet High Command hoped to "cut Finland in two" by driving past the key road junction of Suomussalmi and continuing to the Baltic Sea.  The Finnish commander, von Mannerheim, believed the Soviet attack had to be stopped at Suomussalmi, or his nation was doomed.
column2: 1939 年冬，芬兰(Finland)遭到苏联入侵。芬兰人虽然兵力远远不及，却决心保卫自己的国家。苏军最高统帅部希望通过越过苏奥穆萨尔米(Suomussalmi)这一关键道路交叉点、继续向波罗的海(Baltic Sea)推进，把「芬兰一分为二」。芬兰军队指挥官冯·曼纳海姆(von Mannerheim)认为，必须在苏奥穆萨尔米挡住苏军进攻，否则他的国家就完了。

column1: The Finnish forces have trapped one Soviet division in and around Suomussalmi, but an even more powerful Soviet relief force is moving to their aid.
column2: 芬兰军队已在苏奥穆萨尔米及周边困住苏军一个师，但一支更为强大的苏军解围部队正向他们开进。

column1: The Axis fascists are at Stalingrad.  It is time to show the Party that you are the one to lead Soviet troops to the final victory in Berlin.
column2: 轴心国法西斯分子已打到斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)。现在该向党证明，你才是能率领苏军走向柏林最终胜利的人。

column1: Exit deployment screen and select the British "amphibious ships", they must be adjacent to a land hex in order to deploy ground units. The entire core units can be deployed from 1 naval transport ship by deploying one or more units ("deploy forces" button), exiting the deployment screen, moving these units, and repeating as necessary. Of course the path must be cleared of any enemy Navy. You don't have to deploy all your units at the very 1st turn, you can wait.
column2: 退出部署界面并选中英军的「两栖舰船」，它们必须与陆地格相邻才能部署地面部队。整个核心部队可以只靠 1 艘海上运输船部署——部署一个或多个单位（「部署部队」按钮），退出部署界面，移动这些单位，然后按需重复。当然，航路必须先清除敌方海军。你不必在第 1 回合就把所有单位都部署出来，可以等。

column1: The salient around Kursk, created by the Soviet advances after the German loss at Stalingrad, drew the Germans' attention.  The German plans, code named "Zitadelle", were to cut the bulge by capturing Prokhorovka.  While the Germans waited to receive their new Tiger and Panther tanks before attacking, the Soviets, knowing of the German plan, took this time to deploy their forces in depth.
column2: 德军在斯大林格勒失利后，苏军推进形成的库尔斯克周边突出部吸引了德军的注意。德军的计划代号「堡垒」，意图通过夺取普罗霍罗夫卡来切掉这个突出部。当德军等待接收新的「虎」式和「豹」式坦克再发动进攻时，已得知德军计划的苏军利用这段时间把部队作了纵深配置。

column1: Finally, we've accomplished our objectives. The enemies fought very well, but they couldn't stop us.
column2: 我们终于达成了目标。敌人打得很出色，但他们没能挡住我们。

column1: The naval aircrafts can be repaired and resupplied on the carrier and on any Allied airfield.
column2: 海军飞机可以在航母上以及任何盟军机场进行修理与补给。

column1: You fascist nit!!! You'll die in Gulag together with your buddy Paulus!
column2: 你这个法西斯蠢货！！！你会和你的哥们儿保卢斯(Paulus)一起死在古拉格(Gulag)！

column1: Your task is to lead your "all volunteer" SS Panzer Divisions south and capture the approaches to Barcelona.  The Republicans have an enormous force in place to prevent this, destroy them and any others that get in your way.
column2: 你的任务是率「全志愿兵」党卫军装甲师南下，夺取巴塞罗那(Barcelona)的接近地。共和军已在此部署庞大兵力阻你，消灭他们，以及任何挡路之敌。

column1: Well Herr General, despite harsh conditions, you have done quite well!  Your victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new pro-German government in Spain may prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
column2: 好，将军阁下，尽管条件艰苦，你表现得相当不错！你的胜利表明，你已在这种新型战争中积累了宝贵经验。此外，西班牙新成立的亲德政府或许会在未来岁月中成为有用的盟友。

column1: Humph....  Herr General, you did manage to defeat the Poles, but you are behind schedule.  Your forces are no longer in the vanguard of our assault.  This will not do.
column2: 哼……将军阁下，你确实击败了波兰人，但进度落后了。你的部队已不再是我们进攻的先锋。这可不行。

column1: You will be given another opportunity at Warszawa.  Make the most of it!
column2: 在华沙(Warszawa)你会得到另一次机会。好好把握！

column1: Who would have expected such resistance in a futile effort?
column2: 谁会想到，一场徒劳的抵抗竟如此顽强？

column1: Well you have taken their capital; they won't be capable of continuing the fight much longer.
column2: 不管怎么说，你已夺取了他们的首都；他们撑不了多久了。

column1: General, this situation right now is desperate.  The Finnish Army requires you to defeat this enemy horde and turn the tide against the Soviets.  Remember to wear only your Finnish uniforms!
column2: 将军，眼下的局势十分危急。芬兰军队需要你击败这股敌军，扭转对抗苏军的局势。记住，只穿你的芬兰军服！

column1: Take back the city of Raate and while you are there, teach the Soviets a little Blitzkrieg!
column2: 夺回拉泰(Raate)城，顺便在那里给苏军上一小课闪电战！

column1: Herr General, your bold and energetic tactics have allowed us a complete victory.  Finland is still a nation and now a valuable ally.  Good work, Herr General!
column2: 将军阁下，你果敢而充满活力的战术为我们赢得了完胜。芬兰仍是一个国家，如今更是一位宝贵的盟友。干得好，将军阁下！

column1: General, in these frigid conditions, you must capture Gjovik.  Finish this battle so we may go south where it is warm!
column2: 将军，在这种严寒条件下，你必须夺取约维克(Gjovik)。打完这一仗，我们就能南下到暖和的地方去！

column1: Intelligence thinks there may already be British forces in Norway, be careful!
column2: 情报部门认为挪威(Norway)可能已有英军，小心！

column1: You have failed miserably.  With the loss of our surface fleet, England remains dominant on the high seas.
column2: 你败得很惨。随着我们水面舰队的损失，英格兰在公海上仍占优势。

column1: Do not fail us again Herr General.
column2: 不要再让我们失望，将军阁下。

column1: Good work. You have fulfilled the General Staff's hopes!  Your attack has weakened enemy resistance.  And now, the war with Norway will soon be over.
column2: 干得好。你实现了总参谋部的期望！你的进攻削弱了敌军抵抗。如今，对挪威的战争很快就要结束了。

column1: You have accomplished your mission, but your lack of speed has allowed the enemy armies to escape.  It is possible that the campaign against the British and French could go on as long as the last war.  Herr General, we will, no doubt, call on you again for your services.
column2: 你完成了任务，但你的行动迟缓让敌军得以逃脱。对英法的战事有可能像上次大战那样长期拖延下去。将军阁下，毫无疑问，我们还会再次请你效力。

column1: Herr General, you must proceed west towards the coast as quickly as possible.  If you can reach it before June, you will cut the British and French forces in two.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须尽快向西朝海岸推进。如果你能在 6 月前抵达那里，就能把英法军队一分为二。

column1: Intelligence reports that both the French and the British are moving armored divisions to stop you.
column2: 情报报告说，法国人和英国人都正在调集装甲师来阻止你。

column1: Make haste to the coast, Herr General!
column2: 赶快向海岸前进，将军阁下！

column1: Well Herr General, some in the General Staff thought we were taking a risk extending our Panzer forces so far forward, perhaps they were right.
column2: 将军阁下，总参谋部有些人认为我们把装甲部队前伸得这么远是在冒险，也许他们是对的。

column1: How quickly will you be able to attack again?
column2: 你要多久才能再次发起进攻？

column1: We must seize Dunkirk as soon as possible.
column2: 我们必须尽快夺取敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)。

column1: The British Expeditionary Force is making a last stand at Dunkirk.  They are starting to evacuate much of their army back to England.
column2: 英国远征军(British Expeditionary Force)正在敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)做最后的抵抗。他们已开始把大部分军队撤回英格兰。

column1: Intelligence reports they have assembled a powerful army to delay you.
column2: 情报报告说，他们已集结起一支强大的军队来迟滞你。

column1: Destroy them now before they get away!
column2: 趁他们还没逃掉，现在就消灭他们！

column1: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your PanzerKorps is the pride of Germany!  Rather than waste your forces further, we are moving your army to the east for rest and refitting.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。你的装甲军是德国的骄傲！与其继续消耗你的部队，我们不如把你的集团军调往东线休整与整补。

column1: You have won, Herr General. You have crippled the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered. Unfortunately, the English continue to resist us even after the loss of their contemptible, little army. Good work.
column2: 你赢了，将军阁下。你重创了英国远征军，法国也已投降。遗憾的是，即便失去了那支可怜的小军队，英国人仍继续抵抗。干得好。
将军阁下，巴巴罗萨行动(Barbarossa)已经开始！

column1: The German army has made significant progress.  Your PanzerKorps must complete an encirclement by capturing Ternopil' from the east.  Of course, in the process, destroy the Soviet forces defending it.
column2: 德军已取得重大进展。你的装甲军必须从东面夺取捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')，以完成合围。当然，在此过程中还要消灭守御该地的苏军。

column1: I'm sure your pitiful excuse for failing to take Zhytomyr will prove quite amusing.
column2: 我敢肯定，你为没能夺取日托米尔(Zhytomyr)找的那套可怜借口会相当有趣。

column1: I suggest you do not fail me again.
column2: 我建议你不要再让我失望。

column1: Get out of my sight until I can find something you're good for!
column2: 滚出我的视线，等我想出你还能干点什么！

column1: Herr General, you succeeded.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective, Moskva.
column2: 将军阁下，你成功了。占领维亚济马(V'Az'ma)对你下一个目标莫斯科(Moskva)至关重要。

column1: Fine performance, Herr General.  With Khar'kov in our hands we can hold the front.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)既已在我们手中，我们就能守住战线。

column1: Herr General, welcome to Normandy. The British and Americans have assembled a huge force, and they will try to break out.  You must stop them.  Defend the Fatherland at all costs!
column2: 将军阁下，欢迎来到诺曼底(Normandy)。英军与美军已集结起庞大的兵力，他们会试图突围。你必须挡住他们。不惜一切代价保卫本土！

column1: Impressive. Despite the fact the enemy has managed to force their way inland at all other points, you have stopped them here. You have done very well, Herr General.
column2: 令人印象深刻。尽管敌人在其他各处都强行突入了内陆，你却在在这里挡住了他们。你干得非常好，将军阁下。

column1: Herr General, your thrust to Liege will be used as a textbook example of offensive maneuver. This lightning blow, you have changed the course of the war in the west. Outstanding.
column2: 将军阁下，你向列日(Liege)的突击将被当作进攻机动的教科书范例。这一记闪电打击，你改变了西线战争的进程。出色。

column1: Herr General, your progress is impressive.  You must now capture your second objective: Bruxelles.  Make haste, there are impressive forces arrayed against you and the Allies will not be defeated easily!
column2: 将军阁下，你的进展令人印象深刻。你现在必须夺取第二个目标：布鲁塞尔(Bruxelles)。赶快行动，与你对阵的兵力相当可观，盟军不会轻易被击败！

column1: Herr General, your forces have moved within striking distance of Antwerpen, your final objective.  Take this city and defeat the Allies now!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你的部队已进入安特卫普(Antwerpen)的攻击距离，那是你的最终目标。现在就拿这座城，击败盟军！！！

column1: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河，彻底包围了第6集团军。你必须向克列茨卡亚和谢拉菲莫维奇推进，以恢复联系。我们绝不会，绝不会向红军投降，但为了守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝好运。

column1: Herr General, as you know the Kursk Salient poses a serious threat to us. To reduce this salient and restore the integrity of our line, we will attack from the north and south, pocket, and then crush the enemy trapped inside. You and your command will lead the northern thrust of our offensive. You must penetrate as far as the town of Prokhorovka. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，如你所知，库尔斯克突出部对我们构成严重威胁。为削平这个突出部、恢复我军战线的完整，我们将从南北两翼进攻，合围，然后歼灭被困之敌。你和你的指挥部将领导我军攻势的北翼。你必须推进到普罗霍罗夫卡镇。祝你好运。

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General. Despite the overwhelming number of American troops, you managed to pull through very well. I'm afraid that those are the kinds of numbers you will see in the future when you confront the Americans, so hang in there.
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下。尽管美军兵力占压倒优势，你还是应付得非常好。恐怕今后你面对美军时，见到的就是这种数量的敌人，所以要挺住。

column1: Strock: At this crucial point in the war, we cannot allow any incompetent leaders to waste the lives of our men and equipment. Your XO will take over command and you will report immediately to the Chief of Staff in Berlin. Dismissed!
column2: 施特罗克：在战争的这一关键时刻，我们不能容许无能的指挥官白白浪费我们士兵的生命和装备。你的副指挥官(XO)将接掌指挥，你立即前往柏林向总参谋长报到。解散！
北孚日公园(Parc des Vosges du Nord)
斯特拉斯堡克勒贝尔广场

column1: Strock: Herr General or better ex-Herr General war it is a tough business.You should try another occupation. Telegramme incoming... Der Führer in his mercifulness recognizes that you had to fight against overwhelming forces, your knowledge of the French theatre and your excellent past records have given you a very last chance to keep an army leadership in the Wehrmacht. Make a good use of it!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下——或者该说，前将军阁下——战争可是门苦差事。你该换个行当试试。电报来了……元首(Der Führer)出于仁慈，承认你不得不对抗压倒优势的兵力；你对法国战场的了解与过去的优异履历，给了你最后一次在国防军中保留集团军指挥权的机会。好好利用它！
第7装甲集团军保卫帝国

column1: This campaign traces the defensive battles fought by an undocumented group called 7.Panzerarmee. You determine the fate of Germany and the mental health of its leader.
column2: 本战役记述了一支名为第7装甲集团军(7.Panzerarmee)的无正式记录部队所进行的防御战。德国的命运，以及其指挥官的精神状态，都由你决定。

column1: Excellent! Despite the fact the enemy have managed to force their way inland at other points, you have swept all before you. And because of this blow you have dealt them, the Allies will not be able to take advantage of their successes elsewhere. It is unfortunate that we do not have more like you, Herr General.
column2: 干得漂亮！尽管敌军在别处设法突入内陆，你却一路扫荡了面前的一切。正由于你给予他们的这一记重击，盟军将无法利用他们在其他地段取得的战果。遗憾的是，像你这样的人我们不多，将军阁下。

column1: It was hoped that you would once again snatch victory from defeat. But it was not to be. The Wehrmacht is a spent force, unable even to slow the Russian Bear.  I advise you to fight your way to the west, Herr General. The Reds are not known for their hospitality to guests.
column2: 我们曾指望你再次从失败中夺回胜利。但事与愿违。国防军已成强弩之末，连迟滞俄国熊都做不到。我建议你且战且向西，将军阁下。赤俄向来对来客不甚好客。

column1: Herr General, we have broken our teeth on the enemy defenses. The Bolsheviks are counterattacking all along our front. Army Group South has been shaken and must give ground. General Hoth will be assuming your duties. That is all.
column2: 将军阁下，我们在敌军防线上碰得头破血流。布尔什维克正沿我全线反扑。南方集团军群已经动摇，不得不后撤。霍特将军将接替你的职务。就这样吧。

column2: 法莱斯(Falaise)之后德军溃乱后撤，盟军

column1: try to secure Nancy as a springboard for the fall offensive into Germany
column2: 力图夺取南锡(Nancy)，作为秋季攻入德国本土的跳板

column2: 。与此同时，德军急调新的、经过整补的装甲

column1: formations to stop the Allied onslaught.
column2: 部队，以阻止盟军的猛攻。

column1: With the Germans falling back in disarray after Falaise, the Allied forces try to secure Nancy as a springboard for the fall offensive into Germany itself.  Meanwhile, the Germans rush up new and refitted armored formations to stop the Allied onslaught.
column2: 法莱斯(Falaise)之后德军溃乱后撤，盟军力图夺取南锡(Nancy)，作为秋季攻入德国本土的跳板。与此同时，德军急调新的、经过整补的装甲部队，以阻止盟军的猛攻。
塞布河（乌德塞布河）：海洋
拉巴特—丹吉尔公路上的小村庄

column1: Well, you dropped the ball this time. The capture of Port Lyautey was really critical to move into Tunisia. Instead, we're still bogged down. We're going to have to go this thing all over again. But this time, with another guy in charge!
column2: 唉，这次你搞砸了。夺取利奥泰港(Port Lyautey)对进军突尼斯(Tunisia)本当至关重要。结果我们却还陷在原地。我们只好把这件事从头再做一遍。不过这一次，换个头儿！

column1: Finally you have the chance to meet the Krauts, haven't you? Commander, Jerry is trying to delay at all costs our race to the ports of Tunisia. They know very well that if we seize Tunisia the entire Afrika Korps will be lost. Now the battle is on the Tunisian border, where the British paras have just captured the airfield of Bona. Unfortunately also the German green devils have landed at Bona, and they will attack immediately to regain control of the airport. Your task is to reach at top gear Bona to support the British paratroops and seize all the remaining objectives while the Axis reinforcements are moving against you.
column2: 你终于有机会会会那些德国佬了，对吧？指挥官，杰里(Jerry)正不惜一切代价迟滞我们向突尼斯(Tunisia)各港口的赛跑。他们很清楚，一旦我们夺取突尼斯，整个非洲军团就完了。现在战斗在突尼斯边境展开，英国伞兵刚夺取了博纳(Bona)机场。不幸的是，德军「绿魔」也在博纳着陆，他们会立刻进攻以夺回机场控制权。你的任务是全速赶到博纳，支援英国伞兵，并在轴心国增援向你开进的同时夺取所有剩余目标。

column1: Excellent, you hit a home run! The Nazi have been stunned by your superior leadership. Nice going, commander.
column2: 干得漂亮，你打出了一记全垒打！纳粹分子被你高超的指挥打懵了。干得好，指挥官。

column1: Axis forces are converging towards the Kasserine Pass, commander, and they have a real chance to capture even Thebessa. Also once again Gafsa is in high danger, and possibly we'll not be able to hold it. You should focus your counter strikes first on the powerful German tanks, but be sure to give enough air defence covering to your army, or you'll be wiped out very shortly. This is the hardest mission you have yet to participate in: if you score a victory here, you will be surely promoted!
column2: 指挥官，轴心国部队正向卡塞林山口(Kasserine Pass)集中，他们甚至真有机会拿下泰贝萨(Thebessa)。加夫萨(Gafsa)也再次岌岌可危，我们很可能守不住。你的反击应首先针对那些强大的德军坦克，但一定要给你的部队足够的防空掩护，否则你很快就会全军覆没。这是你迄今参加过的最艰难的任务：如果你在这里取胜，必定会得到晋升！

column1: Here we are, commander: we have the chance to write the final chapter of this African campaign and force the Axis to leave the continent. You are to act a key role in the capture of Tunis, but it won't be really easy since Berlin sent a lot of reinforcements to defend the last toehold of the Axis in Tunisia. You'll have to face a very experienced and entrenched enemy, able to destroy even the best units within your army. So be very cautious in managing your advance, or you will suffer heavy losses.
column2: 指挥官，我们到了：我们有机会写下这场非洲战役的最后一章，迫使轴心国离开这片大陆。你将在夺取突尼斯城(Tunis)的行动中扮演关键角色，但这绝不会轻松，因为柏林派来大量增援，保卫轴心国在突尼斯的最后一处立足点。你将面对一支经验丰富、工事坚固的敌军，他们甚至能摧毁你军中最精锐的部队。所以在指挥推进时要格外谨慎，否则你会遭受重大损失。

column1: We are about to launch Operation Husky, the invasion of Sicily. You are to give support to the Bradley 2nd US Corps in assaulting the beaches around the port of Gela. Our marines have just landed at Scoglitti, but the main bulk of this mission lies on your shoulders: rough terrain and enemy entrenched positions will be the biggest problems to deal with. Most of all you will not be able to rely on your formidable air force until you capture the airfield of Ragusa. Therefore this should be the very first objective on your schedule. Good luck!
column2: 我们即将发起哈士奇行动(Operation Husky)，即西西里(Sicily)登陆。你要支援布拉德利(Bradley)指挥的美军第2军，突击杰拉(Gela)港周边的海滩。我们的陆战队刚刚在斯科利蒂(Scoglitti)登陆，但这次任务的主要重担压在你肩上：崎岖地形与敌军坚固阵地将是最难对付的问题。最重要的是，在夺取拉古萨(Ragusa)机场之前，你无法依靠你那强大的空中力量。因此这应当是你计划中的第一个目标。祝好运！
巴尔切洛纳波佐迪戈托
圣斯特凡诺迪卡马斯特拉

column1: Commander, after securing our positions around Salerno, it's time to breakout the German defence line and advance fast towards the city of Naples. Pay attention because recognition reports that the enemy positions in front of you are still very strong, supported by heavy armour and artillery. It will be quite tough for your infantry, who anyway is expected to act a key role in this battle. Good luck, son!
column2: 指挥官，在确保我们在萨莱诺(Salerno)周边的阵地之后，该突破德军防线，迅速向那不勒斯(Naples)城推进了。注意，侦察报告说，你前方的敌军阵地仍然非常坚固，并有重型装甲与炮兵支援。对你的步兵来说这会相当艰难，而他们在这场战斗中仍将扮演关键角色。祝好运，孩子！

column1: General, we are pressing the Axis all over the front but bad weather and rough terrain conditions represent a formidable ally for the Krauts. In the attempt to gain time and put up a strong defence line across central Italy, feldmarschall Kesselring has placed a strong and well entrenched contingent to guard the Volturno River and the nearby mountains, covering the retreat of his fascist comrades. Your task is to break the enemy positions over the Volturno, cross the river and capture the cities of Capua and Castel Volturno as fast as possible.
column2: 将军，我们正在全线上压迫轴心国军队，但恶劣天气与崎岖地形是那些德国佬的强大盟友。为了争取时间并在意大利中部建立坚固防线，凯塞林(Kesselring)元帅已部署了一支强大且工事坚固的部队，守卫沃尔图诺河(Volturno River)与附近山地，掩护他那帮法西斯同伙撤退。你的任务是突破沃尔图诺河一线的敌军阵地，渡过该河，并尽快夺取卡普阿(Capua)与沃尔图诺堡(Castel Volturno)两城。

column1: Well, althought it appears that you did manage to take all the objectives, the enemy has withdrawn and regrouped, and now await us some 20 miles down the road. Next time we need a decisive victory from you.
column2: 嗯，尽管看来你确实夺取了全部目标，但敌人已经后撤并重新集结，现在正在前方约 20 英里处等着我们。下次我们需要你取得一场决定性的胜利。
鹅卵石行动(Operation Shingle) - 安齐奥滩头

column1: The General Staff has just decided to play a bold card on the table, commander: you are to lead another amphibious assault aimed at Anzio and the nearby villages, just behind the enemy defensive line. The idea is to cut off the way to Rome for the Nazi. If this operation succeeds, the Krauts will be forced to leave the Gustav Line to defend Rome or avoid any encirclement. Anyway, it won't be easy for your forces, since as you well know feldmarschall Kesselring has already demonstrated his ability to prevent our plans and react quickly on the battlefield. So be aware: in a few time your landing force could be challenged by strong enemy counterattacks. Hope that bad weather does not set in or it will be extremely hard.
column2: 指挥官，总参谋部刚刚决定在桌上打出一张大胆的牌：你将指挥又一次登陆作战，目标是安齐奥(Anzio)及附近村庄，就在敌军防线正后方。用意是切断纳粹分子通往罗马(Rome)的道路。如果这次行动成功，那些德国佬就不得不放弃古斯塔夫防线去保卫罗马，或者避免被合围。不管怎样，对你的部队来说这都不会轻松，因为你很清楚，凯塞林(Kesselring)元帅已经证明他有能力破坏我们的计划并在战场上迅速反应。所以要当心：不久之后，你的登陆部队就可能遭到敌军猛烈反击。但愿坏天气不要到来，否则会极其艰难。

column1: General, the decisive attack aimed at breaking out the Gustav Line is about to begin. This will be for sure the toughest battle you have yet to participate in. Expect to fight a bloody infantry battle against a very strong enemy, deeply entrenched and dug in a number of die hard bunkers and strategic positions across the Apennines.
column2: 将军，旨在突破古斯塔夫防线的决定性进攻即将开始。这必定是你迄今参加过的最艰苦的一战。准备好打一场血腥的步兵战，对手非常强大，在亚平宁山脉(Apennines)各处顽固的碉堡和战略阵地里深沟高垒。

column1: Sure, Cassino and the Gustav Line were tough nuts to crack, and you did the job. Anyway a lot op people at HQ think that you performance could have been much more brilliant. Very soon you'll another chance to show your talent.
column2: 没错，卡西诺(Cassino)与古斯塔夫防线是难啃的硬骨头，而你办成了。不过司令部里很多人认为你的表现本可以出色得多。很快你就会再有机会展示你的才干。

column1: Campaign describing the German defense from Stalingrad up to expulsion of the Russian and Western Allied troops from Germany.
column2: 本战役记述德军从斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)起，直至俄军与西方盟军被逐出德国为止的防御作战。

column1: Exit deployment screen and select the "amphibious ships", they must be adjacent to a land hex in order to deploy ground units. The entire core units can be deployed from 1 naval transport ship by deploying one or more units ("deploy forces" button), exiting the deployment screen, moving these units, and repeating as necessary. Of course the path must be cleared of any enemy Navy. You don't have to deploy all your units at the very 1st turn, you can wait.
column2: 退出部署界面并选中「两栖舰船」，它们必须与陆地格相邻才能部署地面部队。整个核心部队可以只靠 1 艘海上运输船部署——部署一个或多个单位（「部署部队」按钮），退出部署界面，移动这些单位，然后按需重复。当然，航路必须先清除敌方海军。你不必在第 1 回合就把所有单位都部署出来，可以等。

column1: Herr General the Russians try to break into Crimea through the Kerch straits.  If they succeed it is going to be very difficult to stop them.  We count on you Herr General !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正试图通过刻赤海峡(Kerch straits)突入克里米亚(Crimea)。如果他们得手，要挡住他们就非常困难了。我们全靠你了，将军阁下！！！

column1: Playing tip to transport units by ship from ports to ports (conquest of unoccupied ports is therefore possible but this costs air mission points):
column2: 用船只把部队从港口运往港口的操作提示（因此可以占领无人驻守的港口，但这会消耗空中任务点数）：

column1: 1. Select a unit, click on strategic transport button (on the lower left).
column2: 1. 选中一个单位，点击战略运输按钮（左下方）。

column1: 2. Move the unit from any PORT hex to any unoccupied or friendly PORT hex.
column2: 2. 把该单位从任意港口(PORT)格移动到任意无人驻守或己方的港口(PORT)格。

column1: 3. From the destination PORT hex you can still move normally infantry units, whereas other unit types cannot move anymore during the same turn.
column2: 3. 从目的港口(PORT)格出发，步兵单位仍可正常移动，而其他类型的单位在同一回合内不能再移动。

column1: The Western Allies attack Monte Cassino to break the Axis Central Italian Front.
column2: 西方盟军进攻卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)，以突破轴心国意大利中部战线。

column1: Herr General: The western allies are about to break through the Monte Cassino area in Central Italy. This will be the end of our front. You should prevent it !!!
column2: 将军阁下：西方盟军即将突破意大利中部的卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)地区。这将是我们的战线的终结。你应当阻止他们！！！

column1: The Axis powers attack the Allies at Monte Cassino to relieve the pressure on the Central Italian Front.
column2: 轴心国军队在卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)进攻盟军，以减轻意大利中部战线的压力。

column1: Herr General the Italian Central front is about to be broken by the Western Allies.  It is imperative they do not pass !!!
column2: 将军阁下，意大利中部战线即将被西方盟军突破。绝不能让他们通过！！！
卡西诺山突击 (#8 下部)
塞瓦斯托波尔撤退 (#11 下部)
德涅斯特河沿岸(Transnistria) - 1944年4月15日

column1: The Russians cross the Bug river into Romanian held territory. The Germans try to stop the invasion of Romania.
column2: 俄军渡过布格河(Bug river)进入罗马尼亚控制的领土。德军力图阻止对罗马尼亚的入侵。

column1: Herr General the Russians have crossed the Bug river and entered into the Romanian province of  Transnistria. They try to cross the Dniestr and knock Romania out of the war. You have to stop them before they succeed. You can deploy only 16 units choose wisely !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄军已渡过布格河(Bug river)，进入罗马尼亚的德涅斯特河沿岸(Transnistria)省。他们试图渡过德涅斯特河(Dniestr)，把罗马尼亚逐出战争。你必须在他们得手之前挡住他们。你只能部署 16 个单位，慎重选择！！！
德涅斯特河沿岸 (#10 下部)

column1: The Germans defend St. Lo the key to the Normandy peninsula from the Western Allies attack.
column2: 德军防守圣洛(St. Lo)——诺曼底(Normandy)半岛的钥匙——抵御西方盟军的进攻。

column1: Herr General the Western Allies try to break our lines at St. Lo.  If they can break free from Normandy everything will be lost. We should counterattack before is too late !!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军正试图在圣洛(St. Lo)突破我们的防线。如果他们能冲出诺曼底，一切都完了。我们应当趁还来得及发起反击！！！

column1: The Germans attack the Western Allies in the Ardennes.
column2: 德军在阿登(Ardennes)进攻西方盟军。

column1: Herr General this is our opportunity to break the western allies lines and reach Antwerp. Speed is crutial to reach Bastogne and St. Vith. If we fail the German border is open to them !!!
column2: 将军阁下，这是我们突破西方盟军防线、打到安特卫普(Antwerp)的机会。速度对于抵达巴斯托涅(Bastogne)与圣维特(St. Vith)至关重要。如果我们失败，德国边境就对他们敞开了！！！
帝国防御 - 历史战役

column1: Good work Bob, it seems your men are ready for the big one!!
column2: 干得好，鲍勃，看来你的部下已经准备好打大仗了！！

column1: Under much sniper fire your force has been successful in its task. Now we can attack over the river.
column2: 在猛烈狙击火力下，你的部队成功完成了任务。现在我们可以渡河进攻了。

column1: The German troops try to clear Polish forces from Mlawa and Ciechanow.  The Polish army attempts to defend their homeland against the German invaders.
column2: 德军试图把波兰军队逐出姆瓦瓦(Mlawa)与切哈努夫(Ciechanow)。波兰军队则力图保卫家园，抗击德国入侵者。

column1: Great work Bob, you have rescued your men and now you can rejoin the lines at the town of Haguenau.
column2: 干得漂亮，鲍勃，你救出了你的部下，现在可以回到阿格诺(Haguenau)镇的阵地了。

column1: Sorry to hear that another force took Berchtesgaden!!!
column2: 很遗憾听说另一支部队拿下了贝希特斯加登(Berchtesgaden)！！！
A连/第1营/第326工兵营/空降第101师

column2: 部署你的营部以保护空降场，把你的部队分成 2 群，准备在黎明出发。

column2: 把你的 3 个连部单位放到你的胜利格上。

column1: For the moment your objective is to seize the northern Carentan bridges to open a way for our planned assault on the town. Also the 327th GIR and 401st GIR should capture the Vire-Taute Canel bridges to the east of Carentan to prevent the enemy escaping.
column2: 目前你的目标是夺取卡朗唐(Carentan)北面的桥梁，为我们计划中对城镇的突击打开通路。此外，第327滑翔步兵团(GIR)与第401滑翔步兵团应夺取卡朗唐以东的维尔-托特(Vire-Taute)运河桥，以防敌人逃逸。

column1: The bolshevik bidgehead has been crushed, but Russian forces have crossed the Mius at multiple other locations. Kharkov is now under severe Russian pressure. Send your troops to the Kharkov area to safeguard the city. Your well-trained Panther battalion will join you shortly.

column1: Note: your duty was close to the historic one, thanks for playing!

column1: Campaign designer: Santiago Fuertes and Pablo Schelgel, 2004
column2: 战役设计：Santiago Fuertes 与 Pablo Schelgel，2004

column1: Herr General!  Very good work!  The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.  Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers.  Congratulations.
column2: 将军阁下！干得非常好！危机已过，波兰军队已经崩溃。你一带我们渡河，就再没什么能挡住我们的装甲部队。恭喜。

column1: Your less than spectacular performance has motivated a reevaluation of your usefulness.   Some of the enemy has retreated into Romania.  The British and French have now declared war on Germany.  If we did not need every man to fight, your career would be over!
column2: 你并不出彩的表现让人不得不重新评估你的价值。部分敌人已撤入罗马尼亚。英法现已对德宣战。若不是我们还需要每一个人去打仗，你的军旅生涯就该到此为止了！
东普鲁士装甲集群 战术胜利

column1: Herr General!  Good work!  The crisis is over, and the Polish Army has collapsed.  Once you led us past the river, nothing could stop our panzers.  Congratulations.
column2: 将军阁下！干得好！危机已经解除，波兰军队已经崩溃。你率我们渡河之后，就再没有什么能阻挡我们的装甲部队了。祝贺你。

column1: The tide has turned.  After a long struggle, the British Empire returns to the Continent.  You now lead British forces into battle with the final goal of unconditional surrender of the Axis powers.
column2: 形势已经逆转。经过长期苦战，大英帝国重返欧洲大陆。你现在率英军投入战斗，最终目标是轴心国无条件投降。

column1: Great job general. The French have retreated back to Belgium. Continue the pursuit and do not give them any rest.
column2: 干得好，将军。法国人已撤回比利时。继续追击，别给他们喘息之机。
法国第7集团军北上 失败

column1: French forces are still active in the Netherlands. You will spend the coming weeks mopping up pockets of French resistance. It are other forces that will continue the drive into Belgium and France.
column2: 法军仍在荷兰活动。接下来几周你将用于清剿法军的抵抗据点。继续向比利时和法国推进的将是其他部队。

column1: During the night the 8th Panzer Division drove into Belgrade, occupied the center of the city, and hoisted the Swastika flag.
column2: 夜间，第8装甲师驶入贝尔格莱德，占领市中心，并升起了卐字旗。

column1: With General von Kleist at the head, the 11th Panzer Division has been rolling into the capital since 0632.
column2: 由冯·克莱斯特将军率领，第11装甲师自6时32分起就开进了首都。

column1: Congratulations, you have successfully crossed the Dniepr. Gather your forces for the drive on Smolensk.
column2: 恭喜，你成功渡过了第聂伯河(Dniepr)。集结你的部队，向斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)推进。

column1: Congratulations Herr General. With Yelnya captured, the next stop is Moscow!
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。叶利尼亚既已拿下，下一站就是莫斯科！

column1: Congratulations. The Belgian king has capitulated and the British forces are retreating towards the port of Dunkirk. The Luftwaffe can take further care of destroying the encircled troops. Move your forces east to wrap up Maginot line garrisons.
column2: 恭喜。比利时国王已投降，英军正撤向敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)港。德国空军(Luftwaffe)可以继续负责消灭被围的部队。把你的部队东调，解决马奇诺防线(Maginot line)的守备部队。

column1: Closing in on Dunkirk May1940 TV
column2: 逼近敦刻尔克 1940年5月 战术胜利

column1: What a poor performance Herr general. You were lucky that the Leibstandarte on your left flank has performed much better than your troops. The Belgian king has capitulated and the British forces are retreating towards the port of Dunkirk. The Luftwaffe can take further care of destroying the encircled troops. Move your forces east to wrap up Maginot line garrisons.
column2: 表现得多差啊，将军阁下。你运气好，左翼的警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)打得比你的部队好得多。比利时国王已投降，英军正撤向敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)港。德国空军(Luftwaffe)可以继续负责消灭被围的部队。把你的部队东调，解决马奇诺防线(Maginot line)的守备部队。

column1: Congratulations, 600,000 Bolsjeviks are trapped in the Kiev pocket!
column2: 祝贺你，60万布尔什维克被困在基辅包围圈里！
基辅合围——科诺托普 1941年9月 失败

column1: We missed the chance to trap 600,000 Bolsjeviks in what would have been the Kiev pocket. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the raspoetitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
column2: 我们错失了把60万布尔什维克困进本可形成的基辅包围圈的机会。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道「泥泞季」——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

column1: After the Russian 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps, now also the 33rd Army is encircled. You have stopped the Russian Winter offensive. Congratulations.
column2: 继俄军第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军之后，如今第33集团军也被合围。你遏止了俄军的冬季攻势。恭喜。

column1: After success in North Africa and Sicily, The Americans, along with their British allies, decide to invade the soft underbelly of Europe.  You are to lead your troops in the struggle to free Europe from Axis control.  Anything less than an Axis unconditional surrender is unacceptable.
column2: 在北非与西西里(Sicily)取胜之后，美国人同他们的英国盟友决定入侵欧洲柔软的下腹部。你将率你的部队投入把欧洲从轴心国控制下解放出来的斗争。任何不及轴心国无条件投降的结果都不可接受。
列日行动(Operation Lüttich) - 1944年8月 BV

column1: Even with limited forces you achieved great success. The frontline opposite the American troops has been restored.
column2: 即便兵力有限，你仍取得了巨大成功。面对美军的战线已经恢复。
列日行动(Operation Lüttich) - 1944年8月 V

column1: With victory at Uman secured, the Leibstandarte moved south to take the city of Cherson.  During the march another attrocity is alleged to have taken place.  According to a postwar account of a Waffen-SS journalist serving with the 4th Battalion, east of Gejgova, men from the battalion found the mutilated bodies of six fellow SS soldiers who had been captured and executed at the town's NKVD headquarters.  In reprisal, Dietrich ordered the Leibstandarte to shoot all surrendering Soviet troops for three days, and in the ensuing slaughter an estimated 4,000 were killed.  The allegations remain unproven.
column2: 乌曼(Uman)之战取胜后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)南下夺取赫尔松(Cherson)城。据称在行军途中又发生了一起暴行。根据一名战后撰文的、在党卫军第4营服役的武装党卫军记者的记述，在盖戈瓦(Gejgova)以东，该营的士兵发现了六名党卫军同袍被肢解的尸体——他们被俘后在该镇的内务人民委员部(NKVD)总部遭处决。作为报复，迪特里希(Dietrich)命令警卫旗队在三日内枪杀所有投降的苏军，在这场随后的屠杀中估计有 4,000 人被杀。这些指控至今未获证实。

column1: On the 27th of September, the Soviets launched a counter offensive aimed at the German southern flank.  It was a strong attack which breached the 3rd Romanian Army and Germany's XXX Armeekorps sector of the front and threatened an envelopment.  The Leibstandarte and elite German mountain divisions were rushed into the line to halt the attack, and then to force them back.
column2: 9 月 27 日，苏军对德军南翼发起反攻。这是一次强有力的进攻，突破了罗马尼亚第3集团军与德军第30军当面地段，并有造成合围之势。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)与德军精锐山地师被紧急投入战线，以阻止这次进攻，随后再迫使其后退。

column1: First contact with British troops was made north of Vevi at 11:00 on 10 April. An intercepted radio message indicated that the British command was surprised by the swiftness of the Leibstandarte's thrust and gave orders for immediate withdrawal from the Vermion Position. The SS troops seized Vevi on 11 April, but were stopped a short distance south of that town, where strong Australian forces held the dominating heights overlooking the pass road. During the next day the Leibstandarte reconnoitered the enemy positions and at dusk launched a frontal attack against the pass. After heavy fighting the Leibstandarte overcame the enemy resistance and broke through the defile.
column2: 4 月 10 日 11:00，在韦维(Vevi)以北首次与英军接触。一份截获的无线电报文显示，英军统帅部对警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)突击之迅速感到意外，随即下令立即从韦尔米翁(Vermion)阵地撤退。党卫军部队于 4 月 11 日夺取韦维，但在该镇以南不远处被挡住——强大的澳军控制了俯瞰隘路的高地。次日，警卫旗队侦察了敌军阵地，并在黄昏对山口发起正面进攻。经过激战，警卫旗队压倒了敌军抵抗，突破隘口。

If Stalin has nuclear missiles already built in these silos, then he could launch them at London, Paris and Berlin. We must capture the silos in Kiev before he gives the order to launch...
column2: 你在里加(Riga)救出的那位科学家已告知我们斯大林(Stalin)核导弹发射井的位置。看来它们正在乌克兰的基辅(Kiev)周边地区建造。幸运的是，我们在俄罗斯南部的入侵部队已成功突入周边地区，正在这次行动中支援你。快点，指挥官。如果斯大林已在这些发射井里造好了核导弹，他就能把它们射向伦敦(London)、巴黎(Paris)和柏林(Berlin)。我们必须在他下令发射之前夺取基辅的发射井……

column1: Combined British and German forces have managed to penetrate the ring of Soviet defense surrounding Volgorad. This city is crucial to our overall plan, which is to flank Moscow and attack it from the north where the Soviet defenses are the least ready for a large-scale attack. The formidable and determined Soviet forces will give you a tough fight, Commander. Use the experienced German forces as you will, and keep in mind we've sent one of our own naval flotillas to help you. Take the city, and liberate the oppressed Soviet people.
column2: 英德联军已成功突入环绕伏尔加格勒(Volgorad)的苏军防御圈。这座城市对我们的总体计划至关重要——我们要包抄莫斯科(Moscow)，从北面进攻它，因为那里的苏军防御对大规模进攻准备最不充分。指挥官，强大而坚定的苏军会给你一场硬仗。你可以随意使用那些经验丰富的德军部队，并且记住，我们已派出一支自己的海军分舰队来协助你。拿下这座城市，解放受压迫的苏联人民。

column1: The base remains in Soviet hands, and our forces have taken serious losses.
column2: 基地仍在苏军手中，我军遭受了严重损失。

column1: Commander, if we are to encircle Soviet troops successfully, we will need to cut their lines of supply. You will lead an attack from the west to capture important supply bridges. Deployment areas are limited, however several Combat Engineers have escaped from a Soviet camp to the south. A quick victory here will allow both our western and eastern forces to converge and eliminate the Soviet threat.
column2: 指挥官，若要成功合围苏军，我们就得切断他们的补给线。你将率部从西面发起进攻，夺取重要的补给桥梁。可部署的区域有限，不过有几名战斗工兵已从南面的苏军战俘营逃出。在这里迅速取胜，就能让我军东西两路会合，消除苏联的威胁。

column1: The spy's information points to a submarine pen in southern Greece. The Soviets are developing new advanced submarines there that could disrupt Allied shipping and bring our war effort crashing to a halt. Unfortunately, Greece is currently being invaded by the Soviets, and our troops are stretched too wide to help them. Take your troops in, destroy those bloody submarines and get back before the main army discovers your force. The French have pledged their navy to assist us in this operation.
column2: 那名间谍的情报指向希腊(Greece)南部的一处潜艇洞库。苏联人正在那里研制新型先进潜艇，那可能破坏盟军航运，使我们的事业骤然停摆。不幸的是，希腊目前正遭苏联入侵，而我们的部队铺得太开，无力援助他们。率你的部队进去，摧毁那些该死的潜艇，并在苏军主力发现你的部队之前撤回。法国人已承诺派海军协助我们这次行动。

column1: Welcome back, Commander. It's been roughly 2 months since your destruction of the Soviet submarine pen in Sweden, and almost all of Scandanavia is back under Allied control. However, your next assignment is far from the Scandanavian region, in the vicinity of Salerno, Italy. Italy was a hotspot for much of the early war. Eventually the combined might of British and French forces pushed the Soviet forces back into the sea, making it a safe haven for Allied weapon testing. The Soviets have learned of a very important development in our tests going on here at Salerno, however, and have landed a sizeable force to stop our development process.
column2: 欢迎回来，指挥官。自你摧毁瑞典(Sweden)的苏联潜艇洞库以来大约过了 2 个月，斯堪的纳维亚(Scandanavia)几乎全部回到了盟军控制之下。不过，你的下一项任务远离斯堪的纳维亚，在意大利的萨莱诺(Salerno)附近。战争前期的大部分时间里，意大利一直是热点地区。最终英法联军合力把苏军赶回了海里，使这里成为盟军武器试验的安全避风港。然而苏联人已得知我们在萨莱诺这里进行的试验中有一项非常重要的进展，并已投送一支规模可观的兵力来阻止我们的研制进程。

column1: This cannot happen, Commander. The weapons being tested here are crucial to our survival against increasingly well armed Soviet forces. Your job is to reinforce the badly beaten garrison of our base to the north, then to retake the area from the cowardly bastards.
column2: 这绝不可以，指挥官。这里试验的武器对于我们在装备日益精良的苏军面前生存下来至关重要。你的任务是增援北面我们那座损失惨重的基地守备部队，然后从那些懦弱的混蛋手里夺回该地区。

column1: Good luck Commander. You'll bloody well need it!!!
column2: 祝你好运，指挥官。你他妈的太需要好运了！！！

column1: Welcome back, Commander. I hope you enjoyed your vacation, but things
column2: 欢迎回来，指挥官。希望你的假期过得愉快，但事情

column1: have erupted out of control. Stalin, apparently getting desperate at the outcome of the war, has begun building nuclear weapons.
column2: 已经失控爆发了。斯大林(Stalin)显然对战争结局越来越绝望，已开始建造核武器。

column1: A Soviet scientist wishes to defect to our cause, bringing with him intimate knowledge of Stalin's nuclear weapon program. However, there is a limited gap of time for us to rescue him from the Soviet base in Riga before Soviet units arrive to reinforce the base. Our forces have begun an amphibious landing in the area. Secure the area as quickly and efficently as possible, to retrieve the scientist's crucial information and also to begin the liberation of the Baltic states.
column2: 一名苏联科学家希望投奔我们的事业，他会带来关于斯大林(Stalin)核武器计划的详尽内情。不过，我们要在苏军部队赶来增援里加(Riga)基地之前把他从那里救出来，时间窗口很有限。我军已在该地区开始登陆。尽快、尽可能高效地控制该地区，取回那名科学家的关键情报，同时开始解放波罗的海诸国。

column1: Comrade Komdiv, the Kharkov is taken, but the situation on our southern flank is critical... Comrade Stalin has ordered to hold the city at all costs, but German tanks can anytime get through our supply lines. Marshal Tiomoshenko has ordered retreat. Maybe you'll manage to get out of the cauldron...
column2: 师长同志，哈尔科夫(Kharkov)已经拿下了，但我们南翼的局势十分危急……斯大林(Stalin)同志命令不惜一切代价守住这座城市，可德军坦克随时可能切断我们的补给线。铁木辛哥(Tiomoshenko)元帅已下令撤退。也许你能设法突出包围圈……

column1: We have a big problem Commander. Get your men ready to move!
column2: 指挥官，我们遇到大麻烦了。让你的人准备好出发！

column1: Victory!!!, the British have been kicked from another place more!. Now, the Mediterranean is closed, and the South Bank is secured. Of course, we will put a permanent garrison in Spain, surely this won't please to Franco, but... this is not important! HAHAHAHAHA!
column2: 胜利！！！英国人又被我们从一个地方踢了出去！现在，地中海已经封闭，南岸也已确保。当然，我们会在西班牙驻一支永久守备部队，这肯定不讨佛朗哥(Franco)喜欢，但……这不重要！哈哈哈哈哈！

column1: Well, that was tricky but Ivan has been stopped and now we can get back to our original plans.
column2: 嗯，那确实棘手，但伊万(Ivan)已经被挡住了，现在我们可以回到原定计划。

column1: Commander, Here is the prize, Moscow!
column2: 指挥官，大奖就在这里——莫斯科(Moscow)！

column1: Stalin has turned the city into a fortress comprised of heavily entrenched infantry and anti tank. You will need to muster all of your skill to take the city. You have a small battle group of crack German troops and armor at your disposal to assist in the siege. General Patton's army has been sent south to Rostov to try and divert Russian forces from your objective.
column2: 斯大林(Stalin)已把这座城市变成一座堡垒，由深沟高垒的步兵与反坦克部队组成。你需要使出全部本事才能拿下它。你手上有支由德军精锐部队与装甲组成的小型战斗群，可用于协助攻城。巴顿(Patton)将军的集团军已被派往南面的罗斯托夫(Rostov)，试图把俄军兵力从你的目标引开。

column1: Commander, this is your finest hour, make us all proud!
column2: 指挥官，这是你最辉煌的时刻，让我们大家都为你骄傲！

column1: BTW: we shall test the A bomb on Moscow, find a suitable airbase to reload! A B29 will appear during the course of the scenario...
column2: BTW：我们将在莫斯科(Moscow)试验 A 弹，找一处合适的机场来装弹！场景进行过程中会出现一架 B29……

column2: 应巴顿(Patton)的特别请求，经验丰富的武装党卫军部队将参战协助你。
