column1: The attack was launched at 03:30hrs on the 5th of July.  The three SS divisions moved on three parallel lines of advance.  Fighting through thick minefields north of Byelgorod, Leibstandarte was by 19:30hrs on the southern outskirts of Jakovleva, a village within the second defensive line some 14 miles into Soviet territory, and had taken 97 killed and 522 wounded.
column2: 进攻于7月5日03:30时发起。三个党卫军师沿三路平行轴线推进。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在别尔哥罗德(Byelgorod)以北穿过浓密雷场奋战，到19:30时已进抵雅科夫列沃(Jakovleva)南郊——该村位于深入苏联领土约14英里的第二道防线之内——自身阵亡97人、负伤522人。

column1: After a night marked by continuous infantry battles in puring rain, by dawn the Leibstandarte assaulted bunkers and fortified positions in the second line of defensive works.  In a day of heavy fighting, the panzers of the Leibstandarte engaged the 1st Guards Armoured Brigade and destroyed a large part of it.  The advanced carried the front line to Pokrovka, south-west of Prokhorovka.
column2: 在倾盆大雨中经历了一整夜接连不断的步兵战斗之后，拂晓时警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)向第二道防御工事线的地堡与坚固阵地发起突击。在一天的激烈战斗中，警卫旗队的装甲部队与近卫第1装甲旅交战，并歼灭了其大部。这次推进把前线推到了普罗霍罗夫卡(Prokhorovka)西南的波克罗夫卡(Pokrovka)。

column1: The aims of Operation Spring Awakening were as wildly ambitious as those laid out for the Ardennes offensive three months previously.  They were: to destroy the Soviet forces in the region bounded by Lake Balaton and the Danube and Drava rivers, secure the Hungarian oil deposits, and establish bridgeheads over the Danube with a view to further offensive operations.
column2: 「春醒」行动(Operation Spring Awakening)的目标，与三个月前为阿登攻势所定的目标一样狂妄。它们分别是：消灭巴拉顿湖(Lake Balaton)与多瑙河(Danube)、德拉瓦河(Drava)之间地域内的苏军，确保匈牙利的油田，并在多瑙河上建立桥头堡，以便进一步发起攻势作战。

column1: Despite battling hard the Leibstandarte and the rest of the 1st Panzer Army were forced from Rostov.  The defeat badly exposed how overstretched the German forces were.  The fighting had left the Leibstandarte decimated.  At the end of November it was pulled out and spent December in defensive positions outside Rostov behind the River Mius.  It was engaged in defensive actions, in temperatures that sank as low as -40 degrees, with deep carpets of snow and partisan actions in the rear.
column2: 尽管奋力苦战，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)与第1装甲集团军的其余部队仍被迫撤出罗斯托夫(Rostov)。这次失败充分暴露了德军兵力过度拉伸。战斗已使警卫旗队损失惨重。11月底它被撤出，12月则在罗斯托夫城外、米乌斯河(River Mius)后方占据防御阵地。它参与了防御作战，气温低至零下40度，积雪深厚，后方还有游击队活动。
追击至图卜鲁格：重制版
西方小型战役（11 个剧本）

column1: The Soviets attempt to cut the Axis supply line going to Stalingrad.
column2: 苏军试图切断通往斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的轴心国补给线。

column1: Playing tip : move transport ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops (one single ship can disembark all your units).
column2: 游戏提示：把运输船移到任何与海岸相邻的格子，以便部署你的部队（单艘船即可让所有单位下船）。

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the Italian path.
column2: 同志，你选择了意大利的道路。

column1: Come on, you have not chosen! Make your choice please.
column2: 来吧，你还没有选择！请做出你的选择。

column1: The Supreme Council of the Soviet Union has decorated you with the Golden Star of the Hero of the Soviet Union and Order of Lenin, but don't let your head be turned. We still remember you were imprisoned for Trockists' Deviationism, any false move will not be forgiven...!
column2: 苏联最高苏维埃已授予你苏联英雄金星勋章与列宁勋章，但别让脑袋发昏。我们还记得你曾因托洛茨基式的偏离而身陷囹圄，任何错误的举动都不会被原谅……！

column1: You poor performance has not helped the situation at all, I am sorry to say you are being replaced.
column2: 你糟糕的表现对局势毫无帮助，很遗憾，你将被替换。

column1: But, that is not your problem. You will no doubt be called on again soon.
column2: 但是，那不是你的问题。毫无疑问，很快又会有人来召你。
鲁韦萨特岭 : 崎岖地
阿拉姆哈勒法岭(Alam Halfa Ridge) : SAND
反坦克营/党卫军第1装甲师

column1: Superb performance, we have destroyed or captured most of germany's forces in France. The end for Hitler is near! You are the best of the best, Commander!
column2: 干得漂亮，我们已消灭或俘获了德军在法国的大部分兵力。希特勒的末日近了！你是精英中的精英，指挥官！
反坦克营/党卫军第2装甲师

column1: Commander, you have been chosen to lead our forces back onto European soil. You will lead our invasion of the Italian mainland at Salerno. You must succeed. The whole free world is watching!
column2: 指挥官，你已被选中率领我军重返欧洲大陆。你将指挥我们在萨莱诺(Salerno)对意大利本土的登陆。你必须成功。整个自由世界都在看着！

column1: Exit deployment screen and select the British naval transport boat, it must be adjacent to a land hex in order to deploy ground units. The entire core units can be deployed from 1 naval transport ship by deploying one or more units ("deploy forces" button), exiting the deployment screen, moving these units, and repeating as necessary. Of course the path must be cleared of any enemy Navy. You don't have to deploy all your units at the very 1st turn, you can wait.
column2: 退出部署界面并选中英国海军运输船，它必须与一个陆地格子相邻才能部署地面单位。全部核心单位都可以从1艘海军运输船部署：先部署一个或多个单位（「部署部队」按钮），退出部署界面，移动这些单位，然后按需要重复。当然，航路上必须清除一切敌方海军。你不必在第1回合就部署所有单位，你可以等。

column1: Comrade General, you have cleared the way to liberate Ukraine!
column2: 将军同志，你已为解放乌克兰清除了道路！

column1: Comrade General, Your troops did excellent job! You have taken a bridgehead on the Vistula's western bank. This will be the basis for our offensive that should liberate Poland from Fascist-capitalist oppression!
column2: 将军同志，你的部队干得非常出色！你已在维斯瓦河(Vistula)西岸夺取了一个桥头堡。这将是我们把波兰从法西斯资本主义压迫下解放出来的攻势的基础！

column1: Outstanding work, General.  You have continued to display superior skill.  We will not be having much of a problem with the remaining Republicans.  Good luck on your next assignment.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军。你继续展现了高超的技能。收拾残余的共和军，不成问题。祝你在下一个任务中好运。

column1: I am aware that conditions have been harsh, but you have done poorly!  The only positive result is that you and your troops have gained some experience in this new type of armored warfare.   But, the new Spanish government and our other allies have not yet learned to respect our military capabilities, which we require!   Herr General, do not disappoint us again.
column2: 我知道条件艰苦，但你打得很差！唯一的好处是，你和部队在这种新型装甲战中取得了一些经验。可是，新的西班牙政府与我们的其他盟友，还没有学会尊重我们的军事能力——而这正是我们所需要的！将军阁下，不要再让我们失望。
欢迎来到波兰，将军阁下。

column1: Your task is to lead your SS PanzerKorps into Poland and destroy the Polish Army around Lodz.  You will be fighting the best of the Polish Army, and the battle will depend upon how quickly you can eliminate these enemy forces and seal off any their escape routes.
column2: 你的任务是率你的党卫军装甲军进入波兰，消灭罗兹(Lodz)周边的波兰军队。你将与波兰军队中最精锐的部队交战，此战取决于你能多快消灭这些敌军并封死他们的退路。

column1: Herr General, How could you let the Poles defeat your mighty PanzerKorps?
column2: 将军阁下，你怎么能让波兰人击败你强大的装甲军？

column1: There are rumors from Berlin about a replacement for your command.
column2: 柏林有传言说要有人接替你的指挥职务。

column1: However, I have no time for such things, There is a war still to be fought and I need your PanzerKorps for the final assault on Warszawa.
column2: 不过，我没时间管这些事，仗还得打下去，我需要你的装甲军参加对华沙(Warszawa)的最后突击。

column1: Do not fail me again Herr General.
column2: 不要再让我失望，将军阁下。

column1: General, you have been assigned the ultimate objective: Your SS PanzerKorps must destroy the remaining Polish forces situated around Warszawa and secure the Polish Capital.  Be aware that if you go too far east you may encounter our new Allies.
column2: 将军，你已被赋予最终目标：你的党卫军装甲军必须消灭华沙(Warszawa)周边的残余波兰军队，并确保控制波兰首都。注意，如果你过于向东推进，可能会遇到我们的新盟友。

column1: Due to your incompetence, the Soviets are moving further West every day.
column2: 由于你的无能，苏军每天都在向西推进。

column1: I recognize you have friends in Berlin, but keep this level of performance up and even they won't be able to save you.
column2: 我承认你在柏林有朋友，但你要是继续保持这种表现，连他们也救不了你。

column1: The Finns are very impressed.  Your elite divisions bring glory to the Fatherland.  Germany needs more Generals like you!
column2: 芬兰人印象极深。你的精锐师为本土带来荣耀。德国需要更多像你这样的将军！

column1: You have once again defeated a numerically superior enemy with your elite SS units, even the British are impressed, on to France, Herr General!
column2: 你又一次以你的党卫军精锐部队击败了兵力占优的敌人，连英国人都为之折服，向法国进军，将军阁下！

column1: Herr General, the invasion of France has begun.  Your force will move swiftly and quietly through the Ardennes and attack the French where they least expect.
column2: 将军阁下，入侵法国已经开始。你的部队将迅速而隐蔽地穿过阿登(Ardennes)，在法国人最意料不到之处发起攻击。

column1: Cross the Meuse and destroy any resistance you find.  The French have been called the best army in the world, but frankly, we haven't found them very impressive.
column2: 渡过默兹河(Meuse)，消灭你遇到的一切抵抗。法国人一直被称为世界上最好的军队，但坦率地说，我们并不觉得他们有什么了不起。

column1: Excellent!  You have achieved a tremendous victory against incredible odds.  Move quickly, now, and destroy the last British forces at Dunkirk!
column2: 好极了！你在极其不利的条件下取得了巨大胜利。现在动作要快，消灭敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)的最后一支英军！

column1: Well Herr General, you handled that counter attack very nicely.  I think some of the Allied Generals have studied your tactics!
column2: 好啊，将军阁下，你那次反击处理得非常漂亮。我看有些盟军将领研究过你的战术！

column1: Now you must move against the last British forces at Dunkirk.
column2: 现在你必须向敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)的最后一支英军发起进攻。

column1: Herr General, the British have successfully embarked their Expeditionary Force and the French continue to resist.
column2: 将军阁下，英国人已成功让他们的远征军登船，而法国人仍在抵抗。

column1: If this is the way you handle your forces, I do not think your PanzerKorps will be required for the final battle against the French.
column2: 如果你就是这样使用你的部队，我认为对法国的最后一战不需要你的装甲军了。

column1: Your forces are being transferred east where you cannot interfere with the war effort further.
column2: 你的部队正被调往东线，在那里你再也无法干扰战事了。

column1: You have achieved a Great Victory, Herr General. You have crippled the British Expeditionary Force, and the French have surrendered. Very good.
column2: 你取得了一场大捷，将军阁下。你重创了英国远征军，法国也已投降。很好。

column1: Herr General, on every other front the Russians are melting before our forces like a slab of butter on a skillet.
column2: 将军阁下，在其他各条战线上，俄国人在我军面前就像热锅上的一块黄油般消融。

column1: How is it you have failed?
You had best pray this war lasts a bit longer so you will have a chance to redeem yourself.
column2: 你最好祈祷这场战争再持续久一点，好让你有机会挽回自己。

column1: Herr General, you exceed our expectations!  The Russians are retreating on all fronts.  Prepare for your next objective!
column2: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望！俄国人在各条战线上都在退却。为你的下一个目标做准备！

column1: Herr General, we need your skill and daring once again!
column2: 将军阁下，我们再次需要你的才干与胆识！

column1: Take your PanzerKorps and capture the important town of Zhytomyr.  Intelligence reports the remainder of a Soviet army group is in the vicinity, but you should be able to handle them and destroy any Russian forces foolish enough to continue fighting!
column2: 率你的装甲军夺取重要城镇日托米尔(Zhytomyr)。情报报告说，一个苏军集团军群的残部就在附近，但你应该能应付他们，并消灭任何蠢到继续顽抗的俄军部队！

column1: The high command sends it highest regards!  Every other army commander envies you and your SS PanzerKorps!  Continue with the war, Herr General!
column2: 最高统帅部致以最崇高的敬意！其他每一位集团军司令都羡慕你和你的党卫军装甲军！继续打下去，将军阁下！

column1: Herr General, You've taken Zhytomyr after fierce resistance.
column2: 将军阁下，你在激烈抵抗之后拿下了日托米尔(Zhytomyr)。

column1: I know your forces are in need of a rest, nevertheless we must press on to Kyiv at once!
column2: 我知道你的部队需要休整，但我们仍必须立刻向基辅(Kyiv)推进！

column1: A fine performance, to be sure. Kyiv has fallen; the Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And now, we might be able to threaten Moscow.
column2: 确实是一场漂亮仗。基辅(Kyiv)已经陷落；布尔什维克军队已被切断，毫无解围的希望。而现在，我们也许能够威胁莫斯科了。

column1: Herr General, I hope you can withstand this cold.  The 1st SS PanzerKorps must capture V'Az'ma.  This city will be a stepping stone and a base of operations for the final attack on Moscow!
column2: 将军阁下，我希望你能顶住这样的严寒。党卫军第1装甲军必须夺取维亚济马(V'Az'ma)。这座城市将成为最后进攻莫斯科的踏脚石与作战基地！

column1: If you succeed, we will all enjoy the spring back in Berlin!
column2: 如果你成功，我们大家都能回柏林享受春天！

column1: Well done, Herr General!  They couldn't stop your advance.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective.
column2: 干得好，将军阁下！他们挡不住你的推进。占领维亚济马(V'Az'ma)对你达成下一个目标至关重要。

column1: On to Moskva!  Nothing can stop you now!
column2: 向莫斯科(Moskva)进军！现在没什么能挡住你了！

column1: Herr General, you failed to take V'Az'ma!
column2: 将军阁下，你没能拿下维亚济马(V'Az'ma)！

column1: This will make our attack on Moskva far more difficult.
column2: 这会使我们对莫斯科(Moskva)的进攻困难得多。

column1: Nevertheless, we must make that assault or face a winter in Russia!
column2: 尽管如此，我们必须发起那次突击，否则就得在俄国过冬！

column1: Herr General, fine performance.  The occupation of V'Az'ma will be critical towards your next objective.
column2: 将军阁下，干得漂亮。占领维亚济马(V'Az'ma)对你达成下一个目标至关重要。
接下来我们突击莫斯科(Moskva)！

column1: General, this is the attack all of Germany has been waiting for.  You and your SS PanzerKorps have been chosen because of your brilliant victories for the last two years.
column2: 将军，这是全德国都在等待的进攻。你和你的党卫军装甲军之所以被选中，是因为你们过去两年辉煌的胜利。

column1: The Russians have erected considerable defenses around Moskva, but you must break through and capture their capitol.  Move quickly before they bring in more reinforcements from the east.
column2: 俄国人在莫斯科(Moskva)周边构筑了相当规模的防御，但你必须突破并夺取他们的首都。要在他们从东面调来更多补充兵员之前迅速行动。

column1: Herr General, after your incredible victory, the entire Russian line is in complete collapse.
column2: 将军阁下，在你令人难以置信的胜利之后，俄军整条战线已彻底崩溃。

column1: The Soviet armies are fleeing east; The Fuher himself has demanded your presence in Berlin to award your medal!
column2: 苏军正向东逃窜；元首本人已要求你前往柏林，为你授勋！

column1: We should have no trouble crushing the remaining forces.
column2: 粉碎残余的敌军应当不成问题。

column1: Herr General, you narrowly accomplished what was expected of you.  Because of this the Soviets held the rail lines long enough for more troops to arrive.  In addition, heavy snows are now falling.  Unfortunately our offensive cannot continue under these conditions.
column2: 将军阁下，你勉强完成了对你的期望。正因如此，苏军把铁路线守得够久，等来了更多部队。此外，现在正下着大雪。遗憾的是，在这样的条件下我们的攻势无法继续。

column1: You have been summoned to Berlin.
Herr General, I hope you enjoyed the last year spent at the academy teaching your tactics to Germany's future commanders.  However, we have need of you at the front once again.
column2: 将军阁下，我希望你在学院度过的这一年过得愉快——你向德国未来的指挥官们传授了你的战术。不过，前线再次需要我们使用你。

column1: The 1st SS PanzerKorps has been reformed and I've placed you in charge.
column2: 党卫军第1装甲军已重建，我已让你担任指挥。
库尔斯克(Kursk)攻势已经开始。

column1: The Russians have assembled a Guards Tank Army at Prokhorovka, destroy them!
column2: 俄国人在普罗霍罗夫卡(Prokhorovka)集结了一个近卫坦克集团军，消灭他们！

column1: Herr General, your have once again defeated the finest force Stalin could muster.  Where did he get so many tanks!
column2: 将军阁下，你又一次击败了斯大林能集结起来的最精锐部队。他哪来这么多坦克！

column1: Your next objective is Obojan.  It is likely heavily defended Smash them!
column2: 你的下一个目标是奥博扬(Obojan)。那里很可能防御坚固，粉碎他们！

column1: Herr General,... well it would seem your year off has not improved your abilities.
column2: 将军阁下，……看来你这一年的休假并没有提升你的能力。

column1: The fate of the war rests on what we do during this offensive.
column2: 战争的命运取决于我们在这场攻势中的作为。

column1: Herr General, that was done by the narrowest of margins.  This offensive has just begun; you are in danger of falling behind schedule.
column2: 将军阁下，这次只是以极微弱的优势完成的。这场攻势才刚刚开始，你有落后于时间表的危险。

column1: Herr General, you must take Obojan so that we can move unhindered towards Kursk.  The attack has stalled everywhere else.  Set an example and inspire the rest of the Wehrmacht to renew their efforts!
column2: 将军阁下，你必须拿下奥博扬(Obojan)，这样我们才能不受阻碍地向库尔斯克(Kursk)推进。其他各地的进攻都已停滞。树立一个榜样，激励国防军其余部队重新奋起！

column1: You have an explanation for this abysmal failure?
column2: 你对这次惨败有什么解释吗？

column1: Due to your incompetence the troops assigned the task to take Kursk will suffer greatly.
column2: 由于你的无能，受命夺取库尔斯克(Kursk)的部队将付出惨重代价。

column1: Do you have anyone in mind who should get this "reward"?
column2: 你心里有谁该得到这个「奖赏」吗？

column1: Fine performance Herr General. You have taken Obojan but we must hurry to exploit this advantage before the Russians can reinforce Kursk.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。你已拿下奥博扬(Obojan)，但我们必须抓紧利用这一优势，抢在俄国人增援库尔斯克(Kursk)之前。

column1: Well done Herr General.  Now that we have Obojan, we can continue towards Kursk.
column2: 干得好，将军阁下。既然我们已拿下奥博扬(Obojan)，就可以继续向库尔斯克(Kursk)推进了。
欢迎来到库尔斯克(Kursk)，将军阁下。

column1: The Soviets have erected an impressive defensive perimeter around Kursk.  You are the only one who can break through.  Once you make headway, the attack will commence on all the other fronts and we can push these Soviets back to Siberia!
column2: 苏军在库尔斯克(Kursk)周边构筑了令人印象深刻的环形防御。只有你能突破。一旦你取得进展，其他各条战线都将发起进攻，我们就能把这些苏军赶回西伯利亚！

column1: Well Done! With success at Kursk we can resume the offensive in Russia.  Your troops have won a well-deserved rest Herr General!
column2: 干得好！随着库尔斯克(Kursk)得手，我们就能在俄国恢复攻势。你的部队赢得了一个当之无愧的休整，将军阁下！

column1: Herr General, though able to achieve some limited success, you did not show the initiative demanded of German field commanders.  You were expected to do more than merely follow orders. The Bolsheviks still defy us.
column2: 将军阁下，你虽取得了一些有限的成功，却没有展现出对德军战地指挥官所要求的主动性。你被期望做到的，不止是服从命令。布尔什维克仍在抗拒我们。

column1: General, welcome back.  We must move to defeat the last vestiges of Russian resistance.
column2: 将军，欢迎回来。我们必须行动，击败俄国抵抗的最后残余。

column1: The Soviets have assembled the best of their remaining forces around Voronezh.  Take your 1st SS PanzerKorps and finish them off!
column2: 苏军已在沃罗涅日(Voronezh)周边集结了他们残余部队中最精锐的部分。率你的党卫军第1装甲军去把他们解决掉！

column1: Attack immediately while the weather is good!
Fantastic Herr General, the remaining Russian forces are retreating in disarray from your assault.  Attack now, and seize Khar'kov before they can recover!
column2: 太棒了，将军阁下，残余的俄军正因你的突击而溃乱退却。现在就进攻，趁他们还没恢复，夺取哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)！

column1: Herr General, How could you have lost?

column2: 拿下哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)来挽回你自己。

column1: Herr General, that was a very close thing.
column2: 将军阁下，那次真是千钧一发。

column1: You must now quickly take Khar'kov before the Russians can regain the initiative.
column2: 你现在必须迅速拿下哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)，抢在俄国人夺回主动权之前。
你现在必须拿下哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)。

column1: Herr General, defeat these remaining Soviet forces.  We must have Khar'kov.
column2: 将军阁下，击败这些残余的苏军。我们必须得到哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)。

column1: Germany has defeated the Soviets soundly on all fronts, and soon we must turn our attention towards the west!
column2: 德国已在各条战线上彻底击败苏军，很快我们就必须把注意力转向西面！

column1: We have more battles for you to win!
column2: 我们还有更多的仗要你去打赢！

column1: Well done, Herr General!  We have stabilized the war in the east.
column2: 干得好，将军阁下！我们已稳住了东线的战局。

column1: Don't forget to stop in Berlin to collect your medal!
column2: 别忘了在柏林停留，领取你的勋章！

column1: Well we have Khar'kov.  However, the Russians still pose a threat.
column2: 好啊，我们拿下了哈尔科夫(Khar'kov)。不过，俄国人仍构成威胁。

column1: Yet the General Staff considers the Normandy situation the greater threat.
column2: 然而总参谋部认为诺曼底(Normandy)的局势是更大的威胁。

column1: Very good! Despite the fact the enemy has managed to force their way inland at other points, you have swept all before you. And because of this blow you have dealt them, the Allies will not be able to take advantage of their successes elsewhere. You have done very well, Herr General.
column2: 非常好！尽管敌人在其他地点已强行突入内陆，你却将当面之敌横扫一空。由于你给予他们的这记重击，盟军将无法利用其在别处的战果。你干得非常出色，将军阁下。

column1: Well done, Herr General.  You are Germany's most decorated commander!  Rest now, we have a winter counterattack in mind for you...
column2: 干得好，将军阁下。你是德国受勋最多的指挥官！现在休整吧，我们为你筹划了一场冬季反击……

column1: Well Herr General we have retaken Aachen.  I hope that there is sufficient time left for us to mount the winter counterattack we have in mind.
column2: 好啊，将军阁下，我们已重新夺回亚琛(Aachen)。我希望剩下的时间足够我们发动心里盘算的那场冬季反击。

column1: Well done, Herr General.  With Aachen in our hands we can proceed with our winter counterattack.
column2: 干得好，将军阁下。亚琛(Aachen)在我们手中，我们可以着手冬季反击了。

column1: Herr General, you and your 1st SS PanzerKorps will spearhead the winter offensive that will split the British and American forces in Western Europe.  If you succeed, they will sue for peace.  Your first objective is Liege, Good luck!
column2: 将军阁下，你和你的党卫军第1装甲军将充当冬季攻势的先锋，把西欧的英美军队一分为二。如果你成功，他们就会求和。你的第一个目标是列日(Liege)，祝好运！

column1: Herr General, the Allies are totally surprised.  The capture of Liege has provided a windfall of supplies.  Take your second objective now!
column2: 将军阁下，盟军完全措手不及。夺取列日(Liege)带来了意外的补给收获。现在去拿下你的第二个目标！

column1: Herr General, you are moving far ahead of schedule.  Excellent!  Start your next attack! Seize Antwerpen and end this war!
column2: 将军阁下，你的进展远超时间表。好极了！开始你的下一次进攻！夺取安特卫普(Antwerpen)，结束这场战争！

column1: Herr General, your failure to seize Bruxelles means the entire fate of Germany rests on one roll of the dice!
column2: 将军阁下，你未能夺取布鲁塞尔(Bruxelles)，这意味着德国的整个命运就押在一次掷骰上！

column1: Do not fail us at Antwerpen!
column2: 不要在安特卫普(Antwerpen)让我们失望！

column1: Herr General, With Bruxelles in our hands we are close to splitting the Allies
column2: 将军阁下，布鲁塞尔(Bruxelles)在我们手中，我们已接近把盟军一分为二

column1: You must seize Antwerpen before they can react.
column2: 你必须抢在他们反应过来之前夺取安特卫普(Antwerpen)。

column1: You have turned the tide of war against the Allies, Herr General, rest your army and make haste to Berlin, you must collect your Field Marshall's Baton!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你已扭转了对盟军作战的局势，让你的集团军休整，并速往柏林，你必须去领取你的元帅权杖！！！

column1: Germany lies prostrate at the feet of the Allies!
column2: 德国已匍匐在盟军脚下！

column1: You have turned the tide of war against the Allies, General, rest your army and make haste to Berlin, you must collect your Field Marshall's Baton!!!
column2: 将军，你已扭转了对盟军作战的局势，让你的集团军休整，并速往柏林，你必须去领取你的元帅权杖！！！

column1: Von Beck: Sir, the Americans are on the rampage, and we only have enough time to set up a defense perimeter.
column2: 冯·贝克(Von Beck)：长官，美国人正在横冲直撞，我们只来得及布置一道环形防线。

column1: Strock: Herr General, The Soviets are counterattacking in the direction of Kharkov. We have to stop them!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，苏军正向哈尔科夫(Kharkov)方向反击。我们必须挡住他们！

column1: Strock: Herr General, You have achieve a marvellous victory! It is almost a miracle! Kharkov is safe and our lines restored!. Good Job!!!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，你取得了了不起的胜利！这几乎是个奇迹！哈尔科夫(Kharkov)安全了，我们的战线也恢复了！干得好！！！

column1: This is a disaster!, the Brits have captured again Agedabia and Mersa el Brega, and now they are driving to Tripoli!!!. Obviously, you are dismissed.
column2: 这是一场灾难！英国人再次夺取了阿杰达比亚(Agedabia)与布埃尔加港(Mersa el Brega)，现在正向的黎波里(Tripoli)推进！！！。显然，你被解职了。

column1: Strock: Herr General, I need you to take some of General Heidrich's units and drive the British off of Cassino. You will also have some Italian units, Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，我需要你带上海德里希(Heidrich)将军的一部分部队，把英国人赶出卡西诺(Cassino)。你也会有一些意大利部队，祝好运。

column1: Strock: Excellent work! The Italians should not have to worry anymore about the Allies being on their soil. Now, you must hurry your men to France. You can take only some of your ground units and all of your Luftwaffe, and head to Normandy. The rest will go further north. I will brief you again when we get up there.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：干得漂亮！意大利人不必再担心盟军踏上他们的国土了。现在，你必须把你的部下急调往法国。你只能带上一部分地面部队和你的全部空军，前往诺曼底(Normandy)。其余的将开往更北面。等我们到了那里，我会再向你交代。

column1: Ja Wolfgang, I was as surprised as you that they chose Normandy.... Ah, Herr General, come in. Allow me to explain the present situation. We have a chance to drive the Allies back into the sea, here, near Caen. I will not pretend that this will be an easy task, but you have shown yourself to be a most resourceful fellow time and time again, ja? You will need all your skill to wrest a victory here. Our thoughts are with you. Ja, As I was saying, Wolfgang...
column2: 是的，沃尔夫冈(Wolfgang)，他们选择了诺曼底(Normandy)，我和你一样意外……啊，将军阁下，请进。容我解释一下当前的局势。我们有机会把盟军赶回海里去，就在这里，卡昂(Caen)附近。我不会假装这会是件容易的事，但你一次又一次证明自己是个极有办法的人，是吧？你需要用上全部本领才能在这里夺下一场胜利。我们挂念着你。是的，就像我刚才说的，沃尔夫冈……

column1: Strock: I hear that the infamous General Patton is commanding the American army that you are going up against. The Americans are trying to invade Germany through Lorraine. You should defeat him, Herr General.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：我听说，那个臭名昭著的巴顿(Patton)将军正指挥着你要对阵的美国集团军。美国人正试图穿过洛林(Lorraine)入侵德国。你应该击败他，将军阁下。

column1: von Beck: The Americans are on a rampage again, sir. They act as if we are raping their women and children. Anyway, we have little time to get set up before they arrive.
column2: 冯·贝克(von Beck)：美国人又在横冲直撞了，阁下。他们那副样子，就好像我们在糟蹋他们的妻儿。不管怎样，我们没多少时间在他们到达之前完成部署。

column1: Strock: Congratulations, Herr Feldmarschall! You have captured General Patton!. We now have an armistice signed, and all fighting can stop. The U.S. is very lucky to have General Patton. He's a very reasonable man. He was instrumental in helping to draft the armistice. And you, my friend, there's talk about renaming a city in your honor. Come now, let us celebrate!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：恭喜，元帅阁下！你俘获了巴顿(Patton)将军！我们现在已签署了停战协定，一切战斗都可以停止了。美国能有巴顿将军真是幸运。他是个非常通情达理的人。他在协助起草停战协定上起了关键作用。而你，我的朋友，有人在谈论要以你的名字给一座城市重新命名。来吧，让我们庆祝一下！

column1: Strock: Herr Feld-Marschall, the Soviets threaten Berlin. Zhukov is about to break the Oder Front and Konev has already broken the 3rd Panzer army lines in the South. You are the only one who can stop them !!! You are in the direct path of Konev. Feld Marschall Rommel came out of retirement to raise a Panzer Corps to slow down Zhukov.  He will try to buy some time for you. You should defeat Konev first and then Zhukov.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：元帅阁下，苏军威胁柏林。朱可夫(Zhukov)即将突破奥得河(Oder)防线，科涅夫(Konev)已突破南面的第3装甲集团军防线。只有你能挡住他们！！！你正处在科涅夫的正前方。隆美尔(Rommel)元帅已复出，组建了一个装甲军来迟滞朱可夫。他会尽力为你争取时间。你应当先击败科涅夫，再对付朱可夫。

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall.  You have achieved a complete victory. The Russians are in complete disarray. You have earned the gratitude of your people for all times !!!
column2: 元帅阁下。你取得了完全的胜利。俄国人已彻底溃乱。你永远赢得了你人民的感激！！！

column1: Glorius news Herr Feld-Marschall!!! Marshall Model has taken Breslau ejecting the Russians from Silesia and southern Poland.  It is your turn to purge of invaders the sacred soil of the Fatherland!!! Attack towards Konigsberg and the Baltic coast. End this war Herr Feld-Marschall!!! \x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00
column2: 光荣的消息，元帅阁下！！！莫德尔(Model)元帅已夺取布雷斯劳(Breslau)，把俄国人逐出西里西亚(Silesia)与波兰南部。现在轮到你肃清本土神圣土地上的入侵者了！！！向柯尼斯堡(Konigsberg)与波罗的海沿岸进攻。结束这场战争，元帅阁下！！！ \x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00

column1: The Western Allies land in Sicily. The Axis powers try to throw them into the sea.
column2: 西方盟军在西西里(Sicily)登陆。轴心国试图把他们赶下海去。

column1: Herr General the western allies have invaded Sicily. You have to throw them into the sea before is too late. The loyalty of our Italian allies is at stake!!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军已入侵西西里(Sicily)。你必须在为时未晚之前把他们赶下海去。我们意大利盟友的忠诚正处在危急关头！！！

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifice of your fine troops have been in vain. You have been ordered to Berlin. I do not envy your reception there.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾你精锐部队的牺牲成了徒劳。你已被命令前往柏林。我可不羡慕你在那里会受到什么接待。

column1: Herr General, your thrust to Strasbourg will be used as a textbook example of offensive maneuver. This lightning blow has changed the course of the war in the west.  Outstanding.
column2: 将军阁下，你向斯特拉斯堡的突击将被用作进攻机动的教科书范例。这一闪电般的打击改变了西线的战争进程。卓越。

column1: Excellent! The spy has been quickly extracted, and the area secured.  Soon we shall find out what he has learned over the past three months. The Germans are impressed with your tactics and are now calling you the "Blitzkrieg" General.
column2: 好极了！间谍已被迅速接出，该地区也已确保安全。很快我们就会查明他过去三个月学到了什么。德国人对你的战术印象深刻，现在都称你为「闪电战」将军。

column1: Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled.... You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 将军阁下，德国与苏联的外交代表此刻正在会谈……你在此地以及在西线取得的一连串胜利都是前所未有的......你将返回祖国，接受一个感恩的国家的欢迎。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your troops have successfully cleared a corridor to our comrades in Sixth Army. We will be able to continue to send reinforcements and supplies to our brave men.  Bravo.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下。你的部队成功打通了通往第6集团军战友们的走廊。我们将能够继续向勇敢的士兵们输送增援和补给。干得漂亮。

column1: Herr General, this is a disaster! Sixth Army is entirely lost to us.  Though this situation is not totally of your making, your career is obviously finished. You are dismissed.
column2: 将军阁下，这是一场灾难！第6集团军已彻底损失。尽管这一局面并不完全由你造成，你的仕途显然已经结束。你被解职。

column1: You have dealt the Red Army a crippling blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer a large number of  troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Superlative work, Herr General.
column2: 你已给红军一记毁灭性的打击。随着我们的战线缩短，我们将能把大量部队转调给斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的保卢斯(von Paulus)元帅。无与伦比的工作，将军阁下。

column1: You have dealt the Red Army a severe blow. With our line shortened, we will be able to transfer some troops to Feldmarschall von Paulus at Stalingrad. Good work, Herr General.
column2: 你给了红军沉重一击。随着我方战线缩短，我们将能抽调部分部队支援斯大林格勒的冯·保卢斯陆军元帅。干得好，将军阁下。

column1: At the same time the Allies are establishing a foothold near Salerno, German forces are trying to push the Allied invasion back out to sea.
column2: 当盟军在萨莱诺附近建立立足点时，德军正试图把盟军的入侵赶回海里。

column1: Kongratulieren!, our elite paratroopers have showed they skills again. The entrance of the Kanal is secured, the British won't be able to use it anymore to resupply their units in Egypt and the Middle East.
column2: 恭喜！我们的精锐伞兵再次展示了他们的本领。运河入口已得到确保，英国人再也无法利用它为埃及与中东的部队运送补给。

column1: ALLIES ON THE MARCH - US SIDE
Allies On The March - US Side

You act the role of a promising talent within the US Army. If successful, your career will cover the major theatres of operations during WW2, leaving your elite troops the hardest work on the way from Africa to the heart of the Third Reich. Then you will be challenged even more by a new 15 scenarios extra-campaign against the Soviets. 48 scenarios, a lot of new maps to play, increasing difficulty during the campaign: persuade Washington that you are the rising military leader of the United States Army!
column2: 你扮演美国陆军中一位前途无量的人才。如果成功，你的军旅生涯将覆盖二战期间各主要战区，最艰难的任务都留给你的精锐部队——从非洲直到第三帝国的心脏。随后，一场新的 15 个场景的对苏额外战役将给你更大的挑战。48 个场景、大量新地图可玩、战役难度递增：让华盛顿相信，你就是美国陆军中冉冉升起的军事领袖！

column1: You act the role of a promising talent within the US Army. If successful, your career will cover the major theatres of operations during WW2, leaving your elite troops the hardest work on the way from Africa to the heart of the Third Reich. [Then you will be challenged even more by a new 15 scenarios extra-campaign against the Soviets. 48 scenarios, a lot of new maps to play, increasing difficulty during the campaign: persuade Washington that you are the rising military leader of the United States Army!]
column2: 你扮演美国陆军中一位前途无量的人才。如果成功，你的军旅生涯将覆盖二战期间各主要战区，最艰难的任务都留给你的精锐部队——从非洲直到第三帝国的心脏。[随后，一场新的 15 个场景的对苏额外战役将给你更大的挑战。48 个场景、大量新地图可玩、战役难度递增：让华盛顿相信，你就是美国陆军中冉冉升起的军事领袖！]

column1: Welcome to Africa, commander! You have been selected to join the Patton Western Task Force in Operation Torch. A few part of your core force has just landed the Moroccan coast, but you'll have to debark quickly the rest of your army in order to accomplish successfully this
column2: 欢迎来到非洲，指挥官！你已被选入「火炬」行动(Operation Torch)中的巴顿(Patton)西部特混舰队。你的核心部队已有一小部分在摩洛哥(Moroccan)海岸登陆，但你必须迅速让其余部队下船，才能顺利完成这项

column1: mission. Casablanca is our ultimate objective: expect heavy resistance by the French only there. Also pay attention for the enemy vessels. Good luck.
column2: 任务。卡萨布兰卡(Casablanca)是我们的最终目标：只在那里才会遇到法国人的顽强抵抗。另外要留意敌方的舰艇。祝好运。

column1: Welcome to Africa, commander! You have been selected to join the Patton Western Task Force in Operation Torch. A few part of your core force has just landed the Moroccan coast, but you'll have to debark quickly the rest of your army in order to accomplish successfully this mission. Casablanca is our ultimate objective: expect heavy resistance by the French only there. Also pay attention for the enemy vessels. Good luck.
column2: 欢迎来到非洲，指挥官！你已被选入「火炬」行动(Operation Torch)中的巴顿(Patton)西部特混舰队。你的核心部队已有一小部分在摩洛哥(Moroccan)海岸登陆，但你必须迅速让其余部队下船，才能顺利完成这项任务。卡萨布兰卡(Casablanca)是我们的最终目标：只在那里才会遇到法国人的顽强抵抗。另外要留意敌方的舰艇。祝好运。

column1: This operation has been a toal fiasco from the start. The United States Army doesn't have the time or the patience to put up with such ineptitude. Do me a personal favor and get outta here. Dismissed!
column2: 这次行动从一开始就是一场彻底的惨败。美国陆军没有时间、也没有耐心容忍这种无能。帮我个私人忙，滚出去吧。解散！

column1: Commander, you got the job done.  Unfortunately, we lost a lot of GIs to accompplish this mission. Anyway you did your best, so you'll be given another chance to prove yourself.
column2: 指挥官，你把事情办成了。遗憾的是，为完成这次任务我们损失了许多美国兵。不管怎样，你已尽了全力，所以你会再得到一次证明自己的机会。

column1: Commander, Port Lyautey is the final objective for you here in Morocco. With this port in our hands, we'll be able to race to the east towards the Krauts in Tunisia. Once again you will be supported by our powerful ships and a small contingent of marines. You have to expect poor resistance from the French garrisons, by the way we are in a hurry. Do not waste your time!
column2: 指挥官，利奥泰港(Port Lyautey)是你在摩洛哥这里的最终目标。这个港口到手，我们就能向东疾进，直扑突尼斯(Tunisia)的德国佬。你这次仍将得到我们强大舰艇和一支小型陆战队分遣队的支援。法国守军的抵抗预料不会强，顺便说一句，我们时间紧迫。别浪费时间！

column1: Commander, this will certainly earn you another medal! The capture of Port Lyautey has been really an amazing job. Now we must race to the east towards the Krauts in Tunisia.
column2: 指挥官，这肯定会为你再赢得一枚勋章！夺取利奥泰港(Port Lyautey)真是件了不起的功绩。现在我们得向东疾进，直扑突尼斯(Tunisia)的德国佬。

column1: Well, your performance was not so good, commander, but you did your best and you will be given another chance to prove yourself. Good luck.
column2: 嗯，你的表现不算太好，指挥官，但你已尽了全力，你会再得到一次证明自己的机会。祝好运。

column1: You were brilliant! It is time to celebrate: the Axis has been totally defeated in Africa. Now I want you and your men to get some badly needed rest. Soon we will meet again.
column2: 你太出色了！该庆祝了：轴心国在非洲已被彻底击败。现在我要你和你的部下好好休整一下。我们很快会再见。

column1: I don't know a diplomatic way to say this, commander. Your performance has been really awful, you will not see again the battlefield for a long time!
column2: 我不知道该怎样委婉地说这件事，指挥官。你的表现真是糟透了，你很长时间内都不会再见到战场了！

column1: Well, what can I say?  You did manage to secure your objectives as well as capture a few  Jerries. A comparatively successful performance, commander, but you could do much better!
column2: 嗯，我还能说什么呢？你确实保住了你的目标，还抓了几个德国兵。算是比较成功的表现，指挥官，但你本可以干得好得多！

column1: Strock: Herr General, I want you to capture the political prisoners camps in Volchansk. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，我要你夺取沃尔昌斯克(Volchansk)的政治犯营。祝好运。

column1: Commander, you struck out here, and good men died because of it.  We're lucky the Krauts didn't kick us back to Morocco! I guess you need some time for rest and refit before coming back into service...
column2: 指挥官，你在这里彻底失败了，好男儿因此丧命。我们还算走运，德国佬没把我们踢回摩洛哥去！我想在重新服役之前，你需要一段时间休整与整补……

column1: Due to everyone's success in this campaign, the Russian push West has been stopped. Well done Herr General !!
column2: 由于大家在这场战役中的成功，俄国人向西的推进已被挡住。干得好，将军阁下！！

column1: Great great job, commander! We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose. The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
column2: 干得非常非常漂亮，指挥官！我们把你投进了一个烂摊子，你却全身而退、风光无限。战斗很艰苦，但你的小伙子们硬是撑住了。

column1: It's a pity, commander. It seems that the Desert Fox is still too tough for your boys. Do not be afraid, you will have another opportunity to show your talent.
column2: 很遗憾，指挥官。看来「沙漠之狐」对你的小伙子们来说还是太强硬了。别害怕，你还会有一个展示才华的机会。

column1: Good job, commander! We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose. The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
column2: 干得好，指挥官！我们把你投进了一个烂摊子，你却全身而退、风光无限。战斗很艰苦，但你的小伙子们硬是撑住了。

column1: We had restore all colonies of our ally and we control the whole Red Sea, but we have to gain another strong point controlled by the British: Mombasa.
column2: 我们已收复盟友的全部殖民地，并控制了整个红海，但我们必须再夺取一个由英国人控制的据点：蒙巴萨(Mombasa)。

column1: It's really a disgrace. You had everything you needed to win this battle, but you managed to lose. Report to HQ immediately!
column2: 真是丢人。你拥有打赢这一仗所需的一切，却还是输了。立刻到司令部报到！

column1: You were not as brilliant as we expected from you, but you did it at last. Now It is time to celebrate because the Axis has been totally defeated in Africa.
column2: 你并不像我们期望的那样出色，但你终究做到了。现在该庆祝了，因为轴心国在非洲已被彻底击败。
斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk) - 强渡第聂伯河(Dniepr) 1941年7月 TV

column1: You have successfully crossed the Dniepr, but you have lost valuable time. All chances of encircling the Russian forces are gone.
column2: 你已成功渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)，但你失去了宝贵的时间。合围俄军的一切机会都没有了。

column1: Remarkable job, commander. The Axis forces have been completely annihilated. Now let's keep the initiative to occupy fast all the island.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。轴心国部队已被彻底歼灭。现在让我们保持主动，迅速占领全岛。

column1: Shit, what a punishing loss! If we weren't so short of trained officers, you would be on your way back to the States right now.
column2: 妈的，这场败仗代价真惨重！要不是我们这么缺受过训练的军官，你现在已经在回国的路上了。

column1: You complete your mission on schedule, commander, but the Axis has been able to hit your landing forces much more than expected. Next time you should try to keep the casualties down.
column2: 指挥官，你按期完成了任务，但轴心国对你登陆部队的打击远超预期。下次你应当设法压低伤亡。

column1: You have been defeated, but at least you've tried. Now the allies has overrun the Gustav Line and you must retreat to the Gothic Line.
column2: 你已被击败，但至少你努力过。现在盟军已突破古斯塔夫防线，你必须退往哥特防线。

column1: Commander, you did a wonderful job in a tough situation. Your leadership was a key element in demolishing the Axis defences.
column2: 指挥官，你在艰难的处境中干得非常出色。你的领导是摧毁轴心国防线的关键因素。

column1: We really needed a knockout blow here, Commander. Instead, you put up a weak little jab. Our boys are fighters, son, but we need a general who can lead them!
column2: 指挥官，我们这里真正需要的是一记击倒对手的重拳。可你却只打出一记软弱的小刺拳。我们的士兵都是战士，孩子，但我们需要一个能带领他们的将军！

column1: Commander, the stubborn defence put up by the Nazi has been a sort of nightmare for your assaulting troops, but at last you did it. Now please rest and refit for a while.
column2: 指挥官，纳粹的顽固防御对你突击的部队来说简直是场噩梦，但你终究做到了。现在请休整与整补一段时间。

column1: Herr General: You achieved a great victory !!!. It will take a long time before the Russians can take the offensive here.
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了重大胜利！！！。俄国人要在这里发起攻势还得花很长时间。

column1: Commander, as you know Italy has just surrendered. In combination with the announcement of the armistice we have launched Operation Avalanche, our landing assault to the shores nearby the city of Salerno, not so far from Naples. Anyway, the Krauts look absolutely not surprised by the Italian surrender and our landing at Salerno. They have mustered a strong reaction force around our beachheads, so you will need all of your talent to survive the german counterattack, fortify your positions and then advance towards Naples. Good luck!
column2: 指挥官，如你所知，意大利刚刚投降。配合停战公告的宣布，我们已经发起了「雪崩」行动(Operation Avalanche)——在萨莱诺(Salerno)城附近、离那不勒斯(Naples)不远的海岸实施登陆突击。不管怎样，德国佬对意大利投降和我们在萨莱诺的登陆看起来一点也不意外。他们已在我们的滩头周围集结了一支强大的反击部队，所以你需要用上全部本领，挺过德军的反击，加固你的阵地，然后向那不勒斯推进。祝好运！

column1: Commander, as you know Italy has just surrendered. In combination with the announcement of the armistice we have launched Operation Avalanche, our landing assault to the shores nearby the city of Salerno, not far from Naples. Anyway, the Krauts look absolutely not surprised by the Italian surrender and our landing at Salerno. They have mustered a strong reaction force around our beachheads, so you will need all of your talent to survive the German counterattack, fortify your positions and then advance towards Naples. Good luck!
column2: 指挥官，如你所知，意大利刚刚投降。配合停战公告的宣布，我们已经发起了「雪崩」行动(Operation Avalanche)——在萨莱诺(Salerno)城附近、离那不勒斯(Naples)不远的海岸实施登陆突击。不管怎样，德国佬对意大利投降和我们在萨莱诺的登陆看起来一点也不意外。他们已在我们的滩头周围集结了一支强大的反击部队，所以你需要用上全部本领，挺过德军的反击，加固你的阵地，然后向那不勒斯推进。祝好运！

column1: The fighting on the beaches of Salerno was clearly too tough for your boys. Now we have a big problem here in southern Italy. You need a period of rest and refit, commander.
column2: 萨莱诺(Salerno)滩头的战斗对你的小伙子们来说显然太艰苦了。现在我们在意大利南部遇到了大麻烦。你需要一段休整与整补的时间，指挥官。

column1: The fighting on the beaches of Salerno was maybe too tough for your boys, commander, but you managed to win. Now you need a period of rest and refit.
column2: 指挥官，萨莱诺(Salerno)滩头的战斗对你的小伙子们来说也许太艰苦了，但你终究赢了。现在你需要一段休整与整补的时间。

column1: Good work, commander! Now, we've got men and machines rolling into central Italy. Next stop maybe is Rome. Nice going.
column2: 干得好，指挥官！现在，我们的人马与车辆正滚滚开进意大利中部。下一站也许就是罗马。干得不错。

column1: What a disaster! We thought the Germans were licked and they have been able to smash even your elite army. All the HQ is very disappointed.
column2: 真是一场灾难！我们以为德国人已被打垮，他们却连你的精锐集团军都能击溃。整个司令部都非常失望。

column1: At last you did it, commander, but we really paid too much. Next time try to limit the casualties using a better strategy on the battlefield.
column2: 指挥官，你终究做到了，但我们的代价实在太大。下次试着用更好的战场策略来限制伤亡。

column1: You have selected the path towards North Afrika, you will have to resist to increasingly powerful Allies.
column2: 你已选择了通往北非的道路，你将不得不抵抗越来越强大的盟军。

column1: Not bad, commander, but we're going to have to do better in the next one, or it's going to be a long war. Now you better rest and refit for a while.
column2: 不错，指挥官，但下一仗我们得干得更好，否则这场战争会拖得很长。现在你最好休整与整补一段时间。

column1: Herr General you achieved a magnificient victory against heavy odds. !!! The drive into Germany has been stopped !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你在极其不利的条件下取得了辉煌的胜利。！！！向德国境内的推进已被挡住！！！
勒热夫-维亚济马战役 1942年2月 失败

column1: The Russian 33rd Army was able to relieve the 39rd Army, 29th Army and the 11th Cavalry Corps. Instead of Russian troops, lots of German divisions are now trapped behind enemy lines.
column2: 俄军第33集团军成功解救了第39集团军、第29集团军和第11骑兵军。如今被困在敌后的不是俄军，而是大批德军师。

column1: Commander, congratulations and accolades on a mission well done! Your troops certainly gave the Germans everything that they deserved and more!
column2: 指挥官，祝贺你，并为你出色完成任务而致敬！你的部队确实给了德国人他们应得的一切，甚至更多！

column1: Strock: The General Staff is very unhappy with your lucklaster performance Herr General! You need to do better or you are going to be replaced!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：总参谋部对你的平庸表现非常不满，将军阁下！你得干得更好，否则就要被替换了！

column1: A spectacular victory, even against all odds! Looks like you might get another star for this one. I heard you were right up there with your boys!  Good job, good job, son.
column2: 一场壮观的胜利，而且是在极其不利的条件下！看来这一仗可能让你再添一颗星。我听说你一直和你的小伙子们一起在最前线！干得好，干得好，孩子。

column1: It's a shame, commander! After your disappointing performance it would be difficult to have you in the vicinity without choking on my crumpet.
column2: 真丢人，指挥官！在你这样令人失望的表现之后，要让你待在附近，我恐怕会被自己的烤面饼噎住。

column1: A good performance, commander, but the brass seems to think you could have moved a lot faster than you did. Don't worry, we'll get them next time.
column2: 表现不错，指挥官，但上面那些人似乎认为你本可以推进得快得多。别担心，下次我们收拾他们。

column1: A spectacular victory, even against all odds! Looks like you might get another star for this one. I heard you were right up there with your boys! Good job, good job, son.
column2: 一场壮观的胜利，而且是在极其不利的条件下！看来这一仗可能让你再添一颗星。我听说你一直和你的小伙子们一起在最前线！干得好，干得好，孩子。

column1: Brilliant Job, commander. The German defences at Cassino were very tough to crack, but you did it even faster than scheduled. Congratulations!
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。卡西诺(Cassino)的德军防线极难攻破，但你完成得比预定时间还快。恭喜！

column1: Getting past Cassino and beyond the Gustav Line was simply critical for this Italian campaign. Instead, we're still bogged down. There's no time for fooling around; we're going to have to go this thing all over again.
column2: 越过卡西诺(Cassino)并突破古斯塔夫防线，对这场意大利战役来说至关紧要。可我们却仍陷在原地。没时间瞎折腾了；我们只得把这件事从头再来一遍。

column1: Congratulations Herr General your victory here has stopped the Americans. Our African Army can now be evacuated to defend Southern Europe.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下，你在这里的胜利挡住了美国人。我们的非洲集团军现在可以撤出，去保卫南欧了。

column1: A properly planned amphibious assault, supported by massive naval
column2: 一场计划周密的登陆突击，若有强大的海军

column1: gunfire, was difficult if not impossible to repel. At Salerno, the Germans,
column2: 炮火支援，即便不是不可能击退，也是很难击退的。在萨莱诺(Salerno)，德国人

column1: who didn't know this, almost crushed the beachhead and might have
column2: 并不知道这一点，几乎碾碎了滩头阵地，而且只要

column1: done so with just slightly better luck.
column2: 运气稍好一点，他们本来也许就做到了。
斯大林格勒反击 - 1942年11月20日

column1: The German player tries to release the 6th Army encircled in Stalingrad.
column2: 德军玩家试图解救被合围在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的第6集团军。

column1: Herr General, we have underestimated the Bolsheviks' powers of resistance. They have crossed the Don and completely encircled Sixth Army. You must drive on Kletskaya and Serafimov to reestablish contact. We will never, never surrender to the Red Army, but in order for us to hold our position, you must prevail. Good Luck.                                                    \x00
column2: 将军阁下，我们低估了布尔什维克的抵抗能力。他们已渡过顿河(Don)，将第6集团军彻底合围。你必须向克列茨卡亚(Kletskaya)与谢拉菲莫维奇(Serafimov)推进，以恢复联系。我们绝不、绝不向红军投降；但要守住阵地，你必须取胜。祝好运。                                                    \x00

column1: The Axis powers try to recover Pantelleria island taken by the Western Allies.
column2: 轴心国试图夺回被西方盟军占领的潘泰莱里亚岛(Pantelleria)。

column1: Strock: Herr General The Western Allies have taken the island of Pantelleria outside the cost of Africa.  It is a direct threat to Sicily !!! You have to retake it.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，西方盟军已夺取非洲海岸外的潘泰莱里亚岛(Pantelleria)。这是对西西里(Sicily)的直接威胁！！！你必须把它夺回来。

column1: The Axis powers try to stop the Western Allies drive into Tunis.
column2: 轴心国试图阻止西方盟军向突尼斯(Tunis)推进。

column1: Strock: Herr General the Americans have invaded Africa.  You should help the Afrika Korps to hold the line. A defeat there will threaten Italy directly.
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，美国人已入侵非洲。你应当帮助非洲军守住防线。那里一败，意大利将直接受到威胁。

column1: The Russians break the Axis troops front in the Don river. The Germans counterattack to restore the front.
column2: 俄国人在顿河(Don)突破轴心国部队的战线。德军反击以恢复战线。

column1: Strock: Herr General you have an opportunity to clear yourself. The Russians have broken our allies front accross the Don river. You should restore the situation !!!
column2: 施特罗克(Strock)：将军阁下，你有一个洗清自己的机会。俄国人已在顿河(Don)对岸突破我们盟友的战线。你应当恢复局势！！！

column1: The Germans try to rescue Mussolini jailed in the Abruzzi.
column2: 德国人试图营救被囚于阿布鲁佐(Abruzzi)的墨索里尼(Mussolini)。

column1: Herr General the General Staff has orderred Mussolini to be release from prison at all costs. We are assemblying a especial team to do the job. I was thinking of that ex-SS officer that serves under you. Otto Skorzeny is his name I believe...
column2: 将军阁下，总参谋部已下令不惜一切代价把墨索里尼(Mussolini)从狱中救出。我们正在组建一支特别小队来完成这件事。我想到了在你手下服役的那个前党卫军军官。我记得他叫奥托·斯科尔兹内(Otto Skorzeny)……
墨索里尼营救 (#5 下部)

column1: The Russians try to cross the Kerch straits to invade Crimea.
column2: 俄国人试图渡过刻赤海峡(Kerch straits)入侵克里米亚(Crimea)。

column1: Herr General you dealt a mighty blow to the Russians.  We will have a quiet Southern front for a long time.
column2: 将军阁下，你给了俄国人一记沉重的打击。南线将长久平静了。
穆齐奥·阿滕多洛号轻巡洋舰
德国 埃马努埃莱·佩萨尼奥号
德国 莱布雷希特·马斯号
希佩尔海军上将号巡洋舰
轻巡洋舰 让·德·维埃纳号(Jean De Vienne)
齐柏林伯爵号航空母舰

column1: Good work by your elite division Bob.
column2: 你的精锐师干得好，鲍勃(Bob)。

column1: With the help of the 14th Armoured Division all the town is in our hands now and some prisoners were taken.
column2: 在第14装甲师协助下，全城现在已在我们手中，还抓了一些俘虏。

column1: The Russians attack Zhitomir trying to break the link between Army Groups Center and South.
column2: 俄国人进攻日托米尔(Zhitomir)，试图切断中央与南方两个集团军群之间的联系。

column1: Herr General the Russians are trying to break in the northern part of Army Group South. If they succeed the link between Army Groups Center and South will be broken. Gomel is threatened. Stop them before is too late !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正试图在南方集团军群北段实现突破。一旦得手，中央与南方两个集团军群之间的联系就会被切断。戈梅利(Gomel)受到威胁。在为时未晚之前挡住他们！！！

column1: The Germans try to eliminate the Kursk bulge.
column2: 德国人试图消除库尔斯克(Kursk)突出部。

column1: Herr General, you got to break through the Soviet's iron grip and seize the city of Kursk. Good luck !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你必须打破苏军的铁腕掌控，夺取库尔斯克(Kursk)城。祝好运！！！

column1: The Russians try to cross the Dniepr river. It is the last great geographical barrier to German controlled territory.
column2: 俄国人试图渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)。这是通往德军控制区最后一道巨大的地理屏障。

column1: Herr General, The Russians are trying to cross the Dnepr river, the last barrier to Western Ukraine. You should prevented this. You will need your bridging units !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正试图渡过第聂伯河(Dnepr)，这是通往西乌克兰(Ukraine)的最后一道屏障。你应当阻止这件事。你会需要你的架桥部队！！！

column1: During the Zitadelle Operation the Russians took Orel. The Germans try to recover the city after their success in Zitadelle.
column2: 在「堡垒」行动(Operation Zitadelle)期间，俄国人夺取了奥廖尔(Orel)。德国人在「堡垒」得手之后试图夺回该城。

column1: Herr General, the Russians during Operation Zitadelle took the Orel Bulge. After your victory there you need to retake Orel to stabilize Army Group Center front.
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人在「堡垒」行动(Operation Zitadelle)期间夺取了奥廖尔突出部。你在那里取胜之后，需要夺回奥廖尔(Orel)，以稳住中央集团军群的战线。

column1: The Russians isolate a German Infantry Corps in Cherkassy, Ukraine.  The Germans counterattack to break the encirclement.
column2: 俄国人在乌克兰(Ukraine)的切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)孤立了一个德军步兵军。德军反击以打破合围。

column1: Herr General the Russians are attacking Army Group Northen Ukraine. A reinforced infantry Corps is encircled in Cherkassy.  You have to break the circle and release these troops !!!
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正在进攻北乌克兰集团军群。一个得到加强的步兵军在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)被合围。你必须打破包围圈，解救这些部队！！！

column1: The Russians try to expel the Germans from Western Ukraine. The action starts after they have broken the German front.
column2: 俄国人试图把德国人逐出西乌克兰(Western Ukraine)。行动在他们突破德军战线之后开始。

column1: Herr General the I and II Ukrainian Fronts have broken our lines in the Ukraine. Kiev the Ukraine capital is threatened.  Several of our garrisons are isolated.  You have to stop them !!!
column2: 将军阁下，乌克兰第1与第2方面军已突破我们在乌克兰(Ukraine)的战线。乌克兰首都基辅(Kiev)受到威胁。我们有几处守备部队已被孤立。你必须挡住他们！！！
塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)撤退 - 1944年5月17日

column1: The Germans and Romanians fight desperately to gain time for the 17th Army to evacuate Sevastopol.
column2: 德国人与罗马尼亚人拼死苦战，为第17集团军撤离塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)争取时间。

column1: Herr General the 17th Army is in a completely desperate position inside Sevastopol. It is surrounded by overwhelmingly superior Russian forces. We organized an evacuation, but we need time desperately to be successful.
column2: 将军阁下，第17集团军在塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)城内已陷入完全绝望的境地。它被占压倒性优势的俄国军队包围。我们组织了一次撤退，但要成功，我们迫切需要时间。

column1: Note: This is a very difficult scenario, victory is achieved only by a careful combination of factors.  Speed is essential. Think carefully.
column2: 注意：这是一个非常困难的场景，只有把各种因素精心结合起来才能取胜。速度至关紧要。仔细思考。

column1: The Germans counterattack to destroy the Allies beachheads.
column2: 德军反击，以摧毁盟军的滩头阵地。

column1: Herr General, the Western Allies have landed in Normandy. We need to drive them to the sea !!!
column2: 将军阁下，西方盟军已在诺曼底(Normandy)登陆。我们得把他们赶下海去！！！

column1: The Russians defeated the Finns at Viipuri. A combined German-Finnish Army counterattacks to recover Viipuri.
column2: 俄国人在维堡(Viipuri)击败了芬兰人。一支德芬联军反击，以夺回维堡。

column1: Herr General bad news. The Russians have defeated the Finnish at Viipuri !!!. If we do not successfully counterattack Finland will sue for peace. We count on you Herr General !!!
column2: 将军阁下，坏消息。俄国人在维堡(Viipuri)击败了芬兰人！！！。如果我们不能成功反击，芬兰将会求和。我们指望你了，将军阁下！！！

column1: The Russians invade the Baltic states and Northern Poland. The Germans try to stop their onslaught.
column2: 俄国人入侵波罗的海各国与波兰北部。德国人试图挡住他们的猛攻。

column1: Herr General, the 1st and 2nd Belorussian Fronts threaten Vilna, Riga and the Reich itself in East Prussia. You should defend the sacred soil of the Fatherland!!!
column2: 将军阁下，白俄罗斯第1与第2方面军威胁维尔纳(Vilna)、里加(Riga)，以及东普鲁士(East Prussia)的本土本身。你应当保卫本土的神圣土地！！！

column1: The Germans attack to cut the Western Allies Front in two.  Bastogne and St. Vith are their objectives.
column2: 德军发起进攻，以把西方盟军的战线切成两段。巴斯托涅(Bastogne)与圣维特(St. Vith)是他们的目标。

column1: Herr General : Pardon me ! Herr Feld-Marschall.  The Americans have created an opening in their advance toward the Reich border. You should cut their lines and reach Antwerp on the channel coast.
column2: 将军阁下：请原谅！元帅阁下。美国人向本土边境的推进中露出了一个缺口。你应当切断他们的交通线，直抵海峡海岸的安特卫普(Antwerp)。

column2: Loading Scen: K:\\Games\\PeG-WW2\\SCENARIO\\BoB_BoB05.SCN - Map file: [K:\\Games\\PeG-WW2\\scenario\\CARENTAN.MAP] not found

column1: The Germans attack the American and French forces near Strasbourg.
column2: 德军进攻斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)附近的美军与法军部队。

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall. You should complete the job by defeating the Americans in the Southern part of the front. Strasbourg should be retaken!!!
column2: 元帅阁下。你应当击败战线南段的美国人，把这件事做完。斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)应当被夺回！！！

column1: The Hungarian capital of Budapest is besieged by the Red Army.  The Germans must break through the Soviet lines to help their last remaining ally and repel the soviets.
column2: 匈牙利首都布达佩斯(Budapest)正被红军围困。德军必须突破苏军防线，帮助他们最后剩下的盟友并击退苏军。

column1: Herr General the Russians are besieging Budapest. We need to relieve the city or the Hungarians will abandon the war.
column2: 将军阁下，俄国人正在围困布达佩斯(Budapest)。我们得解该城之围，否则匈牙利人会放弃这场战争。

column1: The Russians have isolated Budapest the Hungarian Capital. The Germans counterattack to break the ring surrounding the City.
column2: 俄国人已孤立匈牙利首都布达佩斯(Budapest)。德军反击，以打破围住该城的包围圈。

column1: Herr General: The 3rd Ukrainian Front has completed surrounded Budapest. The Hungarians and some of our troops resist bravely inside the city.  They can not hold for long. Relieve them Herr General!!!
column2: 将军阁下：乌克兰第3方面军已完成对布达佩斯(Budapest)的包围。匈牙利人和我们的一些部队正在城内英勇抵抗。他们撑不了多久。去解救他们，将军阁下！！！

column1: The Russians attack the German Capital from the East and South.  Germans try desperately to stop the Russian onslaught.
column2: 俄国人从东面和南面进攻德国首都。德国人拼死试图挡住俄国的猛攻。

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall.  The Russians threaten Berlin. Zhukov is about to break the Oder Front and Konev has already broken the 3rd Panzer army lines in the South. You are the only one who can stop them !!! You are in the direct path of Konev.  Feld Marschall Rommel came out of retirement to raise a Panzer Corps to slow down Zhukov.  He will try to buy some time for you. You should defeat Konev first and then Zhukov.
column2: 元帅阁下。俄国人威胁柏林。朱可夫(Zhukov)即将突破奥得河(Oder)防线，科涅夫(Konev)已突破南面的第3装甲集团军防线。只有你能挡住他们！！！你正处在科涅夫的正前方。隆美尔(Rommel)元帅已复出，组建了一个装甲军来迟滞朱可夫。他会尽力为你争取时间。你应当先击败科涅夫，再对付朱可夫。

column1: The Germans try to liberate Eastern Germany and the Baltic coast from the Russian occupation. Objectives: Danzig, Konisberg and Memel.
column2: 德国人试图把东德与波罗的海沿岸从俄国占领下解放出来。目标：但泽(Danzig)、柯尼斯堡(Konisberg)与梅梅尔(Memel)。

column1: Glorius news Herr Feld-Marschall!!! Marschal Model has taken Breslau ejecting the Russians from Silesia and southern Poland.  It is your turn to purge of invaders the sacred soil of the Fatherland!!! Attack towards Konigsberg and the Baltic coast. End this war Herr Feld-Marschall!!!
column2: 光荣的消息，元帅阁下！！！莫德尔(Model)元帅已夺取布雷斯劳(Breslau)，把俄国人逐出西里西亚(Silesia)与波兰南部。现在轮到你肃清本土神圣土地上的入侵者了！！！向柯尼斯堡(Konigsberg)与波罗的海沿岸进攻。结束这场战争，元帅阁下！！！

column1: This 16 scenarios long linear campaign is designed for skilled players whereas the 31 scenario long "Reich defense" campaign (17 scenarios longest path) is easier and includes what if scenarios. Both campaigns were designed in order to enhance original SSI "Defending the Reich" campaign.
column2: 这条 16 个场景的线性战役是为熟练玩家设计的，而 31 个场景的「帝国保卫战」战役（最长路径 17 个场景）则较容易，并包含假想场景。两场战役都是为了扩充 SSI 原版「帝国保卫战」战役而设计的。

column1: The Western Allies, with the help of the newly formed German Territorial Force, have recaptured Berlin, and are attempting to drive the Soviets back across the Oder.
column2: 西方盟军在新组建的德国国土防卫部队协助下已重新夺回柏林，并正试图把苏军赶回奥得河(Oder)对岸。

column1: This campaign follows the battles of the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment of the US 101st Airborne Division from D Day to VE Day.
column2: 这场战役记述美国第101空降师第506伞降步兵团从诺曼底登陆日(D Day)到欧战胜利日(VE Day)的战斗历程。

column1: You play as the Regimental Commander:

column2: 罗伯特·F·辛克(Robert F Sink)上校。

column1: I'm surprised that your men have let you down this way Bob, maybe they are not yet ready for action.
column2: 我很意外你的部下竟然这样让你失望，鲍勃(Bob)，也许他们还没准备好上阵。
沃拉-克日什托福尔斯卡

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall the USA Capital is in front of you. The American resistance is extremely tough, but you should prevail!!! End this war Herr Feld-Marschall!!!
column2: 元帅阁下，美国首都就在你眼前。美国人的抵抗极其顽强，但你应该能取胜！！！结束这场战争，元帅阁下！！！

column1: Due to heavy flak and pilot error your troops were scattered and now they face the difficult task of forming up in time for your next mission. Good Luck.
column2: 由于猛烈的防空炮火和飞行员失误，你的部队被散落各处，现在他们面临着一项艰难的任务：及时集结起来，为你的下一次任务做好准备。祝好运。

column1: Our fortune has changed, a massive soviet counter-offensive has destroyed our army and invaded Poland as well as East-Prussia.
column2: 我们的运气变了，一场大规模的苏军反攻摧毁了我们的集团军，并侵入了波兰与东普鲁士(East-Prussia)。

column1: Three Soviet armies attack on Dubno and Lutsk cities. Your forces must bring a stop to Ivan.
column2: 三个苏军集团军进攻杜布诺(Dubno)与卢茨克(Lutsk)两城。你的部队必须制止伊万(Ivan)。

column1: I'm impressed.  Boy, you really earned your pay.  Now we've got some elbow room, which means we can get to work liberating France. Commander, I've got a special job for you. We need you over in Caen. The Krauts have really dug in there and we need someone who can kick some tail so we can get a move on.
column2: 我很佩服。好小子，你真对得起你的军饷。现在我们有了些回旋余地，这意味着我们可以动手解放法国了。指挥官，我有个特别任务给你。我们需要你去卡昂(Caen)。德国佬在那里真的挖壕固守了，我们需要一个能踢他们屁股的人，好让我们继续推进。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, this triumph is a fitting end to our Southern campaign.  Once again your skill has led to victory, and more importantly, you have prevented the Americans from using their "Atomic Bomb."  Their research facility is a gutted ruin.  It is most extraordinary that you were able to capture Knoxville despite this distraction.  We must hope that only one such facility exists.
column2: 元帅阁下，这场大捷为我们的南方战役画上了恰如其分的句号。你的才华再一次带来了胜利，更重要的是，你阻止了美国人使用他们的「原子弹」。他们的研究设施已成一片焦土废墟。即便有这等牵制，你仍能攻占诺克斯维尔，实属非凡。我们只能寄望于这样的设施只有一处。

column1: Congratulations on your Regiment's success!! We have protected the beach-head and also cleared up a significant pocket of resistance. Well done!
column2: 恭喜你的团取得成功！！我们守住了滩头阵地，还肃清了一个不小的抵抗包围圈。干得好！

column1: Once again your mistakes heve been covered, this time by the 4th Infantry Division. We will be looking for much improvement if you are to keep your post Bob!!!!
column2: 你的错误又一次被掩盖了，这次是第4步兵师替你兜的。如果你想保住你的职位，我们期待你有大得多的进步，鲍勃(Bob)！！！！

column1: Commander, you have been a disappointment to King and country.  It was necessary to drive through Metz and move on, but instead, we find ourselves sandbagged in the trenches!  Our brave lads will capture Metz, I assure you, but it will be done with a different commander.  Good day.
column2: 指挥官，你让国王与国家失望了。本来必须穿过梅斯(Metz)继续推进，可我们却发现自己被沙袋堵在战壕里动弹不得！我向你保证，我们勇敢的小伙子们会拿下梅斯(Metz)，但那将由另一位指挥官来完成。日安。
科尔孙-舍甫琴科夫斯基

column1: So the snipers scared off your men Bob?? Well luckily the 401st GIB took your objective for you. Now we can attack over the river.
column2: 这么说狙击手把你的部下吓跑了，鲍勃(Bob)？？还好第401滑翔步兵团替你拿下了目标。现在我们可以渡河进攻了。

column1: Although your men failed to take their objective the 502nd PIR and 401st GIR did the job for you. The 101st Division has captured the strategically important town of Carentan and now we can link with the assault force coming inland from Omaha Beach.
column2: 尽管你的部下未能夺取目标，第502伞降步兵团与第401滑翔步兵团替你完成了任务。第101师已夺取具有战略意义的卡朗唐(Carentan)镇，现在我们可以与从奥马哈滩(Omaha Beach)向内陆推进的突击部队会合了。
「台风」行动——维亚济马 失败

column1: You were lucky 2nd Pz and 10th Pz divisions captured your targets. Vayzma and Gzhatsk are in our hands now. Again 100,000s of Russians are trapped in pockets behind our lines. Partisan activity makes it increasingly difficult to operate from the airfields close to the front (That's why the airfields did not offer resupply). Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target. Let's hope we have not lost too much time. Intelligence reports Siberian troops have arrived at the front already.
column2: 你运气不错，第2装甲师与第10装甲师夺取了你的目标。维亚济马(Vayzma)与格扎茨克(Gzhatsk)现在都在我们手中。又有数十万俄国人被困在我们战线后方的包围圈里。游击队活动使我们在靠近前线的机场起降越来越困难（这就是那些机场不提供补给的原因）。现在是向东推进的时候了。目标是莫斯科(Moscow)。但愿我们没有浪费太多时间。情报报告说，西伯利亚部队已经抵达前线。

column1: So far so good Bob!! Although not all the objectives were taken we will be bulstered by the assistance of the 30th Corps for the next stage of operations.
column2: 到目前为止一切顺利，鲍勃(Bob)！！尽管并非所有目标都被夺取，但在下一阶段作战中，我们将因第30军的协助而得到增强。

column1: Although not all our objectives were taken and/or held we are confident that with more of the 2nd Armies tanks and heavy weapons moving north that the operation can still be successful.
column2: 尽管我们并非所有目标都被夺取和／或守住，但我们相信，随着第2集团军更多的坦克与重武器北调，这次行动仍能成功。

column1: Although you held open parts of the road, the British 1st Airborne Division was devastated at Arnhem. The battle has not been declared a total failure, but we doubt the Airborne Divisions will be used in this capacity again in this war.
column2: 尽管你守住了部分道路，英国第1空降师还是在阿纳姆(Arnhem)被重创。此战尚未被宣布为彻底失败，但我们怀疑空降师在这场战争中不会再以这种规模投入使用了。

column1: Although your Regiment didn't hold the line successfully the Germans have been held along the rest of the northern front line and we are in a good position to strike a blow to the heart of the Third Reich.
column2: 尽管你的团未能成功守住防线，德国人在北面其余战线上都被挡住了，我们正处于有利位置，可以对第三帝国的心脏发起打击。
基辅合围——科诺托普 1941年9月 战术胜利

column1: 600,000 Bolsjeviks are trapped in the Kiev pocket, but we lost valuable time. Send your troops back North for the final assault on Moscow. And don't give me any excuses, I know the raspoetitsa - the dreaded Fall rains - have set in. This will disrupt mobility but we do need to reach Moscow before the winter.
column2: 60万布尔什维克被困在基辅包围圈中，但我们浪费了宝贵的时间。把你的部队调回北方，准备对莫斯科的最后突击。别给我找任何借口，我知道「泥泞季」——那可怕的秋雨——已经来了。这会影响机动，但我们必须在入冬前抵达莫斯科。

column1: Although you failed to make it to Bastogne in time the German attack has faultered and we are on the offensive once more.
column2: 尽管你没能及时赶到巴斯托涅(Bastogne)，德军的进攻已经动摇，我们又转入了攻势。
「海狮」行动训练 1940年8月 胜利

column1: This exercise seriously got out of control. Apparently these spaghetti eaters misinterpreted their orders. Congratulations for completing this exercise with reasonable success.
column2: 这场演习严重失控。显然意大利人曲解了他们的命令。恭喜你相当成功地完成了演习。

column1: Thankfully you were able to hold out long enough for the 4th Armoured Division to breakthrough and relieve you.
column2: 幸好你坚守得够久，第4装甲师得以突破并解了你的围。

column1: Unfortunately you have no time to rest as we still need your troops to help push back the German front.
column2: 遗憾的是你没有时间休整，因为我们仍需要你的部队协助把德军战线推回去。

column1: Sorry to hear that most of your men were either killed or captured Bob. I hope they are comfortable in their POW camp until we can liberate them.
column2: 听说你的部下大多非死即俘，我很遗憾，鲍勃(Bob)。我希望他们在战俘营里过得舒服，直到我们能把他们解救出来。

column1: Thanks to our combined divsions the Germans are on the run now!!
column2: 多亏了我们各师的合力，德国人现在正在逃窜！！

column1: Congratulations on your capture of Vyborg. The Finns have sued for peace, but they have declared neutrality and will maintain their archaic capitalist system.  And now, if you will excuse me, I have work to do.
column2: 恭喜你夺取维堡(Vyborg)。芬兰人已求和，但他们宣布中立，并将维持其陈旧的资本主义制度。那么现在，恕我失陪，我还有工作要做。

column1: The southern half of Haguenau is in our hands now and we are poised to enter the Reich.
column2: 阿格诺(Haguenau)的南半部现在已在我们手中，我们已准备好进入本土。

column1: With the help of the 14th Armoured Division all the town and several other villages are now in our hands and many prisoners were taken.
column2: 在第14装甲师协助下，全城以及其他几个村庄现在都在我们手中，还抓了许多俘虏。

column1: All the town is in our hands now and we are poised to enter the Reich.
column2: 全城现在已在我们手中，我们已准备好进入本土。

column1: So you have joined your men behind barbed wire Bob!!
column2: 这么说你也和你的部下一起进了铁丝网后面，鲍勃(Bob)！！

column1: Looks like the war is over for you!!
column2: 看来这场战争对你来说已经结束了！！

column1: You failed to cutoff Berlin making Monty's job significantly harder.
column2: 你未能切断柏林，这让蒙蒂(Monty)的任务难度大增。

column1: He got the job done but I wouldn't go visit our English friends for a while
column2: 他把事情办成了，但要是我，我短时间内不会去拜访我们的英国朋友
侦察排/党卫军第1装甲师
工兵排/党卫军第1装甲师

column1: With the help of the 14th Armoured Division all the town is in our hands now and many prisoners were taken.
column2: 在第14装甲师协助下，全城现在已在我们手中，还抓了许多俘虏。

column1: It looks as if your Division won't be needed in the Pacific theatre after all so let your men relax and enjoy some time in Austria.
column2: 看来你的师毕竟不需要去太平洋战区了，所以让你的部下放松一下，在奥地利(Austria)享享清闲吧。
诺曼底登陆日(D Day)。登陆。
大致位置 空降场 C
大致位置 空降场 D

column1: Take all your objectives by Paradrop, split your force to deal with the obectives simultaneously.
column2: 以伞降夺取你所有的目标，分散你的兵力以便同时处理各目标。

column1: Remember to go easy on the "Tommies" as they are our allies!!
column2: 记住对「英国佬」手下留情，因为他们是我们的盟友！！

column1: Please purchase no new units unless replacing lost ones.
column2: 除非替换损失的单位，请不要购买新单位。

column1: Herr General,  it is your privilege to lead our attack here, south of Novgorod, in the Russian heartland.  A successful offensive here will sever communications between Moscow and Leningrad and trap several Soviet armies. It is, of course, imperative to take your objectives quickly.  Our thoughts are with you.

column1: The battle plan is as follows:-
The British 1st Airborne Division is to land on the clear ground northwest of Arnhem, protect this dropzone for the 2nd drop tomorrow and advance towards Arnhem.
column2: 英国第1空降师将在阿纳姆(Arnhem)西北的开阔地着陆，为明天的第2次空投保护这个空降场，并向阿纳姆推进。

column1: The US 82nd Airborne Division is to land at 2 drop zones, the 504th south of Nijmegan to capture the north and south bridges and the 505th to land near Grave and capture the Grave bridge and protect their dropzone in preperation for Glider-borne reinforcement.
column2: 美国第82空降师将在两个空降场着陆：第504团在奈梅亨(Nijmegan)以南夺取南北两座桥，第505团在赫拉弗(Grave)附近着陆，夺取赫拉弗桥并保护其空降场，为滑翔机增援做准备。

column1: The US 101st Airborne Division is to land at 2 drop zones, the 501st south of Veghal to take the canal bridge, and the 506th to land north of Eindhoven to take the northern bridges, protect the dropzone for Glider-borne reinforcement and enter the city, then to hold the road open for the 30th Corps' advance.
column2: 美国第101空降师将在两个空降场着陆：第501团在费赫尔(Veghal)以南夺取运河桥，第506团在埃因霍温(Eindhoven)以北着陆，夺取北面的各座桥梁，保护空降场以便滑翔机增援，并进入该城，随后守住道路以保障第30军推进。

column1: The British 1st AB will continue it's assault on Arnhem with the objective being to capture and hold the northern end of the bridge until it can be reinforced by Paradrop and Gliders. They must also hold their Drop Zone.
column2: 英国第1空降师将继续其对阿纳姆(Arnhem)的突击，目标是夺取并守住大桥北端，直到能由伞降与滑翔机增援。他们还必须守住自己的空降场。

column1: The US 82nd AB is to hold Nijmegan, the Grave bridge and their Drop Zones. Assault boats will be delivered as soon as possible to allow the 504th to cross the Maas river upstream and attack the north end of the bridge while the 30th Corps attacks from the south. The 82nd AB is not permitted to advance beyond the northern end of Nijmegan bridge.
column2: 美国第82空降师要守住奈梅亨(Nijmegan)、赫拉弗桥(Grave bridge)及其空降场。突击舟将尽快送达，使第504团得以在马斯河(Maas)上游渡河，在第30军从南面进攻的同时攻击大桥北端。第82空降师不得越过奈梅亨桥北端继续推进。

column1: The US 101st AB is to hold the road between Eindhoven and Grave open at all costs. Also the Veghel bridge,and their two Drop Zones. Engineers are working on a temporary bridge at Son which will allow the 30th Corps to continue it's advance. The 101st AB is not permitted to advance beyond Grave.
column2: 美国第101空降师必须不惜一切代价保持埃因霍温(Eindhoven)与赫拉弗(Grave)之间的道路畅通，还要守住费赫尔桥(Veghel bridge)及其两个空降场。工兵正在松村(Son)架设一座临时桥梁，以便第30军继续推进。第101空降师不得越过赫拉弗继续推进。

column1: Send a Recon and Engineeer group into the southern side of Haguenau and eliminate any defences you find there. The rest of your regiment will follow when the way is clear.
