column1: There are plenty of Germans in the area and they will defend their homeland fanatically so be prepared for tough house to house fighting.
column2: 该地区有大量德军，他们会狂热地保卫自己的家乡，所以要准备好打艰苦的逐屋战斗。

column1: Deploy 2 Engineers, 1 Recon and an Infantry unit of your choice. Put your 3 Infantry units in 1/2 tracks.
column2: 部署2个工兵、1个侦察单位以及1个由你选择的步兵单位。把你的3个步兵单位装上半履带车。

column1: Bob you have been given the task of rescuing your captured men from the temporary camp we believe they are being held in. Our intelligence suggests that the camp is in a large open area South-east of your Battalion HQ's. I can't stress enough how dangerous this mission is and that you will be completely cut off from our lines. You must absolutely reach the objective located somewhere within the Camp area.
column2: 鲍勃(Bob)，你已被赋予一项任务：从我们认为关押着你被俘部下的临时战俘营中把他们救出来。我们的情报表明，该营地位于你各营部东南的一片开阔地带。这项任务有多危险，以及你将与我们的战线完全隔绝，我怎么强调都不为过。你必须务必抵达位于营地范围内某处的目标。

column1: As a reward for you Divisions' couragous efforts in this war, you have been given the priviledge of taking the ultimate prize- Hitler's mountain home 'Berchtesgaden'.
column2: 作为对你师在这场战争中英勇奋战的奖赏，你获得了夺取终极战利品的殊荣——希特勒的山间宅邸「贝希特斯加登(Berchtesgaden)」。

column1: Cross the canal at the lock near Bad Reichenhall follow the road through the mountains and assault the complex to capture the Nazi flag and claim your prize.
column2: 在巴特赖兴哈尔(Bad Reichenhall)附近的船闸处过运河，沿山路前进，突击该建筑群，夺取纳粹旗帜，领取你的战利品。

column1: Watch out for the fanatical SS men who will do everything to stop you.
column2: 当心那些狂热的党卫军，他们会不惜一切阻止你。

column1: Send your Regiment into the northern side of Haguenau and eliminate any defences you find there. If any targets become available to the north of Haguenau you are given permission to take them out.
column2: 派你的团进入阿格诺(Haguenau)北侧，消灭你在那里发现的任何防御。如果阿格诺以北出现任何目标，你获准将其清除。

column1: There are reports of many Germans in the area and they will defend their homeland fanatically so be prepared for tough fighting.
column2: 有报告说该地区有大量德军，他们会狂热地保卫自己的家乡，所以要准备好打艰苦的战斗。

column1: After the capture of Bristol, the last important point in our plans on the West coast of England is the city of Gloucester, if we destroy the British resistance here, we will take the control of all this area. Intelligence and our recon flights report us that the British have built here a good defensive line, using the rivers and the city. You will receive reinforcements from two Panzer Divisions, also you the 22nd FJ Division will help us again. Good Luck.
column2: 夺取布里斯托尔(Bristol)之后，我们计划中英格兰西海岸最后一个重要据点就是格洛斯特(Gloucester)城。如果我们在这里摧毁英国的抵抗，就能控制整个这一地区。情报与我们侦察机的报告都告诉我们，英国人利用河流与该城在这里构筑了一道良好的防线。你将得到两个装甲师的增援，另外你的第22伞兵师将再次协助我们。祝好运。

column1: Herr General, your bold and energetic tactics have allowed us a complete victory.  And now the Finnish people have been given the will to face the Soviets with us in future campaigns.  Well done!
column2: 将军阁下，你果敢而充满活力的战术为我们赢得了完胜。如今，芬兰人民已被赋予与我们并肩面对苏联的意志，将在未来的战役中与我们同行。干得好！
卡昂(Caen) -「古德伍德」行动(Operation Goodwood) PeG:
塞卢姆(Sollum)之战与哈勒法亚隘口(Halfaya Pass)

column1: Reports from the Fort Capuzzo and Halfaya Pass garrisons indicates that the British are preparing an assault over our positions. Sollum has been taken by the enemy, and surely the Italians will be eliminated from the Pass. Your divisions must drive to the Fort Capuzzo to face the enemy offensive, and avoid a possible attack over our important backwards positions on Bardia and Sidi Azeiz. Italian units from the 5a Squadra Aereonautica will arrive to help you later.
column2: 来自卡普佐堡(Fort Capuzzo)与哈勒法亚隘口(Halfaya Pass)守备部队的报告表明，英国人正准备对我们的阵地发起突击。塞卢姆(Sollum)已被敌军夺取，意大利人肯定会被逐出山口。你的各师必须向卡普佐堡推进，迎击敌人的攻势，并防止敌人可能对我们后方重要阵地拜尔迪耶(Bardia)与西迪阿扎伊兹(Sidi Azeiz)发起的攻击。来自第5航空队的意大利部队稍后会来协助你。

column1: Historically, this was the last operation of the general Wavell in North Africa, after the high command pulled him out. This operation was called "Operation Brevity"\x00
column2: 历史上，这是韦维尔(Wavell)将军在北非的最后一次行动——在那之后最高统帅部就把他调走了。这次行动被称为「短暂行动」\x00

column1: We have seized the Norwegian capital of Oslo, but still the Norwegians and their British allies resist us.  They are attempting to keep us out of the valley leading north from Oslo through Lillehammer.  Your forces are tasked with securing this important communications center.  Good luck, Herr General.
column2: 我们已夺取挪威首都奥斯陆，但挪威人及其英国盟友仍在抵抗。他们正试图阻止我们进入从奥斯陆经利勒哈默尔向北延伸的谷地。你的部队受命夺取这一重要的交通枢纽。祝你好运，将军阁下。

column1: Counter Attack on the Mius - August 1943 V
column2: 米乌斯河反击 1943年8月 胜利

column1: You've got a tough nut to crack this time.
column2: 这次你要啃的可是块硬骨头。

column1: You've got to take Almaty quickly.
column2: 你必须迅速拿下阿拉木图(Almaty)。

column1: If you don't, Ivan will have time to get forces into the mountains and we'll never get them out.
column2: 如果你不这样做，伊万(Ivan)就有时间把部队调进山里，那我们就再也别想把他们弄出来了。

column1: The Hungarian capital of Budapest is besieged by the Red Army.  The Germans must break through the Soviet lines to help their last remaining ally.
column2: 匈牙利首都布达佩斯被红军围困。德军必须突破苏军防线，去援助他们硕果仅存的盟友。

column1: The British attempt to smash Rommel's armor south of Tobruk.  Rommel
column2: 英国人试图在托布鲁克(Tobruk)以南击碎隆美尔(Rommel)的装甲部队。隆美尔

column1: launches a counter-attack in the afternoon.  By sunset, every British unit
column2: 在下午发起反击。到日落时，每一支试图

column1: trying to get to the "Cauldron" has been driven back.
column2: 冲向「大锅」的英国部队都被击退了。
卡昂——查恩伍德行动：重制版

column1: British commander Bernard Montgomery promised the Allied command
column2: 英军指挥官伯纳德·蒙哥马利(Bernard Montgomery)曾向盟军司令部承诺

column1: that his troops would capture the old city of Caen on the first day of the
column2: 他的部队将在诺曼底登陆的第一天

column1: Normandy landings. After weeks of hard, bloody fighting, Montgomery
column2: 夺取卡昂(Caen)老城。经过数周艰苦血腥的战斗，蒙哥马利

column1: attempts to make good on his promise.
The German troops try to clear Polish forces from Mlawa and Ciechanow.
column2: 德军试图把波兰部队从姆瓦瓦(Mlawa)与切哈努夫(Ciechanow)清除出去。

column1: The Polish army attempts to defend their homeland against the German
column2: 波兰军队试图保卫自己的家乡，抵御德国

column1: Caucasus oilfields -oil and petroleum- and strategic raw materials might be available for our units.
column2: 高加索(Caucasus)油田——石油与汽油——以及战略原料，也许可供我们的部队使用。

column1: Kongratulieren!, the past year frontlines have been restored here.
column2: 恭喜！去年这里的战线已经恢复。

column1: Well done. We have recaptured the important port of Benghazi, and now, onwards to Tobruk!.
column2: 干得好。我们夺回了重要的班加西港，现在，向托布鲁克前进！

column1: This is a real important victory!, the British have been completely surprised by your South "hook". The Gazala Line is destroyed, and also, Tobruk has fallen in our hands. Kongratulieren.
column2: 这是一场真正重要的胜利！英国人对你从南面的「钩击」完全措手不及。加扎拉防线(Gazala Line)已被摧毁，而且托布鲁克(Tobruk)也落入我们手中。恭喜。

column1: Mersa Matruh is taken!, the High Command wants to tell you that the Operation Hercules will be launched in the next hours to take the island of Malta, as a reward for your outstanding results.
column2: 马特鲁港(Mersa Matruh)已被夺取！最高统帅部想告诉你，「赫拉克勒斯」行动(Operation Hercules)将在数小时后发起，以夺取马耳他岛(Malta)，作为对你卓越战果的奖赏。

column1: Mersa Matruh is taken!, now, we must continue our drive on to Egypt.
column2: 马特鲁港已被拿下！现在，我们必须继续向埃及推进。

column1: The enemy have stopped our units. We must dig in and await the next British strikes, this won't be easy General...
column2: 敌人挡住了我军。我们必须构筑工事，等待英军的下一次打击，这不会轻松，将军……

column1: The enemy has been surprised, however we could not get the complete victory, some units have escaped, and surely the British will launch a counteroffensive...
column2: 敌人被打了个措手不及，但我们未能取得全胜，部分敌军逃脱了，英军肯定会发动反攻……

column1: The enemy has been completely surprised and destroyed by your actions!, now, the way to Egypt is clear. Your next mission is to assault the historical port of Alexandria.
column2: 在你的行动下，敌人被彻底打了个措手不及并被歼灭！通往埃及的道路已经打开。你的下一个任务是突击历史名城亚历山大港。

column1: You are victorious! Unfortunately it's a Pyrhus Victory because you have suffered too many losses, as a result the assault in Egypt demands fresh troops. Report to the Führer immediately in Berlin for your promotion, you've earned the Knight cross with brilliants, sword and oak leaves. The Führer wants more troops on the Eastern front for Stalingrad and the Caucasus campaign, you might convince him to change his mind and exploit your advantage in the Mediterranian with reinforcements.
column2: 你胜利了！遗憾的是这是一场皮洛士式的胜利，因为你蒙受了太多损失，其结果是埃及的突击需要生力军。立刻到柏林向元首报到接受晋升，你已赢得带钻石、剑与橡叶的骑士十字勋章。元首想向东线增调部队用于斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)与高加索(Caucasus)战役，你也许能说服他改变主意，用增援来扩大你在地中海的战果。

column1: Obviously, you need to take a rest. Another General will replace you now as Commander in Chief of the DAK. (You are dismissed).
column2: 显然，你需要休息了。现在将有另一位将军接替你出任非洲军(DAK)总司令。（你被解职了）。

column1: You have selected the path to assault Egypt, in case of success the road to oil in the Middle East and the reconquest of former Italian colonies in South Afrika are at hand.
column2: 你已选择突击埃及的道路，一旦成功，通往中东石油的道路以及重新征服意大利在南部非洲的前殖民地的前景都近在眼前。

column1: You haven't chosen any path, please try it again.
column2: 你还没有选择任何道路，请再试一次。

column1: Herr General you have the choice of continuing the historic line (in Tunisia) or moving into an alternative series of scenarios depicting an hypothetical German attack plan (through Egypt).
column2: 将军阁下，你可以选择继续历史路线（在突尼斯(Tunisia)），或者转入另一系列场景，描述一个假想的德军进攻计划（穿越埃及）。

column1: If you want to continue with the historic line move to "Tunis".
column2: 如果你想继续走历史路线，请移向「突尼斯(Tunis)」。

column1: If you want to follow the alternative line move to "Alexandria".
column2: 如果你想走另一条路线，请移向「亚历山大(Alexandria)」。

column1: After the first success agaisnt the Brits (and against the orders of Hitler), the situation is turning positive for us. The Brits are withdrawing their troops, Mersa el Brega has fallen into our hands, and now we must continue the offensive onwards to Benghazi, and later to Mechilli. This way, Cyrenaica would be secured, and the front lines restored for the moment.
column2: 在对英国人取得首次胜利之后（而且是违背希特勒的命令取得的），局势正变得对我们有利。英国人正在撤走他们的部队，布埃尔加港(Mersa el Brega)已落入我们手中，现在我们必须继续攻势，向班加西(Benghazi)推进，随后再向梅基利(Mechilli)推进。这样一来，昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)就能得到确保，战线也能暂时恢复。

column1: Playing tip : don't lose your Mobil Armee HQ unit since there are no supply hexes in this scenario. Deploy and Supply units allow to re-supply and give replacements to any ground or air unit even after it has moved as long as the unit ends up within 2 hexes of the Deploy and Supply unit. They allow the unit to retreat and re-supply on the same turn. Be aware that in the desert full re-supply only occurs in towns, ports, airfields and rough terrain. Those units have also the bridging ability.
column2: 游戏提示：不要丢掉你的摩托化集团军司令部单位，因为这个场景里没有补给格。部署与补给单位可以为任何地面或航空单位补给并提供补充兵员，即使该单位已经移动过，只要它最终位于部署与补给单位2格之内即可。它们还允许该单位在同一回合内撤退并补给。要注意，在沙漠中只有城镇、港口、机场与崎岖地形才能进行完全补给。这些单位还具有架桥能力。
第15团/第55萨沃纳师/[非洲军]
第16团/第55萨沃纳师/[非洲军]
第12团/第55萨沃纳师/[非洲军]
皇家骑炮兵团/第2装甲师/[XIII]
第1皇家骑炮兵团/第2装甲师/[XIII]
第6皇家坦克团/第3旅/第2装甲师/[XIII]

column1: The invasion of France has begun!, after the conquest of Poland in 1939, and with the still unfinished Operation Weserübung, the Wehrmacht has crossed the Ardennes Forest, and you are the general with the duty of manage the attack, starting at Sedan, where the French Army will surely be completely surprised. Can you drive the Wehrmacht to Paris?
column2: 入侵法国已经开始！在1939年征服波兰之后，在「威瑟演习」行动(Operation Weserübung)尚未结束之际，国防军已穿过阿登森林(Ardennes Forest)，而你就是那位肩负指挥这次进攻之责的将军，进攻从色当(Sedan)开始——法国陆军在那里必定会完全措手不及。你能把国防军带到巴黎(Paris)吗？
哈勒法亚隘口(Halfaya Pass)与塞卢姆(Sollum)之战
第1营/75炮兵团/第5轻装师/[非洲军]
第605高射炮营/第5轻装师/[非洲军]
第606高射炮营/第5轻装师/[非洲军]
第2机枪/第5轻装师/[非洲军]
第8机枪营/第5轻装师/[非洲军]
第7皇家坦克团/第4旅/第7装甲师/[XIII]
第68中型炮兵团/第4印度师/[XXX]

column1: A lot of armoured units has been spotted in our forward positions. Surely, the Tommies are trying to stop our assault over Tobruk, which is completely besieged now. Unfortunately, we should stop the attack on Tobruk, to stop the British attack!. In the other hand, beware with the enemy units from Tobruk, if you don't take care, they would be able to attack us from behind.
column2: 在我们的前沿阵地已发现大量装甲部队。英国佬肯定是在设法阻止我们对托布鲁克(Tobruk)的突击，而该地现在已被彻底围困。遗憾的是，我们应当停止对托布鲁克的进攻，以挡住英国人的进攻！另一方面，要当心从托布鲁克出来的敌军部队，如果你不加小心，他们就能从背后攻击我们。

column1: Historically, in this moment the DAK was composed of the 15 Panzer Division, the 21 Panzer Division (formerly 5 Leichte Division, 5 LD) plus 6 Italian Divisions (many of them with outdated equipment). The Operation Crusader was finally an stalemate, but the DAK withdrawed its positions, and in December the 24th, Benghazi came again into the Allied hands.\x00
column2: 历史上，此时非洲军(DAK)由第15装甲师、第21装甲师（原第5轻装师，5 LD）以及6个意大利师（其中许多装备陈旧）编成。「十字军」行动(Operation Crusader)最终形成僵局，但非洲军撤出了阵地，12月24日，班加西(Benghazi)再次落入盟军手中。\x00
第2/第8野战团/第9澳大利亚师/[XXX]
第1皇家坦克团/第7旅/第7装甲师/[XIII]
第1国王皇家步枪团/[第8集团军]
第68中型炮兵团/第4印度师/[XXX]

column1: The time for the counteroffensive has arrived. After the first victories in the past year, the British have recaptured Cyrenaica again. Now, we are in a good position to attack Mersa el Brega, and maybe then, Agedabia. If we can retake these points, we will be able to besiege Benghazi again, and maybe recapture Cyrenaica, restoring the front lines of the past year.
column2: 反攻的时机到了。在去年最初的几场胜利之后，英国人再次夺回了昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)。现在，我们处于有利位置，可以进攻布埃尔加港(Mersa el Brega)，也许随后再进攻阿杰达比亚(Agedabia)。如果我们能夺回这两处，就能再次围困班加西(Benghazi)，也许还能重新夺回昔兰尼加，恢复去年的战线。
第5装甲团/第15装甲师/[非洲军]

column1: After our success in the retaking of Mersa el Brega and Agedabia, the counteroffensive must continue. The British are now trying to regroup some units in the Beda Fomm - Bengazhi - Mechilli area. That units are surely the remnants of the 1st Armored division, and the 4th Indian division, which intelligence reports indicate that is deployed around Bengazhi.
column2: 在我们成功夺回布埃尔加港(Mersa el Brega)与阿杰达比亚(Agedabia)之后，反攻必须继续。英国人现在正试图在贝达富姆(Beda Fomm) - 班加西(Bengazhi) - 梅基利(Mechilli)地区重整一些部队。那些部队肯定是第1装甲师与第4印度师的残部，情报报告指出第4印度师部署在班加西周边。

column1: The mission is re-establish the 1941 lines here, capturing Bengazhi, and then, reaching Mechilli.
column2: 任务是恢复这里1941年的战线：夺取班加西(Bengazhi)，然后进抵梅基利(Mechilli)。
第68中型炮兵团/第4印度师/[XXX]
加扎拉防线(Gazala Line)（「忒修斯」行动(Operation Theseus)）

column1: The whole Cyrenaica area is now under our control, however we know that the enemy have established a defensive line between the villages of Gazalla and Bir Hacheim. Aufklarung reports shows that the British are using anti-personnel, as well as anti-tank mine fields in that line to stop our advance on to Egypt.
column2: 整个昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)地区现在都在我们控制之下，但我们知道敌人已在加扎拉(Gazalla)与比尔哈凯姆(Bir Hacheim)两村之间建立了一道防线。侦察报告显示，英国人在该防线上同时使用反步兵与反坦克雷场，以阻止我们向埃及推进。

column1: Your task is to accomplish the codenamed "Operation Theseus". This operation means to break the enemy lines in the Bir Hacheim area using the best of the DAK armored forces, and make a fast advance behind the front lines, surrounding the enemy. Finally, you should assault the Tobruk fortress, and take all the other mission objetives.
column2: 你的任务是完成代号「忒修斯」行动(Operation Theseus)。这次行动意味着以非洲军(DAK)最精锐的装甲部队突破比尔哈凯姆(Bir Hacheim)地区的敌军防线，并迅速向敌后推进，包围敌人。最后，你应当突击托布鲁克(Tobruk)要塞，并夺取所有其他任务目标。
第205炮兵团/第27布雷西亚师/[X]
第288特别部队/第90轻装师/[非洲军]
第190反坦克营/第90轻装师/[非洲军]
第8皇家坦克团/第1南非师/[XXX]
第1皇家骑炮兵团/第4旅/第7装甲师/[XXX]
第2/第7摩托化旅/第7装甲师/[XXX]

column1: Congratulations Herr Feldsmarschall!!, the high command have promoted you due to your good results in the past. Now, the next aim should be the Mersa Matruh area. The enemy is trying to build up another defensive line in this place, anyway the reports are indicating that this time the enemy lines are weaker than in Gazala. In the other hand, the enemy forces are bigger, and surely will outnumber our troops again. The mission objective is to make a fast assault from the South, like in Gazala, surprising the enemy with our fastests units, and finally assaulting the fortified point of Mersa Matruh.
column2: 恭喜，元帅阁下！！由于你过去的良好战果，最高统帅部已晋升你。现在，下一个目标应是马特鲁港(Mersa Matruh)地区。敌人正试图在这里建立又一道防线，不过报告表明这次敌人的防线比加扎拉(Gazala)薄弱。另一方面，敌军兵力更大，肯定会再次在数量上超过我们。任务目标是从南面发起快速突击，如同在加扎拉那样，以我们最快的部队让敌人措手不及，最后突击马特鲁港的设防要点。
第39反坦克营/第15装甲师/[非洲军]
第1皇家坦克团/第22装甲旅/[X]

column1: The high command thinks that it's time to strike the enemy again, like in the past, surprising the Allies from the South. Your task is to surround the enemy from the South, and capture the Alexandria Supplyline. The Alam Halfa ridge is an important and strategical place, you must secure it also. Viel Gluck!.
column2: 最高统帅部认为现在该再次打击敌人了，像过去那样从南面让盟军措手不及。你的任务是从南面包围敌人，并夺取亚历山大(Alexandria)补给线。阿拉姆哈勒法岭(Alam Halfa ridge)是一个重要的战略要点，你也必须确保它。祝好运！(Viel Gluck)

column1: Historically, the Germans had an important lack of supplies, fuel, and tanks. This attack was ordered due to political pressions, a quick victory was needed...
column2: 历史上，德国人严重缺乏补给、燃料与坦克。这次进攻是因政治压力而下令发起的，当时需要一场速胜……
第7皇家坦克团/第7装甲师/[XIII]

column1: The situation is becoming really dangerous, we have an important lack of fuel and tanks, and the enemy air superiority, plus the minefileds, are making a big amount of losses into our units... We will launch a last hit to the British, hoping to surprise them like in the past - otherwise you must fight at any cost, until the last man!.
column2: 局势正变得非常危险，我们严重缺乏燃料与坦克，而敌方的空中优势加上雷场，正给我们部队造成大量损失……我们将对英国人发起最后一击，希望像过去那样让他们措手不及——否则你必须不惜一切代价战斗，直到最后一人！

column1: Historically, the British had decoded the German "Enigma" codes and knew all the German plans, Montgomery was able to made special plans to kick out the Germans from El Alamein. Marshall Rommel didn't follow the order of fight at any cost, and in November the 12th, he started the retreat of the DAK.
column2: 历史上，英国人已破译了德国的「恩尼格玛」(Enigma)密码，掌握了德国的全部计划，蒙哥马利(Montgomery)得以制定特别计划，把德国人逐出阿拉曼(El Alamein)。隆美尔(Rommel)元帅没有遵从「不惜一切代价战斗」的命令，11月12日，他开始让非洲军(DAK)撤退。

column1: Playing tip: Drop airborne units to capture victory hexes!
column2: 游戏提示：空投空降部队以夺取胜利格！
特别部队/第164轻装师/[非洲军]
炮兵团/第164轻装师/[非洲军]
第68中型炮兵团/第4印度师/[XXX]
第3中型炮兵团/第1南非师/[XXX]
第7皇家坦克团/第4旅/第7装甲师/[XIII]

column1: Excellent, you have captured the oil reserves located at Tebessa.
column2: 好极了，你已夺取位于泰贝萨(Tebessa)的石油储备。

column1: Your next operation will be: try to enclose the Angloamerican's Armies toward Bone.
column2: 你的下一次行动将是：设法把英美联军围向博讷(Bone)。

column1: You couldn't make allies to get back in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunizia with the few units we have.
column2: 你没能迫使盟军撤出突尼斯(Tunisia)，所以我们凭手上这点兵力不可能守得住亚历山大(Alexandria)与突尼斯。

column1: Angloamerican forces have disembarked in French land, moving at full speed toward Tunisia. After you recent victory in Alexandria, we cannot afford a counterattack from behind. Due to your inexperienced rivals, their positions are very week, but they are more in number and supplies.
column2: 英美联军已在法国领土登陆，正全速向突尼斯(Tunisia)推进。在你最近于亚历山大(Alexandria)取胜之后，我们承受不起来自背后的反击。由于你的对手缺乏经验，他们的阵地非常薄弱，但他们在数量与补给上占优。

column1: Your mission: Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
column2: 你的任务：全速推进，夺取泰贝萨(Tebessa)。

column1: Note: In Tebessa, Allies used to have a great oil reserve, if you capture the city, you will be able to perform future offensive operations.
column2: 注意：在泰贝萨(Tebessa)，盟军过去拥有大量石油储备，如果你夺取该城，你就能实施未来的攻势作战。

column1: The Angloamerican attempt to surprise us from behind was a complete failure, from now on we can concentrate on thinking about our next offensive target.
column2: 英美联军从背后偷袭我们的企图彻底失败了，从现在起我们可以专心考虑下一个进攻目标。

column1: You have fail to make allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 你没能迫使盟军在突尼斯(Tunisia)撤退，所以我们凭手上这点兵力不可能守得住亚历山大(Alexandria)与突尼斯。

column1: Thanks to you great successes, now we have the possibility to surround the rookie armies going towards the Tunisian coast, more exactly, city of Bone.
column2: 多亏了你的巨大成功，现在我们有机会包围那些正开往突尼斯海岸的新手军队，更确切地说，是博讷(Bone)城。

column1: With the prestige you've gained, now you can get equiped with new units and make upgrades.
column2: 凭借你赢得的威望，你现在可以用新单位装备自己并进行升级。

column1: Your failure in the invasion on Malta, will drive you to a most historic path in the Alamein sector, where the prestige will be lacking.
column2: 你在马耳他(Malta)入侵中的失败，将把你引向阿拉曼(Alamein)地区那条更具历史意义的道路，在那里威望将会匮乏。
第19团/第27布雷西亚师/第10军
第20团/第27布雷西亚师/第10军
第1团/第27布雷西亚师/第10军

column1: Finally, after the complete defeat of the main British units at El Alamein, we can assault the strongly important port of Alexandria. Unfortunately, some units enemy have escaped from El Alamein area, and now they are trying to set up defences around Alexandria, and also into the city. Air Recon reports shows that the Royal Navy has came to protect the port, our Italian friends will send the Regia Marina to help us in the assault, and to face the Royal Navy.
column2: 终于，在阿拉曼(El Alamein)彻底击败英军主力之后，我们可以突击极为重要的亚历山大(Alexandria)港了。遗憾的是，一些敌军部队已从阿拉曼地区逃脱，现在他们正试图在亚历山大周边以及城内建立防御。空中侦察报告显示，皇家海军已前来保护该港，我们的意大利朋友将派出皇家海军(Regia Marina)协助我们突击，并迎战皇家海军。
RM 尼科洛索·达雷科号
第8野战团/第22近卫步兵旅
第65反坦克团/第22近卫步兵旅

column1: All the main ports of the Mediterranean Sea are now under our control!, only the Suez Kanal remains under British domination... We shall see how long they can use the Kanal!
column2: 地中海的所有主要港口现在都在我们控制之下！只有苏伊士运河(Suez Kanal)仍在英国控制之下……我们倒要看看他们还能用这条运河多久！
塞得港(Port Said)（「鹿特丹」行动(Operation Rotterdam)），1942年11月9日

column1: We cannot leave the entrance of the Port under the British control, however we must send our main units to overrun El Cairo. Following that ideas, the High Command have designed an operation to take Port Said using few units, like in May of 1940 in the Low Countries.
column2: 我们不能让该港的入口留在英国人控制之下，但我们又必须派出主力部队去攻占开罗(El Cairo)。基于这一思路，最高统帅部设计了一次只用少量部队夺取塞得港(Port Said)的行动，就像1940年5月在低地国家那样。

column1: 1. Use the elite units of the Raemcke brigade and the Folgore division to take far mission objectives, like Port Said and El Qmic.
column2: 1. 使用雷姆克(Raemcke)旅与「闪电」(Folgore)师的精锐部队夺取远处的任务目标，如塞得港(Port Said)与埃尔卡米奇(El Qmic)。

column1: 2. The ground forces must take Darakisha and El Matariya, and then, drive to the Kanal. Maybe the air elite units would need help.
column2: 2. 地面部队必须夺取达拉基沙(Darakisha)与埃尔马塔里亚(El Matariya)，然后向运河推进。也许空中精锐部队会需要帮助。

column1: 3. The 101 Italian Trieste division should drive directly to Port Said.
column2: 3. 意大利第101「的里雅斯特」(Trieste)师应直接向塞得港(Port Said)推进。

column1: 4. You should complete the operation as soon as possible, because the assault on El Cairo must begin in two or three days.
column2: 4. 你应当尽快完成这次行动，因为对开罗(El Cairo)的突击必须在两三天内开始。

column1: Excellent job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。你不仅守住了防线，甚至把那些赤色分子打退了几英里。

column1: El Cairo is in front of us, after more than one year of battles in Afrika, we are starting the final assault to the British stronghold of Egypt.
column2: 开罗(El Cairo)就在我们眼前，在非洲一年多的战斗之后，我们正开始对英国在埃及的据点发起最后突击。

column1: The coast of Egypt is closed, Alexandria and Port Said are under our control, however the British have not accepted our surrender. Now, we must assault the city in order to end the British control over North Africa.
column2: 埃及海岸已被封锁，亚历山大(Alexandria)与塞得港(Port Said)都在我们控制之下，然而英国人还没有接受我们的招降。现在，我们必须突击该城，以终结英国对北非的控制。

column1: El Cairo has been cleared. Now, the next aim is to complete the conquest of the Suez Kanal.
column2: 开罗(El Cairo)已被肃清。现在，下一个目标是完成对苏伊士运河(Suez Kanal)的征服。

column1: After the fall of El Cairo and Port Said, the last point of British resistance in Egypt is the Suez Canal. The enemy have regrouped some units around Suez, as a last chance to stop us. Intelligence reports says that the Americans are preparing an invasion of Nort Africa soon, so you must finish with the British as soon as possible, to control the Suez Canal for a possible future meeting with the Americans in the next months.
column2: 在开罗(El Cairo)与塞得港(Port Said)陷落之后，英国在埃及最后的抵抗据点就是苏伊士运河(Suez Canal)。敌人已在苏伊士(Suez)周边重整了一些部队，作为阻止我们的最后机会。情报报告说，美国人很快就要准备入侵北非，所以你必须尽快解决英国人，控制苏伊士运河，以备未来几个月可能与美国人交手。

column1: You have selected the path towards South Afrika, you have to recapture the Italian Colonies.
column2: 你已选择了通往南部非洲的道路，你必须收复意大利的殖民地。

column1: You have selected the path to ensure the oil routes going through Syria, Irak and Persia.
column2: 你已选择了确保经由叙利亚(Syria)、伊拉克(Irak)与波斯(Persia)的石油通道的道路。

column1: This is a choice scenario, after the fall of Egypt, and the defeat of the Allied invaders over the Vichy France African territories, you should decide where the Deutsches Afrika Korps will go this time. We have made two different plans:
column2: 这是一个选择场景：在埃及陷落、盟军入侵者在维希法国非洲领地上的失败之后，你应当决定德国非洲军(Deutsches Afrika Korps)这次将开往何处。我们制定了两个不同的计划：

column1: BV: This means to select the plan proposed by our Italian friends: the recapture of Erythrea, Ethiopia, and Somaliland, and then, going towards South following the Nile river. To select this path move south to "East Africa" hex.
column2: BV：这指的是选择我们意大利朋友提出的计划：收复厄立特里亚(Erythrea)、埃塞俄比亚(Ethiopia)与索马里兰(Somaliland)，然后沿尼罗河(Nile river)向南推进。要选择这条道路，请向南移向「东非」格。

column1: V or TV: By selecting this path, you will go to ensure the Mediterran Sea, the oil paths and, the chance to open a second front in the Caucasus, piercing into Persia. To select this path move east to "Middle East" hex.
column2: V 或 TV：选择这条道路，你将去确保地中海(Mediterran Sea)、石油通道，以及在高加索(Caucasus)开辟第二战场、突入波斯(Persia)的机会。要选择这条道路，请向东移向「中东」格。

column1: The fate of Afrika is in your hands.
column2: 非洲的命运掌握在您手中。

column1: We'd crossed the Channel, and now we are going to the Mediterran's coast, but even now here are the remnants of the 8th British Army and a Egyptian complete division, so you have to destroy them. Our Intelligence report says that anti-Britain Palestine groups will be present behind the enemy positions to support us.
column2: 我们已渡过英吉利海峡(Channel)，现在正开往地中海沿岸，但即使现在这里仍有英国第8集团军的残部和一个完整的埃及师，所以你必须消灭他们。我们的情报报告说，敌后会有反英的巴勒斯坦团体支持我们。

column1: Now the coasts are secured and we can go for the inner oil camps.
column2: 如今海岸已安全，我们可以向内陆的油田进发了。

column1: Commander, The city of Smolensk is your next objective. You will have some help from the 10th Mountain and 2nd Rangers. You must take the city by the end of the month.
column2: 指挥官，斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)城是你的下一个目标。你将得到第10山地师与第2游骑兵的一些协助。你必须在月底之前夺取该城。

column1: We are closing to the land where the very first people loved by Hitler were originated (kiddin'). The High Command says that there are many Jewish Militia units across the whole territory, after the conquest we will send the SS to "silence" the sector.
column2: 我们正逼近那片土地——希特勒最先喜爱的那类人正是发源于此（开玩笑的）。最高统帅部说，整个领土上有很多犹太民兵部队，征服之后我们将派党卫军去「封住」这一地区。

column1: Be quickly as you can and close the Mediterranean's coast to avoid enemy reinforcements.
column2: 尽快行动，封锁地中海海岸，以防敌军增援。
喀尔巴阡步枪旅/ 波兰
工兵/喀尔巴阡步枪旅/ 波兰
枪骑兵/喀尔巴阡步枪旅/ 波兰
反坦克/喀尔巴阡步枪旅/ 波兰
炮兵/喀尔巴阡步枪旅/ 波兰
HMS B/喀尔巴阡步枪旅/ 波兰

column1: Now we can continue easily towards the major oil reserves in the world, the rear is secure.
column2: 现在我们能轻松地向世界上最大的石油储区推进了，后方已经稳固。

column1: This is the French's last bastion, the zone isn't the best for tanks, so beware.
column2: 这里是法国人最后的堡垒，这一带的地形不太适合坦克，请当心。
atB/哈巴尼亚部队/阿拉伯军团

column1: The oil is ours, German engineers are on the way to put refineries online.
column2: 石油归我们了，德国工程师正在赶来让炼油厂开工。

column1: We are in the doors of the Iraqi Capital City, the main obstacle is the Arab Legion and the 10th Indian Division brought as reinforcements, so do whatever you can and take the needed oil for the Deutsches Reich!
column2: 我们已来到伊拉克首都的门前，主要障碍是阿拉伯军团(Arab Legion)和作为增援调来的第10印度师，所以尽你所能，为德意志帝国(Deutsches Reich)夺取所需的石油！

column1: After the fall of Baghdad, we won't suffer anymore the lack of fuel. Only Persia, one of the places with more petrol reserves in the World, is still not under our control. Please, let me a moment to explain you the Persian situation:
column2: 巴格达(Baghdad)陷落之后，我们再也不必忍受燃料短缺了。只有波斯(Persia)——世界上石油储量最多的地方之一——仍不在我们控制之下。请给我一点时间，向你说明波斯的局势：

column1: In the past years, Persia was a pro-German country, however, in the first days of 1943 the Soviets, aided by some remaining British units who escaped from other fronts, (mainly of the 8th Army), have invaded the country. The King of Persia, Reza Shah have abdicated, forced by the invaders. Fortunately for us, some Persian army officers, loyals to Reza Shah, have contacted us, offering their help to kick out the Soviets and the British from Persia. Intelligence reports that the Armed Persian Police, and the weak Persian Air Force will remain under the enemy control, also, a good number of Soviet tanks have been spotted. There is an only airstrip near to Tehran, so you must take it to allow our airforce to be resupplied here.
column2: 过去几年里，波斯一直是个亲德的国家，然而在1943年的最初几天，苏军在一些从其他战线逃出的英国部队（主要是第8集团军）协助下入侵了该国。波斯国王礼萨·沙阿(Reza Shah)在入侵者逼迫下退位。对我们来说幸运的是，一些忠于礼萨·沙阿的波斯军官已与我们接触，愿意帮助我们赶走波斯的苏军与英军。情报报告说，波斯武装警察以及弱小的波斯空军仍将处于敌方控制之下，此外还发现了相当数量的苏军坦克。德黑兰(Tehran)附近只有一条简易机场，所以你必须夺取它，以便我们的空军在此得到补给。

column1: Your task is to aid the Persian "rebels" to clear Teheran. With a success here, Persia will surely be an important ally in the coming years.
column2: 你的任务是协助波斯的「叛军」肃清德黑兰(Teheran)。若在此成功，波斯在未来数年必定会成为一个重要盟友。

column1: Kongratulieren!, the Soviets have been kicked out from Persia, and the British Armies will no longer disturb us here. The Middle East is under our command as well as the oil resources from this land. In spite of the failure at Stalingrad, our presence in Persia will bring some trouble at the Soviet South borders. We hope the Kursk offensive will be a decisive victory for the Werhmacht, helped now by our big amount of oil supplies...
column2: 恭喜！苏军已被赶出波斯(Persia)，英国军队再也不会在这里打扰我们了。中东以及这片土地上的石油资源都在我们掌控之下。尽管在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)遭遇失败，我们在波斯的存在将给苏联南部边境带来一些麻烦。我们希望库尔斯克(Kursk)攻势将成为国防军的决定性胜利——如今有了我们大量的石油补给相助……

column1: (You have managed the DAK better than Rommel, congratulations General!)
column2: （你把非洲军(DAK)指挥得比隆美尔(Rommel)还好，恭喜，将军！）

column1: You have passed this first trial, now we are going to Massawa's Port to cut off any supply entry from the Indian Ocean.
column2: 您已通过了第一次考验，现在我们前往马萨瓦港，以切断来自印度洋的一切补给输入。

column1: The allies have been stop you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
column2: 盟军挡住了你，我们未能达成既定目标。我们明白这确实非常艰难，而你手上的部队又太少。

column1: We'd started to advance toward south direction, we are in Keren doors, however this city won't give us any trouble the main resistance is in the mountains.
column2: 我们已开始向南推进，我们已来到克伦(Keren)的门前，不过这座城市不会给我们带来什么麻烦，主要的抵抗在山里。

column1: The Italians are grateful because we help them to recover their colonies
column2: 意大利人很感激，因为我们帮助他们收复了他们的殖民地

column1: If we acquire Massawa's Port, all the Erythrea will be ours, so Afrikans won't have any choice but surrender prior to receive supplies. Beware, some ships of Royal Navy are defending the Port.
column2: 如果我们拿下马萨瓦(Massawa)港，整个厄立特里亚(Erythrea)就都是我们的了，非洲人除了在获得补给之前投降别无选择。当心，皇家海军的一些舰艇正在守卫该港。

column1: Kongratulieren!, you have achieved the High Command objectives. The enemy forces are divided in two, and the drive to the French Channel can continue.
column2: 恭喜！你已达成最高统帅部的目标。敌军已被一分为二，向法国海峡的推进可以继续了。

column1: The Allies have been stopped you, we couldn't accomplish the targeted goals. We realize that it was really very hard and you had very few units.
column2: 盟军挡住了你，我们未能达成既定目标。我们明白这确实非常艰难，而你手上的部队又太少。

column1: We're in the door of the conquest of all the Italians had lost, the last resistance point is located here in Mogadishu. Be careful, don't underestimate the Royal Navy.
column2: 我们已来到征服意大利人失去的一切的门前，最后的抵抗据点就在这里的摩加迪沙(Mogadishu)。小心，不要低估皇家海军。

column1: The campaign has reached its end, your duty was superb and better than the historic one. Congratulations and thank you for playing.
column2: 战役已到尽头，你的表现极为出色，胜过了历史上的实况。恭喜，并感谢你的游玩。

column1: The Soviet super tank is crushed. The base has been captured, but in the
column2: 苏联的超级坦克已被摧毁。基地已被夺取，但以

column1: amount of time it took to accomplish our objectives the Soviets may have been
column2: 我们完成目标所花的时间来看，苏联人也许已经

column1: able to transmit the schematics...let's hope they never got that chance.
column2: 把图纸传出去了……但愿他们从未得到那个机会。

column1: This is the last strategic point controlled by the British in the Indian's coast, once we will take it, the allies will be unable to counterattack, because we will have in our hands all the important ports. The configuration of the Mombasa City makes the assault very tough and the presence of the Royal Navy, will push your command to the extreme, but we trust you.
column2: 这是英国人在印度洋海岸控制的最后一个战略据点，一旦我们拿下它，盟军就无法反攻，因为所有重要港口都将落入我们手中。蒙巴萨(Mombasa)城的布局使突击极为艰难，而皇家海军的存在将把你的指挥推向极限，但我们信任你。

column1: This zone of Algiers is secure, Italian detachments will stay behind and we will continue our unstoppable advance.
column2: 阿尔及尔(Algiers)这一地区已确保安全，意大利分遣队将留守，而我们将继续我们不可阻挡的推进。

column1: The Allies have been able to stop our advance! From now on we cannot do any more attacks, we will only defend our positions because our units are in bad shape!
column2: 盟军已能挡住我们的推进！从现在起我们不能再发动任何进攻，我们只能防守我们的阵地，因为我们的部队状况很差！

column1: After you have destroyed the Angloamerican forces in Bone and stopped the advance of the 8th army, we are going to chase the survivors of Bone toward Algiers in order to destroy the second front and take our revenge against the French traitors.
column2: 在你消灭博讷(Bone)的英美联军并挡住第8集团军的推进之后，我们将把博讷的幸存者追向阿尔及尔(Algiers)，以摧毁第二战场，并向法国叛徒报仇。

column1: 1. The italian naval aircraft Re 2001 can be repaired and resupplied on its carrier and on any Axis airfield.
column2: 1. 意大利海军飞机 Re 2001 可在其航母上以及任何轴心国机场修理与补给。

column1: 2. The Mine layer boat as well as the carrier can be used to deploy mines: after deployment of ground units exit the deployment screen, select a ship then click on the "deploy forces" button, only then you can deploy sea mines wherever you move the ship at any game turn.
column2: 2. 布雷艇与航母都可以用来布雷：部署地面单位之后退出部署界面，选中一艘船，然后点击「部署部队」按钮，只有这样你才能在该船于任何游戏回合移动到的任何位置部署水雷。

column1: The English have withdrawn, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  Your performance has been excellent, and we will continue to rely on your expertise.  Well done!
column2: 英军已撤离，希腊抵抗已崩溃。你的表现出色，我们将继续仰仗你的专长。干得好！

column1: We keep on our unstoppable advance by the Afrikan coasts. Now Oran in the next Allied fortified target, your mission is to clean it as fast as you can, before our enemies can reinforce and make this conquest an impossible duty to perform.
column2: 我们继续沿非洲海岸不可阻挡地推进。现在奥兰(Oran)是盟军下一个设防目标，你的任务是尽快肃清它，抢在我们的敌人增援之前——否则这次征服就将成为一项不可能完成的任务。

column1: We have just one step left to kick-out the americans from the east coast, start to move!
column2: 我们只差一步就能把美国人赶出东海岸，开始行动！

column1: We have left Algiers and are now in Morocco, your quick advance didn't give our enemies time to strengthen their defensive positions. You have to advance faster and avoid the mistakes you have already made in the past.
column2: 我们已离开阿尔及尔(Algiers)，现在在摩洛哥(Morocco)，你的迅速推进没给我们的敌人时间去加强他们的防御阵地。你必须推进得更快，并避免你过去已经犯过的错误。

column1: There is a heavy activity in the Atlantic, so be careful.
column2: 大西洋(Atlantic)上有频繁的活动，所以要小心。

column1: You will be assisted by Kriegsmarine units, OKW has decided to mine the Mediterranean sea in the sector of Medhia Harbor in order to submit the Royal Navy to a blockade before the arrival of a "Wolfpack" of submarines.
column2: 你将得到海军(Kriegsmarine)部队的协助，国防军最高统帅部(OKW)已决定在地中海马赫迪耶(Medhia)港海域布雷，以便在「狼群」潜艇到达之前对皇家海军实施封锁。

column1: Playing tip to deploy sea mines:
1. Deploy first your ground units and exit the deployment screen.
column2: 1. 先部署你的地面部队，然后退出部署界面。

column1: 2. Select a mine layer ship then click on the "deploy forces" button, only then you can deploy sea mines wherever you move the ship at any game turn.
column2: 2. 选中一艘布雷舰，再点击「部署部队」按钮，此后你便可在任何回合、舰只移动到之处布置水雷。

炮兵团/第4步兵师/第5集团军

column1: Excellent! The campaign has reached its end!
column2: 太好了！战役已走到终点！

column1: Note: your duty was better than the historic one, Congratulations and thanks for playing!
column2: 注：你的表现比历史上的更出色，恭喜你，也感谢你的游玩！

column1: We have lost our three divisions here!!! they have been unarmed into Spain, this is a completely disaster!. A military council is waiting for you in Germany.
column2: 我们在这里损失了三个师！！！他们已在西班牙被解除武装，这是一场彻底的灾难！军事法庭正在德国等着你。

column1: This is the last battle to complete your campaign in the Afrikan's West, the fortified City of Casablanca! The city is surrounded by mine fields and fortitications, in the ocean the Angloamerican Navy is awesome and the RAF has used all its forces from bases in Gibraltar, but we trust you and we believe that you'll find the way to avoid all these obtacles in this struggle and kick-out the allies from this sector of Afrika.
column2: 这是在非洲西部完成你战役的最后一战——设防坚固的卡萨布兰卡(Casablanca)城！该城四周遍布雷场与工事，海上的英美海军令人生畏，皇家空军已动用其驻直布罗陀(Gibraltar)基地的全部兵力；但我们信任你，也相信你会找到办法避开这场斗争中的一切障碍，把盟军逐出非洲的这一地段。
第60 aaB/第9步兵师/第2军/第1集团军

column1: Very Good! you'd demonstrate clearly your superiority, now is time to advance towards Algeria.
column2: 很好！你已清楚展现了你的优势，现在是向阿尔及利亚(Algeria)推进的时候了。

column1: You couldn't make allies to get back in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Alexandria and Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 你未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯(Tunisia)，以我们手头这点部队，是无法守住亚历山大(Alexandria)与突尼斯的。

column1: We know that you've recently arrived from El Alamein but the severity of the situation right here demand your services.
column2: 我们知道你刚从阿拉曼(El Alamein)赶到，但此地的严峻局势需要你来效力。

column1: After Angloamerican's disembarks in the Afrikan coasts they'd surround us. Due to our lack of forces we failed to resist in battle.
column2: 英美军队在非洲海岸登陆后，就将我们合围。由于兵力不足，我们未能抵挡住。

column1: Your mission: show the enemy that we are no defeated, advance quickly towards the inner Tunes to create a chaos within their armies.
column2: 你的任务：向敌人表明我们并未战败，迅速向突尼斯内陆推进，在他们的军队中制造混乱。

column1: Your efforts have been very meritorious, but the Americans have broken the line in El Guettar, so we don't have another choice: the retreat.
column2: 你的努力十分可嘉，但美军已在盖塔尔(El Guettar)突破防线，我们别无选择：撤退。
第1营/第5装甲团/第21装甲师/非洲军
第2营/第5装甲团/第21装甲师/非洲军

column1: Excellent!! You have captured the oil reserves located in Tebessa!
column2: 太棒了！！你已夺取位于泰贝萨(Tebessa)的石油储备！

column1: Your next assignment will be: try to enclose the Angloamerican armies which are currently in Bone.
column2: 你的下一个任务将是：设法包围目前位于博讷(Bone)的英美军队。

column1: The city of London still resist to our efforts Herr General. We need your intervention to take the city and end British resistance for good!!!
column2: 伦敦城仍在抗拒我们的努力，将军阁下。我们需要你出手拿下该城，彻底终结英国的抵抗！！！

column1: The Angloamerican forces have disembarked in French territory, at full speed following a route to Tunisia, after your defeat in Egypt, this is the only defendible sector of Afrika that we have left.
column2: 英美军队已在法国领土登陆，正全速取道突尼斯；你在埃及战败之后，这是我们手中非洲唯一还可防守的地段了。

column1: Due to the unexperienced rivals, their positions are badly defended, but they outnumbered you easily and have more supplies. Your mission: Advance at full speed and take Tebessa.
column2: 对手缺乏经验，他们的阵地防守很差，但他们在兵力上轻易压过你，补给也更多。你的任务：全速推进，拿下泰贝萨。

column1: Note: In Tebessa, the allies used to have a great oil reserve, if you capture it, we could proceed to future offensive operations.
column2: 注：盟军过去在泰贝萨拥有大量石油储备，你若夺取它，我们便能着手未来的进攻作战。

column1: The Angloamerican attempt to surprise us from behind was a complete failure, now we can concentrate on fight agaisnt Monty in the Mareth Line.
column2: 英美军队想从背后偷袭我们，结果彻底失败，现在我们可以专心在马雷特防线(Mareth Line)对付蒙蒂(Monty)了。

column1: You have failed to force allies to retreat in Tunisia, so it's impossible to defend Tunisia with the few units we have.
column2: 你未能迫使盟军在突尼斯撤退，以我们手头这点部队，是无法守住突尼斯的。

column1: Thanks to you great successes, now we have the possibility to surround the rookie armies going to the Tunisian coast, more exactly, the city of Bone.
column2: 多亏你的重大胜利，现在我们有机会包围开往突尼斯海岸的新手军队，更确切地说，是博纳城。

column1: If you are successful, they won't have any choice but surrender.
column2: 你若成功，他们便只有投降一条路。

column1: Excellent! after this great victory, the 8th army won't be able to make a quick reorganization, this is our chance to take the iniciative, we will chase the Allies toward west.
column2: 太好了！经此大胜，第8集团军无法迅速重整，这是我们夺取主动权的机会，我们将把盟军向西驱赶。

column1: You couldn't force allies to get back in Tunis, so it's impossible to attack with the few units we have.
column2: 你未能迫使盟军退回突尼斯(Tunis)，以我们手头这点部队，是无法发起进攻的。

column1: After West front destruction, you are facing your most difficult duty, once more battle against the Monty's 8th, this is a very difficult mission, but if you are successful you will have stopped the menace of our expulsion from Afrika.
column2: 西线覆灭之后，你面临最艰难的任务——再次与蒙蒂的第8集团军交战，这是极为困难的一战，但你若成功，就能挡住我们被逐出非洲的威胁。

column1: Note: this was the last operation commanded by Rommel in the Afrikan arena.
column2: 注：这是隆美尔(Rommel)在非洲战场指挥的最后一次作战。

column1: In 1941 the Italian Army was unable to face the Brits in Africa. After a year of disasters, they called for help to his German allies. Germany couldn't bring free hands to the British in North Africa, and in February 12th of 1941 they sent the General Rommel with the first German equipment and men to Tripoli.
column2: 1941 年，意大利陆军在非洲无力对抗英国人。灾祸连连一年之后，他们向自己的德国盟友求援。德国无法在北非对英国人放手不管，遂于 1941 年 2 月 12 日把隆美尔(Rommel)将军连同第一批德国装备与人员派往的黎波里(Tripoli)。

column1: Can you manage the Deutsches Afrika-Korps to the victory, and overcome the Rommel's achievements in Africa ?
column2: 你能率领德意志非洲军(Deutsches Afrika-Korps)走向胜利，并超越隆美尔在非洲的战绩吗？

column1: The Central Committee is very displeased.  Leningrad continues to suffer under enemy bombardment.  You are clearly unfit to lead troops into combat.  Report at once to Ulyanovsk.  A detachment of Red Octobrists are waiting for you to join them.
column2: 中央委员会极为不满。列宁格勒(Leningrad)仍在敌军轰炸下受苦。你显然不适合带兵作战。立即前往乌里扬诺夫斯克(Ulyanovsk)报到。一支红色十月分队正等着你加入。

column1: Superb  performance, Herr General! The Bolsheviks have fled to Siberia and sued for peace. You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not -  the conquest of Russia.  Our panzers rumble through Red Square, and our troops sleep in the Kremlin!
column2: 表现得极为出色，将军阁下！布尔什维克已逃往西伯利亚并求和。你助我们完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——征服俄国。我们的装甲部队隆隆驶过红场，我们的士兵睡在克里姆林宫！
列日行动 - 1944 年 8 月 L

column1: American forces are moving fast through the gap that you failed to close near Avranches. The US VII and XV corps are moving East to the South of us, threatening to surround us now that the Brits have broken through North-East of us near Caen. Retreat East towards Falaise to save your troops.
column2: 美军正快速从你未能在阿夫朗什附近封住的缺口涌过。美军第7军和第15军正从我们南面向东推进，而英军已在我们东北的卡昂附近突破，我们面临被包围的危险。向东撤退，往法莱斯方向，以保全你的部队。

column1: PG2 Campaign Designer: Jurgen Smet aka Wonderdoc, 28/02/2005
column2: PG2 战役设计：Jurgen Smet（即 Wonderdoc），28/02/2005

column1: The DAS REICH campaign puts you in control of the SS units known as SS-Division Verfuegungstruppe, SS-Division Das Reich, SS-Panzergrenadier-Division Das Reich and 2SS Panzer Division Das Reich. The division was one of the classic SS divisions that quickly earned a reputation for courage and bravery.
column2: 本「帝国」师战役让你指挥党卫军部队——党卫军「武装」师（SS-Verfuegungstruppe）、党卫军「帝国」师（SS-Division Das Reich）、党卫军装甲掷弹兵「帝国」师（SS-Panzergrenadier-Division Das Reich）和第2党卫军装甲师「帝国」师。该师是经典的党卫军师之一，很快以勇敢无畏赢得了声誉。

column1: The division's troops saw action in Poland, The Netherlands, Belgium, France, The Balkans, Russia, Normandy, The Ardennes, Hungary, Vienna and Prague. Expect a Blitzkrieg type of campaign with battalion size units.
column2: 该师部队转战波兰、荷兰、比利时、法国、巴尔干、俄国、诺曼底、阿登、匈牙利、维也纳和布拉格。这是一场营级规模的闪电战式战役。

column1: Restrictions: To increase playing fun and historic accuracy, you can follow the restrictions given for the number and type of core units. When doing so, Inf does not cover Pioniere and Krad Infanterie. Only add Pioniere and Krad to your core when specifically requested to do so. Also differentiate between towed AT and SPAT.
column2: 限制：为增加游玩乐趣与历史准确性，你可以遵循关于核心部队数量与类型的限制。这样做时，步兵不含工兵与摩托车步兵。只有明确要求时才把工兵与摩托车部队加入核心。同时要区分牵引反坦克炮与自行反坦克炮。

column1: There are no upgrading or over-strengthening restrictions.
column2: 没有升级或超编加强的限制。

column1: Your forces arrived at The Hague too late to capture the Dutch government and Queen Wilhelmina - they managed to escape to England. Fortunately the Dutch have capitulated after the center of Rotterdam was bombed into oblivion by the He-111s of Kampfgeschwader 4.
column2: 你的部队抵达海牙太晚，没能俘获荷兰政府和威廉明娜女王——他们成功逃往英格兰。所幸在第4轰炸航空团的 He-111 把鹿特丹市中心炸成废墟后，荷兰人投降了。
法国第7集团军北上 辉煌胜利

column1: We had expected you to move faster. Move your troops South. They are needed in the North of France where we have encircled a large number of enemy forces.
column2: 我们本以为你能推进得更快。把你的部队调往南面。法国北部需要我们围住的大批敌军，那里正需要他们。

column1: Supurb performance Herr General, textbook Blitkrieg. The Belgian King has contacted us to discuss terms of surrender. The French 7th Army has been surrounded and will give up soon. We are getting in orders to move to a different sector of the front.

column1: Congratulations! It was the Waffen SS that captured Belgrade and not Heer troops. One of your SS patrols entered the city center and has hoisted the Nazi flag atop the German legation. About two hours later the mayor of Belgrade officially handed over the city to Obersturmfuehrer Klingenberg who was accompanied by a representative of the German Foreign Ministry, previously interned by the Yugoslavs.
column2: 恭喜！拿下贝尔格莱德的是武装党卫军，而非陆军部队。你的一个党卫军巡逻队进入市中心，在德国公使馆顶上升起了纳粹旗。约两小时后，贝尔格莱德市长把城市正式移交给了党卫军上级突击队领袖克林根贝格，陪同他的是一位此前被南斯拉夫人扣留的德国外交部代表。

column1: What a pitiful performance Herr General. Von Kleist will have to divert more troops to the North to capture Belgrade now. This will delay the next phase of our invasion of Greece. The plan to capture Crete has been given up already in order not to further delay the invasion of Russia.
column2: 多么可悲的表现，将军阁下。冯·克莱斯特现在不得不抽调更多兵力北上夺取贝尔格莱德。这将延误我们入侵希腊的下一阶段。为不再延误入侵俄国，夺取克里特的计划已经被放弃。

Once you broke through, they had no reserve forces to stop you. Partisan activity makes it  increasingly difficult to operate from the airfields close to the front (That's why the airfields did not offer resupply). Now it's time to move East. Moscow is the target.

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifice of your fine troops have been in vain.  You have been ordered to Berlin.  I do not envy your reception there.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你精锐部队的牺牲都白费了。你已被命令前往柏林。你在那里将受到的接待，我可一点也不羡慕。

column1: Ja Wolfgang, I was as surprised as you that they chose Normandy.... Ah, Herr General, come in. Allow me to explain the present situation. We have a chance to drive the Allies back into the sea, here, near Caen. I will not pretend that this will be an easy task, but you have shown yourself to be a most resourceful fellow time and time again, ja? You will need all your skill to wrest a victory here. Our thoughts are with you. Ja, As I was saying, Wolfgang....
column2: 是啊，沃尔夫冈，他们竟选择了诺曼底，我和你一样吃惊……啊，将军阁下，请进。请允许我说明当前局势。我们有机会把盟军赶下海，就在这里，卡昂附近。我不会假装这是一件轻松的事，但你已经一次又一次证明自己足智多谋，是吧？你需要用上全部本领才能在此赢得胜利。我们与你同在。是啊，就像我刚才说的，沃尔夫冈……

column1: Commander, congratulations and accolades on a mission well done!  Your troops certainly gave the Germans everything that they deserved and more!  A field marshal's baton, engraved with your name awaits your arrival at Number 10.  I shall personally be there with the PM for the ceremony.  A spot of tea, Commander?
column2: 指挥官，恭喜你，任务完成得很出色，谨致赞誉！你的部队无疑给了德国人他们应得的一切，还远不止此！一根刻着你名字的元帅权杖正在唐宁街10号(Number 10)等候你到来。我会亲自与首相一同出席仪式。来杯茶吗，指挥官？

column1: Well Herr General, despite harsh conditions, you have done quite well!
column2: 将军阁下，尽管条件艰苦，你干得相当不错！

column1: Your victory has shown that already you have gained valuable
column2: 你的胜利表明，你已经获得了宝贵的

column1: experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new pro-German
column2: 在这种新型战争中的经验。此外，新的亲德

column1: government in Spain may prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
column2: 西班牙政府，在未来几年里或许会证明是个有用的盟友。

column1: The combined German and Italian army attempts to push back British forces in North Africa.
column2: 德意联军试图在北非击退英军。

column1: Herr General, we have an excellent opportunity to deliver a crushing blow to the enemy, here, north of Strasbourg. As you can see, the advance of the American Third Army has left this sector of
column2: 将军阁下，我们有一个绝佳的机会给敌人一记重击——就在这里，斯特拉斯堡(Strasbourg)以北。如你所见，美军第3集团军的推进已使该段

column1: their front inadequately defended. If you can knife through to Strasbourg, the Americans and British will be forced to halt their drive on the Fatherland. Good luck.
column2: 他们的战线防御不足。如果你能直插斯特拉斯堡，美国人和英国人将被迫停止向德国本土推进。祝你好运。

column1: This is a bitter defeat. Even now, enemy troops are advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines.  I must leave you now, Herr General.
column2: 这是一场惨痛的失败。即便此刻，敌军正在向我阵地推进。拿起一支步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。我得走了，将军阁下。

column1: Good Work!, the British resistance into the streets of Bristol has been really hard, but finally you did it, now we have the control of the whole South East coast of England, the Allies can't sent supplies for the British anymore.
column2: 干得好！英军在布里斯托尔(Bristol)街巷中的抵抗确实顽强，但你终于拿下了，如今我们控制了英格兰整个东南海岸，盟军再也无法给英国人运送补给了。

column1: Herr General, I know that you and your men have not had time even to catch a breath, but the situation here is critical. Buda-Pest is besieged by the Bolsheviks. Your troops must force their way into the city. It is doubtful that our Hungarian allies will continue to fight if Buda-Pest falls. If you can drive the Reds into the Danube, we may stop the Russian Bear from consuming us.
column2: 将军阁下，我知道你和你的部下连喘口气的时间都没有，但此地局势十分危急。布达佩斯正被布尔什维克围困。你的部队必须强行突入城内。如果布达佩斯陷落，我们的匈牙利盟友是否还会继续作战就很值得怀疑了。如果你能把赤色分子赶进多瑙河，我们或许还能阻止那头俄国熊把我们吞掉。

column1: The Russians are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in relieving Buda-Pest, you drove the Reds back across the Danube. Herr General, diplomatic representatives of Germany and the Soviet Union are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and in the west, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 俄国人被你和你英勇部队的重击打得晕头转向！你不仅成功解围了布达佩斯，还把红军赶回了多瑙河对岸。将军阁下，德国和苏联的外交代表此刻正在会晤……你在这里以及西线的一连串胜利无人能及。你将回到一个感恩的祖国。

column1: Excellent!, we have cleared of enemies the Somme River, and Amiens has fallen into our hands. Now we must continue closing the encirclement, driving to the North, to Arras, where the British have sent some divisions.
column2: 太好了！我们已肃清索姆河(Somme)一带的敌人，亚眠(Amiens)也已落入我们手中。现在我们必须继续收紧包围圈，向北推进至阿拉斯(Arras)，英国人已把一些师派往那里。
明斯克(Minsk) 1946 - 1946 年 5 月 12 日

column1: Commander, Stalin has turned the city of Minsk into a fortress. We need your skills to take the city. This is not going to be easy commander, the Russians are heavily entrenched and abundently supplied. You will have a little less than three weeks to complete this mission.
column2: 指挥官，斯大林已把明斯克城变成一座堡垒。我们需要你的本领来拿下该城。这不会容易，指挥官，俄军构筑了坚固工事，补给充足。你完成这项任务的时间略少于三周。

column1: Due to your failure you are out of charge and you will not command another operation in this campaign. The Allies have taken the Gustav Line and there are no defenses available until the Balcanes.
column2: 由于你的失败，你已被解职，在这场战役中不会再指挥任何作战。盟军已夺取古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)，在巴尔干之前已无防线可用。
英格兰中部地区 - 1944 年 4 月 3 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, the British have concentrated their last reserves in the Midlands. A victory here will be their doom!! End British resistance for good!!!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，英国人已把最后的预备队集中在中部地区。在此取胜将是他们的末日！！彻底终结英国的抵抗！！！

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column2: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。

column1: The Germans attempt to push through central Norway, hoping to destroy the Norwegian army before the British Expeditionary Force arrives.
column2: 德军试图穿过挪威中部，希望在英国远征军抵达之前歼灭挪威军队。

column1: Your leadership has shattered the British forces.  Congratulations, Herr General.  Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk before the English can prepare an effective defense.
column2: 你的领导击垮了英军。恭喜，将军阁下。现在，我们必须在英国人组织起有效防御之前攻占托布鲁克港。

column1: Congratulations Comrade, Italy has surrendered to us and there's only
column2: 恭喜你，同志，意大利已向我们投降，只剩下

column1: a few allied resistance groups that will be crushed soon.
column2: 少数盟军抵抗组织，很快就会被粉碎。

column1: Reports confirm that the French Campaign was successful, now
column2: 报告证实法国战役已经成功，现在

column1: we can force the allies to surrender.
column2: 我们可以迫使盟军投降了。

column1: Herr General, you already know that the enemy has launched an amphibious operation south of Naples, near Salerno. The terrain in this part of Italy is hilly and rugged, and we have been able to contain the enemy beachhead thus far. It is of critical importance that the Americans and British are not allowed to gain a foothold on the continent. We are relying on you and your crack troops to throw the enemy into the sea. Failure here is not an option.
column2: 将军阁下，你已得知敌军在那不勒斯以南、萨莱诺附近发动了两栖行动。意大利这一带地形丘陵起伏、崎岖不平，我们迄今尚能遏制敌军滩头。绝不能让美英在欧洲大陆取得立足点，这一点至关重要。我们仰仗你和你的精锐部队把敌军赶进大海。此处不容有失。

column1: Herr General, once again you and your courageous men have kept us from the brink of disaster. Italy remains firmly in our camp, and the invaders have been forced out of Salerno. The Fatherland owes you a great debt.
column2: 将军阁下，你和你的勇士们再一次使我们免于坠入灾难的边缘。意大利仍牢牢留在我们阵营，入侵者已被逐出萨莱诺。祖国欠你一份厚重的恩情。

column1: Herr General, once again you and your courageous men have kept us from the brink of disaster. The invaders have been forced out of Salerno. The Fatherland owes you a great debt.
column2: 将军阁下，你和你英勇的部队再一次把我们从灾难边缘拉了回来。入侵者已被赶出萨莱诺。祖国欠你一份大恩。

column1: Herr General, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain. Italy has  capitulated to the Allies, and we must fall back quickly or face annihilation. You have been ordered to Berlin. I do not envy your reception there.
column2: 将军阁下，我很遗憾，你精锐部队的牺牲都白费了。意大利已向盟军投降，我们必须迅速后撤，否则将面临被歼灭。你已被命令前往柏林。你在那里将受到的接待，我可一点也不羡慕。

column1: Excellent! You will figure in the history books! You have destroyed the beachhead in Anzio! Now we can concentrate all our forces at the Gustav Line.
column2: 太好了！你将被载入史册！你已摧毁安齐奥(Anzio)的桥头堡！现在我们可以把全部兵力集中在古斯塔夫防线了。

column1: You have disgraced the Allied forces, and on a more specific note, the British Army. You are being sent on a rather long leave. Enjoy your leisure years.
column2: 你让盟军蒙羞，更具体地说，是英国陆军。你被送去度一个相当长的假期。好好享受你的闲居岁月吧。

column1: Comrade General you have fought bravely throughout all German attacks! Unfortunately the city is mostly in German hands. Our situation is very precarious!
column2: 将军同志，你在德军的历次进攻中一直英勇作战！不幸的是，城市大部分已落入德军之手。我们的处境十分危险！
马特鲁港 - 1946 年 2 月 1 日

column1: The enemy has regrouped and launched a counter offensive against our quickly erected defenses.  You must immediately repel the attack and continue our Egyptian campaign to eliminate the Americans.
column2: 敌人已重整并对我方仓促构筑的防线发起反攻。你必须立即击退这次进攻，并继续我们的埃及战役，消灭美军。

column1: Thanks to you we've got Ivan on the run.
column2: 多亏了你，我们已让伊万(Ivan)溃逃。

column1: The Germans try to break through the Anglo-French lines and capture
column2: 德军试图突破英法联军防线，夺取

column1: Good job Commander. Although Greece has fallen, those submarines have been destroyed and Allied shipping is safe.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。希腊虽已陷落，但那些潜艇已被摧毁，盟军航运安全了。

column1: Soviet offensive to liberate the cities of Kharkov and Belgorov.
column2: 苏军解放哈尔科夫与别尔哥罗德(Belgorov)的攻势。

column1: With the help of their German ally, Finland tries to retake what was lost to the Soviets a year earlier.
column2: 在德国盟友的帮助下，芬兰试图夺回去年输给苏联的地方。

column1: Well, The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet.  Your ability on the battlefield continues to confound our enemies.
column2: 好，总参谋部对你的表现感到满意。埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。你在战场上的能力持续令敌人困惑。

column1: You know, Commander, if we're ever going to win this war, we need people who do more than just punch the clock.  You took St. Lo, yeah, but it cost us, not just time, but GIs.  It's been decided, we're going to give you another chance - in Caen.  Make your country proud, Commander.
column2: 你知道，指挥官，我们要想打赢这场战争，需要的是不只打卡混日子的人。你拿下了圣洛(St. Lo)，没错，但那让我们付出了代价——不只是时间，还有美国大兵。已经定了，我们再给你一次机会——在卡昂(Caen)。让你的国家为你骄傲吧，指挥官。

column1: Paris is in panic!, our divisions are driving into France quickly, and the Allied army is in a complete disarray. Herr General, your task now will consist in secure this area in order to allow the drive of our spearheads into the French soil. This, will avoid the joining of the Allied forces in the North, with the Southern allied forces, and will cut the Allied controlled space in two.
column2: 巴黎一片惊慌！我们的师正迅速突入法国，盟军已完全陷入混乱。将军阁下，你现在的任务就是确保控制这一地区，以便我们的先头部队向法国腹地推进。这将阻止北面的盟军与南面的盟军会合，并把盟军控制的地域一分为二。

column1: Viel Gluck!, we need a complete victory here to continue the drive to the French Channel..
column2: 祝好运！我们需要在此取得全胜，才能继续向法国海峡推进。

column1: The 26 and the 47 infanterie divisions are already taking positions around the Somme River, which is a possible bridgehead. Your mission is to deploy your forces here to aid in the crossing of the Somme River. Amiens is the biggest objective of your mission. Intelligence reports show that the garrison of Amiens consist only of one BEF regiment, but personally, I know the Frenchs will fight hard trying to avoid the crossing of the Somme.
column2: 第26与第47步兵师已在索姆河周边占领阵地，那里可能成为桥头堡。你的任务是把部队部署在此，协助强渡索姆河。亚眠是你这项任务中最大的目标。情报显示亚眠的守军只有一个英国远征军(BEF)团，但就我个人所知，法国人会拼命作战，力图阻止我们渡过索姆河。

column1: Comrade General you have failed to break the lines on the flanks of Sixth Army! We cannot expelled the Germans now! Vassiliev is very upset with your incompetence!
column2: 将军同志，你未能突破第6集团军两翼的防线！我们现在无法把德军逐出了！瓦西里耶夫对你的无能极为不满！

column1: After the victory in Amiens, our Panzer forces are taking positions to attack Arras, where some units from the 1st French Army are deployed, as well as some BEF forces. The 7th Panzer division of the General Rommel is available to support the attack (in fact we didn't know where really was this division), and also the SS Division "Totenkopf", and other Wehrmacht units which will arrive later. We expect a complete victory here.
column2: 亚眠告捷之后，我们的装甲部队正在占领阵地，准备进攻阿拉斯；那里部署着法国第1集团军的一些部队，以及部分英国远征军。隆美尔将军的第7装甲师可用来支援这次进攻（其实我们并不知道这个师究竟在哪里），此外还有党卫军「骷髅」师，以及其他稍后抵达的国防军部队。我们期待在此取得全胜。
圣波勒-坦努瓦兹(St. Pol-s T.)

column1: Finally we have reached the Channel. The enemy forces are trying to delay our advance while they are embarking their units in the port of Dünkirchen. We have spent a precious time in the ordered pause by OKH, but we will destroy all the forces enclosed in our trap, if we can make a fast assault on the enemy positions.
column2: 我们终于抵达海峡。敌军正一边在迪恩基兴(Dünkirchen)港登船，一边设法迟滞我们的推进。陆军总司令部(OKH)下令暂停，让我们耗费了宝贵的时间；但只要能对敌军阵地发起快速突击，我们就会消灭落入我们陷阱的全部敌军。

column1: After our Blitz advance over Duenkirchen, the remnants of the Allied forces are enclosed arond the Ypres Channel and the city of Lille. Your mission is to end with the enemy resistance as soon as possible, by attacking from the South, taking Lille, and the another mission objective.
column2: 在我军闪击推进越过迪恩基兴之后，盟军残部被围困在伊普尔(Ypres)海峡与里尔(Lille)城一带。你的任务是尽快终结敌人的抵抗：从南面进攻，夺取里尔，以及另一个任务目标。

column1: The enemy airforce is completely destroyed, so our Stukas can work without any opposition, and bomb the enemy positions easily. We expect a fast and complete victory here which allow us to get the complete surrender of the French forces.
column2: 敌军航空兵已被彻底摧毁，因此我们的斯图卡(Stuka)可以毫无阻碍地行动，轻易轰炸敌军阵地。我们期待在此迅速取得全胜，从而迫使法国军队全面投降。

埃布罗河(Ebro) - 1938 年 11 月 2 日

column1: Feldmarschall Strock (Assistant Chief of Staff): Good day, Herr Oberst. Due to our need to expand our forces, you have been selected to train a group of young infantry school graduates. To get them started, you will assist our Nationalist friends in Spain at the river Ebro. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克元帅（助理参谋长）：你好，上校阁下。由于我们扩军的需要，你被选中去训练一批年轻的步兵学校毕业生。为让他们起步，你将在埃布罗河协助我们在西班牙的民族主义阵营朋友。祝好运。
赫罗纳(Gerona) - 1939 年 1 月 31 日

column1: Feldmarschall Strock (Assistant Chief of Staff): Good day, Herr Oberst. After your victory you can assist our Nationalist friends in Spain at the city of Gerona. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克元帅（助理参谋长）：你好，上校阁下。胜利之后，你可以到西班牙的赫罗纳城协助我们在民族主义阵营的朋友。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Let me be the first to congratulate you on your promotion, Herr General! We are very pleased by your performance. I know you deserve to celebrate, but keep it short, you'll need your rest. You have a long day ahead of you tomorrow.
column2: 施特罗克：请允许我第一个祝贺你晋升，将军阁下！我们对你的表现非常满意。我知道你该庆祝一下，但别太久，你需要休息。明天还有漫长的一天等着你。

column1: Strock: Herr General, we have a pressing situation with Poland. For months now, the Führer has been trying to negotiate with them a generous settlement regarding Katowitz and Danzig. Since they have numerous allies on their side, including England, they have been very unreasonable and unrelenting in their demands. Several days ago, they have gotten so arrogant that they crossed our border at several places. The Führer felt obligated that in order to preserve the freedom of our citizens, we have to strike back. I want you to go forth with such force that they, and any future aggressors, will see that we will not be pushed into submission.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我们在波兰问题上面临紧迫局势。数月来，元首一直在就卡托维兹(Katowitz)与但泽(Danzig)问题与他们商谈一项宽厚的解决方案。由于他们那边有众多盟友，包括英格兰，他们的要求一直极不讲理、毫不松口。几天前，他们变得如此狂妄，竟在几处越过了我们的边界。元首感到有义务回击，以保全我们公民的自由。我要你以如此强大的力量出击，让他们以及任何未来的侵略者都看到，我们绝不会被逼屈服。

column1: Comrade General: You will command the Second Baltic Front in charge of liberating the city of Riga and most of Latvia!
column2: 将军同志：你将指挥波罗的海沿岸第2方面军，负责解放里加(Riga)城与拉脱维亚(Latvia)大部！
托尔瓦湖(Tolvajarvi) - 1939 年 12 月 9 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, here is another opportunity for you and your men to gain valuable battlefield experience. The Soviet Union has invaded Finland, and Finland has requested our help. You will meet with Colonel Talvela at Tolvajarvi to assist him at repelling their enemy. Because we basically gave Finland to the Soviet Union, you and your men will go only as volunteers. If you are captured, the German government will deny the legitimacy of your identity.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，这里又有一个让你和你的部下获得宝贵战场经验的机会。苏联已入侵芬兰，芬兰已请求我们援助。你将在托尔瓦耶尔维与塔尔韦拉(Talvela)上校会合，协助他击退敌人。由于我们基本上已把芬兰让给了苏联，你和你的部下只能以志愿兵身份前往。若你们被俘，德国政府将否认你们身份的合法性。

column1: Major von Beck (Intelligence Officer): Sir, several of Colonel Talvela's units are isolated. Luckily, they have somewhat entrenched themselves and can hold out for some time in case they get discovered. We also have a unit of Fallschirmjager due to arrive in approximately six hours to assist them.
column2: 冯·贝克(von Beck)少校（情报军官）：长官，塔尔韦拉上校的几支部队已被孤立。所幸他们多少构筑了工事，万一被发现也能支撑一段时间。我们还有一支伞兵部队约六小时后抵达，前来支援他们。

column1: Strock: Herr General, the Soviets are withdrawing in disarray! You achieved a great victory!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，苏军正溃乱撤退！你取得了重大胜利！
圣康坦(St. Quentin) - 1940 年 5 月 14 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, the French have discovered that our west wall is weak, and numerous confrontations have erupted between our border guards and their patrols. The Fuhrer has decided to solve this problem in the same manner as the Polish campaign, and we have to do this now. Because as time passes, the Allies get stronger. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，法国人已发现我们的西墙虚弱，我方边防部队与他们的巡逻队之间已爆发多次冲突。元首已决定以与波兰战役相同的方式解决这个问题，而我们必须现在就动手。因为随着时间推移，盟军会越来越强。祝好运。

column1: von Beck: Sir, there are enemy anti-aircraft batteries and at least two enemy fighter units operating in the area. For support, we are receiving a fighter and a bomber unit, which are due to arrive in eight hours. Additional infantry support is delayed and won't be arriving for another two and a half days.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，该地区有敌军高炮连，至少还有两支敌军战斗机部队在活动。作为支援，我们将得到一支战斗机部队和一支轰炸机部队，约八小时后抵达。额外的步兵支援被延误，还要再过两天半才能到达。

column1: Strock: Due to your success in this campaign, the French are now on the run. Good job!
column2: 施特罗克：由于你在这场战役中的成功，法国人如今正在溃逃。干得好！
索姆河 - 1940 年 6 月 5 日

column1: Herr General, we are now at the second stage of our French campaign. Our victory here will cut off the French from their British allies. Good luck to you.
column2: 将军阁下，我们现在进入法国战役的第二阶段。我们在此取胜，就能把法国人与他们的英国盟友隔开。祝你好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, despite the enemy resistance you have destroyed the enemy factory!!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，尽管敌人顽抗，你仍摧毁了敌军工厂！！
西迪拜拉尼(Sidi Barrani) - 1940 年 9 月 13 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, Mussolini has requested your guidance, along with several reconnaissance, panzer, and artillery units to assist him in Egypt. Furthermore, since our Luftwaffe can deploy very quickly, you can bring all of your available aircraft. You and your detachment won't be away long and the rest will stay as a contingency force. This will be a great opportunity for some of your units to gain valuable battlefield experience. Good luck to you.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，墨索里尼(Mussolini)已请求你前往指导，并带上几支侦察、装甲与炮兵部队到埃及协助他。此外，由于我们的空军能极快部署，你可以带上所有可用的飞机。你和你的分遣队不会离开太久，其余部队将留作应急力量。这对你的一些部队来说，是获得宝贵战场经验的大好机会。祝你好运。

column1: von Beck: Sir, there is a fighter unit and a bomber unit that are six hours away and two unmotorized infantry units that are about fourteen hours away to reinforce us. Other than those, the Italians have no more forces to commit.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，有一支战斗机部队和一支轰炸机部队距此六小时路程，还有两支非摩托化步兵部队约十四小时路程，可用来增援我们。除此之外，意大利人再无兵力可投入。

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General. You have stopped the British offensive!
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下。你已挡住英军的攻势！
班加西(Benghazi) - 1941 年 1 月 24 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, due your success at Sidi Barrani, Mussolini once again requests your guidance. This time, it is to recapture Benghazi in Cyrenaica. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，由于你在西迪拜拉尼的成功，墨索里尼再次请求你前往指导。这一次，是夺回昔兰尼加(Cyrenaica)的班加西。祝好运。

column1: von Beck: Sir, there are additional enemy fighters on the way to add to what they currently have. They are several days away, but exactly how many days, we don't know.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，还有更多敌军战斗机正在赶来，将加入他们现有的兵力。它们距此有数日路程，但究竟几天，我们不知道。

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General. Now, you and your reconnaisance crew need to do your celebrating in my plane, and your Luftwaffe needs to get rest right away for their journey to Berlin tomorrow. All of us have to get there ASAP. There, you will be briefed on the next mission. You are going to England!
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下。现在，你和你的侦察机组得到我的飞机上去庆祝，你的空军也得马上休息，明天还要飞往柏林。我们都得尽快赶到那里。在那里，你会听取下一个任务的简报。你要去英格兰了！
格拉斯哥(Glasgow) - 1941 年 3 月 13 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, while the rest of the Luftwaffe are busy with the ports of Liverpool and Glasgow, your mission is to destroy a munitions factory nearby. Unfortunately, you have a ground restriction, we are only able to land two of your ground units. The rest of the ground units you will have attached to you are Fallschirmjager units that have been inserted several days ago. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，当空军其余部队忙于利物浦(Liverpool)与格拉斯哥的港口时，你的任务是摧毁附近的一座弹药工厂。不幸的是，你在地面兵力上有限制，我们只能让你空运两个地面部队。配属给你的其余地面部队，是几天前已潜入的伞兵部队。祝好运。

column1: von Beck: Sir, since we can only land two ground units, may I suggest that we land our recon units? As far as the Fallschirmjager units are concerned, there is a problem. In the process of acquiring ground transports, they have been compromised, and the British home guards are alerted. The good news is that they have stolen an AAA gun for our protection.
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，既然我们只能空运两个地面部队，我建议空运我们的侦察部队？至于伞兵部队，有个问题。他们在搞地面运输车辆的过程中暴露了，英国国民自卫队已提高警惕。好消息是他们偷来了一门高射炮供我们自卫。

column1: The Allies pushed us to the mountains, but we still keep the important passes.
column2: 盟军把我们逼进了山里，但我们仍守着那些重要的隘口。
明斯克 - 1941 年 6 月 30 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, we are now in Operation Barbarossa. We have to neutralize Russia before we can conclude our war with England. We will do this by pushing back the Russian army far enough to keep their air forces from attacking our homeland and to deprive them of their use of naval bases. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我们现在已进入巴巴罗萨行动(Operation Barbarossa)。我们必须在结束对英战争之前先解除俄国的威胁。办法是把俄军逼退得足够远，使其空军无法攻击我们的本土，并剥夺他们使用海军基地的能力。祝好运。

column1: Strock: Herr General, with the success of Operation Barbarossa on all fronts, our leadership has decided to shift production away from guns and tanks to U-boats and aircraft. Therefore, our ability to resupply will be reduced significantly in the coming months. Take care of our equipment.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，随着巴巴罗萨行动在各条战线上的成功，我们的领导层已决定把生产从火炮与坦克转向潜艇与飞机。因此，未来几个月我们的补给能力将大幅下降。爱惜我们的装备。
奥尔沙(Orsha) - 1941 年 8 月 1 日

column1: Major Mannheim (Logistics Officer): I have excellent news, sir. We have captured a fully operational Soviet tank, and we have plenty of ammunition to go along with it.
column2: 曼海姆(Mannheim)少校（后勤军官）：我有极好的消息，长官。我们缴获了一辆完全可用的苏军坦克，还有充足的弹药可用。

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General! Now, our drive to Moscow is nearly complete. Also, the General Staff has successfully persuaded the Fuhrer to resume the manufacture of guns and tanks; so now in a matter of months, we will again have the ability to upgrade into the latest equipment.
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下！现在，我们向莫斯科的推进已接近完成。另外，总参谋部已成功说服元首恢复火炮与坦克的生产；所以再过几个月，我们就又能升级到最新装备了。
莫斯科 - 1941 年 11 月 26 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, I want you to take some of your units, along with an attachment from General Strauss' 9.Armee, and lead the advance party to capture Moscow. Winter is upon us and we want to end this war quickly. Good luck.
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，我要你带上你的一部分部队，连同施特劳斯(Strauss)将军第9集团军的一支配属部队，率领先遣队去夺取莫斯科。冬天已至，我们想尽快结束这场战争。祝好运。

column1: Mannheim: Sir, 9.Armee has a captured Soviet tank and artillery piece and asks us not to fire at them.
column2: 曼海姆：长官，第9集团军有一辆缴获的苏军坦克和一门火炮，要求我们不要向它们开火。

column1: von Beck: Sir, You have achieved a great victory liberating all the Bolchevicks polytical prissoners!
column2: 冯·贝克：长官，你取得了一场重大胜利，解放了所有布尔什维克的政治犯！
海狮43(SeaLion43) - 1943 年 8 月 9 日

column1: Strock: Herr General, you have been selected to lead the invasion of England! Do not dissapoint us!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，你已被选中领军入侵英格兰！不要让我们失望！

column1: Debark your troops from the landing zones
column2: 让部队离开登陆场下船

column1: Strock: Excellent work, Herr General! You have successfully established a bridgehead in English territory!
column2: 施特罗克：干得漂亮，将军阁下！你已成功在英格兰领土上建立桥头堡！

column1: The Romanian army, with the help of its German ally, musters its strength to capture the Soviet controlled city of Kishinev.
column2: 罗马尼亚军队在德国盟友的帮助下集结兵力，准备夺取苏军控制的基希讷乌城。
赤色威胁(Red Menace) - 1945 年 8 月 8 日

column1: International tensions boil over into a full blown Russian invasion of Western Europe. You must stop the Red Menace from over running Berlin and push them back across the Oder. Renforcements are on the way...
column2: 国际紧张局势沸腾成了俄国对西欧的全面入侵。你必须阻止红色威胁席卷柏林，把他们赶回奥得河(Oder)对岸。增援正在途中……

column1: Herr General you achieved what Napoleon could not do !!! You have taken the city of London!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你做到了拿破仑(Napoleon)做不到的事！！！你已拿下伦敦城！！！

column1: Herr General you have achieved what has not been done for thousand years the conquest of Britain!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你成就了千年来无人成就之事——征服不列颠！！！

column1: Herr General in order to plan an invasion of the continental USA we need a base in the Caribbean. The island of St. George has been selected. You will lead the invasion force!!!
column2: 将军阁下，为了筹划对美国本土的入侵，我们需要在加勒比海(Caribbean)有一个基地。圣乔治(St. George)岛已被选定。你将率领入侵部队！！！

column1: Herr General St. George is ours!!! Your victory cements our control of the area.
column2: 将军阁下，圣乔治是我们的了！！！你的胜利巩固了我们对这一地区的控制。

column1: Herr General you have been selected to lead an invasion of the continental USA. This unprecedented effort will entail the capture of the port-city of Savannah by an invasion force leaving from the island of St. George.  The Americans will defend up to the last men and they have powerful sea, air and land units in the area.  Good luck!!!
column2: 将军阁下，你已被选中率军入侵美国本土。这项前所未有的行动，将由一支从圣乔治岛出发的入侵部队夺取港口城市萨凡纳(Savannah)。美国人会战至最后一人，而且他们在该地区拥有强大的海、空、陆部队。祝好运！！！
萨凡纳野生动物保护区
沃索国家野生动物保护区(Wassaw Nat. Wildlife Res.)

column1: Herr General your great victory has secured a beachhead on American territory!!! We can have real posibilities of victory if our Japanese Allies can do the same on the west coast
column2: 将军阁下，你的重大胜利已在美国领土上夺得一处桥头堡！！！如果我们的日本盟友能在西海岸做到同样的事，我们就真有获胜的可能

column1: Strock: Herr General you have achieved victory, but the enemy has been able to withdraw most of its forces! The General Staff has decided to put somebody more daring in command for the final battles of the war! You will retire with honors, of course!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，你取得了胜利，但敌人得以撤走了大部分兵力！总参谋部已决定为战争的最后几场战斗换一位更有胆识的指挥官！当然，你将带着荣誉退役！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall Congratulations on your promotion!!! After a series of victories both East and West on American soil we are in a position to close conclusively the fight on the southern theater. We need to capture the city of Knoxville and destroy the atomic facilities at Oak Ridge. A victory here will put final victory at hand!!!
column2: 元帅阁下，恭喜你晋升！！！在美国土地上东西两线连番胜利之后，我们已有能力彻底终结南方战区的战斗。我们需要夺取诺克斯维尔(Knoxville)城，并摧毁橡树岭(Oak Ridge)的原子设施。在此取胜，最终胜利便唾手可得！！！

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall your wonderful victory has closed the fight on the southern front and your troops can be used on the final assault on the Washington area!!!
column2: 元帅阁下，你的精彩胜利已终结南方战线的战斗，你的部队可以投入对华盛顿地区的最后突击！！！

column1: Strock: I'm glad you made it out of there in one piece. Those Americans took us completely by surprise, and we lost a lot of good men. Now we have to redeploy all of our troops and take them south. This is most unfortunate. ... Herr General, the war is over for you! You have to retire! With honors of course....
column2: 施特罗克：我很高兴你完好无损地从那里脱身。那些美国人完全打了我们一个措手不及，我们损失了许多好兵。现在我们必须重新部署所有部队，把他们调往南方。这真是太不幸了。……将军阁下，你的战争结束了！你必须退役！当然是带着荣誉……

column1: Strock: The Oberkommando der Wehrmacht is highly dissapointed with your pitiful performance Herr General! You are demoted to rank of corporal where you can do less harm!
column2: 施特罗克：国防军最高统帅部(Oberkommando der Wehrmacht)对你那可怜的表现极为失望，将军阁下！你被降为下士，在那里你能少害些人！

column1: Colonel Schmidt?  Please, come in.  You have heard the news?  Maybe it is best that he did not return from Novgorod.  After all, the shame of utter defeat would have been too much for him to bear.  A slice of strudel Colonel Schmidt?
column2: 施密特上校？请进。你听说消息了吗？也许他没从诺夫哥罗德回来反倒是件好事。毕竟，惨败的耻辱对他而言太重，难以承受。来块果馅卷吗，施密特上校？

column1: You have failed miserably.  With the loss of our surface fleet, England remains dominant on the high seas. Report for reassignment immediately!
column2: 你惨败了。随着我们水面舰队的损失，英格兰仍在公海上占据主导。立即报到接受重新安排！

column1: The Spanish Civil War was a major conflict in Spain that started after an attempted coup d etat by a group of Spanish Army generals against the government of the Second Spanish Republic. The Civil War devastated Spain from 17 July 1936 to 1 April 1939.
column2: 西班牙内战是西班牙的一场重大冲突，始于一批西班牙陆军将领对第二共和国政府发动的未遂政变。这场内战使西班牙满目疮痍，自1936年7月17日持续至1939年4月1日。

column1: Adolf Hitler sent troops, aircraft, tanks, and other weapons to support Franco.
column2: 阿道夫·希特勒派出军队、飞机、坦克及其他武器支援佛朗哥。

column1: You must defend the bridge near Osera city - medium strong republicans units -  and occupy Villanueva city and bridge on rio Gallego.
column2: 将军阁下，您必须防守奥塞拉城附近的桥梁（共和军部队中等强度），并攻占比利亚努埃瓦城及加列戈河上的桥梁。

比利亚努埃瓦-德韦尔瓦

column1: The invasion of Poland marked the start of World War II in Europe.
column2: 入侵波兰标志着第二次世界大战在欧洲爆发。

column1: Herr General, you must occupy the bridge over Olesznica river and Pyszna river and defend the area.
column2: 将军阁下，您必须占领奥莱斯尼察河与皮什纳河上的桥梁，并防守该地区。
彼得库夫(Piotrkow) - 1939 年 9 月 7 日

column1: Herr General, Armeegruppe Sud is attacking Warsaw. You must occupy the roads and railroads south of Warsaw. This will allow you to use Karl railguns when needed.
column2: 将军阁下，南方集团军群正进攻华沙。你必须占领华沙以南的公路与铁路。这将使你能在需要时使用「卡尔」列车炮。

column1: Playing tip: Deploy airborne units (if any) at airfield.
column2: 技巧：把空降部队（如有）部署在机场。

column1: Good job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你设法守住了防线，甚至把那些赤色分子打退了几英里。

column1: Herr General, you must capture the bridge across the Vistula river.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须夺取维斯瓦河(Vistula)上的桥梁。

column1: On 13 May, the German XIX Army Corps forced three crossings near Sedan, executed by the motorised infantry regiments of 1st, 2nd and 10th Panzerdivision, reinforced by the elite Grossdeutschland infantry regiment. Instead of slowly massing artillery as the French expected, the Germans concentrated most of their tactical bomber force to punch a hole in a narrow sector of the French lines by carpet bombing. Hermann Goring had promised Guderian that there would be an extraordinary heavy air support of a continual eight hour air attack, from 8am until dusk...
column2: 5月13日，德军第19军在色当附近强渡，由第1、第2、第10装甲师的摩托化步兵团在精锐的大德意志步兵团加强下实施。德军没有像法军预料的那样缓慢集结炮兵，而是将大部战术轰炸机兵力集中，以地毯式轰炸在法军防线的一个窄段撕开缺口。赫尔曼·戈林曾向古德里安承诺，将从清晨8点至黄昏持续8小时，提供异常猛烈的空中支援……

column1: ...The Wehrmacht attacks France, across the Meuse river near the city of Sedan.
column2: ……国防军渡过默兹河，在色当城附近跨过法国边境发起进攻。

column1: On the 2nd day in a place near Meziers city, our support units - Grossdeutschland and 10th Panzer division will begin their attack.
column2: 次日，在梅济耶尔城附近，我方支援部队——大德意志师与第10装甲师——将发起进攻。
法国北部 - 1940 年 5 月 15 日

column1: Herr General, you must clear the banks of the Somme and Authie rivers from enemy soldiers. Near the Authie river location are standing strong enemy positions.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须肃清索姆河与欧蒂河(Authie)两岸的敌军士兵。欧蒂河一带设有坚固的敌军阵地。
马其诺防线 - 1940 年 5 月 17 日

column1: The Maginot Line is named after French Minister of Defense Andre Maginot, is a line of concrete fortifications, tank obstacles, artillery casemates, machine gun posts, and other defenses, which France has built along its borders with Germany and Italy, in the light of experience from World War I, and in the run-up to World War II. Generally the term describes either the entire system or just the defenses facing Germany, while the Alpine Line is used for the Franco-Italian defenses.
column2: 马其诺防线以法国国防部长安德烈·马其诺命名，是一系列钢筋混凝土工事、反坦克障碍、炮兵炮台、机枪阵地及其他防御设施，法国在第一次世界大战的经验与二战前夕沿德、意边境修建。通常该词指整套体系或仅指面向德国的防御，而「阿尔卑斯防线」用于法意之间的防御。

column1: Herr General - very strong enemy position - inf. and aty fortresses - you must use the artillery and Flak 88 units and fight through  over hill and enemy bunkers.
column2: 将军阁下——敌军阵地极为坚固，步兵与炮兵要塞——您必须动用炮兵与88毫米高射炮部队，翻越山丘、突破敌军地堡。

column1: Playing tip: Use paratroopers along with Stukas to conquer your objectives. 88mm AT units are also very effective against fortifications...
column2: 技巧：配合斯图卡使用伞兵来夺取目标。88 毫米反坦克炮部队对付工事也十分有效……
防御阵地 - 1940 年 5 月 19 日

column1: You must defend Le Cateau city and when possible you must attack at Beamont city the French supply depot and occupy it.
column2: 你必须守住勒卡托(Le Cateau)城，并在可能时进攻博蒙(Beamont)城的法军补给站并将其占领。
通往巴黎之路 - 1940 年 6 月 3 日

column1: Churchill refused the generous offer of the Führer. So be it...
column2: 丘吉尔(Churchill)拒绝了元首的宽厚提议。那就这样吧……

column1: It's a pity to be forced to crush this great nation of conquerors we admire so much.
column2: 被迫去粉碎这个我们如此钦佩的伟大征服者民族，实在令人遗憾。

column1: You must destroy airfields, other city defenses, RAF, land and navy units. Beware that islanders are defending their homes.
column2: 你必须摧毁机场、其他城市防御设施、皇家空军以及陆军和海军部队。要当心，岛民正在保卫他们的家园。

column1: Our Luftwaffe will pave the way for landings of our glorious Wehrmacht, support will be given by fallschirmjägers too.
column2: 我们的空军将为我们光荣的国防军登陆铺平道路，伞兵也会提供支援。
