column1: Brest - citadel on Bug river - has very strong artillery. You must use 2-4 artillery units, engineers and tanks to destroy all enemy units within the fort.
column2: 布列斯特——布格河上的要塞——火炮极为强大。您必须投入2至4个炮兵单位、工兵与坦克，肃清要塞内全部敌军。
明斯克 - 1941 年 6 月 26 日

column1: Encircle all soviet units near Minsk and destroy them. You must be as swift as an arrow because our units must quickly move to Smolensk, Viazma and Moscow...
column2: 合围明斯克附近的所有苏军部队并消灭他们。你必须快如箭矢，因为我们的部队必须迅速开往斯摩棱斯克、维亚济马和莫斯科……
博布鲁伊斯克(Bobruisk) - 1941 年 7 月 2 日

column1: The 21st Red army defends the bridges, you must occupy all the bridges and hold them as long as the relief comes.
column2: 红军第21集团军防守着那些桥梁，你必须占领所有桥梁，并坚守到援军到来。
布良斯克(Bryansk) - 1941 年 10 月 1 日

column1: The 50st Red army is defending the Bryansk area. You must attack the  Bryansk and Orel city areas and break down the resistance of the Soviet army - especially tank brigades and strong artillery batteries.
column2: 红军第50集团军正在防守布良斯克地区。你必须进攻布良斯克与奥廖尔(Orel)城区，打垮苏军的抵抗——尤其是坦克旅和强大的炮兵连。
莫扎伊斯克(Mozhaisk) - 1941 年 10 月 27 日

column1: Final attack on Moscow. The Winter war in Soviet Union is a very hard battle on the Eastern front.
column2: 对莫斯科的最后进攻。在苏联的冬季战争是东线一场极为艰苦的战斗。

column1: We have a chance for victory over Red army, but enemy resistance will be very strong. Soviet units from Siberia are tough troops. Bad weather, the severe frost, difficult trackless ground... in short it is a pure Soviet battlefield.
column2: 我们有机会战胜红军，但敌人的抵抗将非常顽强。来自西伯利亚的苏军部队是强悍的部队。恶劣天气、严寒、难以通行的无路地带……总之，这是一片纯粹的苏军战场。
杰米扬斯克(Demjansk) - 1942 年 2 月 1 日

column1: you must hold all your positions until further notice.
column2: 你必须守住所有阵地，直至另行通知。
哈尔科夫 42 - 1942 年 5 月 17 日

column1: The Soviets counterattack from the west and the east. Be careful, Soviet tank units will attack your position. Look toward the brunt of the battle being in the south-east and east. The second attack will come in the northwest. You must repel ground attacks and occupy two bridges on Kharkov river in order to secure our units attacking Voronez and the city of Stalingrad.
column2: 苏军从西面和东面反击。小心，苏军坦克部队会进攻你的阵地。预计战斗的主要压力在东南与东面。第二次进攻将来自西北。你必须击退地面进攻，并占领哈尔科夫河上的两座桥梁，以保障我军进攻沃罗涅日与斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)城的部队。
顿河 - 1942 年 8 月 6 日

column1: you must cross the Liska and Don rivers then occupy the bridges near Kalach.
column2: 你必须渡过利斯卡河(Liska)与顿河，然后占领卡拉奇(Kalach)附近的桥梁。

column2: 二战 1/2：突入波兰 - 1945 年 8 月 2 日

column1: General, we've got to keep the pressure on Ivan.
column2: 将军，我们得继续对伊万施压。

column1: This is the same ground Guderian crossed in 8 days in 1939.
column2: 这正是古德里安(Guderian)1939 年用 8 天穿越的同一片地域。

column1: You should be able to do better.
Your performance was pathetic and you cannot stay in charge in this campaign. The Allies have taken the Gustav Line and Rome is about to fall.
column2: 你的表现可悲，在这场战役中你不能再继续指挥。盟军已夺取古斯塔夫防线，罗马即将陷落。
新亚历山德罗夫斯卡亚
普罗奇诺奥科普斯卡亚
彼得罗巴甫洛夫斯卡亚

column1: The General Staff has decided that you should lead the attack against the British in North Africa.  Their will to fight has by no means been broken.  If we can push the English out of North Africa, we will gain access to the Suez Canal and the oil-rich Middle East.
column2: 总参谋部已决定由你领导对北非英军的进攻。他们的战斗意志丝毫没有瓦解。如果我们能把英国人赶出北非，就能打开通往苏伊士运河和石油资源丰富的中东的道路。
库尔斯克 - 1943 年 7 月 5 日

column1: The biggest tank battle of all time wis about to begin. Soviet tank armies, infantry, heavy artillery and Red air force will render your task highly difficult. Soviet defences are strong, they have fortified the area and have the resolution to hold it at all cost.
column2: 史上规模最大的坦克战即将开始。苏军坦克集团军、步兵、重炮兵与红军空军将使你的任务极为艰难。苏军防御坚固，他们已将该地区筑垒设防，并有不惜一切代价守住的决心。
向北之路 - 1943 年 8 月 1 日

column1: The attack on north and north-east line of operations on Zhukovka and Turgenevo cities is now about to start. If you can close nearer to Tula we could launch an attack on Moscow this year. Make this happen!
column2: 对茹科夫卡(Zhukovka)与图尔格涅沃(Turgenevo)两城北面与东北面作战地段的进攻即将开始。你若能逼近图拉，我们今年就能对莫斯科发起进攻。务必办到！

column1: A huge battle against the last Soviet units is about to begin, the Red army will fight to the finish and has countless forces. Unfortunately bad weather conditions are on its side like in 1941...
column2: 一场对付苏军最后部队的大战即将开始，红军将战至最后，且兵力不计其数。不幸的是，与 1941 年一样，恶劣天气站在他们一边……
巴格拉季昂(Bagration) - 1944 年 6 月 22 日

column1: Hell, this is the biggest counter-offensive against Armeegruppe Mitte so far!!!
column2: 见鬼，这是迄今对中央集团军群最大规模的反攻！！！
法莱斯(Falaise) - 1944 年 8 月 9 日

column1: Our encircled units in the Falaise pocket must raise the blockade and connect with the rest of our units.
column2: 我部在法莱斯口袋中被合围的部队必须突破封锁，与主力会合。
屈斯特林(Kustrin) - 1945 年 1 月 20 日

column1: The Soviet attacks Berlin, Stalin has put Zhukov and Koniev into competition for the fall of the Capital city of the Reich. You must put an end to this plan and defeat both Soviet armies, Berlin will be the place where Stalin was stopped!!!
column2: 苏军进攻柏林，斯大林已让朱可夫(Zhukov)与科涅夫(Koniev)竞争夺取帝国首都之功。你必须终结这一计划，击败两支苏军，柏林将成为斯大林被挡住的地方！！！
塞洛(Seelow) - 1945 年 4 月 16 日

column1: Ivan crossed the Oder river, you must stop this onslaught otherwise this is the end of our glorious Reich!
column2: 伊万已渡过奥得河，你必须挡住这场猛攻，否则我们光荣的帝国就完了！

column1: The German forces attempt to cut the Eastern United States in half, while the Americans try to hold onto Knoxville, site of the gold reserves.
column2: 德军试图把美国东部一分为二，而美军则力图守住诺克斯维尔——黄金储备所在地。

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and the gate for Moldavia is open! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！敌人已经投降，通往摩尔达维亚(Moldavia)的门户已经打开！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Very well done!  You have exceeded the General Staff's hopes!  Your drive through the Lillehammer Valley has broken enemy resistance. And, because of your bold attack, the Norwegian government has sued for peace.  Congratulations!
column2: 干得非常好！你超出了总参谋部的期望！你穿过利勒哈默尔山谷的推进粉碎了敌军抵抗。而且，由于你的果敢进攻，挪威政府已求和。恭喜！

column1: We have the silos. Our forces will have to rest before we can restart the drive
column2: 我们拿下了那些发射井。我们的部队必须休整，才能重新开始向

column1: to Moscow... Let's hope Stalin doesn't have any more secret weapons.
column2: 莫斯科的推进……但愿斯大林没有更多秘密武器了。

column1: With the bridges cut, the supply of Soviet materials have been cut down to a trickle. Good job Commander. However, I am now aware that your presence is requested back in the Seelow Heights.
column2: 桥梁被切断后，苏军物资的补给已缩减到涓涓细流。干得好，指挥官。不过，我现在得知，塞洛高地(Seelow Heights)那边要求你回去。

column1: General you narrowly achieved victory and closed the mountain passes to the Soviet troops !!! They will have to agree to an armistice now !!!
column2: 将军，你勉强取得了胜利，并封闭了通往苏军的高山隘口！！！他们现在只能同意停战了！！！

column1: Herr General, your victory at Lillehammer allows us an opportunity to crush our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
column2: 将军阁下，你在利勒哈默尔的胜利使我们有机会粉碎我们的宿敌法国。他们的军队号称是世界上最精锐的。我们走着瞧！现在，我们相信盟军会以进军比利时来回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率领你的部队穿过阿登地区，出现在敌人后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国成为强国。你在色当的胜利将使德国重获那一地位。

column1: Congratulations on your successful escape from Finland, Herr General.  Rapid developments over the past few months have caused the General Staff to forget your failure there.  You are given one last chance - to play an important role in our invasion of France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
column2: 恭喜你从芬兰成功脱身，将军阁下。过去数月形势的迅速发展，使总参谋部淡忘了你在那里的失败。你得到了最后一次机会——在我们入侵法国中扮演重要角色。据说他们的军队是世界上最精锐的。走着瞧吧！现在，我们认为盟军计划推进到比利时，以回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率部穿过阿登，出现在敌军后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国跻身列强。你在色当的胜利将使我们重返这一地位。

column1: Herr General, though you shamed the Wehrmacht with your miserable performance against the Poles, other recent victories have put the General Staff in a forgiving mood.  You have been granted another chance to lead an attack against our old enemy, France.  Their army is said to be the world's finest.  We shall see!  Now, we believe the Allies plan to push into Belgium in response to our offensive.  Your task is to lead your forces through the Ardennes and emerge behind the enemy.  Our victory at Sedan in 1870 made Germany a Great Power.  Your victory at Sedan will return us to that status.
column2: 将军阁下，尽管你对付波兰人时的糟糕表现让国防军蒙羞，但近来的其他胜利让总参谋部心情宽宥。你获准再有一次机会，领导对我们宿敌法国的进攻。据说他们的军队是世界上最精锐的。走着瞧吧！现在，我们认为盟军计划推进到比利时，以回应我们的攻势。你的任务是率部穿过阿登，出现在敌军后方。我们1870年在色当的胜利使德国跻身列强。你在色当的胜利将使我们重返这一地位。

column1: Ah, Good day, Herr General!  Please sit down  and allow me to explain the present situation.  The Spanish Nationalists have requested the help of Germany to wrest control of Spain from their enemies. In leading this expedition, you will have the opportunity to sharpen your skills in the art of war. You will test the General Staff's new ideas regarding tank use, concentration of force, and combined arms operations.  Your expertise can then be put to work towards the real objective:  the return of Germany to its proper place,  the leader of Europe.
column2: 啊，你好，将军阁下！请坐，容我说明当前局势。西班牙国民军已请求德国出手，帮助他们从敌人手中夺回西班牙的控制权。率领这支远征军，你将有机会磨炼自己的战争技艺。你将检验总参谋部关于坦克运用、集中兵力和合成兵种作战的新构想。此后，你的专长便可投入到真正的目标上：让德国恢复其应有的地位，成为欧洲的领袖。

column1: Commander, jolly good performance!  I think something stronger than tea is appropriate after your capture of Nancy.  Now, the door is open for our invasion of Germany.  Do you know, there's been talk, merely rumor at this stage, of honours, possibly a knighthood?  Coffee?
column2: 指挥官，干得真是漂亮！我看在你拿下南锡(Nancy)之后，该来点比茶更带劲的东西。现在，入侵德国的大门已经敞开。你知道吗，有些议论——眼下还只是传言——说要给你授勋，可能是骑士爵位？来杯咖啡吗？

column1: Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have escaped encirclement and already have begun to counterattack.  The General Staff has no need for incompetent commanders.
column2: 你的失败令人无法理解。敌军已逃出合围，并已开始反攻。总参谋部不需要无能的指挥官。

column1: Well, following your success at Sedan, your brave men must now capture the port of Dunkirk on the Channel.  Allied forces in Belgium will be trapped if we can secure this harbor.  With the British Army as prisoners, we can dictate peace on our terms.  Of course, the English are aware of this possibility and will fight  furiously to protect their lines of retreat.  Good luck to you.
column2: 好，继色当的胜利之后，你的勇士们现在必须夺取英吉利海峡上的敦刻尔克港。如果我们能拿下这个港口，在比利时的盟军部队就将陷入包围。把英国军队变成俘虏，我们就能按我们的条件决定和平。当然，英国人明白这种可能，他们会拼死保卫自己的撤退路线。祝你好运。

column1: Excellent! The spy has been quickly extracted, and the area secured.  Soon we shall find out what he has learned over the past three months.
column2: 太好了！间谍已被迅速接出，该地区也已确保安全。很快我们就会知道他这三个月来查到了什么。

column1: Herr General, German field commanders are not allowed to fail. Do you understand? I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 将军阁下，德军战地指挥官不允许失败。你明白吗？我对你无话可说了。

column1: Well, our forces have stormed ashore on England's beaches only to meet ferocious resistance.  Our drive to capture London has been stalled.  Now, your services are needed to capture Windsor, a vital communications center.  With this rail junction in our hands, London will be cut off from their industrial centers and be forced to surrender.  Good luck, Herr General.
column2: 唉，我们的部队强攻英格兰海滩，却遭遇了凶猛抵抗。我们攻占伦敦的推进已陷入停滞。现在需要你夺取温莎——一个重要的交通枢纽。这个铁路交叉点一旦落入我手，伦敦将与其工业中心隔绝，被迫投降。祝你好运，将军阁下。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General!  You have accomplished what has not been done for centuries, the conquest of England.  Now, the English have no choice but to sue for peace.  I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.  I salute you, Herr General!
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下！你完成了数个世纪以来无人做到的事——征服英格兰。现在，英国人别无选择，只能求和。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我们民族最伟大的英雄一道被铭记。我向你致敬，将军阁下！

column1: Well, you barely accomplished your mission, but the conquest of England is the positive result.  Now, the English will have no choice but to sue for peace.  You have been lucky, Herr General, with this narrow victory.
column2: 唉，你只是勉强完成了任务，但征服英格兰是积极的成果。如今，英国人将别无选择，只能求和。这场险胜，你真是走运，将军阁下。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General!  You have accomplished what has not been done for centuries, the conquest of England.  Now, the English have no choice but to sue for peace.  I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.
column2: 恭喜，将军阁下！你完成了数个世纪以来无人做到的事——征服英格兰。现在，英国人别无选择，只能求和。我可以向你保证，你的名字将与我们民族最伟大的英雄一道被铭记。

column1: Herr General, it may have been to your advantage to have remained in captivity. This failure was completely unexpected from an officer of your caliber and experience. Your services will no longer be required!
column2: 将军阁下，也许一直待在战俘营对你更有利。以你的才干和资历，这次失败完全出乎意料。我们不再需要你的效劳了！

column1: My commendations, Herr General!  Under harsh conditions, you have done very well!  Your complete victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience in this new type of warfare.  In addition, the new pro-German government in Spain will prove to be a useful ally in the coming years.
column2: 向你致敬，将军阁下！在严酷的条件下，你表现得非常出色！你的全胜表明，你已在这种新型战争中获得了宝贵的经验。此外，西班牙新成立的亲德政府将在未来数年里证明自己是个有用的盟友。

column1: Congratulations, Herr General.  Your aggressive leadership has shattered the British forces. Now, we must capture the port of Tobruk, before the English can prepare an effective defense.
column2: 祝贺你，将军阁下。你果断的领导已经击溃了英军。现在，我们必须赶在英国人做好有效防御之前，攻占托布鲁克港。

column1: You have pushed the British back, but they have managed to withdraw into their Tobruk fortress.  Unfortunately, we do not have the resources to capture Tobruk at this time.  The war in the desert will continue.  Herr General, you are to return to Germany immediately.
column2: 你击退了英军，但他们已设法撤入托布鲁克要塞。遗憾的是，我们眼下没有资源攻取托布鲁克。沙漠之战将继续。将军阁下，你必须立即返回德国。

column1: Thanks to your feeble efforts, the war in North Africa will continue to drag on.  You will return immediately to Germany to face a court martial. Your replacement here will be Herr General Rommel.  You are dismissed.
column2: 由于你软弱无力的表现，北非的战事将继续拖延下去。你须立即返回德国接受军事法庭审判。你在此处的继任者是隆美尔将军阁下。你可以退下了。

column1: Herr General, you must quickly crush the defenses of Tobruk and finish what you have so successfully begun.  If Tobruk falls into our hands, the British will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them into the sea.
column2: 将军阁下，你必须迅速粉碎托布鲁克的防御，把你如此成功地开始的事业进行到底。如果托布鲁克落入我们手中，英国人将永远无法恢复。现在正是我们把他们赶下海的机会。

column1: Congratulations!  The General Staff is pleased by your performance.  Egypt and the Middle East lie at our feet. Herr General, you have exceeded all expectations. Your mastery of the art of war continues to dismay our enemies.
column2: 恭喜！总参谋部对你的表现十分满意。埃及和中东已匍匐在我们脚下。将军阁下，你超出了所有的预期。你对战争艺术的掌握持续令我们的敌人沮丧。

column1: Well, Herr General, you have managed to take Tobruk after a hard fight, but the English were still able to withdraw and strengthen their forces in Egypt.  Unfortunately, the war in North Africa will continue to drag on, since we lack the resources to sustain a major effort in the desert.
column2: 唉，将军阁下，你经过苦战拿下了托布鲁克，但英军仍得以撤退，并加强了在埃及的兵力。遗憾的是，北非战争将继续拖延，因为我们缺乏资源在沙漠维持大规模行动。

column1: Herr General, you have disgraced the Wehrmacht with your conduct of this battle!  Many here demand your return to Berlin to face a court-martial.  Your services will no longer required.
column2: 将军阁下，你在这场战斗中的表现让国防军蒙羞！这里许多人要求你返回柏林接受军事法庭审判。你的效劳不再需要了。

column1: Ah, Herr General, I hope you have enjoyed your leave.  As you know, British and Commonwealth  troops have occupied the historic pass at Thermopylae.  You must secure this pass and prevent the escape of the enemy.  The terrain is rugged and difficult for maneuver.   You must act decisively.
column2: 啊，将军阁下，希望你享受了休假。如你所知，英国和英联邦部队已占领历史性的温泉关。你必须夺取这个隘口，阻止敌人逃脱。地形崎岖，难以机动。你必须果断行动。

column1: Herr General, I must congratulate you on this resounding success.  British and Commonwealth forces have surrendered, and Greek resistance has collapsed.  You handled this difficult assignment with great skill and intelligence.  You will be, no doubt, honored when you return to the fatherland.
column2: 将军阁下，我必须为这次响彻四方的成功向你祝贺。英军和英联邦部队已经投降，希腊的抵抗也已瓦解。你以高超的技艺和智慧完成了这项艰巨的任务。当你回到祖国时，无疑将受到表彰。

column1: I am aware that conditions have been harsh, but you have done poorly!  The only positive result is that you and your troops have gained some experience in this new type of armored warfare.   But, the new Spanish government and our other allies have not yet learned to respect our military capabilities which we require!   Herr General, do not disappoint us again.
column2: 我知道条件一直很艰苦，但你们打得并不好！唯一的好消息是你和你的部队在这种新型装甲战中积累了一些经验。但是，新的西班牙政府以及我们的其他盟国，还没有学会尊重我们所需的军事能力！将军阁下，不要再让我们失望了。

column1: The English have withdrawn, and Greek resistance has collapsed.   Your performance has been adequate.  Thank you, Herr General.
column2: 英军已撤离，希腊抵抗已崩溃。你的表现尚可。谢谢，将军阁下。

column1: Good Work, the British have been withdrawn from the Portsmouth area!, and now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.
column2: 干得好，英军已从朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)地区撤走！现在我们可以在这里建立司令部，并开始从大陆本土接收补给。

column1: Herr General, you have failed.  The British have successfully withdrawn.  We expected more from you.  Dismissed.
column2: 将军阁下，你失败了。英军成功撤离了。我们对你的期望更高。解职。

column1: For far too long, the English based on Malta have interrupted our flow of supplies to North Africa.  You have been selected to lead an elite assault force and subdue this enemy stronghold.  You must secure all the island's harbors and airfields so that our hold on the Mediterranean is secure.
column2: 太久以来，盘踞马耳他的英军一直切断我们对北非的补给流。你被选中率领一支精锐突击队，去制服这座敌军堡垒。你必须确保该岛所有港口和机场，好让我方对地中海的掌控牢不可破。

column1: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.  Excellent work!
column2: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。应当祝贺你。干得漂亮！

column1: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.
column2: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。应当祝贺你。

column1: Your successful capture of Malta has secured our position in the Mediterranean basin.  The English will trouble us no longer, and the entire area is under our control.  Good day, Herr General.
column2: 你成功夺取马耳他，巩固了我们在地中海盆地的地位。英国人再也不会给我们添麻烦了，整个地区都在我们掌控之下。日安，将军阁下。

column1: German field commanders are not allowed to fail.  I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 德军战地指挥官不允许失败。我对你无话可说了。

column1: Herr General, this victory is worthy of great praise. The southern front is now secure, and, more importantly, the Ukraine with its rich resources is ours.  It is my pleasure to inform you that your request for leave has been granted.  Berlin is beautiful in the summer.  Enjoy yourself.
column2: 将军阁下，这场胜利值得大力褒奖。南方战线现已稳固，更重要的是，拥有丰富资源的乌克兰已归我们所有。我很高兴通知你，你的休假申请已获批准。夏日的柏林很美。尽情享受吧。

column1: Herr General, you must break through and encircle the enemy along the Polish frontier, exploiting their lack of mobility.  We will send pre-emptive strikes to destroy the Polish air force, therefore no aircraft will impede your advance.  Speed is essential; a successful advance here will allow us to threaten Warsaw from the north and east simultaneously.  In addition, we can welcome our Soviet friends to the key city of Brest-Litovsk on the new German-Soviet border.  The General Staff will not be pleased if it is the Soviets who welcome us instead.
column2: 将军阁下，您必须沿波兰边境实施突破并包围敌军，充分利用其机动性不足的弱点。我们将发动先发制人的打击摧毁波兰空军，因此不会有敌机阻碍您的推进。速度至关重要；此处的成功推进将使我们得以从北面和东面同时威胁华沙。此外，我们还能够在德苏新边界上的重镇布列斯特-立托夫斯克迎接我们的苏联友军。倘若反过来是苏联人迎接我们，总参谋部绝不会高兴。

column1: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
column2: 将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。

column1: Herr General. Even now, enemy troops are advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines. You may leave at once.
column2: 将军阁下。即便此刻，敌军正在向我阵地推进。拿起一支步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。你可以立即离开了。

column1: Excellent. The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And, even now,  communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed.  Leningrad should now fall easily; Moscow will be more problematic.
column2: 出色。布尔什维克军队已被切断，毫无解围希望。而且，即便此刻，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通已被切断。列宁格勒如今应可轻易拿下；莫斯科会更棘手些。

column1: A  good performance, to be sure. The Bolshevik armies are cut off without hope of relief.  And, even now,  communication between Moscow and Leningrad has been severed.  Leningrad should now fall easily; Moscow will be more problematic.
column2: 确实是不错的表现。布尔什维克军队已被切断，毫无解围希望。而且，即便此刻，莫斯科与列宁格勒之间的交通已被切断。列宁格勒如今应可轻易拿下；莫斯科会更棘手些。

column1: Herr General, you have narrowly achieved your objectives.  Unfortunately, the Soviet armies have been able to withdraw in good order and regroup behind new defensive lines.  You are obviously suffering from combat stress and will be reassigned to oversee the construction of beach defenses in Norway.  Dismissed.
column2: 将军阁下，你勉强达成了目标。遗憾的是，苏联各集团军得以有序后撤，并在新的防线之后重新集结。你显然患有战斗疲劳症，将被调去监督挪威滩头防御工事的构筑。你被解职。

column1: Herr General, our drive on Moscow has been quite successful, but enemy resistance continues to stiffen.  You must break through along the Volokolamsk Highway.   There is no doubt; the enemy will commit his toughest units to defend the capital, but we will persevere.
column2: 将军阁下，我们对莫斯科的推进相当顺利，但敌军抵抗日益顽强。您必须沿沃洛科拉姆斯克公路实施突破。毫无疑问，敌人必将投入其最精锐的部队保卫首都，但我们定能坚持到底。

column1: Herr General, you have exceeded our expectations.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await your attack.  Defeat them and end this war.
column2: 将军阁下，你超出了我们的期望。敌军英勇作战，但这没能阻止你。如今，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，结束这场战争。

column1: Herr General, the enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  And now, the last Bolshevik reserves await your attack.  Defeat them and end this war.
column2: 将军阁下，敌军英勇作战，但这没能阻止你。如今，布尔什维克最后的预备队正等着你的进攻。击败他们，结束这场战争。

column1: Herr General,  you narrowly accomplished what was expected of you.  Unfortunately, the Soviets held the Volokolamsk Highway long enough for more troops to arrive.  In addition, heavy snows are now falling.  Our offensive cannot continue under these conditions. Herr General, you are not suited to command at this level.  You will report to the officer training school at Metz. There is an opening for a panzer maintenance instructor.
column2: 将军阁下，你只是勉强完成了对你的期望。遗憾的是，苏军守住沃洛科拉姆斯克公路足够久，让更多部队得以抵达。此外，现在正下着大雪。在这种条件下，我们的攻势无法继续。将军阁下，你不适合这一层级的指挥。你将去梅斯的军官学校报到。那里有个装甲维护教官的空缺。

column1: Well,  Herr General, a bold stroke from the city of Klin to Fedoroloka will close the ring on Moscow. If we can drive through to this point, the enemy capital will surely be ours.  Good luck!
column2: 将军阁下，由克林向费多罗夫卡发起一次大胆突击，即可合拢对莫斯科的包围。若能推进至此，敌国首都必归我有。祝您好运！

column1: Superb  performance, Herr General! The Bolsheviks have fled to Siberia and sued for peace. You have helped accomplish what Napoleon could not -  the conquest of Russia!  Our panzers rumble through Red Square, and our troops sleep in the Kremlin!  Your reputation in war is unparalleled.
column2: 表现得极为出色，将军阁下！布尔什维克已逃往西伯利亚并求和。你助我们完成了拿破仑未能做到的事——征服俄国！我们的装甲部队隆隆驶过红场，我们的士兵睡在克里姆林宫！你在战争中的威望无与伦比。

column1: The Great Stalin himself congratulates you and your devoted young troops; you are true Communists.  The fascists are fleeing before us, and now our army has successfully crossed the Dnepr.  Very good work, Comrade.
column2: 伟大的斯大林本人向你和你忠诚的年轻部队致贺；你们是真正的共产党人。法西斯分子正在我们面前逃窜，如今我军已成功渡过第聂伯河。干得非常好，同志。

column1: Herr General, German field commanders are not allowed to fail. Do you understand?  I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 将军阁下，德军战地指挥官不允许失败。你明白吗？我对你无话可说了。

column1: Ah, Herr General, excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall! As you know, our campaign in the north continues to go well.  You have been chosen to lead our invasion in the south.  After your beachhead is secure,  it is imperative for you to seize the port city of Savannah. Once this is accomplished, our drive inland will cut the United States in half.  It is believed that the Americans are ignorant of our plans.  But be aware that the people of this region will fight us to their last breath.
column2: 啊，将军阁下，恕我失礼，元帅阁下！如你所知，我们在北方的战役进展顺利。你被选中指挥我方在南方的入侵。滩头堡巩固之后，你必须夺取港口城市萨凡纳。一旦达成，我们向内陆的推进将把美国一分为二。据信美国人对我们的计划毫不知情。但要注意，该地区的人民会与我们战斗到最后一息。

column1: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  The capture of Savannah will rank with Tannenberg and Koniggratz as great German victories.  There is talk of renaming the city in your honor.
column2: 恭喜！表现精彩。萨凡纳的攻占，将与坦能堡和克尼格雷茨并列为德国的伟大胜利。已有传言说要把这座城市以你的名字更名。

column1: Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  The capture of Savannah will be remembered as a great German victory.  There is talk of renaming the city in your honor.
column2: 恭喜！表现精彩。萨凡纳的攻占将被铭记为德国的一场伟大胜利。已有传言说要把这座城市以你的名字更名。

column1: Herr Feldmarshall, though your performance has been.....competent, the decision has been made to ... relieve you of command.  The General Staff feels it is best that a more.... seasoned officer replace you.  The great Erich von Manstein will assume your duties.
column2: 陆军元帅阁下，尽管你的表现……还算称职，但已作出决定……解除你的指挥权。总参谋部认为最好由一位更……老练的军官接替你。伟大的埃里希·冯·曼施泰因将接手你的职责。

column1: Herr Feldmarshall, I am at a loss for words.  Your failure is...  incomprehensible. You have left us no choice but to come to terms with the Americans. This debacle will be remembered as one of the worst military disasters of our nation.  It is better for you that you will never return to the fatherland.  Much better.
column2: 元帅阁下，我无言以对。你的失败是……不可理喻的。你让我们别无选择，只能与美国人达成协议。这场溃败将被铭记为我们民族最惨重的军事灾难之一。对你而言，永远不再回到祖国会更好。好得多。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, due to your unprecedented advance, we will soon see the triumphant finish of our Southern campaign.  Feldmarschall von Manstein's Army Group North is within 100 kilometers of Knoxville, and .....  excuse me, Herr Feldmarschall .....           Herr Feldmarschall, I have just received information of the most critical importance. Less than 20 kilometers north of us, here, is a large facility. Intelligence reports indicate that the Americans are building a weapon of terrifying explosive power there. It is imperative that we act decisively and destroy this facility.
column2: 元帅阁下，由于你前所未有的推进，我们很快将看到南方战役的胜利收官。冯·曼施泰因元帅的北方集团军群已推进至距诺克斯维尔100公里处，而且……恕我打断一下，元帅阁下……元帅阁下，我刚刚收到一份至关重要的情报。就在我们这里以北不到20公里处，有一处大型设施。情报报告显示，美国人正在那里建造一种具有可怕爆炸威力的武器。当务之急是我们必须果断行动，摧毁这处设施。

column1: Herr Feldmarschall, although you overran the Oak Ridge facility, the Americans had time to dismantle and move the most critical material. This Atomic Bomb may still a threat to us. We have no choice but to negotiate with the Americans.
column2: 陆军元帅阁下，尽管你攻占了橡树岭设施，美国人却有时间拆走并转移了最关键的材料。这枚原子弹可能仍是我们的威胁。我们别无选择，只能与美国人谈判。

column1: The Soviet Union has invaded Finland, Herr General, and our Finnish friends have trapped a Soviet division in the town of Suomussalmi. Unfortunately, an even greater Soviet relief force is moving to aid their comrades, and the Finns are outnumbered. It is your task to destroy the isolated enemy and prevent the relief force from reaching him. Of course, due to our non-aggression pact with the Soviet Union, you and your troops will be considered volunteers.  If you are defeated, the General Staff will deny any knowledge of your participation, and you may expect the worst if captured.
column2: 苏联已入侵芬兰，将军阁下，我们的芬兰友军已将一支苏军师围困在苏奥穆萨尔米镇。不幸的是，一支规模更大的苏军救援部队正前去接应他们的同志，而芬兰人兵力处于劣势。您的任务是歼灭这支被孤立的敌军，并阻止救援部队与之会合。当然，鉴于我们与苏联签有互不侵犯条约，您和您的部队将被视为志愿者。倘若您战败，总参谋部将否认知悉您的参与，而您一旦被俘，就别指望有什么好下场。

column1: We have reached the Atlantic coasts of France, the Allies and the survivors from the French army are embarking to England. Stalin has naming you as one of the peoples heroes after this action.
column2: 我们已抵达法国的大西洋海岸，盟军与法军残部正登船前往英格兰。此役之后，斯大林已把你列为人民英雄之一。

column1: The Germans try to open the gate to Moscow at Klin, while the Soviet
column2: 德军试图在克林(Klin)打开通往莫斯科的门户，而苏军

column1: forces attempt to slam it closed.
The Axis players take on the Allied players.
column2: 轴心国玩家对阵盟国玩家。

column1: If your performance does not improve, we will be forced to retire you. The spy is badly wounded. Only time will tell if he will live.
column2: 如果你的表现没有改善，我们将不得不让你退役。间谍伤势严重。他能否活下来，只有时间才能说明。

column1: The Soviets attempt to destroy the German-Romanian troops surrounded at Sevastopol.
column2: 苏军试图消灭被围在塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的德罗联军。

column1: PeG-WW2 Campaign: Mark Kirby, 01/06/2000 and Robert Mary, 03/01/2009
column2: PeG-WW2 战役：Mark Kirby，01/06/2000 与 Robert Mary，03/01/2009

column1: Comrade General you have stopped the German offensive. The enemy cannot release the Sixth Army! The Sixth Army is now doomed! The Rodina is safe!
column2: 将军同志，你已挡住德军的攻势。敌人无法为第6集团军解围！第6集团军现在注定覆灭！祖国安全了！

column1: Comrade General your success has trapped and destroyed important German troops at the city of Cherkassy! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你的成功已在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)城围歼了德军重要部队！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！
守住防线 - 1946 年 8 月 25 日

column1: Commander, it appears that once again High Command has grossly underestimated the ability of the Soviet forces to bounce back.
column2: 指挥官，看来最高统帅部又一次严重低估了苏军恢复元气的本事。

column1: You are facing another Russian offensive. They have broken through our front lines and are now bearing down on your position. You must meet this offensive and force it back.
column2: 你正面临俄军的又一次攻势。他们已突破我们的前线，如今正向你的阵地压来。你必须迎击这次攻势，并把它逼退。

column1: Playing tip: purchase paratroopers (with jeep so that they can move next turn after landing), then drop them to recapture lost VHs after a big bombing by tactical bombers...
column2: 技巧：购买伞兵（带上吉普车，这样他们着陆后的下一回合就能移动），然后在战术轰炸机大规模轰炸之后把他们空投下去，夺回丢失的胜利格……
闪击战：率领德国的党卫军装甲师

column1: You take command of Elite German SS PanzerDivisions from the civil war in Spain, to the blitzkrieg victories of early World War II, and then to the tough battles with the Allies later in the war.
column2: 你将指挥精锐的德国党卫军装甲师，从西班牙内战，到二战初期闪击战的胜利，再到战争后期与盟军的苦战。

column1: This is a very tough and lengthy campaign !
column2: 这是一场极为艰苦而漫长的战役！

column1: After many days of hard fighting in the northern part of Sicily elements of the Italian division "Aosta" and the 15th Panzergrenadier managed to briefly stop the overwhelming advance of Pattons forces. Patton was forced to replace the 3rd Infantry Division with the 45th because very high losses amongst his men. Meanwhile Patton was also concentring a large amount of artillery to try to break the Axis lines at Etna. Your mission is to stop the American advance and give the Axis time to evacuate the stationed troops on Sicily.
column2: 在西西里(Sicily)北部苦战多日之后，意大利「奥斯塔」(Aosta)师与第15装甲掷弹兵师的部分部队设法短暂挡住了巴顿(Patton)部队的压倒性推进。由于人员损失极为惨重，巴顿不得不把第3步兵师换成第45步兵师。与此同时，巴顿还在集中大量炮兵，试图突破埃特纳(Etna)的轴心国防线。你的任务是挡住美军的推进，给轴心国争取时间撤走驻西西里的部队。

column1: You have to resist sixteen turns in order to archieve victory. On the last turn for BV a unit will appear. Use this unit to take the goal next to it.
column2: 你必须坚守十六个回合才能取胜。在争取辉煌胜利的最后一回合会出现一支部队。用这支部队夺取它旁边的目标。

column1: The Soviets attack the Eighth Italian Army to threaten the flanks of Von Manstein relief force.
column2: 苏军进攻意大利第8集团军，以威胁冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)解围部队的侧翼。

column1: An Axis defeat here will mean the end of Winter Storm and the doom of Sixth Army.
column2: 轴心国在此战败，就意味着冬季风暴(Winter Storm)行动的终结与第6集团军的覆灭。

第2营/第2营/第68团/第2装甲师

column1: During the first days of August 1943 the German army evacuated 100.000 men and 10.000 vehicles stationed on Sicily. This represented a terrible failure for the Allies. You have to take advantage of the Allied mistakes.
column2: 1943 年 8 月初的头几天，德军从西西里撤走了 100,000 人和 10,000 辆车辆。这对盟军而言是一次可怕的失败。你必须利用盟军的失误。

column1: Delay the Allied advance on the north and south of Sicily and take control over the harbour of Messina (place units on the four port hexes (18,11); (17,11); (17,12); (18,13)) and prepare an escape route through Bagnara (ferry a unit across and occupy hex (35,4)).
column2: 迟滞盟军在西西里南北两面的推进，并控制墨西拿(Messina)港（把部队置于四个港口格 (18,11)；(17,11)；(17,12)；(18,13)），同时准备一条经巴尼亚拉(Bagnara)的退路（把一个部队摆渡过去并占领格 (35,4)）。

column1: Move units from PORT hexes ("Messina Harbour") to PORT hexes ("Reggio C. Harbour", "Villa S.G. Harbour") via the "strategic transport" button (see lower left button of any unit when right-clicking on it).
column2: 通过「战略运输」按钮（右键点击任一部队时见其左下方的按钮），把部队从（港口）格（「墨西拿港」）移动到（港口）格（「雷焦卡拉布里亚港」、「维拉圣乔瓦尼港」）。
雷焦卡拉布里亚港（港口）

column1: On September 9th Vietinghoff was unable to establish comunication with Kesselring and give orders to the 14th Panzerkorps to quickly concentrate all forces in Salerno and try to eliminate the beachhead. As a result the Allies managed to disembark several divisions.
column2: 9 月 9 日，菲廷霍夫(Vietinghoff)未能与凯塞林(Kesselring)建立联络，因而无法命令第14装甲军迅速把全部兵力集中在萨莱诺(Salerno)，以图消除登陆场。其结果是盟军得以卸下几个师。

column1: In front of the Gustav Line the Germans made another defensive line called the Reinhard Line, a.k.a. "Winter Line". Here the Germans planned to delay the Allied offensive as long as possible with the goal to obtain the largest amount of time in order to strengthen the Gustav Line. The central point in the Reinhard Line was Mignano's throat and the two summits around: Camino mont and Sammucro mont. By the time however the Germans had neither the time nor the men to fortify it...
column2: 在古斯塔夫防线之前，德军又构筑了一道防线，称为莱因哈德防线(Reinhard Line)，又名「冬季防线」。德军打算在此尽可能久地迟滞盟军攻势，以争取最多时间来加强古斯塔夫防线。莱因哈德防线的中心点是米尼亚诺(Mignano)隘口及其周围的两座山峰：卡米诺山(Camino mont)与萨穆克罗山(Sammucro mont)。然而到那时，德军既无时间也无人力去把它筑垒设防……

column1: Delay the Allied offensive. On the last turn for BV a hidden VH will appear. Take that hex.
column2: 迟滞盟军的攻势。在争取辉煌胜利的最后一回合会出现一个隐蔽胜利格。夺取该格。

column1: After the successes in Foggia, Termoli and Vinchiaturo the 8th army commanded by Montgomery decided to initiate an offensive. The Germans on the other hand used a break given by the Americans to reorganize their forces. The Germans retreated to the Tringo River and fortified themselves along the Sangro River.
column2: 在福贾(Foggia)、泰尔莫利(Termoli)与温基亚图罗(Vinchiaturo)取得胜利之后，由蒙哥马利(Montgomery)指挥的第8集团军决定发起攻势。而德军则利用美军给予的间歇重整部队。德军退到特里尼奥河(Tringo)一线，并沿桑格罗河(Sangro)构筑工事。

column1: At the end of 1943 the 8th Army advanced beyond the rivers Sangro and Moro, but was delayed at the Ortona-Orsogna Line.
column2: 1943 年底，第8集团军越过了桑格罗河与莫罗河(Moro)，但在奥尔托纳-奥尔索尼亚(Ortona-Orsogna)防线前被迟滞。

column1: As a prelude to the landing in Anzio the Allies forces make an operation against the Gustav Line in order to attract as many German units as possible to the Monte Cassino area.
column2: 作为安齐奥登陆的前奏，盟军对古斯塔夫防线发起一次作战，以尽量把德军部队吸引到卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)地区。

column1: The greatest first successes were scored by 5th and 56th British Infantry Divisions in the zone of Garigliano River, where they captured the towns of Minturno and Castelforte.
column2: 最初最大的战果由英国第5与第56步兵师在加里利亚诺河(Garigliano)一带取得，他们夺取了明图尔诺(Minturno)与卡斯泰尔福尔特(Castelforte)两镇。

column1: Your assignment: Restore the defensive line and crush the Allied bridgeheads.
column2: 你的任务：恢复防线，粉碎盟军的桥头堡。

column2: 夺取盟军所有胜利格，并保护轴心国的胜利格。

column2: 第29装甲掷弹兵师已奉命开赴该地区，将从西北抵达。

column1: Due to the delay on the Allied advance towards Rome, The Germans got an opportunity to regroup and fortify. With the retake of The Factory, Carroceto and Cisterna they furthermore had the possibility to launch an attack against the beachhead in Anzio. The Allies were still in lack of fuel and equipment, but they counted with a crushing air superiority and naval support.

column1: After the Balkans campaign, the Leibstandarte was given divisional status and reinforced with a new motorised infantry battalion.  Manpower shortages - thanks to restrictions placed on the number of SS personnel allowed by the Army - meant the division couldnt be fully fleshed out with reinforcements, and the situation was not helped any by Himmler's insistance that the Leibstandarte remain 'racially pure'.  While Volksdeutsche could serve in the SS, they were not accepted into the LSSAH.
column2: 巴尔干战役之后，警卫旗队获得了师级建制，并以一个新的摩托化步兵营得到加强。兵员短缺——由于陆军对党卫军人员数量所设的限制——意味着该师无法用补充兵员充实到满编，而希姆莱(Himmler)坚持警卫旗队必须保持「种族纯洁」，更使情况雪上加霜。虽然德意志裔人(Volksdeutsche)可以在党卫军服役，却不被警卫旗队接纳。

column1: The Leibstandarte was held in reserve for the opening stages of the assault on the Soviet Union due to the unit's ongoing reorganisation.  A week after the invasion the division crossed the Vistula and headed into Western Ukraine as part of III Panzer Corps, 1st Panzer Army.  Due to the rapid advance made by the Panzer units of Army Group South, the foot infantry was finding itself being left behind, with gaps appearing between the forces.  It was in this situation that the Leibstandarte showed the usefulness of motorised infantry by filling the gaps that had been left behind.
column2: 由于部队仍在整编，警卫旗队在进攻苏联的开局阶段被留作预备队。入侵一周后，该师渡过维斯瓦河，作为第1装甲集团军第3装甲军的一部进入乌克兰西部。由于南方集团军群的装甲部队推进迅速，徒步步兵发现自己被甩在后面，各部队之间出现了缺口。正是在这种情况下，警卫旗队填补了那些留下的缺口，显示出摩托化步兵的用处。

column1: When Soviet commander Budenny began moving a section of his forces on Odessa, leaving the remainder around Uman, Hitler found his hand forced.  He ordered the 6th Army to move south-east in the hopes of linking with the 17th Army, and trapping Soviet forces at Uman.  The Leibstandarte would have the task of parrying any Soviet counter-thrusts aimed at Von Kleists armoured column.
column2: 当苏军指挥官布琼尼(Budenny)开始把一部兵力调往敖德萨(Odessa)、把其余部队留在乌曼(Uman)一带时，希特勒觉得自己别无选择。他命令第6集团军向东南推进，希望与第17集团军会合，把苏军困在乌曼。警卫旗队的任务将是挡开任何针对冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)装甲纵队的苏军反击。
进攻罗斯托夫(Rostov) - 1941 年 11 月 17 日

column1: On 15th November, Army Group South had reached the Don River, the last natural obstacle before Stalingrad.  A penetration of some 600 miles into Soviet territory had been accomplished, in five months of bitter fighting.  The Leibstandarte was now transferred to the command of III Corps, 1st Panzer Army, and on the 17th began the attack on Rostov from the Black Sea coast.
column2: 11 月 15 日，南方集团军群已抵达顿河——斯大林格勒之前的最后一道天然障碍。经过五个月的苦战，已向苏联领土纵深突入约 600 英里。警卫旗队此时被转隶第1装甲集团军第3军指挥，并于 17 日从黑海沿岸发起对罗斯托夫的进攻。

column1: In October 1942, the LSSAH was transfered to Southern France for a spell of occupation duty. During this time, the unit was given a refit and was re-designated a Panzergrenadier Division.  In January 1943, the division was transfered back to the Eastern Front, with the situation of Army Group South verging on the collapse.  In February the division was re-designated once again, this time recieving the status of a Panzer Division.
column2: 1942 年 10 月，警卫旗队被调往法国南部执行一段占领勤务。在此期间，该部队得到整补，并被改称为装甲掷弹兵师。1943 年 1 月，该师被调回东线，当时南方集团军群的局势已濒临崩溃。2 月，该师再次被改称，这一次获得了装甲师的建制。

column1: The encirclement of the 6th Army at Stalingrad was a disaster of the worst kind for Germany.  A vast gap was formed in the line, through which Soviet troops stormed forward, towards Rostov, Kursk and Kharkov.  As Kursk fell on the 8th February, the right flank of Army Group B was forced onto Kharkov.  Hitler, remembering the way the Waffen-SS units defended themselves during the winter of 1941 ordered the SS-Panzer Corps to hold Kharkov.  SS-Panzer Corps commander  Paul Hausser disobeyed orders and pulled out of the city.  There they held firm and halted the Soviet attack.  Von Manstein now prepared an assault to destroy the Soviet troops around Kharkov.
column2: 第6集团军在斯大林格勒被合围，对德国来说是最糟糕的一类灾难。防线上出现了一个巨大的缺口，苏军由此向前猛冲，直指罗斯托夫、库尔斯克和哈尔科夫。2 月 8 日库尔斯克陷落后，B 集团军群的右翼被迫退向哈尔科夫。希特勒想起武装党卫军部队在 1941 年冬天自卫的方式，命令党卫军装甲军守住哈尔科夫。党卫军装甲军军长保罗·豪塞尔(Paul Hausser)违抗命令，撤出了该城。他们在那里坚守，挡住了苏军的进攻。冯·曼施坦因随即准备一次突击，以消灭哈尔科夫周围的苏军。

column1: In 1943 there were sharp divisions among the German high command on whether an offensive on the Eastern Front should be launched that year.  Heinz Guderian, recently called back to active duty was of the opinion that Germany would only be able to go on the offensive again in 1944, as the divisions were much too weak presently to go on the attack.  Von Manstein on the other hand, believed it essential to deal the Red Army a series of powerful blows and to remove the threat to the Ukraine and Crimea.  After months of deliberation, Hitler decided to chase one more big victory in Russia, 'that will shine like a beacon around the world'.  This would be known as 'Operation Zitadelle'.
column2: 1943 年，德军最高统帅部内部就是否当年在东线发起一次攻势产生了尖锐分歧。新近被召回现役的海因茨·古德里安(Heinz Guderian)认为，德国要到 1944 年才能再次转入进攻，因为各师目前过于虚弱，无法发起进攻。而冯·曼施坦因则认为，必须给红军一连串有力打击，并消除对乌克兰与克里米亚的威胁。经过数月斟酌，希特勒决定在俄国再追取一次大胜，「它将像灯塔一样照耀全世界」。这次行动将被称为「堡垒行动」(Operation Zitadelle)。

column1: The plan called for a converging strike by the 9th Army in the north and 4th Panzer Army to the south in the aim of enveloping the Kursk salient.  The Leibstandarte now with a new commander - Theodor Wisch, because of Dietrich's promotion - would operate in the south with 4th Panzer Army.  They were given the task of driving through the defences of the Voronezh Front before moving North-East to take Prokharovka.
column2: 计划要求北面的第9集团军与南面的第4装甲集团军实施向心突击，以包围库尔斯克突出部。警卫旗队此时换了新任指挥官——因迪特里希(Dietrich)晋升而由特奥多尔·维施(Theodor Wisch)接任——将在南面随第4装甲集团军作战。他们的任务是突穿沃罗涅日方面军的防御，然后向东北推进，夺取普罗霍罗夫卡。

column1: On the 10th the SS-Panzer Corps regrouped for the assault on Prokharovka.  Fighting through a sea of mud to the banks of the Psel River, to the west of the town and the last natural obstacle before Kursk, the SS formations had by late afternoon crossed the river and were in position to attack the rear of the Soviet concentration.  To the south 3rd Panzer Corps began battling toward Prokharovka, attempting to link up with the SS-Panzer Corps before Soviet reserves could be brought up.
column2: 10 日，党卫军装甲军重新集结，准备突击普罗霍罗夫卡。党卫军各部队在泥海中苦战，推进到该镇以西、库尔斯克之前最后一道天然障碍普肖尔河(Psel)畔；到下午晚些时候，他们已渡过该河，并进入可以攻击苏军集结地后方的位置。在南面，第3装甲军开始向普罗霍罗夫卡苦战前进，力图在苏军预备队调上来之前与党卫军装甲军会合。

column1: On the plain outside the small town scene the forces massed for the largest tank battle yet seen, and the final decisive encounter on the Eastern Front.  For the battle the Germans could muster some 600 tanks while the Soviets sent around 850 into battle.
column2: 在这座小镇外的平原上，双方部队集结起来，准备进行迄今为止规模最大的坦克战，也是东线上最后一场决定性的交锋。为这一战，德军能集结约 600 辆坦克，而苏军投入了约 850 辆。
日托米尔(Zhitomir) - 1943 年 11 月 19 日

column1: The Dniepr River offers the strongest natural defensive line in western European Russia, but the losses incurred in battles to the east of the river denied Hitler the resources adequately to man and fortify the line and, coupled with the fact that the Red Army had established five bridgeheads over the river, the positions the Wehrmacht held was at best tenuous.  The stark reality of the situation was that in just two and a half months Army Group Centre and South had been forced back for an average of 150 miles on a front 650 miles long, and in so doing, had the lost the most valuable territory taken during the advances of 1941-42.
column2: 第聂伯河是俄国西部最强的天然防线，但在该河以东各次战斗中遭受的损失，使希特勒没有资源为这道防线配备足够兵力并加以筑垒设防；再加上红军已在该河上建立了五个桥头堡，国防军所守的阵地充其量也只是勉强维持。形势的严酷现实是：仅仅两个半月，中央与南方两个集团军群就在一条 650 英里长的战线上平均后退了 150 英里，并因此丢掉了 1941-42 年推进中所夺取的最宝贵领土。

column1: In November the Leibstandarte was ordered back to the Eastern Front.  It travelled via Lvov to Tarnapol as part of 48th Corps of the 4th Panzer Army, and was rushed east into positions on the southern flank of the Kiev salient for a counter-attack that aimed at Zhitomir, and the Soviet bridgehead on the Dniepr.
column2: 11 月，警卫旗队奉命重返东线。它作为第4装甲集团军第48军的一部，经利沃夫(Lvov)开往塔尔诺波尔(Tarnapol)，随后被紧急调往东面，进入基辅(Kiev)突出部南翼的阵地，准备发起一次以日托米尔和第聂伯河上的苏军桥头堡为目标的反击。
古德伍德行动 - 1944 年 7 月 17 日

column1: On 11th July, Leibstandarte took over the Caen sector from the seriously depleted Hitlerjugend.  Here, over the coming week it played its most crucial role in the Normandy battles.  Beginning on 17th July, three British armoured divisions attempted to break through the gap between Caen and the eastern heights, across a small bridgehead over the Orne River and through the four lines of man-made and natural defences, then across the hills of Bourgebus and to the open ground beyond.
column2: 7 月 11 日，警卫旗队从损耗严重的「希特勒青年团」师手中接过卡昂地段。在此后一周里，它在这里扮演了诺曼底战役中最关键的角色。从 7 月 17 日开始，三个英国装甲师试图突穿卡昂与东部高地之间的缺口，越过奥恩河(Orne)上的一处小桥头堡，穿过四道人工与天然防御线，再越过布尔格比(Bourgebus)丘陵，直抵其后的开阔地。

column1: During late October and early November, the LSSAH as part of 7th Army, refitted itself with new equipment, though munitions and fuel were becoming scarce.  3,500 new recruits were also drafted in, with only the bare minimum level of training.  Towards the end of November the division was assigned to the Sixth Panzer Army, and on December 14th moved into positions to launch the coming winter offensive.
column2: 10 月底至 11 月初，警卫旗队作为第7集团军的一部，用新装备进行了整补，尽管弹药与燃料日益短缺。还征召了 3,500 名新兵，他们只受过最低限度的训练。11 月底，该师被编入第6装甲集团军，并于 12 月 14 日进入阵地，准备发起即将到来的冬季攻势。

column1: The attack began at first light on the 16th December against the American lines, which were thinly held by six divisions of resting and newly arrived troops.  The LSSAH attack came after the intial defences had been breached by the 12th Volksgrenadier Division, and the division - split into Kampfgruppe - made it's way through the heavy snow and narrow roads towards their objectives.
column2: 进攻于 12 月 16 日拂晓发起，直指美军防线；该防线由六个正在休整和新到的师稀疏地防守着。警卫旗队的进攻是在第12国民掷弹兵师突破最初防御之后发起的，该师分成若干战斗群，穿过大雪与狭窄的道路，向各自的目标前进。
查恩伍德行动 - 1944 年 7 月 8 日

column1: On the 8th July the Allies launched Operation Charnwood, an operation to secure the city of Caen.  The Leibstandarte, along with other German units was rushed to the British sector and until the 9th was engaged in repulsing the attack, which cost the life of former Leibstandarte regimental commander and current Hitlerjugend commander Fritz Witt, killed in his HQ by naval gunfire.
column2: 7 月 8 日，盟军发起查恩伍德行动，目的是夺取卡昂城。警卫旗队与其他德军部队一起被紧急调往英军地段，直到 9 日都在击退这次进攻；此战使前警卫旗队团长、现任「希特勒青年团」师师长弗里茨·维特(Fritz Witt)丧命，他在自己的司令部里被舰炮火力击毙。

罗斯托夫防御 - 1941 年 11 月 22 日

column1: The victory in capturing Rostov was a brief one.  During the following week the 1st Panzer Army, racked by sickness, badly overstreched and plagued by shortages, was battered by a fierce offensive by Tiimoshenko's 9th and 39th Armies.  Although retreat was the only viable option given the situation, Hitler refused to allow such a move.  In response to Hitler's 'no retreat' order, Von Rundstedt issued an ultimatum - either the order be rescinded or he be relieved of his command.  He was soon replaced by Walther von Reichenau.
column2: 夺取罗斯托夫的胜利十分短暂。在随后一周里，饱受疾病折磨、战线过长、物资短缺的第1装甲集团军，遭到铁木辛哥第9与第39集团军的猛烈攻势打击。尽管就当时形势而言撤退是唯一可行的选择，希特勒却拒绝允许这样的行动。针对希特勒的「不得撤退」命令，冯·伦德施泰特(von Rundstedt)发出最后通牒——要么撤销该命令，要么解除他的指挥权。他很快被瓦尔特·冯·赖歇瑙(Walther von Reichenau)取代。

黄色方案 - 1940 年 5 月 9 日

column1: The German assault in the west finally began before daylight on May 9th, with extensive air attacks on Dutch and Belgian airfields and the seizure of vital river crossings by paratroops.  When dawn came, the Leibstandarte, as part of 18th Army, Army Group B, drove into Holland, with its main column striking towards the southern Netherlands to envelop the southern flank of the 'Vesting Holland' region.
column2: 西线的德军进攻终于在 5 月 9 日天亮前开始，包括对荷兰与比利时机场的大规模空袭，以及伞兵夺取重要的渡河点。黎明到来时，警卫旗队作为 B 集团军群第18集团军的一部开入荷兰，其主力纵队向荷兰南部突击，以包抄「荷兰要塞」地区的南翼。

column1: The Leibstandarte was attached to the 227th Infantry Division, and had been given the role of penetrating the enemy defences and securing the road and river bridges along the advance to the Ijssel River after they had been captured by airborne troops.
column2: 警卫旗队被配属给第227步兵师，其任务是突穿敌军防御，并在空降部队夺取艾瑟尔河(Ijssel)沿线公路与河流桥梁之后，确保这些桥梁的安全。

column1: By midday LSSAH was 50 miles inside Dutch territory, but found its progress halted by blown bridges at Boernbrock and Zwolle.  To the south however, the 3rd Battalion found another crossing near Zutphen, and before it halted to rest that night the regiment had covered 130 miles.
column2: 到正午，警卫旗队已深入荷兰领土 50 英里，但发现其推进被伯恩布罗克(Boernbrock)与兹沃勒(Zwolle)被炸毁的桥梁所阻。不过在南面，第3营在聚特芬(Zutphen)附近找到了另一处渡口；当晚停下休息之前，该团已推进 130 英里。
黄色方案 - 1940 年 5 月 25 日

column1: After the fighting in Holland, the Leibstandarte was offered a brief rest, during which it remained under the command of the 18th Army.  Shortly after it was transported south, and crossed into France on the 20th of May.  The regiment soon found itself under the new command of the XXXXIV Corps, 6th Army, Army Group B.  The Leibstandarte was then moved to positions along the Aa canal, which formed part of the defensive perimeter of the trapped BEF.
column2: 荷兰的战斗之后，警卫旗队得到短暂的休整，其间仍归第18集团军指挥。不久之后它被南运，并于 5 月 20 日进入法国。该团很快便归 B 集团军群第6集团军第44军指挥。随后警卫旗队被调往阿河(Aa)运河沿线的阵地，那里是被围英国远征军防御周界的一部分。

column1: On 25th May, against Hitler's orders, Dietrich ordered an assault across the canal to eliminate the French artillery positions on the Wattenberg heights, which commanded the surrounding flatlands.  During the middle of the attack, General Guderian - to whose Panzer Corps the Leibstandarte was subordinate - appeared at Dietrich's HQ demanding to know why orders were being disobeyed.  Dietrich replied that the enemy on Mont Watten could 'look right down the throat' of anyone on the far bank of the canal.  Suitably appraised of the situation and encouraged by the early success of the advance, Guderian immediately approved the decision taken by Dietrich and ordered the 2nd Panzer Division to move up in support.
column2: 5月25日，迪特里希违抗希特勒的命令，下令越过运河发动进攻，以消灭瓦滕贝格高地上的法军炮兵阵地——那些阵地俯瞰着周围的平原。进攻进行到一半时，古德里安将军——警卫旗队所属装甲军的军长——出现在迪特里希的司令部，质问为何违抗命令。迪特里希回答说，蒙瓦滕的敌人能「直盯着」运河对岸任何人的喉咙。古德里安在恰当了解情况后，又受到推进初期成功的鼓舞，当即批准了迪特里希的决定，并命令第2装甲师前出支援。

惩罚行动 - 1941 年 4 月 6 日

column1: In February 1941, the Leibstandarte was transferred from Metz to Campalung in Romania, in response to the crisis in the Balkans.  The brigade was placed under the command of XIV Corps, 12th Army, in preperation for the upcoming campaign 'Operation Marita' - the invasion of Greece.  Following a pro-Allied coup de'etat in Yugoslavia however, access to the Greek border was blocked.  In response Hitler ordered 'Operation Strafe', another campaign against Yugoslavia to run concurrent with Marita.  The LSSAH moved once again to Temesvar in Bulgaria.
column2: 1941 年 2 月，为应对巴尔干危机，警卫旗队从梅斯调往罗马尼亚的肯帕隆(Campalung)。该旅被置于第12集团军第14军指挥之下，为即将到来的「玛丽塔行动」(Operation Marita)——入侵希腊——作准备。然而，南斯拉夫发生了一场亲盟军的政变，通往希腊边界的通道被阻断。作为回应，希特勒下令实施「惩罚行动」，即另一场与玛丽塔行动同时进行的对南斯拉夫作战。警卫旗队再次转移到保加利亚的泰梅什瓦尔(Temesvar)。

column1: The Leibstandarte advanced into Yugoslavia alongside the 9th Panzer Division, starting from the border town of Kustendil, and heading towards Skopje.  Only after heavy fighting against the fully mobilised Yugoslav 3rd Army was the brigade able to achieve its objectives, and continue south to advance on Greece.
column2: 警卫旗队与第9装甲师并肩突入南斯拉夫，从边境城镇丘斯滕迪尔(Kustendil)出发，向斯科普里(Skopje)前进。只有在与全面动员的南斯拉夫第3集团军激战之后，该旅才得以达成目标，并继续南下向希腊推进。
白色方案 - 1939 年 9 月 15 日

column1: After the Polish attacks, the Leibstandarte was withdrawn to the west, where it was attached to the forces attempting to encircle the Polish forces on the Bzura.  Under XVI Corps, the Leibstandarte played a major part in this operation, which was the largest battle of the Polish campaign.  Some of the heaviest fighting took place in the streets of Sochaczev, where strong resistance was encoutered.
column2: 在波兰的进攻之后，警卫旗队被撤往西面，配属给试图在布祖拉河(Bzura)合围波兰军队的部队。在第16军指挥下，警卫旗队在这场波兰战役中规模最大的战斗中发挥了重要作用。一些最激烈的战斗发生在索哈切夫(Sochaczev)的街巷中，在那里遭遇了顽强的抵抗。

column1: The Battle of Bzura was distinguished by the great bravery of the trapped Polish forces, who by now facing annihilation, put up a spirited defence.  By the 19th however, the jaws closed around them.
column2: 布祖拉河之战以被围波兰军队的极大勇气而著称，他们此时已面临覆灭，仍进行了顽强的防御。然而到 19 日，钳口已在他们周围合拢。

column1: Not good Commander, not good at all.  We cannot have another defeat like this.
column2: 不好，指挥官，一点也不好。我们不能再有这样一次失败了。

column1: Pack your bags, it's time to go home.

column2: 特拉维夫(Tel Aviv) - 1946 年 3 月 1 日

column1: The British have finally admitted that their tanks are worthless against ours.  In order to delay our advance into Lebanon, the enemy is using swarms of infantry and older aircraft in the hopes that they can destroy some small portion of your Core Army.
column2: 英国人终于承认，他们的坦克对我们的坦克毫无价值。为了迟滞我们向黎巴嫩(Lebanon)的推进，敌人正动用成群结队的步兵和老旧飞机，指望能消灭你核心军队的一小部分。

column1: Intelligence has reported a new anti-aircraft weapon in Tel Aviv that is stolen Germany technology.  No submarine activity is expected in the region.
column2: 情报报告特拉维夫出现了一种新的防空武器，是窃取的德国技术。预计该地区不会有潜艇活动。

column1: Commander, We are quite dissapointed. I will give you just one more chance to prove yourself. Do not dissapoint us again.
column2: 指挥官，我们相当失望。我只再给你一次证明自己的机会。不要再让我们失望。
黎巴嫩 - 1946 年 3 月 30 日

column1: The only landing zone is covered in Sea Mines.  Take care because intelligence reports a large enemy Naval task force in the region.  The British are hiding their tanks from us but eventually you will find them and destroy them.
column2: 唯一的登陆区布满了水雷。要小心，因为情报报告该地区有一支庞大的敌军海军特混舰队。英国人正把他们的坦克藏起来不让我们发现，但你最终会找到并消灭它们。

column1: Comrade General Marshall Zhukov is preparing an offensive to push the Germans from the northern Ukraine. You should coordinate the operations of the Second Ukrainian Front.
column2: 将军同志，朱可夫元帅正在准备一次攻势，把德军逐出乌克兰北部。你应协调乌克兰第2方面军的作战。

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! Rocket science is no longer a secret for us!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！火箭科学对我们已不再是秘密！！！
赫勒斯(Helles) - 1946 年 4 月 15 日

column1: The Soviets have slipped south into Greece and Turkey.  A large naval task force has been spotted in your region.  Find a suitable landing area quickly and get the Soviets the Hell out of Helles!
column2: 苏军已南下潜入希腊(Greece)与土耳其(Turkey)。你所在区域发现一支大型海军特混舰队。赶快找到一处合适的登陆场，把苏军从赫勒斯赶出去！

column1: Playing Tip #1: Use Air Recon to spot ships near coast
column2: 技巧1：用空中侦察发现海岸附近的舰只

column1: Playing Tip #2: Deployed ships can be easy targets for long range enemy firepower.  Do not over deploy.
column2: 技巧2：已展开的舰只容易成为敌军远程火力的靶子。不要过度展开。

column1: Playing Tip #3: The Soviets are very aggressive.  Get on the beach and prepare for an attack using defensive air cover.
column2: 技巧3：苏军极为凶悍。登上滩头，并在防御性空中掩护下准备迎击进攻。

column1: U.N. forces attack Russian rebels and their Chinese allies along the Trans-Siberian Railroad.
column2: 联合国(UN)部队沿西伯利亚大铁路(Trans-Siberian Railroad)进攻俄罗斯叛军及其中国盟友。
阿里角(Ari Burnu) - 1946 年 5 月 3 日

column1: The Soviets have set up defensive position in the mountains.  You must find a way through the mountains, escarpments, and minefields to rid Turkey of the Soviet occupation.
column2: 苏军已在山区建立防御阵地。你必须找到一条穿过山地、断崖与雷场的通路，把苏军占领者逐出土耳其。

column1: The initial landing area has proven to be inhospitable.  Scout the region for a better landing area.
column2: 最初的登陆场已被证明不宜登陆。侦察该地区，另寻一处更好的登陆场。

column1: Your performance makes me wonder if you're the right guy for the job.
column2: 你的表现让我怀疑你是否适合这份差事。
科林斯(Korinth) - 1946 年 6 月 26 日

column1: Three major naval ports have been mined; battleships have been spotted in two ports and submarines in the third.  Be careful when approaching these ports because we suspect the enemy can fire upon us even when docked.
column2: 三个主要海军港口已被布雷；两个港口发现战列舰，第三个港口发现潜艇。接近这些港口时要小心，因为我们怀疑敌人即便停泊在港内也能向我们开火。

column1: You must find a landing area quickly before the Soviet naval forces break free of the mines.
column2: 你必须在苏军海军挣脱雷场束缚之前赶快找到一处登陆场。

column1: Commander, you have taken too long to succeed. We cannot afford to keep taking such losses. We expect much more from you.
column2: 指挥官，你成功所花的时间太长了。我们承受不起这样不断的损失。我们对你的期望远不止于此。
克里特(Crete) - 1946 年 7 月 26 日

column1: The Soviet air force has retreated back home to Russia.  Our blockade of the Black Sea has kept the Soviet Navy in local waters.  You must make your landing immediately before they have a chance to stop us.
column2: 苏联空军已撤回俄国本土。我们对黑海(Black Sea)的封锁把苏联海军困在近海水域。你必须立即登陆，不能给他们阻止我们的机会。

column1: With nowhere else to run, expect entrenched elite troops to fight to the last man.
column2: 他们已无处可逃，要料到掘壕固守的精锐部队会战至最后一人。

column1: Splendid job, Commander! The missiles are neutralized, and our forces can
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！导弹已被解除，我军现在可以

column1: push farther into Russia now that the threat of Armageddon no longer hangs
column2: 向俄国纵深推进了，末日之战的威胁已不再
直布罗陀(Gibraltar) - 1946 年 9 月 30 日

column1: The British are in control of Gibraltar and are receiving support from the best that the Americans and Soviets can offer.  We have mined their naval port but this is not expected to keep them out of the battle for too long.
column2: 英军控制着直布罗陀，并正得到美国人与苏联人所能提供的最好的支援。我们已对他们的海军港口布雷，但料想这无法长久把他们挡在战斗之外。

column1: We have sent elements from the Atlantic fleet as reinforcements; they will arrive shortly.  Our missile batteries are being installed but we suggest you do not wait and commence the final assault.
column2: 我们已从大西洋舰队派出部队作为增援；他们很快就会到达。我们的导弹连正在安装，但我们建议你不要等待，直接发起最后突击。

column1: Seal the Mediterranean and return home a hero.
column2: 封锁地中海，以英雄之姿凯旋。

column1: Playing Tip #1: Missiles love to shoot at Recon.
column2: 技巧1：导弹最爱打侦察部队。

column1: Playing Tip #2: Sometimes it better to wait for the enemy to come to you.
column2: 技巧2：有时最好等敌人自己送上门来。

column1: Comrade General your failure to break the lines on the flanks of Sixth Army has meant that the enemy still threatens Stalingad! Vassiliev is very upset with your incompetence!
column2: 将军同志，你未能突破第6集团军两翼的防线，这意味着敌人仍在威胁斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)！瓦西里耶夫对你的无能极为不满！
马耳他(Malta) - 1945 年 9 月 9 日

column1: Commander, the British Navy is fast approaching to aid the already entrenched defenses.  You must find and destroy the British Navy or the planned landing will not succeed.
column2: 指挥官，英国海军正快速逼近，前来支援已构筑工事的防御。你必须找到并摧毁英国海军，否则计划的登陆不会成功。

column1: Expect well bunkered artillery and a strong air defense.  Intelligence reports no enemy submarine activity.
column2: 要料到有工事掩蔽良好的炮兵和强大的防空。情报报告敌军无潜艇活动。

column1: Commander, that was outstanding! You have managed to hold the russians back and even push them back past their jump off point. Now we need you to continue to hold the line. The Reds have us pinned in an area south of here and we could be in big trouble if they manage to push through. You must stop them!
column2: 指挥官，干得漂亮！你成功挡住了俄国人，甚至把他们逼退到出发线之后。现在我们需要你继续守住防线。赤色分子把我们压制在此地以南一片区域，一旦他们突破，我们就会有大麻烦。你必须挡住他们！

column1: The enemy has been unable to crack our new Funkschlüssel and is spread thin across thousands of kilometers of coastal territory.  The time is right to invade British occupied Algeria.
column2: 敌人一直未能破译我们新的无线电密钥(Funkschlüssel)，且兵力稀薄地散布在数千公里的沿海地带。现在正是入侵英占阿尔及利亚(Algeria)的时机。
阿尔及尔(Algiers) - 1945 年 10 月 10 日

column1: Commander, the British have been demoralized but their erroneous belief that they are masters in desert warfare keeps their spirit alive.  You must crush them!
column2: 指挥官，英军士气已受挫，但他们自认是沙漠战行家的错误信念仍支撑着他们的精神。你必须粉碎他们！

column1: Advance Fallschirmjager scouts report just a small French detachment.  It appears our deception of landing in Tunisia has succeeded and the British have left Algiers unguarded.
column2: 先遣伞兵侦察部队报告，只有一支小规模法军分遣队。看来我们登陆突尼斯(Tunisia)的欺骗行动已经奏效，英军已弃守阿尔及尔。
突尼斯(Tunis) - 1945 年 11 月 2 日

column1: We have pushed the British out of Algeria and now the time has come to liberate Tunisia from Churchill's tyranny.
column2: 我们已把英军逐出阿尔及利亚，现在是从丘吉尔(Churchill)的暴政下解放突尼斯的时候了。

column1: Expect a strong defensive stand from the British with little naval support.  Be cautious of exposing your fleet to enemy artillery.  Also, there are rumors of a British submarine design that is difficult to detect.
column2: 要料到英军会顽强防御，但海军支援很少。当心别让你的舰队暴露在敌军炮兵火力之下。另外，有传闻说英国有一种难以探测的潜艇设计。

column1: Playing Tip #1: Capture the port at Bizerte to deploy naval units.
column2: 技巧1：夺取比塞大(Bizerte)的港口，以便展开海军部队。

column1: Playing Tip #2: Do not run out of ammo in the sand.
column2: 技巧2：别在沙地里把弹药打光。

column1: General, the White House and Pentagon is ours. The cradle of Capitalism has collapsed. Stalin is delighted and proud of you because you allowed him to be in a very strong position at the peace negotiation table. Remnants of US army must now surrender and the US communist party can rule the country according to Moscow's wills.
column2: 将军，白宫与五角大楼已归我们所有。资本主义的摇篮已经崩溃。斯大林对你又欣喜又骄傲，因为你让他在和谈桌上处于极为有利的地位。美军残部现在必须投降，美国共产党可以按莫斯科的意旨统治这个国家。

column1: You and your troops have freed Leningrad.  The birthplace of the revolution can again breathe the sweet air of freedom.  Now, we must help our Finnish brothers to the north to escape the fascist scourge. That will be all, Comrade General.
column2: 你和你的部队解放了列宁格勒(Leningrad)。革命的诞生地又可以呼吸自由的甜美空气了。现在，我们必须帮助北面的芬兰兄弟摆脱法西斯的祸害。就这些，将军同志。
梅德宁(Medenine) - 1945 年 11 月 21 日

column1: Commander, Welcome to Phase II of the operation to free Tunisia.
column2: 指挥官，欢迎进入解放突尼斯行动的第二阶段。

column1: The remnants of the British army have retreated south to fortified positions in the hills.  With no place left to run, expect massive amounts of troops to surrender.  It is believed that the enemy navy is operating out of the numerous ports in the region.
column2: 英军残部已南撤至山中的设防阵地。他们已无处可逃，要料到会有大量部队投降。据信敌军海军正以该地区众多港口为基地活动。

column1: As you near the Soviet controlled Libyan border there will be a large show of Russian military might.  It is just a show.  Diplomatic negotiations will keep the Russians out of this fight.
column2: 当你接近苏军控制的利比亚(Libya)边境时，会出现一场俄国军力的大展示。那只是做样子。外交谈判会把俄国人挡在这场战斗之外。

column1: Playing Tip #1: Capture the port at Gabes to deploy naval units.
column2: 技巧1：夺取加贝斯(Gabes)的港口，以便展开海军部队。

column1: The Soviets attempt to surround the new German Sixth Army at Cherkassy in the  Ukraine.
column2: 苏军试图在乌克兰(Ukraine)的切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)包围新的德国第6集团军。
的黎波里(Tripoli) - 1945 年 12 月 7 日

column1: Commander, your leadership is now needed to free Libya.
column2: 指挥官，现在需要你的领导来解放利比亚。

column1: The Soviets are in control of Libya and they are ready to repel our offensive.  You must act quickly before they can entrench themselves.  A naval port is required to bring in reinforcements from Tunisia.
column2: 苏军控制着利比亚，并已准备好击退我们的攻势。你必须在他们得以构筑工事之前迅速行动。需要一处海军港口，以便从突尼斯运入补充兵员。

column1: Playing Tip: Capture the port at Tripoli.
column2: 技巧：夺取的黎波里的港口。

column1: The city remains in Soviet hands, blockading the northern roads to Moscow.
column2: 该城仍在苏军手中，封锁着通往莫斯科(Moscow)的北方道路。

column1: Now our forces will be forced to head directly into the gauntlet in front of the Soviet capital, costing us men, time and maybe even the war... You are dismissed.
column2: 现在我们被迫径直冲进苏联首都门前的夹道火网，代价是人员、时间，甚至可能是整场战争……你被解职了。
阿杰达比亚(Agedabia) - 1945 年 12 月 23 日

column1: Intelligence reports that an entire Russian Armored Corp and several independant Tank Brigades are bearing down on the coast as we speak. You need to hit the beach ASAP so that your Naval support can defend against an expected heavy Soviet surface ship counterattack.
column2: 情报报告，就在我们说话的当口，整整一个俄国装甲军和几个独立坦克旅正朝海岸压来。你需要尽快登上滩头，好让你的海军支援抵御预料中苏军水面舰只的猛烈反击。

column1: Do not underestimate the enemy defenses.
Comrade General you have achieved complete victory! The German are retreating towards the Dnepr river at full speed! We have them on the run!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了完全的胜利！德国人正全速向第聂伯河(Dnepr)撤退！我们把他们打跑了！
托布鲁克(Tobruk) - 1946 年 1 月 7 日

column1: Commander, the initial amphibious landing has stalled.  You must get on the beach and find a way to break through the enemy defenses.
column2: 指挥官，最初的登陆已经停滞。你必须登上滩头，找到突破敌军防御的办法。

column1: Tobruk is heavily defended and is meant to be a distraction to consume all our resources while the enemy escapes into Egypt via Sidi Rezegi.  Captured German equipment has been reported being used by the enemy.
column2: 托布鲁克防御坚固，其用意是牵制并消耗我们的一切资源，好让敌人经西迪雷泽吉(Sidi Rezegi)逃入埃及(Egypt)。报告称敌人正在使用缴获的德军装备。

column1: Remove the Russian scourge from the African continent forever.
column2: 把俄国祸害永远逐出非洲大陆。
塞瓦斯托波尔-克尔索内斯(Sevastopol-Kersones)
西迪拜拉尼(Sidi Barrani) - 1946 年 1 月 21 日

column1: Commander, the American forces that you defeated in Sicily have occupied Egypt.  You must liberate Egypt.
column2: 指挥官，你在西西里(Sicily)击败的美军已占领埃及。你必须解放埃及。

column1: The American tanks are inferior to ours but their air power should not be underestimated.  Intelligence has reported a new American submarine that is deadly.  Fortunately only one of these submarines is expected in the area and should not cause any problems to our mighty Navy.
column2: 美军的坦克不如我们，但他们的空中力量不可低估。情报报告了一种致命的新型美国潜艇。所幸该地区预计只有一艘这样的潜艇，不会给我们强大的海军带来任何麻烦。

column1: Welcome to Mediterranean 46! This is a fictional campaign. The premise is simple; Germany has risen from the ashes! A leadership change has sparked the superior capability of the Wehrmacht to retake what was once theirs.  This campaign begins at the final stage of the Italian offensive and takes the German commander throughout the Mediterranean; establishing bases in preparation for future expansion of the German empire in Africa and the Middle East.
column2: 欢迎来到地中海'46！这是一个虚构战役。前提很简单：德国已从废墟中崛起！一次领导层的更替激发了国防军(Wehrmacht)的卓越能力，去夺回曾经属于他们的东西。本战役始于意大利攻势的最后阶段，带领德军指挥官走遍地中海；建立基地，为德意志帝国日后在非洲与中东的扩张做准备。

column1: The Kriegsmarine is providing a large Task Force throughout this campaign to get rid the Mediterranean of American, British, and Soviet occupation.  There exists no current capability to overstrength or replace Naval units during the campaign.  Damaged units will be restored to their original strength at the start of each scenario.
column2: 整个战役期间，海军(Kriegsmarine)将提供一支大型特混舰队，把美国、英国与苏联的占领势力逐出地中海。目前尚无在战役中让海军部队超编加强或替换的能力。受损部队将在每个场景开始时恢复至原有兵力。

column1: This campaign was designed for experts and is not for the faint at heart. Use of Bat Wing fighters and bombers are not recommended.
column2: 本战役是为行家设计的，不适合胆小者。不建议使用蝙蝠翼战斗机与轰炸机。
第1党卫军「警卫旗队」师战役

column1: The Leibstandarte began its life as the 'SS-Stabswache Berlin', acting as bodyguards for the Nazi leader Adolf Hitler.  It was the first armed SS formation and, by most measures, the most capable.  Initially they were referred to contemptuously by the Heer regulars as the 'asphalt soldiers' for their obsessive spit and polish drill and purely ceremonial duties.  After the campaigns in Poland and France, contempt gave way to geniune respect as the Leibstandarte earned a reputation as a combat unit which lived for the 'sheer beauty of the fighting'.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)最初是「党卫军柏林参谋卫队」(SS-Stabswache Berlin)，充当纳粹领袖阿道夫·希特勒(Adolf Hitler)的保镖。它是第一支武装党卫军部队，而且从各方面衡量都是最能干的一支。起初，国防军正规军轻蔑地称他们为「沥青士兵」，因为他们痴迷于队列操练与纯粹的礼仪勤务。在波兰与法国战役之后，轻蔑让位于真诚的敬意，因为警卫旗队赢得了「为战斗的纯粹之美而活」的战斗部队之名。
亚眠(Amiens) - 1946 年 1 月 5 日

column1: The advance through France continue successfully, like in Italy.
column2: 穿越法国的推进像在意大利一样顺利继续。

column1: This time, your mission will be to capture the city of Amiens.
column2: 这一次，你的任务将是夺取亚眠城。

column1: Soon continental Europe will be ours.
column2: 不久之后，欧洲大陆就将归我们所有。

column1: All right, Commander, a job well done!  The Krauts never knew what hit them.  Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you.  Hey, rumor has it the president may want to pin a medal on you himself.
column2: 好了，指挥官，干得漂亮！那些德国佬到死都不知道是什么打中了他们。是啊，多亏了你，我们的处境真不错。嘿，有传言说总统可能想亲自给你别上一枚勋章。

column1: I had hoped for a deeper penetration General.
column2: 我本希望突入得更深一些，将军。

column2: 将越过海滩上岸，消灭该岛守军。
