column1: Your new base in Poland will desperately need supplies if it is to flank the Soviets and liberate Germany. A convoy is on route to your base, however the road is blocked by Soviet troops.
column2: 你在波兰(Poland)的新基地若要包抄苏军并解放德国，就急需补给。一支运输队正开往你的基地，但道路被苏军部队阻断。

column1: You need to clear out this road before the convoy arrives. And do not worry about Berlin. It is not heavily guarded from this direction.
column2: 你需要在运输队到达之前肃清这条道路。不必担心柏林(Berlin)。从这个方向看，它防守并不严密。

column1: The convoy's path is cleared. And the Soviet forces are reeling
column2: 运输队的通路已清空。而苏军正因你在其战线后方的

column1: from your counter-attack behind their lines. Keep it coming Commander.
column2: 反击而踉跄后退。继续干，指挥官。
割喉行动（第2部分） - 1940 年 12 月 5 日
伦敦-多佛路线(London Dover Path)

column1: Nice work General. We are one step closer to Moscow.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军。我们离莫斯科又近了一步。

column1: We have just heard that General Patton's army has taken Kiev! Now rest your men Commander. Your next assignment begins on August 5th.
column2: 我们刚听说巴顿(Patton)将军的部队已夺取基辅(Kiev)！现在让你的部下休整吧，指挥官。你的下一个任务将于 8 月 5 日开始。
割喉行动（第1部分） - 1940 年 12 月 5 日

column1: Great job Commander! The remaining Soviet forces in Germany have all surrendered, and the road is open for an offensive into Russia...
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！德国境内残余的苏军已全部投降，向俄国进攻的道路已经打通……
重逢之旅(Reunion Tour) - 1941 年 2 月 4 日

column1: I'm sure you remember the battle we fought here to open a supply route into Poland. Well, it turns out it was a big mistake to wait to attack Berlin. Soviet forces in Germany, desperate, encircled and low on supplies, have launched a counter-attack with what's left of their forces.You'll have to defend your base in this area and eventually lead a counter-attack into Berlin. Good luck.
column2: 我相信你还记得我们为打通通往波兰的补给线而在此打的那一仗。结果证明，迟迟不进攻柏林是个大错。德国境内那些绝望、被围、补给不足的苏军部队，已用残部发起反击。你必须守住你在此地的基地，最终率部反攻柏林。祝好运。

column1: Hmm. Although you did accomplish your objective, it was at a great cost in men and materials. At least the majority of Germany is ours.
column2: 嗯。虽然你确实完成了目标，但代价是人员和物资的巨大损失。至少德国的大部分已归我们所有。

column1: Great job Commander! Although the Soviets are still putting up some resistance, for the most part Germany is ours. And now the road is open for an offensive into Russia...
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！虽然苏军仍在作些抵抗，但德国大体上已归我们所有。现在向俄国进攻的道路已经打通……

column1: Great work!!, we have eliminated the allied menace in the Mediterranean, greek partisans have established a proper socialist goverment in their country.
column2: 干得漂亮！！我们已消除地中海的盟军威胁，希腊游击队已在他们国家建立了像样的社会主义政府。
突围（第2部分） - 1941 年 3 月 16 日

column1: The Soviets are severely disrupted and the Brits have stabilized their
column2: 苏军已严重陷入混乱，而英国人已稳住他们的

column1: sector and have even begun pushing them back in some areas.
column2: 地段，甚至已开始在某些地区把他们逼退。
突围（第3部分） - 1941 年 3 月 16 日
突围（第1部分） - 1941 年 3 月 16 日

column1: Good work, the lines are secured, and now the British won't be able to make anything against us here. Now we must drive to Bristol.
column2: 干得好，防线已经稳固，现在英国人在这里对我们无可奈何了。现在我们必须向布里斯托尔(Bristol)推进。

column1: You and your forces have crushed the enemy.  We are victorious.   Now, the Red Army holds the initiative.  This is good.  To the west, Comrade!
column2: 你和你的部队粉碎了敌人。我们胜利了。现在，红军掌握着主动权。这很好。向西，同志！
国之危难（第2部分） - 1941 年 4 月 21 日

column1: Comrade General, Marshall Zhukov wants you to reduce Bucharest and force Rumania to fight on our side. Moldavia must be brought back to Soviet Union!
column2: 将军同志，朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅要你攻下布加勒斯特(Bucharest)，迫使罗马尼亚(Rumania)站在我们一边作战。摩尔达维亚(Moldavia)必须重归苏联！
国之危难（第1部分） - 1941 年 3 月 16 日

column1: We must congratulate you to have saved Seelöwe from a disaster! The Führer himself sends you his honest thanks and in Germany you are a national Hero.
column2: 我们必须祝贺你使「海狮」(Seeloewe)免于一场灾难！元首亲自向你致以诚挚的谢意，在德国你是一位民族英雄。

column1: The subs are lying at the bottom of the sea. But we have suffered a grievous loss in men and materials. Are you sure you're not a spy?
column2: 那些潜艇正躺在海底。但我们在人员与物资上遭受了惨重损失。你确定你不是间谍？

column1: The invasion of this area of the British Islands has been a total success. A big beachhead has been established.
column2: 对这一带英伦诸岛的入侵取得了完全成功。一个大滩头阵地已经建立。

column1: Great job Commander! Not only are the last of those blasted subs gone, we now can easily liberate the rest of Scandinavia from this point. We really should promote you...
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！不但那些该死的潜艇最后一艘也没了，我们现在还能从此地轻松解放斯堪的纳维亚(Scandinavia)其余地区。我们真该给你升官……
未竟之事(Unfinished Business) - 1941 年 5 月 28 日

column1: A coded radio transmission was intercepted from the Greek submarine facility before you captured it. Radio traces now indicate a secret Soviet sub base in Sweden was the reciever of the transmission. Air recons confirm that more of the advanced submarines are being produced there. Your job is to lead the attack on this facility Commander.If you can neutralize these subs, not only will Allied shipping be safe but we will be able to set up an invasion force to retake Soviet-held Scandanavia from this beachhead...
column2: 在你夺取那座希腊潜艇设施之前，我们截获了一段加密无线电传输。无线电追踪现在表明，瑞典(Sweden)境内一处秘密苏联潜艇基地是这段传输的接收方。空中侦察证实那里正在生产更多这种先进潜艇。你的任务就是指挥对这座设施的进攻，指挥官。如果你能解除这些潜艇的威胁，不仅盟军航运将安全，我们还能从此滩头组建一支入侵部队，夺回苏占斯堪的纳维亚……

column1: Our army lies broken.Now that the Soviets know where our main force will land, Scandinavia will be practically impenetrable.And the subs are free to wreak havoc on Allied supply ships. You're hereby put on permanent leave.
column2: 我们的军队已残破不堪。既然苏军知道我军主力将在何处登陆，斯堪的纳维亚将几乎无法攻入。而那些潜艇则可以肆意蹂躏盟军补给船。特此将你永久停职。

column1: Led by American forces, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in South Korea.
column2: 在美国(America)带领下，联合国(United Nations)试图在韩国(South Korea)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)。

column1: Good job Commander. Those blasted subs are now at the bottom of the sea, where they belonged in the first place. And now we can begin the liberation of Scandinavia...
column2: 干得好，指挥官。那些该死的潜艇现在躺在海底，那本来就是它们该待的地方。现在我们可以开始解放斯堪的纳维亚了……
红色合围（第2部分） - 1941 年 7 月 19 日

column1: Jolly good job, Commander. The Soviets have been driven right back where they came from, and our research continues unabated.
column2: 干得真漂亮，指挥官。苏军已被逐回他们来的地方，我们的研究也丝毫未减地继续着。
红色合围（第1部分） - 1941 年 7 月 19 日

column1: Unthinkable! Your stunning defeat has set us months, years back in
column2: 难以置信！你这惊人的失败使我们在

column1: technological advancements that the Soviets can now employ against us,
column2: 技术进展上倒退数月、数年，苏军现在可以把这些成果用来对付我们，

column1: having secured our facilities. Leave now, Commander. You have disgraced the Allies.
column2: 因为他们已夺取我们的设施。现在走吧，指挥官。你让盟军蒙羞。

column1: Although the area is secure, the research has been set back by damages
column2: 虽然该地区已安全，但研究因这场持久交火中

column1: caused during the extended firefight. You'll need to do much better to impress me, Commander.
column2: 造成的破坏而倒退。你得干得好得多才能让我刮目相看，指挥官。

column1: Jolly good job, Commander. The Soviets have been driven right back where they came from, and our research continues relatively unabated.
column2: 干得真漂亮，指挥官。苏军已被逐回他们来的地方，我们的研究也相对未受影响地继续着。
致命叛逃（第2部分） - 1941 年 11 月 18 日

column1: Well that could have been better, General.
column2: 嗯，这本可以做得更好，将军。

column1: We've now got a marginal base that will limit future operations.
column2: 我们现在只得到一个勉强可用的基地，这会限制未来的行动。
致命叛逃（第1部分） - 1941 年 11 月 18 日

column1: This is absolutely unacceptable. The scientist has been executed upon our defeat by the Soviets, and now all we have to do is wait for the first missiles to crash down upon western Europe.
column2: 这绝对不可接受。我们败给苏军后，那名科学家已被处决，现在我们能做的只是等待第一批导弹砸向西欧。

column1: We have the scientist in Allied hands now. Unfortunately, we have lost a great sum of men and vehicles. Try to be more careful in the future, ok?
column2: 科学家现在已在盟军手中。遗憾的是，我们损失了大量人员与车辆。以后尽量小心些，好吗？

column1: Good job, Commander. Now it's time to interrogate the scientist and find those missiles, before it's too late.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。现在是审讯那名科学家、找出那些导弹的时候了，别等到来不及。

column1: Not good Commander, not good at all. We cannot have another defeat like this. Do not force me to relieve you. Now you need to head south and try to plug a nasty gap which is forming in our lines. God speed commander.
column2: 不太妙，指挥官，一点也不妙。我们不能再来一次这样的失败。别逼我撤你的职。现在你需要南下，设法堵住我们防线上正在形成的一个麻烦缺口。一路顺风，指挥官。

column1: Well, you barely escaped destruction there. I sincerely hope you can improve your performance otherwise I will be forced to revieve you. Now you need to head south and try to plug a nasty gap which is forming in our lines. God speed commander.
column2: 唉，你在那里险些被消灭。我真心希望你能改进表现，否则我将不得不撤你的职。现在你需要南下，设法堵住我们防线上正在形成的一个麻烦缺口。一路顺风，指挥官。

column1: Good job Commander. Now we need you to head south and plug a gap that is quickly becoming a very tricky situaion. The Russians are about to punch a huge hole in our lines. The 3rd Armored division will be joinging you in a few days. Good Luck!
column2: 干得好，指挥官。现在我们需要你南下，堵住一个正迅速变得十分棘手的缺口。俄国人即将在我们的防线上打出一个大洞。第3装甲师将在几天内与你会合。祝好运！

column1: Commander, Congratulations for the capture of Minsk. I do not have time pin to any medal however.
column2: 指挥官，恭喜你夺取明斯克(Minsk)。不过我没时间给你别上什么勋章。

column1: What a disaster! Consider yourself relieved!
column2: 真是一场灾难！你被撤职了！

column1: Commander, Congratulations for the capture of Minsk. I do not have time to pin any medal however.
column2: 指挥官，恭喜你夺取明斯克。不过我没时间给你别上什么勋章。
行军命令(Marching orders) - 1946 年 6 月 6 日

column1: Commander, it appears we have grossly underestimated the current situation with the Soviets. We thought they were stricktly on the defensive but now we know that was to be untrue. It seems that a very large force of Russian troops and armor has infiltrated our forward positions and is now bearing down on a critical road juncture. Commander, if a Russian force of this size gets into our rear we could be in big trouble.
column2: 指挥官，看来我们严重低估了当前对苏军的形势。我们以为他们完全处于防御，但现在我们知道那并非事实。似乎有一支非常庞大的俄国部队与装甲力量已渗透进我们的前沿阵地，此刻正压向一处关键的公路枢纽。指挥官，如果这么大规模的俄军进入我们后方，我们就会有大麻烦。

column1: You must move your forces as far forward as possible to meet and crush the attack. This is not exactly going to be a cakewalk Commander but if it was, we wouldn't be sending you. One more thing, G2 reports there may be a Russian airborne element on it's way. Be careful Commander and good luck!
column2: 你必须把部队尽可能前调，迎击并粉碎这场进攻。这可不是什么轻松差事，指挥官；若真轻松，我们就不会派你去了。还有一件事，G2 报告可能有一支俄国空降部队正在途中。小心点，指挥官，祝好运！

column1: That was one heck of a bit of soldiering.
column2: 那可真是一手了不起的军人本事。

column1: Your advance bagged the rest of Ivan's forces in the East.
column2: 你的推进把伊万在东部的其余部队全都兜了进去。

column1: You've got nothing in front of you so drive like hell!
column2: 你面前什么都没有，拼命开进吧！

column1: Well, that was a tough assignment but you did it!.. Now it's time for us to go over to the attack again. Get your men ready Commander.
column2: 唉，那是个艰难的任务，但你办成了！……现在又轮到我们转入进攻了。让你的人准备好，指挥官。
维捷布斯克(Vitebsk)'46 - 1946 年 6 月 30 日

column1: Commander, High Command has asked me to personaly thank you and your brave men for crushing that nasty Soviet attack earlier this month.
column2: 指挥官，最高统帅部要我个人感谢你和你勇敢的部下粉碎了本月早些时候那场凶险的苏军进攻。

column1: For your outstanding achievment they are going to once again give you the opportunity to achieve greatness. You must take the city of Vitebsk no later than July 9th. Good luck Commander.
column2: 由于你的杰出成就，他们将再次给你建功立业的机会。你必须在 7 月 9 日前夺取维捷布斯克城。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: One last thing, you can expect air supremacy in this battle.
column2: 最后一件事，这场战斗中你可以指望掌握制空权。

column1: You have done splendidly General. Now that we control Vitebsk the Russians are denied an important railhead and transportation center. We've really got them on the run now.
column2: 你干得非常出色，将军。既然我们控制了维捷布斯克，俄国人就失去了一个重要的铁路终点站与运输中心。现在我们真把他们打跑了。

column1: Comrade General STAVKA has prepared plans to encircle and destroy the new German Sixth Army  around the Ukranian city of Cherkassy. You should coordinate the operation!
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部已制定计划，要在乌克兰城市切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)周围合围并消灭新的德国第6集团军。你应当协调这次作战！
波美拉尼亚壁垒(Wal Pomorski) -「波美拉尼亚阵地」(Pommernstellung)
党卫军第15装甲军野战司令部
党卫军第11装甲军野战司令部
党卫军第36装甲军野战司令部

column1: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from the Leningrad area! You will command the Second Baltic Front and cross the Narva river destroying Army Group North!
column2: 将军同志：这是你把德国法西斯逐出列宁格勒(Leningrad)地区的机会！你将指挥波罗的海沿岸第2方面军，渡过纳尔瓦河(Narva)，消灭北方集团军群！

column1: Comrade General, now, after there are no german troops on the Ukraine, you'll be commanded to Byelorussia. From there we shall make a decisive blow to drive the fascist invaders away from Rodina!
column2: 将军同志，如今乌克兰境内已无德军，你将被调往白俄罗斯(Byelorussia)。我们将从那里发起决定性一击，把法西斯入侵者逐出祖国(Rodina)！

column1: The allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible shock for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia. Vorkuta is a perfect destination for a diet...
column2: 盟军消灭了你的部队。这对我人民、对苏联共产党(PCUS)、对斯大林都是可怕的打击。你的下一个去处是西伯利亚(Siberia)。沃尔库塔(Vorkuta)是个减肥的绝佳去处……
步步为营(Step by step) - 1946 年 8 月 5 日

column1: Commander, we need you to open the door to  Orel by cracking a Russian defensive line just 40 miles west of the city. G2 reports some lesser Russian units in the area and does not feel this will be too much of a problem.
column2: 指挥官，我们需要你打穿该城以西仅 40 英里处的一道俄军防线，从而打开通往奥廖尔(Orel)的大门。G2 报告该地区只有一些次要的俄军部队，认为这不会有多大问题。

column1: Now on to Orel. If we can keep this momentum the Russians just might surrender by Christmas!
column2: 现在向奥廖尔进军。如果我们能保持这个势头，俄国人说不定会在圣诞节前投降！

column1: Now on to Orel. If we can keep this momentum the Russinas just might surrender by Christmas!
column2: 现在向奥廖尔进军。如果我们能保持这个势头，俄国人说不定会在圣诞节前投降！

column1: Commander, the attack on Orel has been rescheduled for September 8th. Prepare your men for the assault.
column2: 指挥官，对奥廖尔的进攻已改期至 9 月 8 日。让你的人为突击做好准备。

column1: Commander, the attack on Orel has been rescheduled for September 12th. Prepare your men for the assault.
column2: 指挥官，对奥廖尔的进攻已改期至 9 月 12 日。让你的人为突击做好准备。
奥廖尔(Orel) - 1946 年 9 月 8 日

column1: Commander, the time has come to take the city of Orel. If you can accomplish your mission before the end of the month we still may have a chance to take Moscow by Christmas.
column2: 指挥官，夺取奥廖尔城的时候到了。如果你能在月底前完成任务，我们也许还有机会在圣诞节前拿下莫斯科。

column1: Nice job General. You are doing very well.
column2: 干得漂亮，将军。你做得非常好。

column1: General Patton's army is approaching Karkov. High Command has a little bet going on which of you will be the first to motor down Red Square!
column2: 巴顿(Patton)将军的部队正在逼近哈尔科夫(Karkov)。最高统帅部打了个小赌：你们俩谁会第一个乘车驶过红场！

column1: Comrade your job in the last battle was brillant, and Comrade Stalin has decided to begin a risked plan to invade America and he trusts you as his main leader to execute this operation.
column2: 同志，你在上一场战斗中的表现非常出色，斯大林同志已决定启动一项冒险的入侵美国计划，他信任你，要你作为主将执行这次作战。
先锋(Spearhead) - 1946 年 9 月 30 日

column1: Commander, after your success at Orel the Russians have broken. They have formed a line just west of Novograd. You must pierce the line here and prepare our way to take the city of Novograd. Winter is getting closer Commander, You must hurry!
column2: 指挥官，你在奥廖尔取胜之后，俄国人已经崩溃。他们在诺沃格拉德(Novograd)以西刚组成一道防线。你必须在此地打穿这道防线，为我们夺取诺沃格拉德城铺路。冬天越来越近了，指挥官，你必须抓紧！

column1: That was truely brilliant Commander! You have shattered the last Russian reserves. The road to Novograd is open.
column2: 那真是出色极了，指挥官！你打碎了俄国人最后的预备队。通往诺沃格拉德的道路已经打开。

column1: Great Job commander. Now it's time for phase 2. We must finish up this operation before we're knee deep in snow!
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。现在进入第二阶段。我们必须在深陷雪中之前结束这次作战！
诺沃格拉德'46 - 1946 年 10 月 13 日

column1: Commander, You must take Novograd no later than the end of the month. Once again you have a small battle group of German Nationalist troops to assist you. The German Luftwaffe is even testing out a new fighter in this battle.
column2: 指挥官，你必须在月底前夺取诺沃格拉德。你又一次得到一支德国民族主义部队小战斗群的协助。德国空军(Luftwaffe)甚至将在这场战斗中试飞一种新型战斗机。

column1: I'll bet Zhukov wishes he was never sent East.
column2: 我敢打赌，朱可夫(Zhukov)一定希望自己从没被派到东部去。

column1: His reputation is taking a beating.
You isolated the city and Monty was able to take Berlin.
column2: 你孤立了该城，蒙蒂(Monty)才得以夺取柏林。
通往莫斯科之路 - 1946 年 10 月 30 日

column1: Commander, we are almost there... You must clear out this blocking force and pave the way to the Moscow suburbs.
column2: 指挥官，我们就快到了……你必须肃清这支阻援部队，为通往莫斯科郊区铺平道路。

column1: Commander, you have cleared away the last of Russian forces between our current position and the Moscow suburbs. Congratulations! Now you must prepare your troops for the coming assault.
column2: 指挥官，你已肃清我们当前位置与莫斯科郊区之间最后的俄军部队。恭喜！现在你必须让部队为即将到来的突击做好准备。

column1: Well Commander, you relieved Finland but unfortunately the Russians want it backl. G2 reports strong Russian forces are heading your way. Brace yoursef Commander, you must hold the line.
column2: 唉，指挥官，你解了芬兰(Finland)之围，但不幸的是俄国人想把它拿回去。G2 报告强大的俄军正朝你开来。振作起来，指挥官，你必须守住防线。

column1: Comrade General, here we have the Gauleiter's daughter, if you would like to do it first... The Gauleiter is hanging on the apple-tree in his orchard - boys from NKVD regret they couldn't interrogate him...
column2: 将军同志，我们这里有大区领袖(Gauleiter)的女儿，如果你愿意先来的话……那位大区领袖正挂在他果园的苹果树上——内务人民委员部(NKVD)的人遗憾没能审讯他……

column1: Commander. That was atrocious. The Russians have blasted an enormous hole in our lines and now our entire southern front is in jeapordy. Consider yourself relieved.
column2: 指挥官。那实在太糟糕了。俄国人在我们防线上轰出一个巨大的缺口，现在我们整个南线都岌岌可危。你被撤职了。

column1: Pack your bags General. It's time to go home
column2: 收拾行李吧，将军。该回家了

column1: Commander, unfortunately you did not take the city in time and Stalin has managed to relocate his Command to the Urals and refuses to surrender. The war will continue for some time now, but not for you.
column2: 指挥官，遗憾的是你未能及时夺取该城，斯大林已成功把他的统帅部迁往乌拉尔(Urals)，并拒绝投降。战争还要再打上一段时间，但对你来说已经结束了。

column1: Commander, we must break in to the suburbs of Moscow. Once we clear out these Russian blocking troops we will be able to assault the mighty Russian city itself.
column2: 指挥官，我们必须突入莫斯科郊区。一旦肃清这些俄军阻援部队，我们就能进攻这座强大的俄国城市本身。

column1: We are fortunate that the weather hasn't completely turned to hell!
column2: 我们很走运，天气还没有彻底变得一团糟！

column1: You must complete your mission prior to December 1st.
column2: 你必须在 12 月 1 日之前完成任务。

column1: Great Job Commander! Now on to Moscow!!!
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！现在向莫斯科进军！！！

column1: Commander, you have done it! Stalin has sued for peace and the world is now safe from the perils of Russian communism.
column2: 指挥官，你办到了！斯大林已求和，世界现在不再受俄国共产主义之害了。

column1: Congratulations! Now you return to a grateful nation a here!
column2: 恭喜！现在你回到一个心存感激的国家，成为一名英雄！

column1: Oh, and by the way Commander, I won the bet!
column2: 哦，顺便说一句，指挥官，我打赌赢了！

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is not pleased with your performance!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现很不满意！！！

column1: You have recovered part of Lithuania, but failed to press your attacks
column2: 你收复了立陶宛(Lithuania)的一部分，但未能持续压迫你的进攻，

column1: and the Germans were able to withdraw in good order!
column2: 德国人得以秩序井然地撤走！

column1: Comrade General your initial success has trapped important German troops at the city of Cherkassy! Your failure to follow through has allowed most Germans to escape! Stavka is very displeased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你最初的成功把重要的德军部队困在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)城！但你未能贯彻到底，让大部分德国人逃脱了！最高统帅部对你的指挥极为不满！
行军中(On the move) - 1945 年 10 月 7 日

column1: Commander, the Russians have been slowed down and now it is our turn to take the initiative. Throw the red menace off German soil. You have strong armored and air support.
column2: 指挥官，俄国人已被迟滞，现在轮到我们夺取主动权了。把红色威胁赶出德国土地。你有强大的装甲与空中支援。
恭喜你，指挥官，那真是出色。

column1: Take a few days for rest and refit. We have another important job for you.
column2: 花几天时间休整与整补。我们还有一项重要任务给你。
橡树岭(Oak Ridge) - 1946 年 10 月 5 日

column1: Good day General, welcome back, now this time things are somewhat different.
column2: 你好，将军，欢迎回来，这一次情况有些不同。

column1: We need to take the installations for Soviet benefit, but it will be heavily defended.
column2: 我们需要为苏联的利益夺取那些设施，但它会防守严密。

column1: The Germans attack the flank of the Russians spearheads heading West after Stalingrad.
column2: 德军进攻斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)之后向西开进的俄军矛头的侧翼。

column1: We have pushed the Russians out of Germany and now the time has come to liberate Poland from Stalin's tyrany. A small contingent of German nationalist troops will be covering your flank and are scheduled to arrive in two days. Consider them as "advisors" against fighting the Russians. You must complete this first phase prior to the end of the month.
column2: 我们已把俄国人逐出德国，现在是从斯大林的暴政下解放波兰(Poland)的时候了。一支德国民族主义部队小分遣队将掩护你的侧翼，预定两天后到达。就把他们当作对抗俄国人的「顾问」。你必须在月底前完成这第一阶段。

column1: Great work!, we have eliminated the allied menace on the Mediterranean, greek partisans have established a proper socialist goverment in their country.
column2: 干得漂亮！我们已消除地中海的盟军威胁，希腊游击队已在他们国家建立了像样的社会主义政府。

column1: Nice show Commander. Now it's time for phase 2. We must finish up this operation before we're knee deep in snow!
column2: 干得好，指挥官。现在进入第二阶段。我们必须在深陷雪中之前结束这次作战！

column1: The Russians attack the rocket research center located at Peenemunde.
column2: 俄军进攻位于佩讷明德(Peenemunde)的火箭研究中心。
波兰第二阶段 - 1945 年 11 月 28 日

column1: Commander, Welcome to Phase II of this operation. We must quickly finish the task at hand because the foul winter weather is really starting to set in our air cover will soon be limited.
column2: 指挥官，欢迎进入本次作战的第二阶段。我们必须赶快完成手头的任务，因为恶劣的冬季天气真的开始到来了，我们的空中掩护很快就将受限。

column1: This is not going to be an easy task Commander, the Russians are heavily entrenched and are well prepared for or attack.
column2: 这不会是件轻松的任务，指挥官，俄国人已构筑了坚固工事，对我们的进攻做好了充分准备。

column1: Outstanding! We have proudly freed Poland. Take a few weeks off General. Rest up well because we have another tough job for you next month.
column2: 干得漂亮！我们骄傲地解放了波兰。休几周假吧，将军。好好休息，因为下个月我们还有一项艰巨任务给你。

column1: Good job General. We have proudly freed Poland. Take a few weeks off Commander. Rest up well because we have another tough job for you next month.
column2: 干得好，将军。我们骄傲地解放了波兰。休几周假吧，指挥官。好好休息，因为下个月我们还有一项艰巨任务给你。

column1: The time has come for us to relieve the beleagared Finns. You must force out the Russian occupation force before major Soviet renforcements arrive. You will be assisted by a small contigent of Finnish rebels. Watch your southern flank commander.
column2: 我们为受困的芬兰人解围的时候到了。你必须在苏军大股增援到达之前赶走俄国占领军。你将得到一支芬兰叛军小分遣队的协助。当心你的南翼，指挥官。

column1: Keep this up Commander and I see another star header toward your shoulder. Unfortunately the Russians did not want to give up Finland at all. G2 reports strong Russian forces are heading your way. Brace yoursef Commander, you must hold the line.
column2: 照这样干下去，指挥官，我看又一颗将星要飞向你的肩头了。不幸的是，俄国人根本不想放弃芬兰。G2 报告强大的俄军正朝你开来。振作起来，指挥官，你必须守住防线。

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is extremely pleased with your performance!!! Nazi Germany is no more!!! You are one of the heroes of the hour and a new Marshall of the Soviet Union!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现极为满意！！！纳粹德国已不复存在！！！你是当今的英雄之一，也是苏联的新元帅！！！

column1: Commander, we may be in a bit of trouble here. G2 reports that an entire Russian Armored Corp and several independant Tank Brigades are bearing down on our border positions as we speak. Bad weather has prevented air support from interdicting them. We need you back in that sector as a mobile reserve. The attack could come at any day now. Good luck.
column2: 指挥官，我们这里可能有点麻烦。G2 报告，就在我们说话的当口，整整一个俄国装甲军和几个独立坦克旅正朝我们的边境阵地压来。恶劣天气使空中支援无法拦阻他们。我们需要你回到那个地段充当机动预备队。进攻随时可能到来。祝好运。

column1: You have dealt the Russians a crippling blow. Take a deserved rest Commander.
column2: 你给了俄国人一记致残性的打击。好好休息一下吧，指挥官，这是你应得的。

column1: Comrade General STAVKA wants you to take command in Finland! The fall of Viipuri will knock Finland out of the war! Do not fail us Comrade!
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部要你去芬兰指挥！维堡(Viipuri)的陷落将使芬兰退出战争！不要让我们失望，同志！
土拨鼠日(Groundhog Day) - 1946 年 2 月 2 日

column1: Commander, the Groundhog saw his shadow so we've got a long winter ahead. Now that Finland is free we need to consolidate our front and relieve Lithuania. The Russians have been knocked off balance so I don't expect this to be too much of a problem. General Patton is cleaning out the Balkans as we speak.
column2: 指挥官，土拨鼠看到了自己的影子，所以我们前面还有个漫长的冬天。既然芬兰已获自由，我们需要巩固我们的战线并为立陶宛(Lithuania)解围。俄国人已失去平衡，所以我不认为这会是什么大问题。巴顿(Patton)将军正在清剿巴尔干(Balkans)。

column1: Nice Job Commander. Now that our front is consolidated we can prepare for the spring offensive.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。既然我们的战线已经巩固，我们就可以为春季攻势做准备了。
清剿(Mopping up) - 1946 年 3 月 7 日

column1: Commander, this will be your last assignment before our spring offensive. There is a small pocket of Russian units just north of your current position. We need you to clean them out before they become a more serious problem.
column2: 指挥官，这将是我们春季攻势之前你的最后一项任务。就在你当前位置以北有一个俄军小包围圈。我们需要你在他们变成更严重的问题之前把他们清剿掉。

column1: As you know Commander, we have been utilizing a small number of German Nationalist troops as "advisors" in this campaign. The politians have even allowed Germany to produce war materials again. A small German unit will be joining you on this operation. They will also be testing a new tank design. Good luck.
column2: 如你所知，指挥官，我们在这场战役中一直在使用少量德国民族主义部队充当「顾问」。政客们甚至已允许德国重新生产战争物资。一支德军小部队将参加你这次作战。他们还将测试一种新型坦克设计。祝好运。

column1: Well, that turned out to be rather nasty didn't it. Yu did very well though and finished up before schedule.
column2: 唉，结果那事弄得相当麻烦，不是吗。不过你干得很好，还提前完成了。

column1: I understand that the German Nationalist troops performed very well. The new tank was a great success.
column2: 我了解到德国民族主义部队表现非常好。新型坦克大获成功。

column1: Now on to our spring offensive.
column2: 现在着手我们的春季攻势。

column1: Comrade General we have to surprise the Germans by crossing the middle Dnepr at Mogilev. A beachhead there will threatened the flanks of both Army Groups Center and South. You have to cross to the right bank and penetrate the socalled "Eastern wall".
column2: 将军同志，我们必须出奇不意，在莫吉廖夫(Mogilev)渡过第聂伯河(Dnepr)中游。在那里建立一个滩头阵地，将威胁中央与南方两个集团军群的侧翼。你必须渡到右岸，并突入所谓的「东方壁垒」。
破门而入(Kicking in the door) - 1946 年 4 月 17 日

column1: Commander, our spring offensive has begun. We need you and your men to crack the line just west of Minsk. A small German battle group will be guarding your northern flank.
column2: 指挥官，我们的春季攻势已经开始了。我们需要你和你的部下打穿明斯克(Minsk)以西的防线。一支德军小战斗群将掩护你的北翼。

column1: The Russians have suffered horrific losses in the air over the past month so the only planes you should see overhead will be ours. Good luck Commander.
column2: 过去一个月里俄国人在空中遭受了惨重损失，所以你在头顶应该只会看到我们的飞机。祝好运，指挥官。

column1: Comrade General, Comrade Stalin is seriously thinking on you as a candidate for the Commander of the Polish People's Army - at last thanks to your troops' bayonets the Polish Government in Lublin was created.
column2: 将军同志，斯大林同志正认真考虑让你出任波兰人民军司令——多亏你部队的刺刀，卢布林(Lublin)的波兰政府终于建立起来了。

column1: Nice job Commander. That was a tough nut to crack but you pulled it off with great skill. Now on to Minsk.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。那是块难啃的骨头，但你以高超的技巧把它办成了。现在向明斯克进军。

column1: ---This is the original Red Menace campaign where USA has been replaced by Germany---
column2: ——这是原版「红色威胁」战役，其中美国已被德国取代——

column1: Welcome to Red Menace! This is a fictional campaign which takes place in early post war Europe. The basic premise is that international tensions regarding the division of Germany become explosive and  minor border skirmishes between German and Russian forces erupts into a full scale Soviet invasion. The campaign takes the German commander from trying to resist the initial Soviet advances to taking the initiative and forcing the Russians all way back to Red Square.
column2: 欢迎来到「红色威胁」！这是一个虚构战役，发生在地中海战后初期的欧洲。基本前提是：围绕德国分裂的国际紧张局势变得一触即发，德军与俄军之间的小规模边境冲突升级为苏军的大规模入侵。本战役带领德军指挥官从力图抵抗苏军最初的推进，一直到夺取主动权，把俄国人一路逼回红场。

column1: Wonderful!!!, Stalin himself is sending his congratulations to you. You are a good communist, now we have under our control all the naval bases on Norway, and we can give a pressure on the Brits from Norwegian sea.
column2: 太棒了！！！斯大林亲自向你发来祝贺。你是个好共产主义者，现在我们已控制挪威(Norway)所有的海军基地，我们可以从挪威海(Norwegian sea)对英国人施加压力了。
塞瓦斯托波尔-别利别克
塞瓦斯托波尔-赫尔松涅斯

column1: Well, commander the battle was, shall we say, slightly difficult, and Jerry managed to cause problems for us. Britain has returned to the continent, and for this we are grateful. At least, the enemy must stretch their resources even further.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，这场战斗可以说稍嫌艰难，杰里(Jerry)还是给我们制造了麻烦。英国已重回大陆，对此我们心怀感激。至少，敌人不得不把他们的资源摊得更薄。

column1: General, the fighting has been hard but London is ours!! Churchill has escaped to the North, now no one can deny the Third Reich's Victory!!
column2: 将军，战斗艰苦，但伦敦(London)已归我们所有！！丘吉尔(Churchill)已逃往北方，现在没人能否认第三帝国(Third Reich)的胜利了！！

column1: Impressive!, The British have been erased from the Portsmouth area!, and now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.
column2: 了不起！英国人已被从朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)地区清除出去！现在我们可以在此建立司令部，并开始从大陆本土接收补给。

column1: This is a choice scenario. At this stage the campaign consists in two different paths and you can select which path you will follow.
column2: 这是一个分支选择场景。在这个阶段，战役由两条不同的路线组成，你可以选择走哪一条。

column1: If you get a BRILLAND VICTORY: You will follow the path Arnhem - Metz - The Battle of the Bulge - Dessau - The Ruhr.
column2: 如果你取得辉煌胜利：你将走阿纳姆(Arnhem) - 梅斯(Metz) - 突出部之战 - 德绍(Dessau) - 鲁尔(The Ruhr)这条路线。

column1: If you chose this path, you will always follow this historical line whatever your results.
column2: 如果你选择了这条路线，那么无论你的战绩如何，都将始终沿这条历史线走下去。

column1: If you get VICTORY or a TACTICAL VICTORY: you will try to capture Hitler if he flees from Berlin in the "Alpenfestung", you will follow the path Arracourt - Gothic Line - Malmedy - Austria - Berchtesgaden.
column2: 如果你取得胜利或战术胜利：你将设法在希特勒逃入「阿尔卑斯要塞」(Alpenfestung)时俘获他，你将走阿拉库尔(Arracourt) - 哥特防线 - 马尔梅迪(Malmedy) - 奥地利(Austria) - 贝希特斯加登(Berchtesgaden)这条路线。

column1: Be aware that if you don't achieve a victory in any single scenario, you will play scenarios from the other path without any possibility to come back to this line of events.
column2: 请注意，如果你在任何单独场景中未能取得胜利，你将改玩另一条路线的场景，而且再也没有可能回到这条事件线上。

column1: The Russians attack the Finns at Viipuri.
column2: 俄军在维堡(Viipuri)进攻芬兰人。

column1: A victory here will put Finland out of the war.
column2: 在此取胜将使芬兰退出战争。

column1: The fascists are at Stalingrad.  It is time to show the Motherland that you are the one to lead Soviet troops to the final victory in Berlin.
column2: 法西斯分子已兵临斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)。是时候向祖国证明，你才是那个将率领苏军走向柏林最终胜利的人。

column1: Good morning, general, You've made quite wise decision turning to our side. The Reich appreciates your courage. You and your soldiers can now fight alongside us against communism. Although it is a hard time, we believe the Führer will find the right solution.
column2: 早上好，将军，你投向我们这边是个相当明智的决定。帝国(Reich)赞赏你的勇气。你和你的士兵现在可以与我们并肩对抗共产主义。虽说时局艰难，但我们相信元首会找到正确的解决办法。

column1: Well done General, we are controlling Berlin, I know that was a hard fight but you will receive a reward.
column2: 干得好，将军，我们控制了柏林(Berlin)，我知道那是一场苦战，但你会得到奖赏。

column1: Patton hasn't choice but retreat against our glorious advance of our Soviet army.
column2: 面对我们苏联军队的光荣推进，巴顿(Patton)别无选择，只能撤退。

column1: You did it Commander! We got what we came for, and you've done a fine job for us.  And now son, it's time to go home. You've done your country proud. Here have a cigar. See you stateside.
column2: 你办到了，指挥官！我们得到了想要的东西，你为我们干得很出色。现在，孩子，该回家了。你为你的国家争了光。来，抽支雪茄。咱们国内见。

column1: Commander, we may be in a bit of trouble here. G2 reports that an entire Russian Armored Corp and several independant Tank Brigades are bearing down on our border positions as we speak. Bad weather has prevented the Air Corp from interdicting them. We need you back in that sector as a mobile reserve. The attack could come at any day now. Good luck.
column2: 指挥官，我们这里可能有点麻烦。G2 报告，就在我们说话的当口，整整一个俄国装甲军和几个独立坦克旅正朝我们的边境阵地压来。恶劣天气使航空军(Air Corp)无法拦阻他们。我们需要你回到那个地段充当机动预备队。进攻随时可能到来。祝好运。

column1: General, that was marginal at best.
column2: 将军，那至多只能算勉强合格。

column1: This will make our seizure of Vladivostok far more difficult.
column2: 这将使我们夺取符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)困难得多。

column1: Commander, You have broken through the enemy lines, but you took too long and Rommel retreated relatively unharmmed.
column2: 指挥官，你突破了敌军防线，但你花的时间太长，隆美尔(Rommel)相对无损地撤退了。

column1: Comrade General the Zitadelle offensive has exhausted itself! The time has come to attack towards Orel and threaten the German positions from behind! You should take command and coordinate the operations.
column2: 将军同志，「堡垒」(Zitadelle)攻势已耗尽自身！现在该向奥廖尔(Orel)进攻，从背后威胁德军阵地了！你应当接过指挥权并协调这次作战。

column1: Comrade General you have achieved some success, but your dilatory tactics have failed to clear this part of the Ukraine from Germans invaders! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!

column1: The German plan for the 1940 campaign in the west centered around a surprise strike through the dense Ardennes forest, emerging at Sedan to drive across France to the English Channel. column1: Welcome to Red Menace! This is a fictional campaign which takes place in early post war Europe. The basic premise is that international tensions regarding the division of Germany become explosive and  minor border skirmishes between US and Russian forces erupts into a full scale Soviet invasion. The campaign takes the US commander from trying to resist the initial Soviet advances to taking the initiative and forcing the Russins all way back to Red Square.
column2: 欢迎来到「红色威胁」！这是一个虚构战役，发生在战后初期的欧洲。基本前提是：围绕德国分裂的国际紧张局势变得一触即发，美军与俄军之间的小规模边境冲突升级为苏军的大规模入侵。本战役带领美军指挥官从力图抵抗苏军最初的推进，一直到夺取主动权，把俄国人一路逼回红场。

column2: 将军同志，为表彰你的勇敢与忠诚，斯大林同志根据朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的建议，把突击柏林的任务交给了你！！！由于你的英勇，你再次被授予苏联英雄称号。乌拉！！！

column1: Comrade General STAVKA needs you to straighten the operations leading to the surrender of Sevastopol. The local commanders have botched the attack. You can deploy only six of your units plus your Air Force. You will have also support from the Black Sea Fleet. Do not fail us Comrade!
column2: 将军同志，最高统帅部需要你整顿旨在迫降塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的作战。当地指挥员把这次进攻搞砸了。你只能投入你的六个单位外加你的空军。你还会得到黑海舰队的支援。不要让我们失望，同志！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and finally Crimea is free from invaders! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！敌人已经投降，克里米亚(Crimea)终于摆脱了侵略者！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved some success, but your ineptitude has allowed the enemy to evacuate the city by sea! Vassiliev is displeased even though you captured the city!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了一些战果，但你的无能致使敌人从海上撤走了！尽管你夺取了该城，瓦西里耶夫仍不满意！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great victory! You stopped the German counterattacks and took Budapest! Hungary has surrendered!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了伟大的胜利！你挡住了德军的反击并夺取了布达佩斯(Budapest)！匈牙利(Hungary)已经投降！

column1: Comrade General you have achieved a great success! The enemy has surrendered and Finland has asked for an armistice! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!
column2: 将军同志，你取得了重大胜利！敌人已经投降，芬兰(Finland)已请求停战！最高统帅部对你的指挥非常满意！

column1: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Russian territory!!! Comrade Stalin wants to destroy Army Group Center once and for all. You will attack in the direction of Minsk. Two tanks and four rifle armies will support you.

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! You have recovered Belorussia for us!!!

column2: 将军同志，你来得早。我们现在可以开会了。茶炊刚续满，如果你想喝一杯的话。很好。我们开始吧。马克思(Marx)与列宁(Lenin)提出、并由伟大的斯大林加以完善的历史辩证法，已证明了它必然的真理。我们祖国的法西斯入侵者为了夺取斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)城而过度伸展，徒劳无功。就在这里，沿奇尔河(Chir)一线，你和你的部队将冲垮他们的防御，以最快速度向南推进。工农红军将包围敌人，迫其投降。

column1: Good work, Comrade, very good!  Thanks to your proper understanding of party doctrine, you have been able to accomplish your mission.  The fascist invaders are trapped without any hope of escape.  Now, prepare yourself and your men to drive them out of the Motherland.
column2: 干得好，同志，非常好！多亏你对党的学说有正确的理解，你才得以完成任务。法西斯入侵者已陷入重围，毫无逃脱的希望。现在，让你和你的部下做好准备，把他们赶出祖国。

column2: 你未能遵循党中央委员会的明确指示，导致了一场惨痛的失败。因此，你须前往雅库茨克(Yakutsk)报到，进一步研读马克思(Marx)、列宁(Lenin)与伟大的斯大林的著作。

column1: Good news, Comrade General.  The fascist offensive has been halted.  Now is the time for our counter-offensive.  You have been selected to drive the fascists back.  The Red Army of workers and peasants will triumph!
column2: 好消息，将军同志。法西斯的攻势已被遏止。现在是我们反攻的时候了。你已被选中去把法西斯赶回去。工农红军必将胜利！

column1: At this moment, the fascist invaders are in retreat.  But, we know they hope to stop our offensive along the Dnepr River.  You and your men will force a crossing of the river aided by our Guards Airborne forces. The sight of red parachutes will help demoralize the fascists and bring us victory.
column2: 此刻，法西斯入侵者正在退却。但我们知道，他们希望在第聂伯河(Dnepr)沿线挡住我们的攻势。你和你的部下将在我们近卫空降部队的协助下强渡该河。红色降落伞的出现将有助于瓦解法西斯分子的士气，为我们带来胜利。

column1: Thanks are in order to you and your devoted troops, you are true Communists.  The enemy is fleeing before us. And now, our army has successfully crossed the Dnepr.  Good work, Comrade General.
column2: 应当向你和你忠诚的部队致谢，你们是真正的共产党人。敌人正在我们面前逃窜。如今，我军已成功渡过第聂伯河(Dnepr)。干得好，将军同志。

It is clear the party must place a more dedicated communist in command.  Report to Stalingrad immediately to assist in rebuilding that city.
column2: 你未能听从政治顾问的建议，使党付出了沉重代价。只有投入增援，才能强渡第聂伯河(Dnepr)。显然，党必须任命一位更忠诚的共产党人来指挥。立即前往斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)报到，协助重建该城。

column1: Comrade General, for over 900 days, Leningrad has been entrapped by the fascist invaders.  The Party has decreed that you must break their stranglehold on the city.  Comrade, the people must be freed at all costs. Their sacrifices must not have been in vain.
column2: 将军同志，900多天来，列宁格勒(Leningrad)一直被法西斯入侵者围困。党已下令，你必须打破他们对这座城市的扼制。同志，必须不惜一切代价解放人民。他们的牺牲绝不能白费。

column1: Superb performance, Comrade General.  I salute you.  You and your troops have successfully freed Leningrad.  The birthplace of the revolution can again breathe the sweet air of freedom.  Now, we must help our Finnish brothers to the north to escape the fascist scourge.
column2: 出色的表现，将军同志。我向你致敬。你和你的部队已成功解放列宁格勒(Leningrad)。革命的诞生地又可以呼吸自由的甜美空气了。现在，我们必须帮助北面的芬兰兄弟摆脱法西斯的祸害。

column1: Very good, very good!  You and your troops have successfully freed Leningrad.  The birthplace of the revolution can again breathe the sweet air of freedom.  Now, we must help our Finnish brothers to the north to escape the fascist scourge.

column1: It is time to help the oppressed people of Finland break their capitalist chains, Comrade General.  You and your troops must capture the city of Vyborg, or "Viipuri" as it is known in their language.  The Finns foolishly believe that Vyborg is an ancient Finnish city.  Typical capitalist lie.  But, to defend their city, they will use all available reserves, including their contemptible navy and air force.  Good luck, Comrade.
column2: 是时候帮助受压迫的芬兰(Finland)人民砸碎他们的资本主义锁链了，将军同志。你和你的部队必须夺取维堡(Vyborg)城，也就是他们语言中所称的「维堡(Viipuri)」。芬兰人愚蠢地以为维堡是一座古老的芬兰城市。典型的资本主义谎言。但为了保卫他们的城市，他们会动用一切可用的预备队，包括他们那支可鄙的海军和空军。祝你好运，同志。

column1: Comrade General.  Please, come in. Some caviar?  The occupation of Vyborg has broken the will of the fascists.  The Finns have been abandoned by their German allies and have sued for peace.  Finally, a proper socialist government has been installed.  Excellent, excellent work.
column2: 将军同志。请进。来点鱼子酱？占领维堡(Vyborg)已打垮法西斯分子的意志。芬兰人已被他们的德国盟友抛弃，已请求和平。终于建立了一个像样的社会主义政府。出色，干得非常出色。

column1: Comrade General.  Please, come in.  The occupation of Vyborg has broken the will of the fascists.  The Finns have been abandoned by their German allies and have sued for peace.  Finally, a proper socialist government has been installed. Good work.
column2: 将军同志。请进。占领维堡(Vyborg)已打垮法西斯分子的意志。芬兰人已被他们的德国盟友抛弃，已请求和平。终于建立了一个像样的社会主义政府。干得好。

column2: 多亏你软弱无力的努力，地中海(Med)的战事还将继续拖延下去。你将立即返回英格兰(England)接受军法审判。接替你这里职务的是蒙哥马利(Montgomery)将军。你可以走了。

column1: The historical dialectic has once again proven its inevitable truth.  We stand at the gates of the fascist capital.  It is your task, Comrade General, to destroy this nest of vipers so that the Soviet peoples' sacrifices will not have been pointless.  Once the enemy along the Seelow Heights have been eradicated, the road to the fascist capital will be open.  Good luck, Comrade.

column1: The Party has brought the Great Patriotic War to a victorious end and we celebrate your role in this final battle.  The banners of the SSSR fly over the Reichstag, and our liberation mission is complete.  All the peoples of the world herald your name for freeing them from the fascist nightmare. Comrade General, a dacha on the Black Sea has been granted you and awaits your pleasure. And now, Vodka!
column2: 党已把伟大的卫国战争引向胜利的结局，我们在此庆祝你在这场最后之战中的作用。苏联(SSSR)的旗帜飘扬在国会大厦(Reichstag)上空，我们的解放使命已经完成。全世界的人民都在传颂你的名字，因为你把他们从法西斯的噩梦中解放出来。将军同志，黑海(Black Sea)畔的一座别墅已划拨给你，静候你享用。现在，上伏特加！

column1: Comrade General, we congratulate you!  You are a true Hero of the Soviet Union.  Your forces have freed the world from the scourge of fascism, and the people of the world celebrate this victory with you.  The party, in order to show its gratitude, has secured for you an apartment in Moskva, and looks forward to your continued loyal service.  And now, let us drink tea.  The samovar is full!
column2: 将军同志，我们祝贺你！你是真正的苏联英雄。你的部队把世界从法西斯的祸害中解放出来，全世界的人民都在与你一同庆祝这场胜利。为表示感激，党已在莫斯科(Moskva)为你安排了一套公寓，并期待你继续忠诚服务。现在，我们来喝茶吧。茶炊是满的！

column1: Comrade General, you have completed your mission.  The fascists have been crushed. The western capitalists now understand that a state of free workers and peasants under the enlightened guidance of the Party can never be defeated.  You will be granted a medal to be worn proudly as evidence of your sacrifice and heroism.  Congratulations.
column2: 将军同志，你已完成了任务。法西斯已被粉碎。西方的资本家现在明白，一个在党英明指引下的自由工农国家是永远无法被击败的。你将获授一枚勋章，可自豪地佩戴，作为你牺牲与英勇的见证。恭喜。

It is fortunate for you, Comrade General, that we have won the war. You will report immediately to a site in the Urals to engage in self-criticism.
column2: 你曾有机会以一场光荣的胜利结束这场战争。可你却在法西斯首都的接近地上犹豫不决，让你英勇部队的牺牲白白浪费。将军同志，对你来说幸运的是，我们打赢了这场战争。你将立即前往乌拉尔(Urals)某地作自我批评。

column2: 同志！你的任务是阻止德军在莫扎伊斯克(Mozhaisk)的临时阵地上挡住我们的攻势。

column1: General, the fighting has been hard but London is ours!!! Churchill has escaped to the North, now no one can deny the Third Reich's Victory!!!
column2: 将军，战斗很艰苦，但伦敦(London)是我们的了！！！丘吉尔(Churchill)已逃往北方，现在没有人能否认第三帝国的胜利了！！！

column1: Amazing job, Commander.  We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose.  The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
column2: 干得惊人，指挥官。我们把你投进了一个烂摊子，你却出淤泥而不染。战斗很艰苦，但你的小伙子们咬牙顶住了。

column1: In this case, your defeat was due to the inaptitude of the Italian forces.
column2: 在这种情况下，你的失败要归因于意大利军队的无能。

column1: General, although you overran Hitler's headquarters, the Fuhrer managed to escape by U-Boat to South America. The world still lives in fear of the Nazi menace.
column2: 将军，尽管你攻占了希特勒的总部，元首还是乘 U 艇逃到了南美洲(South America)。世界仍生活在纳粹威胁的恐惧之中。

column1: Finally, we have conquered the Rock, the British showed us a hard resistance by using the hard conditions of the Gibraltar soil. Now the Mediterranean is closed, and the South bank, secured.
column2: 我们终于征服了巨岩(the Rock)，英国人利用直布罗陀(Gibraltar)土地的艰苦条件，向我们展示了顽强的抵抗。现在地中海(Mediterranean)已经封闭，南岸也已确保。

column1: Congratulations, the great British empire is in ruins, the battles were hard but we are victorious.
column2: 恭喜，大英帝国已成废墟，战斗艰苦，但我们胜利了。

column1: Now, the British will have to choice between surrender and die. The Italians in Lybia launch an attack.
column2: 现在，英国人只能在投降与死亡之间做选择。利比亚(Lybia)的意大利人发起了一次进攻。

column1: Badly, you will have some short vacations because the Führer Himself had ordered you to report in Berlin.
column2: 糟糕，你将有一段短暂的假期，因为元首本人已命令你到柏林报到。

column1: No one knows what he is preparing for the glory of Third Reich!
column2: 没有人知道他为第三帝国的荣耀准备了什么！

column1: Well, I don't think that all is over, the Italians have launched an attack from Lybia.
column2: 嗯，我认为一切还没有结束，意大利人已从利比亚(Lybia)发起进攻。

column1: Our task here is over, report in Berlin at once.
column2: 我们这里的任务已经结束，立即到柏林报到。

column1: Congratulations!, all the British Army units have been erased from the map on this area. Now, we can start the refurbishment of the port in order to install here our Field Head Quarters, and start to receiving reinforcements from the Continental soil. Good work.
column2: 恭喜！这一地区所有英国陆军部队都已从地图上被抹去。现在我们可以开始整修港口，以便在此设立我们的野战司令部，并开始接收来自欧洲大陆的增援。干得好。

column1: General here we stand on the banks of the Volga.
column2: 将军，我们此刻就站在伏尔加河(Volga)畔。

column1: We have to get across quickly to keep our advance moving before
column2: 我们必须迅速渡过去，以保持推进势头，赶在

column1: those Soviet forces from Poland get here.
column2: 那些从波兰(Poland)开来的苏军到达之前。

column1: We may have helped them reopen the front there, but I have no
column2: 我们也许帮他们重新打开了那里的战线，但我无

column1: intention to let them get all the credit.
column2: 意让他们把功劳全拿走。

column1: Good work!, we have captured the port of Lyme Regis according to the plan. Now, we should start the refurbishment of the docks in order to allow the arrival of more reinforcements. We will install here our Fields H.Q.
column2: 干得好！我们已按计划夺取莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)港。现在，我们应当开始整修码头，以便更多增援抵达。我们将在此设立野战司令部。

column1: The worst has happened, the British have cut off our supply lines with the port, and we are isolated here!. If we can escape from here, a Military council would be waiting for you in Berlin!!.
column2: 最坏的情况发生了，英国人切断了我们与港口之间的补给线，我们在这里被孤立了！如果我们能从这里脱身，一个军事法庭会在柏林等着你！！

column1: We have secured the city of Taunton, and now the way to Bristol is clear. We expect the improvement of your actions, otherwise we will be forced to remove you from the command.
column2: 我们已确保汤顿(Taunton)城，如今通往布里斯托尔(Bristol)的道路已经畅通。我们期待你的行动有所改善，否则我们将不得不解除你的指挥权。

column1: Commander, you did a good job. However, our forces are losing ground everywhere. You must withdraw you men to Dunkirk to be evacuated.
column2: 指挥官，你干得不错。然而，我们的部队正在各处失守。你必须把部下撤往敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)以便撤离。

column1: Wonderful!, with this victory here all the South East of England is under our control!, now the British can not receive supplies from the United States and its allies!, good work Herr General!.
column2: 好极了！凭此地的胜利，英格兰(England)东南部已全在我们掌控之下！现在英国人无法再从美国(United States)及其盟国获得补给了！干得好，将军阁下！

column1: The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shot you with my Walter P-38!!.
column2: 英国人在这里挡住了我们！在我用我的瓦尔特 P-38 枪毙你之前，给我滚出我的视线！！

column1: Your failure is beyond comprehension.  The enemy armies have already have begun to counterattack.  You are now reassigned to duty as commander of our garrison in the Falkland Islands.
column2: 你的失败令人无法理解。敌军各集团军已经开始反击。你现被改派为我们驻福克兰群岛(Falkland Islands)守备部队的指挥官。

column1: I'm really impressed by your skills!, the defensive lines established by the British here have been completely overrun and all the goals have been captured, also, the supply lines with the South have been secured... and now we can drive to London!.
column2: 你的本领让我大为赞叹！英国人在这里建立的防线已被彻底突破，所有目标都已夺取，与南面的补给线也已确保……现在我们可以向伦敦(London)推进了！

column1: You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your poor actions!, now it's supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!.
column2: 你是个蠢货！你这拙劣的行动毁掉了整个作战！现在按说我们肯定得赶在英军反击之前开始撤离所有滩头阵地。一个军事法庭已在德国等着你了！

column1: We have got the victory!, now London is completely besieged by our forces, and the last British defenders are enclosed into the capital, they have two options; surrender, or die!
column2: 我们胜利了！如今伦敦(London)已被我军彻底围困，英国最后的守军被围在首都之内，他们只有两个选择：投降，或者死亡！

column1: The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shoot you with my Walter P-38!!.
column2: 英国人在这里挡住了我们！在我用我的瓦尔特 P-38 枪毙你之前，给我滚出我的视线！！

column1: Superb work, Commander!  The Italians have been driven from our colony.  Our forces are now pursuing the enemy deep into Abyssynia.  Soon Italy will be out of East Africa entirely.
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官！意大利人已被逐出我们的殖民地。我军正在追击敌人，深入阿比西尼亚(Abyssynia)。意大利很快就会完全退出东非(East Africa)。

column1: Superb work, Commander! The Italians have been driven from our colony.  Our forces are now pursuing the enemy deep into Abyssynia.  Soon Italy will be out of East Africa entirely.
column2: 出色的工作，指挥官！意大利人已被逐出我们的殖民地。我军正在追击敌人，深入阿比西尼亚(Abyssynia)。意大利很快就会完全退出东非(East Africa)。

column1: Well, nice work.  Now, we've got men and machines rolling into southern Italy, and rumor has it that Italy's on the verge of surrendering.  Good goin', Commander.
column2: 嗯，干得漂亮。现在，我们的人马正滚滚涌入意大利南部，还有传言说意大利即将投降。干得好，指挥官。

column1: I would have liked for more time, but this will have to do
column2: 我本想要更多时间，但也只能这样了

column1: The engineers have got part of the defenses in place, I hope its enough
column2: 工兵已把部分防御部署到位，我希望这足够了

column1: You are stupid!, you have destroyed all the operation with your poor performance!, now it is supposed that we surely would start the evacuation of all the beach-heads before the British could make a counter-attack. A Military Council is already waiting for you in Germany!
column2: 你是个蠢货！你这拙劣的表现毁掉了整个作战！现在按说我们肯定得赶在英军反击之前开始撤离所有滩头阵地。一个军事法庭已在德国等着你了！

column1: Thank god we could divert some Marines to finish your job.
column2: 谢天谢地，我们能抽调一些海军陆战队来替你把事情办完。

column1: I don't like owing the Navy a favor so don't do that again.
column2: 我不喜欢欠海军的人情，所以别再这样了。

column1: Very Good General! now is the moment to regroup our units with the reinforcements coming from France.
column2: 非常好，将军！现在正是用来自法国(France)的增援重整我们部队的时候。

column1: Good! the capture of Brighton took much time than expected, but we did it!
column2: 好！夺取布赖顿(Brighton)比预期花了更多时间，但我们还是做到了！

column1: Thanks to this victory, the 9th army under your command and the 16th army can help each other. The 16th will move to the north while we will move to the West.
column2: 多亏这场胜利，由你指挥的第9集团军和第16集团军可以互相策应。第16集团军将向北移动，而我们将向西移动。

column1: The British have stopped us here!, run out from my sight before I shoot you with my Walter P-38!!!
column2: 英国人在这里挡住了我们！在我用我的瓦尔特 P-38 枪毙你之前，给我滚出我的视线！！！

column1: I had hoped you would have performed better General.
column2: 我本希望你能表现得更好，将军。

column1: Ivan has had just as much success in the North.
column2: 伊万(Ivan)在北面也取得了同样的成功。

column1: The whole front is in general retreat.
column2: 整条战线都在全面撤退。

column1: This is a choice scenario. The campaign consists in three different paths and you can select which path you will follow.
column2: 这是一个选择型场景。本战役由三条不同路线组成，你可以选择要走哪一条。

column1: If you get a BRILLAND VICTORY: you will command the 16th army with six divisions embarked in Calais Boulogne-sur-Mer to disembark in the zone of Dover-Margate.
column2: 若你取得辉煌胜利：你将指挥第16集团军，六个师在加来(Calais)与滨海布洛涅(Boulogne-sur-Mer)上船，在多佛(Dover)-马盖特(Margate)地域登陆。

column1: This will be the zone of most battles because you have to keep a line open in the channel to allow reinforcements and transports.
column2: 这将是最多战斗的地域，因为你必须在海峡中保持一条畅通的航线，以便增援与运输船抵达。

column1: If you get VICTORY: You will be assigned to the 9th army with four divisions embarked in Le Havre to disembark between Brighton and Isle of Wight. Your duty will be give support to the 16th army to surround London later.
column2: 若你取得胜利：你将被分配到第9集团军，四个师在勒阿弗尔(Le Havre)上船，在布赖顿(Brighton)与怀特岛(Isle of Wight)之间登陆。你的职责是支援第16集团军，以便日后包围伦敦(London)。

column1: If you get TACTICAL VICTORY: you will be in charge of 6th army with three divisions embarked in Cherbourg to disembark in Lyme Regis, your orders are to distract the attention of the enemy moving out to Bristol to then turn to London.
column2: 若你取得战术胜利：你将负责第6集团军，三个师在瑟堡(Cherbourg)上船，在莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)登陆；你的命令是转移敌人注意力，向布里斯托尔(Bristol)出击，然后转向伦敦(London)。
第3团丹麦/党卫军髑髅师
第5团图勒/党卫军髑髅师
第6团特奥多尔·艾克/党卫军髑髅师

column1: Herr General, the time has come to invade the British islands, your troops embark on Calais, along with other three division embarked on Boulogne-sur-Mer, both have to confront the enemy.
column2: 将军阁下，入侵不列颠诸岛的时刻到了。你的部队在加来(Calais)上船，另三个师在滨海布洛涅(Boulogne-sur-Mer)上船，两路都须与敌人交锋。

column1: You already know that due to the impossibility of transport heavy units, we haven't any land transport, tanks or heavy artillery. Your mission will be the capture the port of Dover and then Margate and Ramsgate.
column2: 你已知道，由于无法运输重型装备，我们没有任何陆上运输工具、坦克或重炮。你的任务将是夺取多佛(Dover)港，随后是马盖特(Margate)与拉姆斯盖特(Ramsgate)。

column1: Paratrooper groups are behind the enemy lines, their mission is capture and airstrip of crusial matter, advanced carefully through the channel to clean the mines. Good luck!
column2: 伞兵部队已在敌后，他们的任务是夺取一处至关重要的简易机场。沿海峡小心推进，清除水雷。祝你好运！

column1: General, we've paid a high price, but we are close to finish the fist stage of our operations.
column2: 将军，我们付出了高昂的代价，但我们即将完成作战的第一阶段。

column1: Your objective is the City of Canterbury and the airstrip of Lympne, crucial communication center of the enemy. The resistance you will find will probably be the rest of 10th and 12th infantry.
column2: 你的目标是坎特伯雷(Canterbury)城与林普尼(Lympne)简易机场——敌人至关重要的通信中心。你将遭遇的抵抗很可能来自第10和第12步兵部队的残部。

column1: Playing tip: Move also reinforcement units from PORT hexes ("Calais") to PORT hexes ("Dover") via the "strategic transport" button (see lower left button of any unit when right-clicking on it).
column2: 技巧：也可通过「战略运输」按钮把增援部队从（港口）六角格（「加来(Calais)」）调往（港口）六角格（「多佛(Dover)」）（右键点击任一单位时，见其左下方的按钮）。

column1: Led by American forces, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in Siberia.
column2: 在美国(America)带领下，联合国(United Nations)试图在西伯利亚(Siberia)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)。

column1: General, I hope you've got enough transports for this operation because the distances are long and we're lacking of time. Your objectives are the cities of Sittingbourne, Sheerness and Gillingham, the capture of Maidstone will be the duty of the 8th panzer division that comes from the south.
column2: 将军，我希望你为这次作战备足了运输工具，因为距离很远，而我们时间不够。你的目标是锡廷伯恩(Sittingbourne)、希尔内斯(Sheerness)与吉灵厄姆(Gillingham)三座城市；夺取梅德斯通(Maidstone)将由从南面开来的第8装甲师负责。

column1: Don't waste your time with the forces on Sheppey's Island because the aren't important at all and would only delay you. Paratrooper groups are already in the landzone to clean the path to advance more quickly.
column2: 不要把时间浪费在谢佩岛(Sheppey's Island)上的部队上，他们根本不重要，只会拖延你。伞兵部队已进入着陆区，清理道路以便更快推进。
格雷夫森德(Gravesend) - 多佛(Dover)路线：

column1: General, we continue with our unstoppable advance in the inner island. Your objectives is the city of Gravesend, it is the key to take Tilbury and Grays, which would allow us to advance to the north.
column2: 将军，我们继续在岛内不可阻挡地推进。你的目标是格雷夫森德(Gravesend)城，它是夺取蒂尔伯里(Tilbury)与格雷斯(Grays)的关键，从而让我们能向北推进。

column1: You will be supported by the 4th panzer division and the 20th motorized division that coming from the south which has the objectives to capture the cities of Dartford and Bexteyhead, outside London.
column2: 你将得到第4装甲师以及从南面开来的第20摩托化师的支援，后者的目标是夺取伦敦(London)城外的达特福德(Dartford)与贝克斯泰海德(Bexteyhead)。

column1: Again, paratrooper groups will be assist you eliminating defensive posts and delay the enemy counterattacks.
column2: 伞兵部队同样将协助你消灭防御据点，并迟滞敌人的反击。

column1: The Plan was better than expected. Now we have to finish the second stage of Seelöwe.
column2: 计划进展得比预期更好。现在我们得完成「海狮」(Seeloewe)行动的第二阶段。

column1: Take three divisions and move to conquer the city of Maldon, meanwhile another three units are moving to Watfort to close the paths to London from the North.
column2: 带三个师去攻取莫尔登(Maldon)城，同时另三个单位正开往沃特福德(Watfort)，以封闭从北面通往伦敦(London)的道路。

column1: Assign two or three units to take Brentwood, I don't think that more forces will be necessary.
column2: 派两三个单位去夺取布伦特伍德(Brentwood)，我认为不需要更多兵力了。

column1: The engineers haven't got very much done.

General, we have underestimated the opponent, not only the British has been denied our surrender offer but they have sent their best troops against us from London lauching a counterattack to Gravesend.
column2: 将军，我们低估了对手，英国人不仅拒绝了我们的投降提议，还从伦敦(London)派出他们最精锐的部队对我们发起反击，直扑格雷夫森德(Gravesend)。

column1: The situation is critical, if they are successful they will split our main forces in the North, on the cities of Maldon and Watfort, preventing our forces to resupply.
column2: 局势危急，如果他们得手，就会把我们北面的主力——在莫尔登(Maldon)与沃特福德(Watfort)两城的部队——割裂开来，使我军无法获得补给。

column1: Your mission is to advance as fast as you can to avoid the lost of Gravesend and restore the front.
column2: 你的任务是以最快速度推进，以免失去格雷夫森德(Gravesend)并恢复战线。

column1: Beware, the Brits have reactivated small well trained resistance groups in the forests and towns nearby.
column2: 当心，英国人已在附近的森林和城镇中重新激活了训练有素的小型抵抗组织。

column1: They can irreversibly delay your advance.
column2: 他们可能不可挽回地拖延你的推进。

column1: The success of this operation is in your hands!\x00
column2: 这次作战的成败掌握在你手中！

column1: Well, the promised hour has come, thirteen division surround London. Since the Roman Empire times, no one has ever reached this point, the direct order to attack London is out, and you are the one in charge.
column2: 好了，预定的时刻已经到来，十三个师包围了伦敦(London)。自罗马帝国(Roman Empire)时代以来，从未有人到达过这一步，直接进攻伦敦的命令已经下达，而由你全权负责。

column1: Most of the London's defenses are out because they died in the Gravesend counterattack, but remember that a big city can eat huge armies like a wolf. Bring down the enemy's morale taking his most representative symbols, each second counts! You are dismissed!!! GO!!!
column2: 伦敦(London)的大部分防御已经失效，因为他们在格雷夫森德(Gravesend)反击战中阵亡了，但要记住，一座大城市能像狼一样吞噬庞大的军队。夺取敌人最具代表性的象征，打垮他们的士气，每一秒都至关重要！你可以走了！！！出发！！！

column1: General, due to your unique successes in amphibious assault operations, our Italians allies have requested our help in the capture of the Malta Island. Have in mind that RAF is weakened, but even under those circumstances, it can overpass the Italians in experience.
column2: 将军，由于你在两栖突击作战中独一无二的成功，我们的意大利盟友已请求我们协助夺取马耳他(Malta)岛。要知道，皇家空军(RAF)虽已被削弱，但即便在这种情况下，其经验也胜过意大利人。
G 计划：突击直布罗陀(Gibraltar)。

column1: After the British surrender, the OKH have selected you to defeat the remaining British troops which have not surrendered yet. While the Japanese will make the same in the Indian Ocean, we are going to destroy the British forces in the Mediterranean, starting with Gibraltar. General Franco finally have allowed us to cross Spain with three divisions wich are supported by a Spanish Infantry division, and by some Spanish navy and Kriegsmarine units. With those forces at your disposal you should take the Rock. The LuftWaffe will arrive to help you, as well as our special commandos 'Brandenburgers', in sea men suits. Good Luck!
column2: 英国投降之后，陆军总司令部(OKH)选定你去击败尚未投降的英军残部。日本人将在印度洋(Indian Ocean)做同样的事，而我们将摧毁地中海的英国军队，首先从直布罗陀(Gibraltar)开始。佛朗哥(Franco)将军终于允许我们带三个师穿越西班牙(Spain)，这三个师还得到一支西班牙步兵师以及若干西班牙海军与德国海军部队的支援。有这些兵力供你调遣，你应当夺取巨岩(the Rock)。德国空军将前来协助你，还有我们穿着水兵服的特种突击队「勃兰登堡」(Brandenburgers)。祝你好运！

column1: General, the British are almost defeated, the Japanese have taken all the British belongings in Asia along with its Mediterran strongpoints. London is under our control, the remaining Royal Navy pieces are scattered everywhere, and they won't be nomore any threat to us.
column2: 将军，英国人几乎已被击败，日本人已夺取英国在亚洲(Asia)的全部属地以及其在地中海的据点。伦敦(London)已在我们控制之下，皇家海军剩下的舰只四散各处，再也无法对我们构成威胁。

column1: However, they have one more important strongpoint: Suez.
column2: 然而，他们还有一个重要的据点：苏伊士(Suez)。

column1: Our Italian allies (don't make any joke, we both know that they are very poor) with a tremendous effort have passed through the channel taking some casualities.
column2: 我们的意大利盟友（别开玩笑，我们都知道他们很糟糕）以极大的努力通过了海峡，付出了一些伤亡。

column1: But now you are here, you will be the one in charge, we know that this is the last fight where the Royal Army still has some power, so beware, and be quick like a bolt of lighting. If you take much time it would probably mean that the British would have destroyed the installations to avoid their capture.
column2: 但现在你来了，将由你负责。我们知道这是皇家军队仍有几分实力的最后一战，所以要当心，要像闪电一样迅捷。如果你花太多时间，很可能意味着英国人已经摧毁了那些设施，以免它们被我们夺取。

column1: After departure from Cherbourg in the past hours, we have reached this nearby point to Plymouth, the little port of Lyme Regis, where you should make the third beach-head, and start to advance following the plan. Two LuftWaffe's Squadrons are above us, and they will show the British what the LuftWaffe is capable of with valuable support, as well as some little Kriegsmarine support ships, wich will destroy the sea mines deployed in all the Lyme Bay by the British. In the other hand, you could test our new amphibious Panzers!, we have just dropped them into the water, and now they are rumbling under the sea!. Be aware, in spite of the defense of Lyme consist of Home Guard militias only, it's possible they will receive some reinforcements from the North.
column2: 在几小时前从瑟堡(Cherbourg)出发之后，我们已抵达靠近普利茅斯(Plymouth)的这一点——莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)小港，你应在此建立第三个滩头阵地，并按计划开始推进。我们上空有两个德国空军中队，他们将用宝贵的支援让英国人见识德国空军的本事；此外还有几艘小小的德国海军支援舰，它们将摧毁英国人在整个莱姆湾(Lyme Bay)布设的水雷。另一方面，你可以检验我们新型两栖装甲车！我们刚把它们放下水，现在它们正在海底下轰隆隆地前进！要注意，尽管莱姆(Lyme)的防御只有本土防卫队民兵，他们仍可能从北面得到一些增援。

column1: We have just established our HQ on Lyme, your next mission after seizing the port, is to make the roads safe we will use to drive our attack on Bristol. We need to capture the city of Taunton, intelligence reports that the British could be preparing a counter-attack from the other side of the river which crosses Taunton; we must avoid this, if the British destroy our communications with the port, our units in Bristol would be completely isolated. We expect the best from you, General.
column2: 我们刚在莱姆(Lyme)建立了司令部。夺取港口之后，你的下一个任务是确保我们将用来向布里斯托尔(Bristol)发起进攻的道路安全。我们需要夺取汤顿(Taunton)城；情报报告说，英国人可能正从横穿汤顿的河对岸准备一次反击；我们必须防止这一点，如果英国人破坏我们与港口之间的交通，我们在布里斯托尔(Bristol)的部队就会完全被孤立。我们期待你拿出最好的表现，将军。

column1: Herr General, we have arrived to our first important goal in our part of the operation; the assault on Bristol. The British are trying to make a defensive line here, using Bristol as an important reference point. Surely, we will face a harder resistance here than in the first days of the invasion. Fortunately, huge LuftWaffe formations will support us in order to suppress these heavy resistance into the streets of Bristol, as well as the 7th FJ Division of General Student, which is coming from the sea to take the British by surprise from their back. Intelligence reports that maybe the British Home Guard are hiding supplies into the nearly forests with the aim to make some skirmishes on our supply lines while we attack Bristol, so be aware about this. Good Luck.
column2: 将军阁下，我们已到达我们这部分作战的第一个重要目标：突击布里斯托尔(Bristol)。英国人正试图在此建立一道防线，把布里斯托尔当作重要的基准点。我们在此遭遇的抵抗必定比入侵头几天更顽强。幸运的是，庞大的德国空军编队将支援我们，以压制布里斯托尔街巷中的顽强抵抗；施图登特(Student)将军的第7伞兵师也将从海上赶来，从背后出其不意地打击英国人。情报报告说，英国本土防卫队可能把补给藏在附近的森林里，意图在我们进攻布里斯托尔时袭扰我们的补给线，所以要当心这一点。祝你好运。

column1: Our Aufklärers have spotted the Big Ben!!, we have reached the London suburbs Herr General!. The last regular British forces are enclosed into the big city, we have offered the British the capitulation, but they have refused it!, this people are amazing me. This, will surely be a complete cataclysm, but they have decided the bad way.
column2: 我们的侦察兵已看到大本钟(Big Ben)！！我们已经到达伦敦(London)郊区，将军阁下！英国最后一支正规部队被围在这座大城市里，我们已向英国人提出投降要求，但他们拒绝了！这些人真让我惊讶。这必定会是一场彻底的大灾难，但他们选择了糟糕的那条路。

column1: Troops from the disembark area on Portsmouth will join you to start the attack over the capital. Good Luck.
column2: 来自朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)登陆地域的部队将与你会合，共同发起对首都的进攻。祝你好运。

column1: We really needed a knockout blow here, Commander.  Instead, you put up a weak little jab.  Our boys are fighters, but we need a general who can lead them!  Son, I put a lot of faith in your abilities... I was wrong, Commander.  It's time to send you back home.
column2: 我们这里真正需要的是一记击倒对手的重拳，指挥官。可你却打出一记软弱无力的小刺拳。我们的小伙子都是战士，但我们需要一位能带领他们的将军！孩子，我曾对你的能力寄予厚望……我错了，指挥官。该送你回家了。

column1: Well, the promised hour has come, thirteen division surround London. Since the Roman Empire times, no one could have reached this point, the direct order to attack London is out, and you are the one in charge.
column2: 好了，预定的时刻已经到来，十三个师包围了伦敦(London)。自罗马帝国(Roman Empire)时代以来，从未有人能够到达这一步，直接进攻伦敦的命令已经下达，而由你全权负责。

column1: Most of London's defenses are out because they died in Gloucester and Windsor battles, but remember that a big city can eat huge armies like a wolf. Bring down the enemy's morale by taking his most representative symbols, each second counts! You are dismissed!!! GO!!!
column2: 伦敦(London)的大部分防御已经失效，因为他们在格洛斯特(Gloucester)与温莎(Windsor)两场战斗中阵亡了，但要记住，一座大城市能像狼一样吞噬庞大的军队。夺取敌人最具代表性的象征，以此打垮他们的士气，每一秒都至关重要！你可以走了！！！出发！！！
朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth) - 怀特岛(Isle of Wight)

column1: Herr General, we have crossed the English Channel departing from Le Havre, and now we are in front of Portsmouth, we must make a beach head here as quickly as possible, the Royal Navy is heading to Portsmouth in order to smash us, however, Kriegsmarine ships, Gneisenau, Admiral Scheer and Koeln will help us too!. Our main goals here are the following: at first Portsmouth and the Isle of Wight, then the city of Southampton. The 22nd FJ Division is here to support us, their mission is to take the Isle of Wight, however, you can change those plans if needed. Two LuftWaffe's Squadrons are above us, and they will show the British what the LuftWaffe is capable of with valuable air support, also, you could test our new amphibious Panzers!, we have just dropped them into the water, and now they are rumbling under the sea to the Isle of Wight!. Good Luck!
column2: 将军阁下，我们已从勒阿弗尔(Le Havre)出发渡过英吉利海峡(English Channel)，现在我们正面对着朴茨茅斯(Portsmouth)，我们必须尽快在此建立滩头阵地；皇家海军正驶向朴茨茅斯，想把我们砸碎，不过德国海军的舰只——格奈森瑙号(Gneisenau)、舍尔海军上将号(Admiral Scheer)与科隆号(Koeln)——也会来帮我们！我们这里的主要目标如下：首先是朴茨茅斯与怀特岛(Isle of Wight)，然后是南安普敦(Southampton)城。第22伞兵师在此支援我们，他们的任务是夺取怀特岛，不过如有需要，你可以改变这些计划。我们上空有两个德国空军中队，他们将用宝贵的空中支援让英国人见识德国空军的本事；此外，你也可以检验我们新型两栖装甲车！我们刚把它们放下水，现在它们正轰隆隆地在海底下驶向怀特岛！祝你好运！

column1: You've heard the casualty reports from Europe?
column2: 你听到来自欧洲(Europe)的伤亡报告了吗？

column1: Would you like to experience it first hand?
If you don't do better, you will.
column2: 如果你不做得更好，你会的。

column1: Now that the disembarkation has been completed, the following step is to get inside the inner island and establish a new secured zone to avoid being attacked by the RAF in the beachhead.
column2: 既然登陆已经完成，下一步就是深入岛内并建立一个新的安全区，以免在滩头阵地遭到皇家空军(RAF)的攻击。

column1: Advance to the city of Winchester in order to cut the enemy grouping which is currently being slowly restored from our surprise attack, you won't find a strong resistance, but anyway you have to be really fast.
column2: 向温切斯特(Winchester)城推进，以割裂敌军集团——他们目前正从我们的突袭中缓慢恢复；你不会遇到顽强抵抗，但无论如何你必须非常快。

column1: Our recon groups report that there is a number of improvised bunkers scattered in the zone.
column2: 我们的侦察分队报告，该地区散布着若干临时构筑的掩体。

column1: The situation has changed, even the important Brighton Port is under British domain, your troops must move to the east to take the city along with the 8th Panzer Division coming from Dover.
column2: 局势已经变化，连重要的布赖顿(Brighton)港也仍在英国人手中；你的部队必须向东推进，与从多佛(Dover)开来的第8装甲师一同夺取该城。

column1: You must secure the port and its installations to allow the arrival of the heavy machinery of the 4th Panzer Division coming from the continent.
column2: 你必须确保该港及其设施的安全，以便从欧洲大陆开来的第4装甲师的重型装备得以抵达。

column1: General, the hardest part of the operation is behind us, now is time to begin the stage two, for this you have our best weapon: the panzer divisions! This is the time to go as fast as you can through the path to London. With your tanks as spearhead, advance quickly to avoid the British defenses. The main obstacles are the 1st and 2nd Armored division that British have in the zone,
column2: 将军，作战最艰难的部分已经过去，现在是开始第二阶段的时候了，为此你有我们最好的武器：各装甲师！现在你要尽可能快地沿通往伦敦(London)的路线前进。以你的坦克为矛头，迅速推进，避开英国的防御。主要障碍是英国人在该地区部署的第1和第2装甲师，

column1: so beware. The targets are the cities of Crawley, Horsham, East Grinstead and Haywards Heath.
column2: 所以要当心。目标是克劳利(Crawley)、霍舍姆(Horsham)、东格林斯特德(East Grinstead)与海沃兹希思(Haywards Heath)四座城市。

column1: General, we continue with our powerful advance through the inner island.
column2: 将军，我们继续以强大的势头在岛内推进。

column1: Your targets are the big city of Gravesend and the minor cities of Dartford and Bexteyhead, which are in London's outskirts. Paratrooper groups are leading the attack to eliminate defensive positions and delay enemy's counterattacks.
column2: 你的目标是格雷夫森德(Gravesend)这座大城市，以及位于伦敦(London)郊外的达特福德(Dartford)与贝克斯泰海德(Bexteyhead)两座小城。伞兵部队正带头进攻，以消灭防御阵地并迟滞敌人的反击。

column1: Your orders are to give support to the 16th army controlling the cities to the outskirts of London, so that the 16th can keep moving to the North.
column2: 你的命令是支援第16集团军控制伦敦(London)郊外的各城市，以便第16集团军能继续向北推进。
格雷夫森德-朴茨茅斯路线

column1: Our Aufklaerers have spotted the Big Ben!!, we have reached the London suburbs Herr General!. The last regular British forces are enclosed into the big city, we have offered the British the capitulation, but they have refused it!, this people are amazing me. This, will surely be a bloodbath, but they have decided the bad way.
column2: 我们的侦察兵已看到大本钟(Big Ben)！！我们已经到达伦敦(London)郊区，将军阁下！英国最后一支正规部队被围在这座大城市里，我们已向英国人提出投降要求，但他们拒绝了！这些人真让我惊讶。这必定会是一场血腥屠杀，但他们选择了糟糕的那条路。

column1: Troops from the disembark zone in Lyme Regis will join you to start the attack over the capital. Good Luck.
column2: 来自莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)登陆地域的部队将与你会合，共同发起对首都的进攻。祝你好运。

column1: Communism is no longer a threat for Western Europe thanks to you Commander.
column2: 多亏了你，指挥官，共产主义对西欧(Western Europe)不再是威胁。

column1: We have avoided each country of Western Europe to become a puppet state vassal to U.S.S.R.
column2: 我们避免了西欧(Western Europe)每一个国家沦为苏联(U.S.S.R.)的傀儡附庸国。

column1: This victory brought huge geopolitical changes in Europe.
column2: 这场胜利给欧洲(Europe)带来了巨大的地缘政治变化。

column1: Well, the promised hour has come, thirteen division surround London. Since the Roman Empire times, no one has reached this point, the direct order to attack London is out, and you are the one in charge.
column2: 好了，预定的时刻已经到来，十三个师包围了伦敦(London)。自罗马帝国(Roman Empire)时代以来，从未有人到达过这一步，直接进攻伦敦的命令已经下达，而由你全权负责。

column1: Most of the London's defenses are out because they died in the Gravesend counterattack, but remember that a big city can eat huge armies like a wolf. Bring down the enemy's morale by taking his most representative symbols, each second counts! You are dismissed!!! GO!!!
column2: 伦敦(London)的大部分防御已经失效，因为他们在格雷夫森德(Gravesend)反击战中阵亡了，但要记住，一座大城市能像狼一样吞噬庞大的军队。夺取敌人最具代表性的象征，以此打垮他们的士气，每一秒都至关重要！你可以走了！！！出发！！！

column1: September 1940, after Great Britain denied to make a peace-treatry, Hitler decided to invade the British islands at once. On 24/09/1940, thirteen German divisions are preparing in France the upcoming battle, waiting the zero hour to cross the Channel while they know that the operations must be carried out perfectly in order to get the slightest chance of success. Due to the Royal Navy superiority you won't have another chance.
column2: 1940年9月，在大不列颠(Great Britain)拒绝缔结和约之后，希特勒决定立即入侵不列颠诸岛。1940年9月24日，十三个德国师正在法国(France)为即将到来的战斗做准备，等待跨越海峡的零时；他们知道，为了获得哪怕最微小的成功机会，这次作战也必须执行得完美无缺。由于皇家海军占据优势，你不会再有第二次机会。

column1: Well you stopped most of Ivan's forces, but some did make it to the
column2: 嗯，你挡住了伊万(Ivan)的大部分部队，但有些还是逃进了

column1: I'll keep them bottled up, you head West
column2: 我会把他们封死在里面，你向西推进

column1: Four long days has passed since the first wave. Our troops at Dover are constantly attacked by the British counterattacks. This is a very important moment, our troops in the north had more lucky and can advance more easily. The situation in the channel is the following: our ships came back, we are going to lauch the second attack with more heavy equipment so that we could disembark at Dover Port. Our miners had placed submarines mines in the channel, our bombers in Norway weren't successful.
column2: 自第一波登陆以来，漫长的四天已经过去。我们在多佛(Dover)的部队不断遭到英军反击。这是非常重要的时刻，我们在北面的部队运气更好，推进更为容易。海峡中的局势如下：我们的舰船已经返回，我们将以更多重型装备发起第二次进攻，以便能在多佛港登陆。我们的布雷部队已在海峡布设潜艇水雷，我们在挪威(Norway)的轰炸机却没有成功。

column1: Your mission won't be easy of course, you have to resist until our second attack wave arrive in Dover and you have to avoid British fleet to close the open line, no matter the cost.
column2: 你的任务当然不会轻松，你必须坚持到我们的第二波进攻抵达多佛(Dover)，还必须不惜一切代价阻止英国舰队封闭这条畅通的航线。

column2: 只有他们深切的复仇欲望，以及粉碎德国政治领导层的意志，驱使苏军各集团军向前推进。

column1: Welcome to the Far East General.
column2: 欢迎来到远东(Far East)，将军。

column1: I hope your boys had a nice rest on the voyage.
column2: 我希望你的小伙子们在航行途中好好休息了。

column1: We've got to do something to breakup the Soviet - Japanese entente.
column2: 我们得想办法拆散苏日(Soviet - Japanese)之间的协约。

column2: 情报显示萨哈林岛(Sakhalin Island)的防御薄弱。

column2: 如果我们能拿下它，就可以把它用作后续作战的基地。

column1: Comrade General, here we have the Gauleiter's daughter, if you would like to do it first... The Gauleiter is hanging on the apple-tree in his orchard - boys from NKVD regret they couldn't interrogate him... Oh, there was a phone from Moscow that you were awarded with Order of Suvorov...
column2: 将军同志，地方长官(Gauleiter)的女儿就在这里，如果你想先来的话……那位地方长官正吊在他果园的苹果树上——内务人民委员部(NKVD)的小伙子们很遗憾没能审讯他……哦，莫斯科(Moscow)来了电话，你被授予苏沃洛夫勋章(Order of Suvorov)……
