column1: The Germans attempt to push through the Australian and New Zealand lines on the way to Athens, Greece.
column2: 德军试图在通往希腊雅典的路上突破澳大利亚和新西兰军队的防线。

column1: Commander, you have delayed the enemy long enough to allow our evacuation at Dunkirk. We cannot afford to keep taking such losses. We expect much more from you.
column2: 指挥官，你拖延敌人的时间已足以让我们在敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)完成撤离。我们承受不起继续遭受这样的损失。我们对你的期望要高得多。

column1: Commander, once again the Americans need our help. The Germans have launched a major counterattack in the Ardennes region. The Americans have been forced to retreat. You will take command of all allied forces in the region and drive the Germans back.
column2: 指挥官，美国人又一次需要我们的帮助。德军已在阿登(Ardennes)地区发起大规模反击。美军被迫撤退。你将指挥该地区所有盟军部队，把德军打回去。

column1: Commander, you did a good job. We can continue our offensive towards the German border.
column2: 指挥官，你干得不错。我们可以继续向德国边界推进攻势。

column1: Good job, Commander. Your success has allowed British troops to pour into southern Italy.  And, as we surmised, Italy may be on the verge of surrendering.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你的胜利让英军得以涌入意大利(Italy)南部。而且正如我们所推测的，意大利可能即将投降。

column1: The offensive has not gone as well as we hoped. In your sector, at least, you have not even managed to control the passes!
column2: 攻势的进展不如我们希望的那样顺利。至少在你这一段，你连各山口都没能控制住！

column1: If it was not for the Americans you would have failed completely, this is not a performance we expected of you - unfortunately I will have to remove you from your command.
column2: 要不是有美国人，你早就彻底失败了；这不是我们期望你有的表现——很遗憾，我不得不解除你的指挥权。

column1: The war effort has come to a critical junction, Commander.  Now that British and Commonwealth troops have landed on the beaches of Normandy, we must surge ahead.  The big push will come at St. Lo, where Jerry is well entrenched.  You must force him back and drive through his lines.  If you cannot achieve some level of success quickly,  the Germans could well give us a hard time in this hedgerow country forever!  Press on.
column2: 战事已到了一个关键的转折点，指挥官。既然英国与英联邦(Commonwealth)部队已在诺曼底(Normandy)各海滩登陆，我们必须乘势猛进。主攻将在圣洛(St. Lo)发起，德国佬在那里构筑了坚固工事。你必须把他逼退，并打穿他的防线。如果你不能迅速取得一定程度的成功，德国人很可能在这片树篱地区永远让我们吃尽苦头！继续推进。

column1: Splendid job, Commander. Quite splendid.  Due to your, if I do say so myself, splendid performance at St. Lo, our forces will have the impetus they require to break out of Normandy and liberate France.  But now your services are needed at Caen, where Monty is having a spot of bother with Jerry.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。相当漂亮。多亏你——恕我直言——在圣洛(St. Lo)的出色表现，我军将获得冲出诺曼底(Normandy)、解放法国(France)所需的冲劲。但现在卡昂(Caen)需要你，蒙蒂(Monty)在那里和德国佬有点小麻烦。

column1: Back from your mission, Commander?  Good. I must say, you were rather long about it.  At least, you took your objectives, I'll grant you that.  But now, your presence is needed at Caen, where the Germans are delaying our advance.  Hopefully,  you will improve your performance.
column2: 任务回来了，指挥官？好。我得说，你花的时间相当长。至少你拿下了目标，这一点我承认。但现在卡昂(Caen)需要你，德国人正在那里迟滞我们的推进。希望你能改进你的表现。

column1: Well, Commander, you are to be given not only a promotion, but also an audience with the Duke of Penzance. It is very important to portray a picture of  success and, thanks to your failure, this will be extremely difficult.  Good day, Commander.  We will not meet again.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，你将得到的不仅是一次晋升，还有一次觐见彭赞斯公爵(Duke of Penzance)的机会。塑造一幅成功的图景非常重要，而多亏你的失败，这将极其困难。再见，指挥官。我们不会再见面了。

column1: Well, Commander, our invasion of Normandy has bogged down near Caen.  Do you know Caen was home to William the Conqueror, 1066 and all that?   At any rate, Commonwealth forces must drive through Caen and press on into France.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，我们对诺曼底(Normandy)的入侵在卡昂(Caen)附近陷于停滞。你知道卡昂是征服者威廉(William the Conqueror)的家乡吗，就是1066年那一套？无论如何，英联邦(Commonwealth)部队必须打穿卡昂，继续深入法国(France)。

column1: Caen proved to be a sticky wicket, indeed, but you brought us off the pitch with no trouble at all.  It was a difficult area for our brave men to break through, but you did it!  By jove, you did it. Good work!  Now, our lads are on their way to liberate all of France.
column2: 卡昂(Caen)确实是个难打的场地，但你毫无困难地把我们带下了场。那对我们勇敢的士兵来说是一块难以突破的地域，但你做到了！老天，你做到了。干得好！现在，我们的小伙子们正在去解放整个法国(France)的路上。

column1: Well,  you had a spot of trouble while capturing Caen.  Nevertheless, British pluck won out in the end. However, the battle of Caen will soon be forgotten as other more glorious victories are won.  Onward, Commander.
column2: 嗯，你在夺取卡昂(Caen)时遇到了点麻烦。尽管如此，英国人的胆气最终还是占了上风。不过，随着其他更光荣的胜利到来，卡昂之战很快就会被遗忘。前进，指挥官。

column1: Well, Commander, I would offer you tea, but after your disappointing performance, it would be difficult to have you in the vicinity without choking on my crumpet.  There's talk at GHQ of your relief.  It seems to be the most positive solution under the circumstances.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，我本想请你喝茶，但在你令人失望的表现之后，要让你待在近旁而不被我的烤面饼噎住，那太难了。总司令部(GHQ)有人在议论撤你的职。在目前情况下，这似乎是最积极的解决办法。

column1: Your mission is to capture the important industrial city of Nancy and secure a springboard for our fall offensive into Germany itself. Without full control of this rail and shipping center, our advance will be impossible.  Commander, please be advised, that directly east of the city, Jerry has armored forces ready to counterattack any offensive against this stronghold.
column2: 你的任务是夺取重要的工业城市南锡(Nancy)，为我们秋季攻入德国本土取得一块跳板。没有对这座铁路与航运中心的完全控制，我们的推进就不可能实现。指挥官，请注意，在该城正东面，德国佬已备好装甲部队，准备反击任何针对这一据点的进攻。

column1: Well, it appears you did manage to take the city, but it seems that, this is all you managed to do.  The enemy has withdrawn and regrouped, and now await us some 20 miles down the road.  Another indifferent performance like this one and the Yanks will be claiming they are winning the war!
column2: 嗯，看来你确实拿下了该城，但似乎你也就只做到了这些。敌人已撤退并重整，如今在沿路约20英里外等着我们。再来一次像这样平庸的表现，美国佬就要声称是他们在打赢这场战争了！

column1: I must say, I do find it hard to believe that you secured a King's commission.  I believe promotion by purchase was banned in the last century. Your name, sir, shall be stricken from your regiment's otherwise honorable rolls.  Your services will no longer be required.
column2: 我得说，我实在难以相信你竟获得了国王的委任状。我相信买官晋职在上个世纪就被禁了。长官，你的名字将从你所在团原本光荣的名册上划掉。我们不再需要你的效劳。

column1: I would invite you to tea Commander, but, there is simply no time.  My apologies.  Here is the situation. The Germans have held the fortress city of Metz for two months against American attacks, and now the Yanks have requested our help.  Our troops must  smash Jerry's resistance, then punch through the Maginot Line. Metz is the site of the German training schools for officers and NCOs, so you can expect a tough fight.  This mission is crucial, Commander.  You must act decisively.
column2: 指挥官，我本想请你喝茶，但实在没有时间。抱歉。情况是这样的。德军已顶住美军的进攻，守住了梅斯(Metz)这座要塞城市两个月，现在美国佬请求我们援助。我们的部队必须粉碎德国佬的抵抗，然后打穿马奇诺(Maginot)防线。梅斯是德军军官与军士训练学校所在地，所以你可以预料到会有一场硬仗。这次任务至关重要，指挥官。你必须果断行动。

column1: Congratulations! Your troops stormed the city in a charge that Henry V would admire!  Your victory at Metz shall stand alongside the great battles of Agincourt and Cressy.  I have heard your name mentioned several times in relation to some promotion or advancement.  Commander, your successful offensive has paved the way to our invasion of the "fatherland."
column2: 恭喜！你的部队以一场亨利五世(Henry V)都会钦佩的冲锋攻下了该城！你在梅斯(Metz)的胜利将与阿让库尔(Agincourt)和克雷西(Cressy)的伟大战役并列。我已多次听到你的名字与某些晋升或提拔联系在一起。指挥官，你成功的攻势为我们入侵「祖国」铺平了道路。

column1: Led by a revamped American military machine that has stopped the Chinese drive at Pusan, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in South Korea, then continue the liberation of all Chinese held foreign territories.
column2: 在美国(America)重整旗鼓的军事机器的带领下——它在釜山(Pusan)挡住了中国的推进——联合国(United Nations)试图在韩国(South Korea)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)，随后继续解放所有被中国占据的外国领土。

column1: That performance makes m e think you're auditioning for a command in
column2: 那样的表现让我觉得你是在为太平洋(Pacific)战区

column1: The Poles are happy to be out from under Ivan's boot.
column2: 波兰人很高兴摆脱了伊万(Ivan)的靴子。

column1: Well, what can I say?  You did manage to secure your objectives as well as capture a few Jerries.  A comparatively successful performance, and the war has been won.
column2: 嗯，我还能说什么呢？你确实确保了目标，还俘虏了几个德国佬。一次相对成功的表现，而且战争已经打赢了。

column1: Commander, good to see you.  Smoke? Here you are.  Well, let's get down to business.  American and British troops are to land at Salerno and begin a Second Front against the Germans and knock Italy out of the war.  Once you're ashore, you'll need to get your men off those beaches  pronto.  By the way, you should be aware that the Krauts have got a panzer division somewhere in the area.  Good luck, Commander.
column2: 指挥官，很高兴见到你。抽烟吗？给你。好，我们谈正事。美英军队将在萨莱诺(Salerno)登陆，开辟对德军的第二战场，并使意大利(Italy)退出战争。一旦上岸，你就得让你的部下赶快离开那些海滩。顺便说一句，你应当知道德国佬在该地区某处有一个装甲师。祝你好运，指挥官。
萨尔莱圣维特机场(Sart lez St Vith Airport)

column1: Not bad, Commander, but we're going to have to do better in the next one, or it's going to be a long war.
column2: 不错，指挥官，但下一次我们必须做得更好，否则这场战争就要拖得很久了。

column1: Commander, fruitcake? Just got it from the wife. Well, as you know, we've got a critical situation on our hands.  Our troops, along with the Brits, have blasted into Normandy.  Now, we've got to drive inland.  You and your men have got to smash through the Kraut lines and take St. Lo as fast as you can.  If you don't get things moving, the Krauts'll keep us pinned down here forever.
column2: 指挥官，来点水果蛋糕？刚从妻子那里收到的。嗯，如你所知，我们手上有个危急的局面。我们的部队连同英国人已突入诺曼底(Normandy)。现在，我们必须向内陆推进。你和你的部下必须打穿德国佬的防线，以最快速度夺取圣洛(St. Lo)。如果你不把事情推动起来，德国佬就会把我们永远钉死在这里。

column1: Well it appears G2 was right,
column2: 看来 G2 说得没错，

column1: Zhukov has come east to try and stop you.
column2: 朱可夫(Zhukov)已东来，想要挡住你。

column1: He's set up quite a nice welcome at Irkutsk.
column2: 他在伊尔库茨克(Irkutsk)设下了相当不错的欢迎仪式。

column1: He loves his defensive works so expect to see a lot of them.
column2: 他钟爱防御工事，所以要准备看到大量的工事。

column1: Most of your forces will be lifted across Lake Baikal using local
column2: 你的大部分部队将利用当地的
船只被运送过贝加尔湖(Lake Baikal)。

column1: I don't know a diplomatic way to say this, Commander.  You've been canned.  Oh, you'll get a medal and they'll probably call you a hero.  But, you know the truth, and you've got to live with it.
column2: 我不知道该怎么委婉地说，指挥官。你被解职了。哦，你会得到一枚勋章，他们大概还会称你为英雄。但你知道真相，而且你得带着它活下去。

column1: Commander, this is going to be a tough one.  Our British friends are having a hard time in Caen. We're gonna have to bail them out and you're the man to do it.  Try not to step on their toes, the Brits think they're the only ones fighting this war.  Just capture Caen and get us back on track.
column2: 指挥官，这一仗会很艰难。我们的英国朋友在卡昂(Caen)处境艰难。我们得去解救他们，而你是做这件事的不二人选。尽量别冒犯他们，英国人自以为只有他们在打这场战争。拿下卡昂，让我们回到正轨。

column1: Good job, Commander.  We dropped you into a real mess, but you came out smelling like a rose.  The fighting was tough, but your boys hung in there.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。我们把你投进了一个烂摊子，你却出淤泥而不染。战斗很艰苦，但你的小伙子们咬牙顶住了。

column1: All right, this is the way it is.  You and your boys must capture the city of Nancy and it's gonna be a tough nut to crack.  And, what's more, the Krauts have armor here to the east of the city ready and waiting to counter-attack.  Good luck.
column2: 好吧，情况就是这样。你和你的小伙子们必须夺取南锡(Nancy)城，这可是一块难啃的硬骨头。而且，德国佬在该城以东已备好装甲部队，严阵以待准备反击。祝你好运。

column1: All right, Commander, a job well done!  The Krauts never knew what hit them.  Well, we're really looking good, thanks to you.  By the way, rumor has it that Ike speaks highly of you.
column2: 好吧，指挥官，干得漂亮！德国佬根本没弄清是什么击中了他们。嗯，多亏了你，我们的形势看起来真不错。顺便说一句，有传言说艾克(Ike)对你评价很高。

column1: Well, you did your best and you will be given another chance to prove yourself.  Good luck, Commander.
column2: 嗯，你已尽了最大努力，你会再得到一次证明自己的机会。祝你好运，指挥官。

column1: Well done General, you prevented a breakthrough
column2: 干得好，将军，你阻止了一次突破

column1: Unfortunately, Ivan's had better success in the North.
column2: 不幸的是，伊万(Ivan)在北面取得了更大的成功。

column1: Look Commander, Metz was a tough nut to crack, and you did it.  But, there's a lot of talk at HQ about you right now.  The brass seems to think you could have moved a lot faster than you did.   Don't worry, we'll get them next time.
column2: 听着，指挥官，梅斯(Metz)是块难啃的硬骨头，而你啃下来了。但是现在司令部里有很多关于你的议论。上头似乎认为你本可以推进得快得多。别担心，下次我们会收拾他们。

column1: You did it Commander.  We got what we came for. You've done a fine job for us.  You've done your country proud.  Here, have a cigar!  See you stateside.
column2: 你做到了，指挥官。我们得到了想要的东西。你为我们干得很出色。你为你的国家争了光。来，抽支雪茄！回国见。

column1: You were fortunate to have escaped capture after the fiasco you perpetrated in North Africa.  However, your previous performance merits another opportunity.  Do not fail us again.
column2: 你在北非(North Africa)闯下那场大祸之后能逃脱被俘，算是运气。不过，你以往的表现值得再给你一次机会。不要再让我们失望。

column1: The Germans drive on the road towards Moscow.
column2: 德军沿公路向莫斯科推进。

column1: Comrade Komdiv, today at dawn the Southwestern Front under the command of Marshal Timoshenko, executing Stalin's order, are to start an offensive on the Ukraine. Your task is to liberate Kharkov. Remember, that the workers' class won't forgive you failure. For the support of your attack, you will be given some NKVD special battalions.
column2: 师长同志(Komdiv)，今日拂晓，由铁木辛哥(Timoshenko)元帅指挥的西南方面军将执行斯大林的命令，在乌克兰(Ukraine)发起攻势。你的任务是解放哈尔科夫(Kharkov)。记住，工人阶级不会宽恕你的失败。为支援你的进攻，将拨给你若干内务人民委员部(NKVD)特种营。

column1: You have defeated the Afrika Korps and thousands of Italians have surrendered.  But now, a crisis of the utmost urgency has arisen. The Axis has launched an invasion of Iceland. Only you can save the Island from defeat. If Iceland falls the sealanes from North America will be imperiled. The fate of our nation is in your hands!
column2: 你已击败非洲军，数千意大利人已经投降。但现在出现了一场极其紧迫的危机。轴心国已发起对冰岛(Iceland)的入侵。只有你能拯救该岛免于失败。如果冰岛陷落，来自北美(North America)的海上航线将受到威胁。我们国家的命运掌握在你手中！

column1: You take command from Narvik to war's end.
column2: 你从纳尔维克(Narvik)一路指挥到战争结束。

column1: This Campaign is for experts only. If you can even survive the last two missions you deserve a Victoria Cross!
column2: 本战役仅供行家。如果你连最后两个任务都能活下来，你就该获得维多利亚十字勋章(Victoria Cross)！

column1: Hint: After "Falaise" the campaign is separated into two different paths you can chose the way to the Ruhr or to Berchtesgaden.
column2: 提示：在「法莱斯(Falaise)」之后，战役分成两条不同路线，你可以选择通往鲁尔(Ruhr)或贝希特斯加登(Berchtesgaden)的那一条。

column1: Commander, Winston Churchill has decided that we must confront the Germans.  You have been chosen to lead an amphibious attack on the Norwegian port of Narvik.  German forces are already occupying the town and are supported by naval units.  A victory here will prove the Germans are not invincible. Good Luck!
column2: 指挥官，温斯顿·丘吉尔(Winston Churchill)已决定我们必须与德国人正面交锋。你已被选中领导一次对挪威(Norwegian)港口纳尔维克(Narvik)的两栖进攻。德军已占领该镇，并有海军部队支援。在此取胜将证明德国人并非不可战胜。祝你好运！

column1: Comrade General, our troops continue pursuit after Germans. Now you have to cross the Dnieper before they establish stronger positions. For Comrade Stalin liberation of Ukraine is crucial.
column2: 将军同志，我军正在继续追击德军。现在你必须在他们建立更坚固的阵地之前渡过第聂伯河(Dnieper)。对斯大林同志来说，解放乌克兰(Ukraine)至关重要。

column2: 将军同志，你的坦克集团军必须尽快渡过维斯瓦河(Vistula)，并在其西岸建立桥头堡。我们预计德军会有非常顽强的抵抗。
为了自由！！！(Za Swabodu - For the Freedom) (ZS#14)，1945 年 6 月 1 日

column1: Comrade Marshal, we've beaten these Nazi pigs, but their capitalistic allies still endanger our Motherland and tyrannize the Europe's working class! We still must fight for their liberation!
column2: 元帅同志，我们打败了这些纳粹猪猡，但他们的资本主义盟友仍在威胁我们的祖国，仍在奴役欧洲的工人阶级！我们仍必须为解放他们而战！

column1: Comrade Stalin has ordered you to destroy with sudden assault the forces of capitalist-fascist US' regime in middle Germany - then you'll liberate the Rühr and march towards Paris!
column2: 斯大林同志命令你以突袭歼灭德国中部资本主义法西斯美国政权的部队——之后你将解放鲁尔(Rühr)，并向巴黎(Paris)进军！

column1: Comrade General, your Tank Army is temporarily commanded to the Baltic Front. With a sudden strike we should capture East Prussia and thus leave the Germans with no possibility of counterattacking our troops on the Vistula's western bank. Tell your soldiers they have the honour of bringing the war into the German territory - you have to rape, burn, murder and plunder. Let these fascist scums feel the war!!!
column2: 将军同志，你的坦克集团军暂归波罗的海沿岸方面军(Baltic Front)指挥。我们应以突袭击夺取东普鲁士，从而使德军再无法反击维斯瓦河(Vistula)西岸的我军。告诉你的士兵，他们有幸把战争带入德国领土——你们必须强奸、烧杀、劫掠。让这些法西斯渣滓尝尝战争的滋味！！！

column1: Comrade General, your Tank Army will strike from the Baranow Bridgehead towards Central Poland and then towards Berlin! You have to destroy Heeresgruppe "Weichsel", they can't stop us now!!!
column2: 将军同志，你的坦克集团军将从巴拉努夫桥头堡(Baranow Bridgehead)向波兰中部出击，然后直指柏林！你必须消灭「维斯瓦」集团军群(Heeresgruppe "Weichsel")，他们现在挡不住我们了！！！

column2: 为了自由！！！-为了人民的自由与解放！

column1: Comrade General, after ferocious fighting during autumn and winter now we have the chance to strike the decisive blow and liberate the whole Ukraine from German occupation. You attack on German flank with task of encirclementing and destruction 4th Panzer Armee.
column2: 将军同志，经过秋冬两季的恶战，现在我们有机会打出决定性的一击，把整个乌克兰(Ukraine)从德国占领下解放出来。你将从德军侧翼进攻，任务是合围并歼灭第4装甲集团军(4th Panzer Armee)。

column1: Comrade Komdiv, today at dawn our troops under the command of Zhukov, executing comrade Stalin's order, will attack 3rd Rumanian Army. You are to cut off the German 6th Army in Stalingrad. If you do it well, you'll be promoted.
column2: 师长同志(Komdiv)，今天拂晓，由朱可夫(Zhukov)指挥的我军将执行斯大林同志的命令，进攻罗马尼亚第3集团军(3rd Rumanian Army)。你要切断斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的德国第6集团军。如果你干得好，就会得到晋升。

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a wonderful victory !!! Your success has restored your good standing with the General Staff !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了辉煌的胜利！！！你的成功恢复了你总参谋部对你的好评！！！

column1: Herr General : The General Staff is displeased with your luckluster victory !!! Your will need to do better to restore your good standing with the General Staff !!!
column2: 将军阁下：总参谋部对你这场平淡无奇的胜利不满！！！你需要做得更好，才能恢复总参谋部对你的好评！！！

column1: Strock: Your great victory Herr General has reduced the threat to Sicily and improved Italy's moral !!!
column2: 施特罗克：将军阁下，你的重大胜利减轻了对西西里(Sicily)的威胁，也提升了意大利的士气！！！

column1: Herr General your complete victory has restored the front and the confidence of our allies !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你的完全胜利恢复了战线，也恢复了我们盟友的信心！！！

column1: Herr General You rescued and flew Mussolini to safety against tremedous odds !!! Well done job !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你顶着极大困难把墨索里尼(Mussolini)救出并送到安全处！！！干得漂亮！！！

column1: Herr General you rejected the Russian attack. Crimea is safe to the Reich !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你打退了俄军的进攻。克里米亚(Crimea)对帝国来说安全了！！！

column1: Herr General congratulations in your victory. You have saved us valuable time. It will be years before Italy is invaded again.  Your services are needed in Russia.
column2: 将军阁下，祝贺你的胜利。你为我们赢得了宝贵的时间。意大利再次被入侵将是多年之后的事。俄国需要你的效力。

column1: Herr General You have achieved a complete victory !!! The loyalty of our Italian allies is secured !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你取得了完全的胜利！！！我们意大利盟友的忠诚得到了确保！！！

column1: Good work!, the enemy has been defeated, we have captured a big number of prisoners and the enemy resistance will end soon.
column2: 干得好！敌人已被击败，我们俘获了大量战俘，敌人的抵抗很快就会结束。

column1: Herr General: You achieved a complete victory !!!. You not only prevented the Russians from crossing the river, you also destroyed their beachheads !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了完全的胜利！！！你不仅阻止了俄军渡河，还摧毁了他们的桥头堡！！！

column1: Herr General: Your great victory here has secured the Central Italian front. Our lines are now impregnable !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你在此地的重大胜利确保了意大利中部战线。我们的防线现已固若金汤！！！

column1: Due to your despicable action you cannot continue in charge because your army has been isolated and captured by the enemy.
column2: 由于你可耻的行径，你无法继续指挥，因为你的集团军已被敌人孤立并俘获。

column1: Herr General your victory is complete !!! The threat to our Italian front has been eliminated !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你的胜利是彻底的！！！我们对意大利战线的威胁已被消除！！！

column1: Herr General, you destroy everything in your path.  It is a tremendous victory !!! Unfortunately the allies broke free elsewhere.
column2: 将军阁下，你一路摧枯拉朽。这是一场巨大的胜利！！！遗憾的是盟军在其他地方突围了。

column1: Herr General: You achieved victory under extremely difficult conditions. Most of the men of the 17th Army will fight again !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你在极其困难的条件下取得了胜利。第17集团军的多数官兵还能再战！！！

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a wonderful victory many of the 17th Army men will fight again !!! Your success has restored your good standing with the General Staff !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了辉煌的胜利，第17集团军的许多官兵还能再战！！！你的成功恢复了你总参谋部对你的好评！！！

column1: Herr General your wonderful victory has steadied Romanian will to resist the red hordes !!!
column2: 将军阁下，你的辉煌胜利稳固了罗马尼亚人抵抗红色蛮潮的意志！！！

column1: Wonderful victory  Herr General !!! Finland has decided to continue fighting along us !!!
column2: 辉煌的胜利，将军阁下！！！芬兰决定继续与我们并肩作战！！！

column1: Herr General : You have achieved a complete victory !!! The western allies are in disarray !!!
column2: 将军阁下：你取得了完全的胜利！！！西方盟军一片混乱！！！

column1: Herr General your victory has contained the Allies. !!! Unfortunately they have broken our lines in the South.
column2: 将军阁下，你的胜利牵制住了盟军。！！！遗憾的是他们已在南面突破了我军防线。

column1: Herr Feld-Marschall. Your victory has stopped the western allies advance on the Fatherland !!!
column2: 元帅阁下。你的胜利阻止了西方盟军向本土推进！！！

column1: Due to everyone's success in this campaign, the Poles have now become receptive of our terms. Well done, Herr General!
column2: 由于大家在此次战役中的成功，波兰人现在已愿意接受我们的条件。干得漂亮，将军阁下！

column1: Well done Herr General.!!! You have relieved Budapest and thrown the Russians to the other bank of the Danube.!!!
column2: 干得漂亮，将军阁下。！！！你解了布达佩斯(Budapest)之围，把俄国人赶到了多瑙河(Danube)对岸。！！！

column1: Take the city of Antwerp and advance South West. There is no time for sightseeing, this is Blitzkrieg warfare! Opposite you are the remnants of the Belgian Army and the retreating French 7th Army that was rushing into The Netherlands only a few days ago. column1: The SS-Division "Reich" and parts of the 10th Panzer Division were approaching the Borodino battlefield 100 km west of Moscow. Between them and the Russian Capital stood the reinforced 32nd Siberian Rifle Division, just arrived by train to man the partly completed Mozhaisk Defense Line. After five days of brutal fighting, the SS finally got through, but fresh units filled in behind the survivors.
column2: 党卫军「帝国」师和第10装甲师一部正逼近莫斯科以西100公里的博罗季诺战场。在他们与俄国首都之间，横着得到加强的第32西伯利亚步兵师——该师刚乘火车赶到，以守御尚未完工的莫扎伊斯克防线。经过五天残酷战斗，党卫军终于突破，但新鲜部队又填补到幸存者的背后。

column1: Lines have stabilized after your retreat from Normandy. Hitler has gathered all available forces for a counterattack. Your division and the 9thSS Hohenstaufen form the 2SS Pz Corps. The original plan called for you to exploit the initial success of the 1SS Pz Corps attack on the northern shoulder of our attack through the Ardennes. The enemy however has stalled the LSSAH's attack. The goal of advancing as far west as Antwerp and cutting the Allied forces in half has been given up.
column2: 你们从诺曼底(Normandy)撤退后，战线已趋稳定。希特勒已集结所有可用兵力发动反击。你的师与党卫军第9「霍恩施陶芬」师(9thSS Hohenstaufen)编成党卫军第2装甲军(2SS Pz Corps)。原计划要求你利用党卫军第1装甲军(1SS Pz Corps)经阿登(Ardennes)进攻我方攻势北肩所取得的初步战果。然而敌人已迟滞了警卫旗队(LSSAH)的进攻。向西推进至安特卫普(Antwerp)、把盟军拦腰切断的目标已被放弃。

column1: Your troops have been transferred from 6SSPz Armee to the 5PzArmee and have swung south around LSSAH. Your task is to capture the crossroads at Baraque Fraiture, push through the US lines of defense and capture Liege. Maybe that will move the Allies to start peace negotiations.
column2: 你的部队已从党卫军第6装甲集团军(6SSPz Armee)转隶第5装甲集团军(5PzArmee)，并绕过警卫旗队(LSSAH)向南迂回。你的任务是夺取巴拉屈弗拉蒂尔(Baraque Fraiture)的路口，突破美军防线，攻取列日(Liege)。也许这会使盟军开始和平谈判。

斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)-强渡第聂伯河(Dniepr) - 1941 年 7 月 7 日

column1: Your Das Reich division is part of Guderian's 2nd Panzer Gruppe. Your troops have covered more than 700km in a bit over 2 weeks since Operation Barbarossa started but have not seen much action yet.
column2: 你的「帝国」师隶属古德里安的第2装甲集群。自「巴巴罗萨」行动开始以来，你的部队在两周多一点的时间里已推进700多公里，但尚未经历多少战斗。

column1: Guderian has decided to not wait for the infantry divisions and to cross the Dniepr with only his mobile troops because General Hoth's 3rd Panzer Gruppe has already done the same to the north of us. Both Gruppen could meet at Smolensk thereby trapping more Russians in a new pocket. 10Pz Division will cross the Dniepr North of Mogilev with your division and the GrossDeutschland Infantry Regiment covering the flanks. The first goals are Kopyr and Gorki.
column2: 古德里安(Guderian)决定不等步兵师，只带他的机动部队渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)，因为霍特(Hoth)将军的第3装甲集群已在我们北面这样做了。两个集群可以在斯摩棱斯克(Smolensk)会合，从而在新的包围圈中困住更多俄国人。第10装甲师(10Pz Division)将与你的师一起在莫吉廖夫(Mogilev)以北渡河，由大德意志步兵团(GrossDeutschland Infantry Regiment)掩护两翼。首要目标是科佩尔(Kopyr)与戈尔基(Gorki)。

column1: SS-V Division, Leibstandarte and Totenkopf have been moved south of Dunkirk to close the gaps between the Panzer divisions encircling the Belgian army, the B.E.F. and numerous French divisions.
column2: 党卫军第5师、警卫旗队和「骷髅」师已被调往敦刻尔克以南，以封闭包围比利时军队、英国远征军和大批法国师的各装甲师之间的空隙。

column1: Your mission: Break through the British lines and force the B.E.F. to surrender. Beware of British counterattacks. Their armoured brigade has already brought Rommel's 7thPz division and the Totenkopf into problems a few days ago near Arras.

column1: On December 30th a Fuehrer order directed Totenkopf, Leibstandarte and Das Reich - the SS Panzer Corps - to return to Russia to strengthen Army Group South. Our trains were given absolute priority over all other railway traffic. As soon as they arrived on the front, our troops were used to try and stop the Bolsjevik advance. Thanks to our commander Hausser our troops could retreat out of Kharkov - against Fuehrer orders - and avoid certain destruction. This decision saved our SS Panzer Corps as a unit and allowed us to open the counterattack in N/E direction towards Kharkov.
column2: 12月30日，一道元首令命「骷髅」、「警卫旗队」和「帝国」各师——即党卫军装甲军——返回俄国，增援南方集团军群。我们的列车获得了高于所有其他铁路运输的绝对优先权。一到前线，我军就被投入阻止布尔什维克推进。多亏我们的指挥官豪塞尔，我军得以违抗元首令撤出哈尔科夫，避免了必定的覆灭。这一决定保全了党卫军装甲军作为一个建制单位，并使我们得以向哈尔科夫方向发起东北向的反击。

column1: STAVKA is apparantly under the impression their troops are still advancing and has marched 3rd Tank Army - a mighty force of 3 Inf divisions, 3 Tank brigades and a Guard Cav Corps in a gap which had openend between our division and the Leibstandarte. Your task is to trap these formations and capture Kharkov.
column2: 苏联最高统帅部显然还以为他们的部队仍在推进，竟把第3坦克集团军——一支由3个步兵师、3个坦克旅和一个近卫骑兵军组成的强大兵力——开进了我们师与警卫旗队之间出现的缺口。你的任务是围住这些部队并夺取哈尔科夫。

基辅(Kiev)合围 - 科诺托普(Konotop) - 1941 年 9 月 4 日

column1: After 19 days of indecisiveness - known as the 19 day interregnum, Hitler has decided you and the rest of Guderian's 2nd Pz Gruppe need turn South to assist Von Rundstedt's less successful Armee Gruppe Sud in the encirclement of Kiev - Ukraine - 350 km South of here. You are to make contact with von Kleist's 1 Pz Gruppe South of Konotop to complete the encirclement. The capture of Moscow will have to wait. Opposing your forces is the newly created Russian 40th Army assisted by the 2nd Air-landing Corps and the 10th Tank Division.
column2: 经过 19 天的犹豫不决——史称 19 天权力空窗期——希特勒决定让你和古德里安(Guderian)第2装甲集群的其余部队转向南面，协助冯·伦德施泰特(Von Rundstedt)不太顺利的南方集团军群(Armee Gruppe Sud)合围基辅(Kiev)——乌克兰(Ukraine)——在此地以南 350 公里。你要在科诺托普(Konotop)以南与冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)的第1装甲集群会合，完成合围。攻取莫斯科(Moscow)只能往后推了。与你对抗的是新组建的俄国第40集团军，配属有第2空降军与第10坦克师。

column1: The Konotop scenario and the map on which it is played are created by Hannes Gruber. One slight modification was made: deployment hexes were added.

column1: We urgently need to regain the offensive on the Eastern front to deal the Red Army a blow that will weaken its offensive potential for a very long time to come. That will allow us to concentrate on the probable invasion by the Western Allies of either Southern Europe or France.
column2: 我们迫切需要在东线重新夺回主动权，给红军一记重击，使其进攻潜力在很长一段时间内难以恢复。这样我们才能集中精力应对西方盟国很可能对南欧或法国发动的入侵。

column1: The location for our summer offensive is clear: the great salient around Kursk. Success here will shorten the front by 500km and create a reserve that can be used in the West. Model's 9th Army will strike from the North and Hoth's 4th Pz Army will attack from the South. The SS Corps is part of Hoth's Army.
column2: 我们夏季攻势的地点很明确：库尔斯克周围的大突出部。在此取胜将使战线缩短500公里，并腾出一支可用于西线的预备队。莫德尔的第9集团军将从北面出击，霍特的第4装甲集团军将从南面进攻。党卫军装甲军隶属霍特的集团军。

莉拉行动(Operation Lila) - 1942 年 11 月 27 日

column1: After a hard winter in Russia, your division is rested and re-equipped. The division is re-designated as SS Panzer-Grenadier Division Das Reich. As a reaction to the Allied landings in North-Africa, Hitler ordered Operation Anton - the occupation of Vichy France to protect it against the Allies. The French were allowed to hold the port of Toulon, to defend it against an Allied invasion. Now Hitler has changed his mind and wants Operation Lila executed. We are to move into Toulon and capture the Vichy French fleet that Hitler has promised to Mussolini. You will have to move fast because the French are expected to scuttle their fleet, rather than hand it over to us. French GMR and SOL forces are thought to be more favorable to our cause than the rest of the Vichy French troops.
column2: 在俄国经历一个严酷的冬天后，你的师得到休整和重新装备，并改称党卫军装甲掷弹兵「帝国」师。为回应盟军在北非登陆，希特勒下令执行「安东」行动——占领维希法国，以防其落入盟军之手。法国人获准保留土伦港，以抵御盟军入侵。如今希特勒改变了主意，要执行「百合」行动。我们要开进土伦，夺取希特勒许诺给墨索里尼的维希法国舰队。你必须行动迅速，因为预计法国人会凿沉舰队，而不是交给我们。据信，法国的 GMR 和 SOL 部队比维希法国其他部队更倾向于我方。

列日行动(Operation Lüttich) - 1944 年 8 月 7 日

column1: Our new operation to break the Allied offensive by driving to Avranches and destroying their forces has started on time, but with fewer troops than expected. Both the 116 (PzLehr) and the 1SS (LSSAH) have problems reaching the front. The attack has started with the 2Pz in the North and our division reinforced with a KG of the 17SS (Goetz von Berlichingen) in the South. Opposite us is the US 30ID which is putting up a stubborn defense.
column2: 我们为粉碎盟军攻势而发起的新行动——向阿夫朗什突进并歼灭其兵力——已按时开始，但兵力比预期少。第116装甲师（装甲教导）和党卫军第1师（警卫旗队）都难以抵达前线。进攻由北面的第2装甲师和我方在南面、得到党卫军第17师（「格茨·冯·贝利欣根」）一个战斗群加强的师发起。与我们相对的是美军第30步兵师，正在顽强抵抗。
马奇诺防线(Maginot line)守军 - 1940 年 6 月 19 日

column1: The British Expeditionary Force has been evacuated from the mainland at Dunkirk. The best divisions of the French Army have surrendered or are in disarray and on the run. Our Panzers are in pursuit heading South. Your forces are ordered to take part in mopping up the Maginot line - a complex of fortifications along the German-French border. You will attack the fortresses from the rear while 2 infantry divisions of the 7th Armee / Armee Gruppe C get the difficult task of attacking the fortresses head-on. Orders are to capture the command posts of the 2 big fortresses in the area. Das Oberkommando has asked you to prevent French troops from fleeing into Switzerland. Brandenburg Kommandos are on site to recon the area.
column2: 英国远征军已从敦刻尔克撤离大陆。法军最精锐的各师或已投降，或溃不成军、四处奔逃。我们的装甲部队正向南追击。你的部队奉命参加清剿马奇诺防线——德法边境上的一片筑垒体系。你将从后方攻击这些要塞，而第7集团军／C集团军群的两个步兵师则承担正面强攻要塞的艰巨任务。命令是夺取该地区两座大型要塞的指挥所。最高统帅部要求你阻止法军逃入瑞士。勃兰登堡突击队已到场侦察该地区。

玛丽塔行动(Operation Marita) - 1941 年 4 月 9 日

column1: Operation Marita, the plan to capture Greece has been complicated after a coup d'etat in Yugoslavia. This coup has ousted the government we signed a protocol with 2 days earlier - which is 2 weeks ago now - a protocol that brought Yugoslavia in the Tripartite Pact. The new government has canceled the protocol and Hitler thinks they will sooner or later join the Allies. He has ordered our troops to not only invade Greece as planned, but Yugoslavia as well. The task of your troops - your division is renamed SS-Division Das Reich - is to cross the border from Rumania into Yugoslavia and to capture Belgrade. The Heer does not want the Waffen SS to capture Belgrade and has added the GrossDeutschland Regiment to your troops. They have also ordered the 8th Panzer division to move on Belgrade from Hungary and has given similar orders to the 11th Panzer Division stationed in Bulgaria.
column2: 「马里塔」行动——夺取希腊的计划在南斯拉夫发生政变后变得复杂起来。这场政变推翻了我们两天前（其实已是两周前）才与之签署议定书的政府，那份议定书把南斯拉夫拉进了三国同盟。新政府取消了议定书，希特勒认为他们早晚会加入盟国。他下令我军不仅按计划入侵希腊，也要入侵南斯拉夫。你的部队——你的师已改称党卫军「帝国」师——的任务是从罗马尼亚越过边境进入南斯拉夫，夺取贝尔格莱德。陆军不愿让武装党卫军拿下贝尔格莱德，于是把「大德意志」团编入你的部队。他们还下令第8装甲师从匈牙利向贝尔格莱德推进，并对驻保加利亚的第11装甲师下达了类似命令。

column1: We had to break up our 11SS Regiment to bring the Deutschland and Der Fürher regiments up to strength again. Some of our units have started to run out of ammo. But even though the  mud, rain and cold slowed us down, we have come close to the end goal of our offensive: the capture of Moscow. The 10th Pz Division will again be fighting at our left flank. Make us proud General.
column2: 我们不得不拆散党卫军第11团，好把「德意志」团与「元首」团补足建制。我们有些单位已开始弹药不足。但尽管泥泞、雨水与严寒拖慢了我们，我们已接近此次攻势的最终目标：攻取莫斯科(Moscow)。第10装甲师将再次在我方左翼作战。让我们为你骄傲，将军。

column1: The story of 3 SS divisions attacking Prokhorovka with hundreds of Tiger and Panther tanks is a myth and so is the SS divisions loosing +400 tanks in the engagement. The Panther battalions were in Germany and each division had only 1 Tiger company. At the start of  Zitadelle, the 3 divisions of II SS Panzer Corps, totalled no more than about 350 tanks. By the time the battle for Prokhorovka started, the number of operational tanks had dropped to 211. Only 15 were Tigers. After the battle, II SS Panzer Corps reported 163 operational tanks. Russian tank losses were close to 650. Leibstandarte's 13th Tiger company (leader) was commanded by 2nd Lt. Michael Wittmann.
column2: 所谓 3 个党卫军师以数百辆「虎」式与「豹」式坦克进攻普罗霍罗夫卡(Prokhorovka)的故事是个神话，说党卫军各师在此战中损失 400 多辆坦克同样如此。「豹」式营当时还在德国，每个师只有 1 个「虎」式连。在「堡垒」(Zitadelle)行动开始时，党卫军第2装甲军(II SS Panzer Corps)的 3 个师总计不过约 350 辆坦克。到普罗霍罗夫卡之战打响时，可用坦克数量已降到 211 辆。其中只有 15 辆是「虎」式。战斗结束后，党卫军第2装甲军报告有 163 辆可用坦克。俄军坦克损失接近 650 辆。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)的第13「虎」式连（连长）由少尉米夏埃尔·维特曼(Michael Wittmann)指挥。

东普鲁士装甲集群(Panzer-Verbande Ostpreussen) - 1939 年 9 月 1 日

column1: In July 1939, the OKH decided to create a unique unit in preparation for the assault on Poland. This unit was officially designated as Panzer-Verbaende Ostpreussen, better known as Panzer Division Kempf. The division was composed of both Heer and Waffen SS units.
column2: 1939年7月，陆军总司令部决定组建一支独特的部队，为进攻波兰做准备。这支部队被正式命名为「东普鲁士装甲部队」，更广为人知的名字是肯普夫装甲师。该师由陆军和武装党卫军两部分单位编成。

column1: The official explanation for moving the unit into Ostpreussen in July 1939 was that it would participate at the Tannenberg Celebration to commemorate Hindenberg's victory at the Tannenberg in WW1.
column2: 1939年7月把这支部队调往东普鲁士的官方解释是，它将参加坦能堡纪念庆典，以纪念兴登堡在第一次世界大战中坦能堡的胜利。

column1: After negotiations between Germany and Poland broke down, Pz Division Kempf units crossed the border into Poland on August 26th 06h00. At the last minute the order to attack was postponed and it wasn't until 09h00 that all the units had been recalled to their assembly points.
column2: 德波谈判破裂后，肯普夫装甲师的部队于8月26日6时越过边境进入波兰。最后一刻进攻命令被推迟，直到9时所有部队才被召回集结点。

column1: Negotiations to prevent hostilities between Poland and Germany fell through for a final time on August 30th and German units crossed the border a second time on September 1st 04h45.
column2: 8 月 30 日，防止波兰与德国之间爆发敌对行动的谈判最后一次破裂；9 月 1 日 04 时 45 分，德军部队第二次越过边境。

column1: With the Polish problem solved, we are now looking at the West: The Netherlands, Belgium and France.
column2: 波兰问题既已解决，我们如今着眼于西面：荷兰、比利时和法国。

column1: We had to abandon our original plan 'Fall Gelb' after one of our Fallschirmguys lost the plans to the Belgians when his plane crashed. The new Sichelschnitt plan is much more daring, shifting the focus of the attack from The Netherlands and Belgium to the South of Belgium: the supposedly impassable Ardennes. This leaves the forces that need to capture the Netherlands much weaker than originally planned. Generalleutnant Student will land his FliegerKorps XI Fliegerdivision 7 and Luftlandedivision 22 near The Hague, Rotterdam and the bridges at Dordrecht and Moerdijk. Your task is to follow Generalleutnant Schmidt's 9th Panzerdivision through the South of the Netherlands. Once your forces arrive as West as Moerdijk, turn North to the Hague and follow the path cleared by Student's troops.
column2: 由于我们的一名伞兵在飞机坠毁时把计划落到了比利时人手里，我们不得不放弃原定的「黄色方案」。新的「镰刀切割」方案大胆得多，把进攻重心从荷兰和比利时转到比利时南部：据信无法通过的阿登地区。这使得负责攻占荷兰的兵力比原计划削弱了许多。施图登特中将将把他的飞行军——第7航空师和第22空降师——投送到海牙、鹿特丹附近，以及多德雷赫特和莫尔代克两座桥。你的任务是跟随施密特中将的第9装甲师穿越荷兰南部。你的部队一旦抵达最西面的莫尔代克，就转向北方前往海牙，沿着施图登特部队开辟的通道前进。

column2: - 如果你认为自己的兵力足够强大，就继续对莫斯科(Moscow)的攻势。如果不够，就转入防御，守住你的胜利格，并注意场景结束时的增援部队：它们的任务就写在它们的名字里。
台风行动 - 维亚济马(Vyazma) - 1941 年 10 月 2 日

column1: Your division has been transferred from Guderian's 2nd Pz Gruppe - South of us - to Hoepner's 4 Pz Gruppe for the final drive on Moscow. Our first task is to break through the Russian lines, following the 10Pz Div and move North to Vyazma to make contact with Hoth's 3rd Pz Gruppe North of us and encirle the Russian 16th, 19th and 20th Soviet Armies of the Western Front and the 24th and 32th Armies of the Reserve Front. The Russians made the mistake of putting their Reserve front in the first line of battle. Once we break through their lines we should be able to move on Vyazma and Gzatsk without too much resistance. Gzatsk is a city vital for or further drive on Moscow and also vital for the Russian defense of Moscow.
column2: 你的师已从我们以南古德里安的第2装甲集群转隶霍普纳的第4装甲集群，参加向莫斯科的最后推进。我们的首要任务是突破俄军防线，跟随第10装甲师北上维亚济马，与我们以北霍特的第3装甲集群建立联系，并合围西方面军的俄军第16、第19、第20集团军以及预备方面军的第24、第32集团军。俄国人犯了把预备方面军摆在第一线的错误。一旦我们突破其防线，就应能在阻力不大的情况下向维亚济马和格扎茨克推进。格扎茨克是继续向莫斯科推进的关键城市，对俄军防守莫斯科也同样关键。

column1: Now that we crossed the Dniepr and broken the Russian lines, the 10th Pz Division will move on Yelnya while your troops are ordered to capture Roslavl. Yelnya will be the starting point for our final drive on Moscow and Roslavl controls the main roads in this area.
column2: 既然我们已渡过第聂伯河(Dniepr)、突破了俄军防线，第10装甲师将向叶利尼亚(Yelnya)推进，而你的部队受命夺取罗斯拉夫尔(Roslavl)。叶利尼亚将是我们最后向莫斯科(Moscow)推进的起点，罗斯拉夫尔则控制着这一地区的主要道路。

column1: After crossing the Ardenne Forest, your task is to strike the enemy at Sedan, where the Frenchs don't expect an attack. Drive your Panzer divisions to cross the Meuse River, and clear this sector, from Sedan to Rethel. Although we surely will surprise the Frenchs, they will sent at least one Army Corps as reinforcements. Exploit at the maximun the Blitzkrieg here, and show what we are capable of.
column2: 穿过阿登森林(Ardenne Forest)之后，你的任务是在色当(Sedan)打击敌人，法国人没料到那里会遭到进攻。率领你的装甲师渡过默兹河(Meuse)，并肃清从色当到勒泰勒(Rethel)的这段地区。虽然我们肯定能打法国人一个措手不及，但他们至少会派一个军作为增援。在这里把闪击战发挥到极致，让他们看看我们的本事。

column2: 我应当提醒你，由于穿越阿登森林的部队数量太多，一些装甲部队还堵在路上，将在接下来几小时内到达。

column1: After this the Frenchs surely are completely scared!, we have destroyed their defenses in Sedan, and now we can launch our Panzer Divisions on to the heart of France. The enemy forces were waiting for us in the Low Countries, and now we will be able to trap them.
column2: 此后法国人肯定被彻底吓住了！我们摧毁了他们在色当(Sedan)的防御，现在可以把我们的装甲师投向法国的心脏地带了。敌军主力一直在低地国家(Low Countries)等着我们，现在我们可以把他们困住。

column1: The Frenchs have stopped our main attack!, this is a complete disaster. Now our attack on the Low Countries is stopped, and we will face another trench war... like in 1914. You are dismissed.
column2: 法国人挡住了我们的主攻！这完全是场灾难。现在我们对低地国家的进攻被挡住了，我们将面对又一场堑壕战……就像 1914 年那样。你被解职了。

column1: Our winter counteroffensive with waffen SS units against a Soviet army corps must occupy Kharkov city, destroy many Red units and save time for our units.
column2: 我们以武装党卫军部队对苏军一个军发动的冬季反攻，必须占领哈尔科夫(Kharkov)城，消灭大量红军部队，并为我们的部队争取时间。

column1: After this the Frenchs surely are completely scared!, we have destroyed their defenses in Sedan, and now we can launch our Panzer Divisions on to the heart of  France. The enemy forces were waiting for us in the Low Countries, and now we will be able to trap them.
column2: 此后法国人肯定被彻底吓住了！我们摧毁了他们在色当(Sedan)的防御，现在可以把我们的装甲师投向法国的心脏地带了。敌军主力一直在低地国家(Low Countries)等着我们，现在我们可以把他们困住。

column1: Our army lies broken. Greece is under Soviet control. And the subs are free to wreak havoc on Allied supply ships. You're hereby put on permanent leave.
column2: 我们的军队已经崩溃。希腊落入苏联控制之下。而潜艇则可以肆意袭击盟军的补给船。兹此命令你永久休假。

column2: 西班牙共和国已经重建。法西斯叛乱的头目们已被送去……西伯利亚(Siberia)度长假。干得好，同志！

column1: Kongratulieren!. The enemy has been defeated again, here in Arras. The distance between us and the coast is fewer every day!. You have won the match to the enemy General De Gaulle and his tank brigade, also, the 9th French Army has been isolated and completely defeated. I'm glad to inform you, that due to your outstanding achievement of the objectives, we have captured the enemy commander, the General Giraud.
column2: 恭喜！敌人在这里，在阿拉斯(Arras)，再次被击败。我们与海岸之间的距离每天都在缩短！你在与敌军戴高乐(De Gaulle)将军及其坦克旅的较量中获胜了，而且法国第9集团军已被孤立并彻底击败。我很高兴地告诉你，由于你出色地达成了目标，我们俘获了敌军指挥官吉罗(Giraud)将军。

column1: The Soviets cross the Oder river and start a direct attack towards Berlin.
column2: 苏军渡过奥得河(Oder)，开始向柏林(Berlin)发起直接进攻。

column1: You and your men have won a rest for now!. The French resistance continues in some places, but the invasion of France is completed, and in the next days we will be celebrating the victory in the Champs Elysees in Paris!!. Personally, I think that the pause made in the final assault on Duenkirchen, will cause consequences in the future...
column2: 你和你的部下现在赢得了一段休整！法国抵抗运动仍在一些地方继续，但对法国的入侵已经完成，接下来几天我们将在巴黎(Paris)香榭丽舍大街(Champs Elysees)庆祝胜利！！就我个人而言，我认为在最后强攻敦刻尔克(Duenkirchen)时的那次停顿，将来会带来后果……

column1: After a day of heavy fighting the Leibstandarte seized the Klidi Pass.  The British immediately began to withdraw to a defensive line west of Mount Olympus and the Greek 1st Army began to pull out of Albania.
column2: 经过一天激战，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)夺取了克利迪山口(Klidi Pass)。英军随即开始向奥林匹斯山(Mount Olympus)以西的一道防御线撤退，希腊第1集团军也开始撤出阿尔巴尼亚(Albania)。

column1: The brigade recon battalion, commanded by Kurt 'Panzer' Meyer was then odered to advance further through the Klissura Pass and on to Lake Kastoria.  One of the most infamous incidents of the SS is recorded from this assault.  Finding his soldiers pinned down by enemy fire and unwilling to attack, Meyer decided to toss a grenade at his own soldiers.  The effect was immediate, the soldiers picked themselves up and wrested control of the enemy positions from the ANZAC defenders.
column2: 旅属侦察营在库尔特·「装甲」·迈尔(Kurt 'Panzer' Meyer)指挥下，随后奉命继续穿过克利苏拉山口(Klissura Pass)，向卡斯托里亚湖(Lake Kastoria)推进。党卫军最臭名昭著的事件之一就记录于这次突击之中。迈尔发现自己的士兵被敌军火力压制住、不愿进攻，便决定朝自己的士兵扔手榴弹。效果立竿见影，士兵们爬起来，从澳新军团(ANZAC)守军手中夺下了敌军阵地。

column1: In concept of Operation Olive, the main priority of the Allied forces in the Adriatic sector was to enter the Po valley is quickly as possible and thereby trap the German divisions that fought on mountains. Despite initial successes of Polish and Canadian units, things were not going so fast the Allied had expected due in part to fanatical German resistance and in part to bad weather conditions.
column2: 按照「橄榄」行动(Operation Olive)的构想，亚得里亚海(Adriatic)战区盟军的首要任务是尽快进入波河(Po)谷地，从而困住那些在山地作战的德军师。尽管波兰与加拿大部队起初取得了成功，但事情进展并不像盟军预期的那样快，部分原因是德军的狂热抵抗，部分原因是恶劣的天气条件。

column1: While Germany was on the strategic defensive after the fall of Stalingrad, there were several operational offensives before the Soviet conquest of Berlin. You take control of Axis forces trying to re-open the way to Stalingrad, and try to change history. Can you stop the Allies before they reach Berlin?
column2: 当德国在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)陷落后转入战略防御时，在苏联征服柏林(Berlin)之前还有过几次战役级攻势。你将指挥试图重新打通通往斯大林格勒之路的轴心国部队，设法改变历史。你能在盟军抵达柏林之前挡住他们吗？

column1: Excellent! We have recovered from the surprise. Now we can reorganize our forces and prepare our defenses.
column2: 太好了！我们已从突袭中恢复过来。现在我们可以重整部队，准备防御。

column1: On July 10th 1943 the US 7th Army, commanded by Patton, and the British 8th, commanded by General Montgomery, started the invasion on Sicily.
column2: 1943 年 7 月 10 日，由巴顿(Patton)指挥的美军第7集团军与由蒙哥马利(Montgomery)将军指挥的英国第8集团军开始入侵西西里(Sicily)。

column1: You are, according to the instructions of Kesselring, commander of the Hermann Goring Panzer Division. You must advance south and contain the Allied beachhead in Gela. The Allied navy and artillery will not let you advance to Gela, so your mission is gain a little time for us to organize and avoid our army being isolated in the north.
column2: 你受凯塞林(Kesselring)之命，担任赫尔曼·戈林装甲师(Hermann Goring Panzer Division)的指挥官。你必须向南推进，把盟军滩头压制在杰拉(Gela)一带。盟军海军与炮兵不会让你推进到杰拉，所以你的任务是为我们争取一点时间完成组织，避免我军被孤立在北面。

column2: 非常好！你成功挡住了英军的推进。古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)现已稳固。

column2: 太好了！盟军的进攻已被挡住，滩头已被压制。迟滞战术效果完美！

It was also hoped that the attack could have the benefit of attracting Allied units, which were pushing towards Bologna.

Here ends your campaign - leaving you with the greatest honors.

column1: After the defeat of the Africa Korps the next step for the Allies was the invasion of Sicily and the Italian mainland, hoping to force the surrender of this German allied and open a second front in Europe. They were expecting a quick victory and the retreat of the German army towards the Alps, but situation turned into a bloody conflict that lasted until the end of war.
column2: 非洲军(Africa Korps)被击败后，盟军的下一步是入侵西西里(Sicily)与意大利本土，希望迫使这个德国盟友投降，并在欧洲开辟第二战场。他们本指望速胜、指望德军向阿尔卑斯山(Alps)撤退，但局势却变成了一场持续到战争结束的血腥冲突。

column1: This campaign reflects the true historical battles in which the German Army fought bravely.
column2: 本战役反映了德国陆军曾英勇作战的那些真实历史战役。

column1: On the first day of the campaign the Leibstandarte had achieved almost all its objectives.  By the evening of the 1st, the bulk of the Regiment was across the river and ready to advance on Wieuroszov, where it would link up with the 17th Infantry Division.  This was accomplished, and in the early hours of the next morning, the Leibstandarte advanced towards Burzenin, where it received orders to cross the Warta River.
column2: 战役第一天，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已几乎达成全部目标。到 1 日傍晚，该团主力已渡过河，准备向维耶乌罗舒夫(Wieuroszov)推进，在那里与第17步兵师会合。会合如期完成；次日凌晨，警卫旗队向布热宁(Burzenin)推进，并在那里受命渡过瓦尔塔河(Warta)。
白色方案(Fall Weiss) - 1939 年 9 月 1 日

column1: The Leibstandarte had been preparing for the Polish campaign since June, and in August had recieved orders to move from their Lichterfelde Barracks to an assembly area in East Berlin. The OKW remained sceptical of SS combat abilities, yet had little option but to accept Hitler's wish that the SS be involved in the attack.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)自 6 月起就在为波兰战役做准备，8 月接到命令，从利希特费尔德(Lichterfelde)营区开赴东柏林(Berlin)的一处集结地域。国防军最高统帅部(OKW)对党卫军的作战能力仍持怀疑态度，但除了接受希特勒要让党卫军参与进攻的意愿之外别无选择。

column1: LSSAH was attached to XIII Corps, 8th Armee, Army Group South, with the task of defending the left flank of 10th Armee.  In the initial advance the Leibstandarte - a fully motorised unit - was put under the control of the 17th Infantry Division and was assigned the task of forward reconnaissance and the defence of slower moving units.
column2: 警卫旗队(LSSAH)配属给南方集团军群(Army Group South)第8集团军(8th Armee)第XIII军，任务是防守第10集团军(10th Armee)的左翼。在最初的推进中，完全摩托化的警卫旗队被置于第17步兵师指挥之下，受领前沿侦察与掩护较慢部队的任务。

column1: The first objective for the LSSAH was to cross the Prosna River and assualt the anti-tank guns across the bridge.  They would then move quickly to seize the heights, and move into the village of Boleslavecz.  They were able to hold the village despite fierce counter-attacks by three Polish infantry divisions and cavalry elements.
column2: 警卫旗队(LSSAH)的首要目标是渡过普罗斯纳河(Prosna River)，突击桥对岸的反坦克炮。随后他们要迅速夺取高地，并进入博莱斯瓦维茨(Boleslavecz)村。尽管波兰 3 个步兵师与骑兵部队发起猛烈反击，他们仍守住了该村。

column1: Well done Comrade, you've got the control of Metz, Comrade Stalin is glad with your work.
column2: 干得好，同志，你已经控制了梅斯，斯大林同志对你的工作很满意。

column1: With the route to Warsaw now wide open, the 10th Army turned its axis of advance north and advanced toward the capital from the south-west, while the 4th Army closed from the north.  Guderian's armoured corps linked up with von Kleist's armoured corps at Brest-Litovsk on the 14th, effectively cutting off any potential escape route.
column2: 通往华沙(Warsaw)的道路已完全敞开，第10集团军将进攻轴线转向北面，从西南方向首都推进；第4集团军则从北面压上。14 日，古德里安(Guderian)的装甲军与克莱斯特(von Kleist)的装甲军在布列斯特-立托夫斯克(Brest-Litovsk)会师，彻底切断了任何可能的退路。

column1: On the Western approaches the 1st Battalion of the Leibstandarte fought bitterly to wrest Oltarzev from its stubborn defenders.  The Pole's although battered, were far from beaten and had declared Warsaw a fortress city.  Instead of withdrawing east, they began a retreat south-east and struck at the 8th Army.  The attacks temporarily threw the Germans off balance and the Leibstandarte was forced onto the defensive.
column2: 在西面接近地，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)第1营为从顽强的守军手中夺下奥尔塔泽夫(Oltarzev)而苦战。波兰人虽遭重创，却远未被击败，并已宣布华沙(Warsaw)为要塞城市。他们没有向东撤退，而是开始向东南退却，并打击了第8集团军(8th Army)。这些进攻一度把德军打得失去平衡，警卫旗队被迫转入防御。

column1: At this point in the campaign the Leibstandarte was able to link up with the 9th Panzer Division in the drive to Rotterdam.  Despite the fact that German airborne troops held the vital Maas bridge at Moerdijk, the tenacious Dutch defence in the north of the city had thus far prevented a crossing.  Hitler issued an ultimatum to the Dutch - capitulate or Rotterdam would be bombed.  Despite ongoing negotiations, the Luftwaffe attacked the city, citing a breakdown in communications.
column2: 此时在战役中，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在向鹿特丹(Rotterdam)推进途中与第9装甲师会合。尽管德国空降部队控制着穆尔代克(Moerdijk)至关重要的马斯河(Maas)大桥，该城北面顽强的荷兰防御此前一直使渡河无法实现。希特勒向荷兰人发出最后通牒——投降，否则鹿特丹将被轰炸。尽管谈判仍在进行，德国空军仍以通信中断为由袭击了该城。

column1: Following the air raid, on the 13th of May, the Leibstandarte advanced through Rotterdam and was involved in an incident which drew heavy criticism from the army.  After spotting Dutch soldiers loitering outside a building, soldiers of the LSSAH opened fire.  Inside that building Dutch and German officers were negotiating a surrender.  One of the German officers inside was Airborne Commander Karl Student, who was severely wounded by the assault.
column2: 空袭之后，5 月 13 日，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)穿过鹿特丹(Rotterdam)推进，并卷入了一起招致陆军严厉批评的事件。在发现荷兰士兵在一栋建筑外闲荡之后，警卫旗队(LSSAH)的士兵开了火。当时那栋建筑里，荷兰与德国军官正在谈判投降事宜。楼内的德国军官之一、空降兵指挥官卡尔·施图登特(Karl Student)在这次突击中身负重伤。

column1: For the army, it was proof again of the indiscipline of the Waffen SS.
column2: 对陆军来说，这再次证明了武装党卫军(Waffen SS)的缺乏纪律。

column1: After the seizure of the Wattenberg heights, the Leibstandarte doggedly pursued the retreating enemy.  The 2nd Battalion tasked with capturing the town of Wormhoudt, encoutered stiff resistance from men of the British 48th Infantry Division, and on 28th May the town was still held by British forces.  As the fighting continued, a number of the 4th Chesire Regiment were taken prisoner and led to a barn, which was then raked with machine gun fire.  Grenades were then tossed inside, and by the time an officer had halted the slaughter, 65 of the 80 POW's were dead.  Those who survived this incident have since implicated Wilhelm Mohnke as the officer who gave the execution order.
column2: 夺取瓦滕贝格(Wattenberg)高地之后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)顽强追击退却之敌。受命夺取沃尔穆特(Wormhoudt)镇的第2营遭到英国第48步兵师(48th Infantry Division)士兵的顽强抵抗，到 5 月 28 日该镇仍由英军据守。战斗继续进行时，柴郡团第4营(4th Chesire Regiment)的一些人被俘并被带进一座谷仓，随后谷仓遭到机枪扫射。接着手榴弹被扔了进去，等到一名军官制止这场屠杀时，80 名战俘中已有 65 人死亡。此事的幸存者后来指认威廉·蒙克(Wilhelm Mohnke)就是下达处决命令的军官。

column1: Dietrich however was cleared of any wrong doing, having spent the day in a muddy ditch after coming under fire from some isolated British soldiers.  With his car on fire, he and his companions took shelter in the ditch, where the Leibstandarte commander covered himself in damp mud to protect against the burning petrol of his car.
column2: 然而迪特里希(Dietrich)被免除了任何罪责，他当天在遭到几名失散英军士兵射击后，一直待在一道泥泞的沟里。他的座车起火，他和同伴们在沟里躲避，这位警卫旗队指挥官用湿泥涂满全身，以抵御座车燃烧的汽油。

column1: The Leibstandarte briefly rested after the fall of Dunkirk, and then moved south with Von Kleist's armoured group where it took part in some minor actions.  The campaign in France cost the Leibstandarte some 500 casualties.  The unit was amply rewarded for its performance and in August was upgraded to Brigade status and began training for Operation Sealion - the proposed invasion of Britain.
column2: 敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)陷落后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)稍作休整，随后随冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)装甲集群南下，参加了一些小规模行动。法国战役让警卫旗队付出了约 500 人的伤亡。该部队因其表现得到丰厚回报，8 月被提升为旅级，并开始为「海狮」行动(Operation Sealion)——即拟议中的入侵英国——进行训练。

column1: After taking Skopje, the Leibstandarte turned soouth, and headed for the strategically important Monastir Gap - the gateway to Greece.  The reconnaissance battalion of the Leibstandarte that had been sent ahead did not encounter any strong opposition until it reached the area east of Florina. Against all expectations, the enemy had left open the Monastir Gap. The Germans did not hesitate to exploit their advantage and continued the advance in the direction of Kozani.
column2: 夺取斯科普里(Skopje)后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)转向南面，直趋具有战略意义的莫纳斯提尔山口(Monastir Gap)——通往希腊的门户。先前派出的警卫旗队侦察营直到抵达弗洛里纳(Florina)以东地区才遇到顽强抵抗。出乎一切预料，敌人让莫纳斯提尔山口敞开着。德军毫不犹豫地利用这一优势，继续向科扎尼(Kozani)方向推进。

column1: The Leibstandarte was instrumental in preventing any Soviet breakout's during the encirclement, as the Soviets threw armour, cavalry and scores of infantry in their direction.  Each time the division was able to repel these attacks, and for its efforts the Leibstandarte earned considerable praise from corps commander, Generalmajor Kempf.  The encirclement was completed on the 8th of August when the 6th Army met the 17th Army on the Southern Bug River, trapping two whole Soviet armies and a large part of another.
column2: 在合围期间，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在阻止苏军突围方面起了关键作用，因为苏军把装甲部队、骑兵和大量步兵朝他们的方向投来。每一次该师都能击退这些进攻，由于这些努力，警卫旗队赢得了军长肯普夫(Kempf)少将(Generalmajor)的相当赞誉。8 月 8 日，第6集团军与第17集团军在南布格河(Southern Bug River)会师，合围得以完成，困住了苏军整整两个集团军以及另一个集团军的大部。

column1: The troops in the pocket were finally eliminated on 22nd August, but the focus of the Leibstandarte's advance had already shifted towards the industrial centre of Kherson.
column2: 包围圈内的部队最终于 8 月 22 日被清除，但警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)推进的重心已转向工业中心赫尔松(Kherson)。

column1: At Dubno, the Leibstandarte was able to defeat the Soviet counter-attack and prevent them from cutting the lengthening line of communications.  Victory came at a cost however, as the division lost 683 killed and wounded.  Following the battle, von Kleist and his armoured group were able to breakthrough the Stalin Line east of Zhitomir, driving a wedge between two Soviet armies.  Moving in behind this breakthrough, the division quickly sped along the road to Kiev, where it soon found itself thrown onto the backfoot thanks to a wide-ranging Soviet attack on the Southwest front.
column2: 在杜布诺(Dubno)，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)得以击败苏军的反击，阻止他们切断不断延长的交通线。但胜利是有代价的，该师有 683 人阵亡与负伤。此战之后，冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)及其装甲集群突破了日托米尔(Zhitomir)以东的斯大林防线(Stalin Line)，在两个苏军集团军之间打进一个楔子。该师紧随这次突破之后，沿通往基辅(Kiev)的道路快速推进，但很快因苏军对西南方面军(Southwest front)发起的大范围进攻而陷入被动。

column1: When the Soviet attacks halted, Hitler's gaze fixed onto Uman, a major transport hub for the Crimea, which had the added attraction of encircling the Soviet forces holding up the 17th and 18th armies.
column2: 当苏军的进攻停下来时，希特勒的目光转向了乌曼(Uman)——克里米亚(Crimea)的一处主要交通枢纽，它还另有一个诱人之处：可以合围拖住第17与第18集团军的苏军部队。
杰拉(Gela) - 1945 年 10 月 25 日

column1: Comrade, this is the last step to conquer Romans's Motherland. We've watched some allied ships approaching, so submarines and extra reinforcements are on the way.
column2: 同志，这是征服罗马人祖国的最后一步。我们已看到一些盟军船只正在接近，所以潜艇与额外增援正在途中。

column1: Only after bitter and bloody fighting were the Leibstandarte able to capture Bubry and the road junction at Sasselje.  Arriving at Kherson on the 17th of August, the division fought yet another bitter battle through the streets for three days before the defenders finally fled the city.
column2: 只有在经过艰苦血腥的战斗之后，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)才得以夺取布布里(Bubry)与萨塞列(Sasselje)的路口。8 月 17 日抵达赫尔松(Kherson)后，该师又在街巷中苦战了三天，守军才最终弃城而逃。

column1: Rostov was fully taken on the 21st November.  In its part in the attack the Leibstandarte had captured the main railway bridge intact, earning SS-Haupsturmfuhrer Heinrich Springer the Knights Cross.  Von Kleist's armour was able to pour over this vital crossing point and play a pivotal role in the victory.  For the division came the reward of 10,000 prisoners, 159 artillery pieces, 56 tanks and 2 armoured trains.
column2: 罗斯托夫(Rostov)于 11 月 21 日被完全攻占。在这次进攻中，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)完整夺取了主要铁路桥，为党卫军上尉(SS-Haupsturmfuhrer)海因里希·施普林格(Heinrich Springer)赢得了骑士铁十字勋章(Knights Cross)。冯·克莱斯特(von Kleist)的装甲部队得以涌过这处至关重要的渡口，在胜利中发挥了关键作用。该师的回报是 10,000 名战俘、159 门火炮、56 辆坦克与 2 列装甲列车。

column1: After five days of bitter fighting, the SS-Panzer Corps reached the city of Kharkov.  Three more days of viscious fighting throughout the city followed, and the city was secured on the 14th March.  On the 18th, Byelgorod was retaken, thus regaining the defensive line of the Donets to Byelgorod, and correcting the tactical situation brought about by the Stalingrad disaster.
column2: 经过五天苦战，党卫军装甲军(SS-Panzer Corps)抵达哈尔科夫(Kharkov)城。随后全城又进行了三天激战，该城于 3 月 14 日被确保。18 日，别尔哥罗德(Byelgorod)被夺回，从而恢复了顿涅茨河(Donets)至别尔哥罗德的防线，纠正了斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)灾难所造成的战术态势。

column1: The battle of Kharkov cost the Leibstandarte 167 officers, 4,373 NCOs and soldiers - 44 percent of its fighting strength.  The square in Kharkov was renamed 'Leibstandarteplatz' in the division's honour, and on March 21st, Hitler awarded Dietrich the Swords to his Knights Cross.
column2: 哈尔科夫(Kharkov)之战让警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)付出了 167 名军官、4,373 名军士与士兵的代价——占其战斗力的 44%。哈尔科夫广场被更名为「警卫旗队广场」(Leibstandarteplatz)以纪念该师，3 月 21 日，希特勒授予迪特里希(Dietrich)骑士铁十字勋章的双剑饰(Swords)。

column1: The late spring on the Eastern Front was quiet, a respite that afforded the division vital needed time for rest and refitting.
column2: 东线晚春一片平静，这段间歇让该师获得了迫切需要的休整与重新装备的时间。

column1: On the 12th, the Soviet Guards Tank Army launched a series of uncoordinated strikes with the intention to seperate the SS divisions.  In an area of only a few square miles, firing at almost point-blank range across the dust-choked plain, the superior German tank guns counted for nothing against suicidal attacks by Soviet tank crews.  In the heavy fighting that ensued the heavy company of the Leibstandarte's tank regiment engaged and destroyed the Soviet 181st Tank Regiment, without loss.  On both sides however, losses were high.  At the end of the day a thick pall of smoke hung over the battlefield.
column2: 12 日，苏军近卫坦克集团军发动了一系列互不协调的突击，意图把党卫军各师分割开来。在仅有几平方英里的地区内，在尘土窒塞的平原上以近乎抵近的距离对射，德军优越的坦克炮面对苏军坦克乘员自杀式的攻击也毫无用处。在随后爆发的激战中，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)坦克团的重型连击毁并歼灭了苏军第181坦克团，自身毫无损失。然而双方损失都很高。一天结束时，浓重的烟幕笼罩着战场。

column1: The Soviet attack had been driven off, but at a heavy price, and the SS-Panzer Corps now held the area around Prokhorovka and the railroad.  In the north however, the Soviets had launched a strong counter-attack behind the 9th Army, threatining them with encirclement - forcing General Model to halt his advance, and pull back his forces.  With the situation in the north becoming increasingly precarious, Hitler called 'Zitadelle' off on the 13th July.
column2: 苏军的进攻已被打退，但代价沉重，党卫军装甲军(SS-Panzer Corps)现在控制着普罗霍罗夫卡(Prokhorovka)周边地区与铁路。然而在北面，苏军已在第9集团军后方发动强大反击，以合围相威胁——迫使莫德尔(Model)将军停止推进并后撤其部队。随着北面局势日益危急，希特勒于 7 月 13 日叫停了「堡垒」(Zitadelle)。

column1: At Kursk the Leibstandarte paid heavily - 2,753 casaulties, including 474 dead, and 19 tanks lost.  Following the Kursk campaign, the Leibstandarte was sent to Italy for occupation duty.
column2: 在库尔斯克(Kursk)，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)付出了沉重代价——2,753 人伤亡，其中 474 人阵亡，损失 19 辆坦克。库尔斯克战役之后，警卫旗队被派往意大利执行占领任务。

column1: Zhitomir was taken, and although it would soon have to be relinquished, Soviet supply routes between the city and Kiev were cut.  The Leibstandarte moved on Brusilov, where it met a strong concentration of 5th and 8th Guards Armoured Corps, and 1st Guard Cavalry Corps.  With the 1st and 9th Panzer Divisions attacking the northern and southern flanks, and Leibstandarte from the west, on 24th November the concentration was encircled and destroyed.  On 16th December amid biting cold and blinding snowstorms the division advanced east with the 1st and 7th Panzer divisions from Korosten, aiming at encircling the Soviet armies around Meleni.  This was achieved, but with so few troops that the positions could not be held and soon attack turned to retreat.
column2: 日托米尔(Zhitomir)被攻占，虽然很快又不得不放弃，但该城与基辅(Kiev)之间的苏军补给线被切断。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)向布鲁西洛夫(Brusilov)推进，在那里遭遇了第5与第8近卫装甲军以及第1近卫骑兵军的强大集群。在第1与第9装甲师进攻南北两翼、警卫旗队从西面进攻的情况下，11 月 24 日这个集群被合围并歼灭。12 月 16 日，在刺骨严寒与令人目盲的暴风雪中，该师与第1、第7装甲师一起从科罗斯坚(Korosten)向东推进，目标是合围梅列尼(Meleni)周边的苏军集团军。目标达成了，但兵力太少，阵地无法守住，攻势很快转为退却。

column1: As the year drew to a close, the 4th Panzer Army was pushed back west and south of the city by a fresh offensive launched on Christmas Eve by the combined forces of four Soviet armies plus two independent corps against the southern rim of Kiev.  The next day it developed a second thrust west, which threatened to destroy the entire left flank of Army Group South, and succeeded in recapturing Zhitomir and the road linking it to Kiev.  While recognising that this thrust could be employed to drive the two army groups back against the Black Sea and Carpathian Mountains, Hitler saw that the southern attack posed the danger of an envelopment of Army Group South and A between the Dniepr and Dniestr Rivers, and considered it the greatest danger.
column2: 随着这一年接近尾声，12 月 24 日平安夜，4 个苏军集团军加上 2 个独立军的联合兵力对基辅(Kiev)南缘发起新攻势，把第4装甲集团军逐出该城以西与以南。第二天，苏军又向西发起第二次突击，有可能摧毁南方集团军群(Army Group South)的整个左翼，并成功夺回了日托米尔(Zhitomir)及其连接基辅的道路。希特勒虽然认识到这次突击可以用来把两个集团军群压向黑海(Black Sea)与喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian Mountains)，但他看出南面的进攻有在第聂伯河(Dniepr)与德涅斯特河(Dniestr)之间合围南方集团军群与A集团军群的危险，因而认为这是最大的危险。

column1: Caen had been lost, and the Leibstandarte had fallen back to the Bourgebus ridge, where they held the line and inflicted heavy casaulties upon the British 7th and 11th Armoured Divisions.  However, the weakened German defences began to lose the battle of attrition, with few reinforcements arriving, and roaming Allied bombers destroying supplies before the could reach the lines.  The division now helped to hold the Caen-Falaise highway until the end of July against repeated British attacks.
column2: 卡昂(Caen)已经失守，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)退到布尔格布斯岭(Bourgebus ridge)，在那里守住了战线，并给英国第7与第11装甲师造成重大伤亡。然而被削弱的德军防御开始输掉这场消耗战：增援寥寥无几，游弋的盟军轰炸机在补给送达前线之前就将其摧毁。该师现在协助守住卡昂-法莱斯(Caen-Falaise)公路，直到 7 月底，抵御英军的反复进攻。

column1: In the last week of July, the US forces had launched a breakout attempt which pulled them out of the bocage country and into the open countryside.  Hitler ordered a counter-attack, of which the Leibstandarte was to be part of, aimed at Avranches and St. Lo which failed.  Subsequently a Canadian attack which thrust south-west threatened to envelop the German forces, and the LSSAH was pulled back into defensive positions.
column2: 7 月最后一周，美军发动了一次突围尝试，使他们冲出了树篱地带(bocage country)，进入开阔的乡野。希特勒下令发动一次反击，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)是其中一部分，目标指向阿夫朗什(Avranches)与圣洛(St. Lo)，但未能成功。随后一次向西南突击的加拿大进攻有合围德军之势，警卫旗队(LSSAH)被撤回防御阵地。

column1: Although we held Caen we can not continue to hold these current positions.  The Americans have broken through the 'bocage' terrain and are advancing rapidly.  We are in danger of being encirlced and we must pull back before it is too late.
column2: 尽管我们守住了卡昂，却无法继续守住眼下的阵地。美军已突破「灌木树篱」地带，正迅速推进。我们有被合围的危险，必须趁早后撤。

column1: The Leibstandarte attack was eventually thwarted by blown bridges and a stubborn defence by the American troops.  By December 23rd, the division was being pushed back following its intial success.  Kampfgruppe Peiper, isolated and under heavy attacks at Stoumont, was given permission to break out to the east while the rest of the division provided cover.  Leaving behind 150 U.S. prisoners and some wounded to destroy his remaining tanks, Peiper led his battered and weary troops back to German lines.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)的进攻最终因桥梁被炸毁与美军顽强防御而受挫。到 12 月 23 日，该师在取得初期的成功之后正被向后压迫。在斯图蒙(Stoumont)被孤立并遭猛攻的派佩尔战斗群(Kampfgruppe Peiper)获准向东突围，由该师其余部队提供掩护。佩佩尔留下 150 名美军战俘和一些伤员去炸毁自己剩余的坦克，然后带领他疲惫不堪的残部返回德军防线。

column1: KG Peiper started the attack with 5,800 men, and left with just 800 survivors.
column2: 派佩尔战斗群(KG Peiper)以 5,800 人发起进攻，离开时只剩下 800 名幸存者。

column1: On the day of the German offensive snow was falling from low cloud and the temperature hovered on either side of zero degrees celcius.  The Leibstandarte began its attack at 0430 hours with an artillery barrage against the 68th Guards Rifle Division positions.  The Soviet defences were strong and well prepared, and the Leibstandarte lost a number of tanks to mines and flame-throwers.  Despite the shock of finding the Soviets well prepared, the Leibstandarte broke through, and by March 14th had reached Simontoya, securing a bridgehead over the Sio Canal by the 15th.  By this point however, the corps left flank was badly exposed, prompting Dietrich to recommend a retreat to defensive positions, as further advance was impossible, owing to the hilly, broken and wooded terrain.
column2: 德军攻势发起当天，低云中飘着雪，气温在零摄氏度上下徘徊。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)于 04 时 30 分以一次炮火准备对第68近卫步兵师阵地开始进攻。苏军防御坚固且准备充分，警卫旗队有多辆坦克损失于地雷与喷火器。尽管发现苏军准备充分令人震惊，警卫旗队仍突破了防线，到 3 月 14 日已抵达西蒙托亚(Simontoya)，并于 15 日在西奥运河(Sio Canal)上取得一个桥头堡。然而此时该军左翼已严重暴露，促使迪特里希(Dietrich)建议撤退至防御阵地，因为由于丘陵、破碎且多林的地形，继续推进已不可能。

column1: Soviet attacks across the Sarvis and Sio Canals were seen as an ominous sign of things to come.  It was clear from intelligence reports that the Soviets were attempting to cut off the Sixth Panzer Army.  On the 16th two Soviet armies launched a major attack between Szekesfehervar and the Vertes hills to the north.  By the 18th, the LSSAH was given orders to withdraw from Simontoya, thus ending the divisions last offensive action of the war.
column2: 苏军越过萨尔维斯运河(Sarvis)与西奥运河(Sio Canals)的进攻被视为不祥之兆。情报报告清楚表明，苏军正试图切断党卫军第6装甲集团军(Sixth Panzer Army)。16 日，两个苏军集团军在北面的塞克什白堡(Szekesfehervar)与韦尔泰什山(Vertes hills)之间发动大规模进攻。到 18 日，警卫旗队(LSSAH)接到命令从西蒙托亚(Simontoya)撤出，该师在战争中的最后一次进攻行动就此结束。
党卫军第1装甲师 警卫旗队(1st SS-Panzer Division LAH)
党卫军旅队长(SS-Brigadefuhrer)奥托·库姆(Otto Kumm)

column1: Whilst the Germans prepared Fruhlingerwachen, the Soviets had their own plans - an attack aimed toward Vienna, to begin on 15th March.  Following the Gran bridgehead fighting however, the Soviets became aware of German intentions and were able to adapt their positions to meet it.  The Third Ukranian Front commander - where the Leibstandarte attack was positioned - reasoned that the Germans could be sufficiently weakened by the depth of the Soviet defences, for them to be able to launch their own attack.
column2: 当德军准备「春醒」行动时，苏军也有自己的计划——一次指向维也纳(Vienna)的进攻，定于 3 月 15 日开始。然而在格兰河(Gran)桥头堡战斗之后，苏军察觉到德军的意图，得以调整阵地加以应对。乌克兰第3方面军(Third Ukranian Front)司令——警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)的进攻正位于其地段——判断，德军的实力会被苏军防御的纵深充分削弱，从而让他们能够发动自己的进攻。

column1: (If playing with rules do not buy any new units, except to replace any core losses.  You should deploy 6 'SS Panzergrenadiere/Infanterie', 2 Tanks, 4 Artillery, 1 Recon, 1 Air Defence/Flak, 1 'Sturmpioniere' and 2 anti-tank units.)
column2: （如果按规则游玩，不要购买任何新单位，只用于补充核心部队的损失。你应当部署 6 个「党卫军装甲掷弹兵/步兵」、2 辆坦克、4 个炮兵、1 个侦察、1 个防空/高射炮、1 个「突击工兵」与 2 个反坦克单位。）

column1: You have failed to do your duty...

For the rescue attempt von Manstein concentrated most of his tank strength in the 46th and 3rd Panzer Corps, and attached Leibstandarte to the latter.  On 11th February the breakout began, with Leibstandarte attacking on the northern flank with the 1st, 17th and 16th Panzer Divisions assaulting to the south.  Conditions could not have been worse with thick fog and hevaily bogged roads rendering rapid movement impossible.  Zhukov threw in the 5th Guards Tank Army to counter the German thrust and halted the Northern flank when it was barely eight miles from the trapped pocket.  Realising that the link-up he envisaged had failed, Hitler consented to a break-out attempt on 16th February, and that night a slow-moving column formed.  Leaving behind the wounded and most of their equipment, 35,000 men began moving toward 3rd Panzer Corps positions.  Men, of the Leibstandarte, covering the retreat, showed considerable bravery.  In one documentated incident, two NCO's of the 2nd Panzergrenadier Regiment held off two companies of Soviet troops before they could be relieved.  In all 32,000 troops had escaped, half of the forces that had been initially trapped.
column2: 为这次救援行动，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)把他大部分坦克兵力集中在第46与第3装甲军，并把警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)配属给后者。2 月 11 日突围开始，警卫旗队在北翼进攻，第1、第17与第16装甲师则向南突击。条件再糟不过：浓雾与严重泥泞的道路使快速运动成为不可能。朱可夫(Zhukov)投入近卫第5坦克集团军来对抗德军突击，在北翼距离被围包围圈仅 8 英里时将其阻止。希特勒意识到他所设想的会合已经失败，便于 2 月 16 日同意尝试突围，当晚一支缓慢行进的纵队编成。留下伤员与大部分装备后，35,000 人开始向第3装甲军阵地移动。负责掩护撤退的警卫旗队官兵表现出相当的勇气。在一份有记载的事例中，第2装甲掷弹兵团的两名军士在得到接应之前挡住了苏军两个连。总共 32,000 名官兵逃脱，是当初被围兵力的一半。

column1: In early March, the weakened divisions of von Manstein were smashed by a mighty assault by the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Ukrainian Fronts between the Carpathian mountains and the Pripet marshes.  The Leibstandarte, fighting as part of the 24th Panzer Corps, was unable to stem the tide and by the 15th was all but annihilated - less than 1,250 men remained.  In the last week of the month, together with 4th Panzer Army it was encircled at Kamenets-Podolski.  The remains of the Leibstandarte fought out of the pocket and by mid-April had reached German lines.
column2: 3 月初，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)被削弱的各师在喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian mountains)与普里皮亚季沼泽(Pripet marshes)之间遭到乌克兰第1、第2与第3方面军(1st, 2nd and 3rd Ukrainian Fronts)的强大突击而崩溃。作为第24装甲军一部分作战的警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)无法遏止这股洪流，到 15 日几乎被全歼——剩余不到 1,250 人。当月最后一周，它与第4装甲集团军一起在卡缅涅茨-波多利斯基(Kamenets-Podolski)被合围。警卫旗队的残部杀出包围圈，到 4 月中旬抵达德军防线。
科尔松包围圈(Korsun Pocket) - 1944 年 2 月 11 日

column1: As the war in the east entered its fourth year, Zhukov's 1st Ukrainian Front moved across the Dnieper against Kirovgrad, taking advantage of the now severely weakened Army Group South right flank.  Two days later Kirovgrad was in Soviet hands, despite spirited defence by 11 German divisions.  Fighting a continuing series of defensive engagements in the area around Zhitomir, Korosten and Beredichev, the Leibstandarte at Beredichev was able to temporarily check the Soviet advance.  By mid-January the Soviet 1st Tank Army, spearheading 1st Ukrainian Front's southern advance, had gained 65 miles and was approaching Uman.  In knee-deep mud, sleet and blizzards, Army Group South fought desperately to prevent it's front from collapsing.
column2: 随着东线战争进入第四个年头，朱可夫(Zhukov)的乌克兰第1方面军(1st Ukrainian Front)趁南方集团军群(Army Group South)右翼此时已严重削弱之机，越过第聂伯河(Dnieper)进攻基洛夫格勒(Kirovgrad)。两天后，尽管 11 个德军师顽强防御，基洛夫格勒仍落入苏军之手。警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在日托米尔(Zhitomir)、科罗斯坚(Korosten)与别列季切夫(Beredichev)一带进行一连串防御作战，在别列季切夫暂时遏止了苏军的推进。到 1 月中旬，作为乌克兰第1方面军南进矛头的苏军第1坦克集团军已前进 65 英里，逼近乌曼(Uman)。在没膝的泥泞、雨夹雪与暴风雪中，南方集团军群拼命阻止其战线崩溃。

column1: A new attack, begun on 25th January by Konev's 2nd Ukrainian Front, in four days linked up with Vatunin's 1st Ukrainian Front and encircled 6 German divisions at Korsun-Shevchenkovsky, north-west of Cherkassy.  Hitler refused to countenance any breakout attempt, insisting that von Manstein instead link up with the trapped forces and thus re-eastablish the Dniepr Line.
column2: 1 月 25 日，科涅夫(Konev)的乌克兰第2方面军(2nd Ukrainian Front)发起新的进攻，四天后与瓦图京(Vatunin)的乌克兰第1方面军会合，在切尔卡瑟(Cherkassy)西北的科尔孙-舍甫琴柯夫斯基(Korsun-Shevchenkovsky)合围了 6 个德军师。希特勒拒不同意任何突围尝试，坚持要冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)改为与被围部队会合，从而重建第聂伯河(Dniepr)防线。

column1: The cutting off of the Greek withdrawal to the south was accomplished by 20 April, following a pitched battle in the 5,000 foot high Metsovon Pass in the Pindus Mountains. Realizing the hopelessness of the situation, the Greek commander offered to surrender his army, which then consisted of fourteen divisions. After brief negotiations, which, on strict orders from Hitler, were kept secret from the Italians, the surrender was accepted with honorable terms for the defeated. In recognition of the valor with which the Greek troops had fought, their officers were permitted to retain their side arms. The soldiers were not treated as prisoners of war and were allowed to go home after the demobilization of their units.
column2: 4 月 20 日，在品都斯山脉(Pindus Mountains)中 5,000 英尺高的迈措翁山口(Metsovon Pass)进行了一场激战之后，切断希腊军队向南撤退的任务完成。希腊指挥官意识到局势已无望，提出率其当时由 14 个师组成的军队投降。经过短暂谈判——按照希特勒的严令，谈判对意大利人保密——投降被接受，战败方获得了体面的条件。为表彰希腊部队作战的英勇，他们的军官获准保留随身武器。士兵没有被当作战俘对待，在部队复员后获准回家。

column1: On the 28th the remaining British forces in Greece surrendered.  During the campaign the Leibstandarte had lost 93 killed, 225 wounded and 3 missing, and thus was afforded a few days rest.
column2: 28 日，希腊境内剩余的英军部队投降。战役期间警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)损失 93 人阵亡、225 人负伤、3 人失踪，因此获得了几天休整。

column1: On 30th September as the remaining Polish units were being mopped up, the Leibstandarte was awarded a special standard in light of the heavy casualties it had suffered during the campaign.  The regiment suffered more than 400 killed, wounded or missing.  This was proof, the army believed that the SS was poorly trained and led, and reckless in attack.  The SS countered that the OKW had consistently given the SS the most dangerous tasks, and that the practice of dividing SS units amongst the army formations was detrimental to their effectiveness in battle.
column2: 9 月 30 日，当残余的波兰部队被肃清时，鉴于警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)在战役中遭受的惨重伤亡，它被授予一面特殊的军旗。该团有 400 多人阵亡、负伤或失踪。陆军认为，这证明了党卫军训练与指挥拙劣、进攻鲁莽。党卫军反驳说，国防军最高统帅部(OKW)一直把最危险的任务交给党卫军，而把党卫军部队分散编入陆军建制的做法损害了它们在战场上的效能。

column1: Overall, with their ability to redeploy rapidly from one sector of fighting to another, the Leibstandarte had proved the effectiveness of motorised units in battle.
column2: 总体而言，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)凭借从一个战区迅速重新部署到另一个战区的能力，证明了摩托化部队在战场上的效能。
埃普索姆防御战战(Epsom Defence) - 1944 年 6 月 28 日

column1: On 18th April the division was sent to France for rest and refitting, to counter the expected summer invasion of north-west Europe.  From the 25th it was headquartered at Turnhout, Belgium, as one of the elements of Dietrichs newly created I SS-Panzer Corps which was given the title Leibstandarte Adolf Hitler.  Here over 2,000 troops were transferred into the division from the 12th SS Division, and on the 3rd May Hitler decreed new equipment for the division, much of it to come straight from the factory.  With these and other replacements, by June 1944 the Leibstandarte had been rebuilt to a strength of 20,000.
column2: 4 月 18 日，该师被派往法国休整与重新装备，以应对预料中的夏季对西北欧的入侵。从 25 日起，其司令部设在比利时蒂伦豪特(Turnhout)，作为迪特里希(Dietrich)新组建的党卫军第1装甲军(I SS-Panzer Corps)的一部，该军被授予「阿道夫·希特勒警卫旗队」的称号。此地有 2,000 多名官兵从党卫军第12师调入该师，5 月 3 日希特勒下令为该师换装新装备，其中许多直接来自工厂。加上这些以及其他补充，到 1944 年 6 月，警卫旗队已重建到 20,000 人的规模。

column1: Thanks to the movement sanctions imposed by Hitler on the German forces on the Western Front, the Leibstandarte was not immediately able to respond to the Allied landings on June 6th.  This left the 21st Panzer, Panzer Lehr and 12th SS Panzer Divisions to bear the brunt of the Allied assaults in the early stages of the battle for Caen.  Not until 28th of June were elements of the Leibstandarte - the 1st Panzergrenadier Regiment - able to arrive at Caen.
column2: 由于希特勒对西线德军施加的调动限制，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)无法立即对 6 月 6 日盟军的登陆作出反应。这使得第21装甲师、装甲教导师(Panzer Lehr)与党卫军第12装甲师在卡昂(Caen)之战初期承受了盟军突击的主要压力。直到 6 月 28 日，警卫旗队的部队——第1装甲掷弹兵团——才得以抵达卡昂。

column2: 南风行动(Operation Sudwind) - 1945 年 2 月 17 日

column1: By 1945 the Leibstandarte had been successfully moved east by train to Vienna, and the difficult task of rebuilding the division began.  The situation for Germany was critical - Budapest had fallen after a 51 day seige; Warsaw, Lodz and Krakow had fallen; a Soviet Army was in East Prussia; the Red Army was now a mere 200km from Prague, and worst of all, it had crossed the river Oder, and was only 70km from Berlin.  The I SS Panzer Corps was to be used to rectify this critical situation.
column2: 到 1945 年，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已通过铁路成功东调至维也纳(Vienna)，重建该师的艰巨任务随之开始。德国的处境十分危急——布达佩斯(Budapest)在被围 51 天后陷落；华沙(Warsaw)、罗兹(Lodz)与克拉科夫(Krakow)已经陷落；一支苏军集团军已进入东普鲁士(East Prussia)；红军距布拉格(Prague)仅 200 公里，而最糟的是，它已渡过奥得河(Oder)，距柏林(Berlin)只有 70 公里。党卫军第1装甲军(I SS Panzer Corps)将用来扭转这一危急局面。

column1: The Soviets held a considerable bridgehead over the Gran river, north of Eztergom.  This position was seen as a potential assembly area for a possible thrust towards Vienna and as such it had to be elminated before the main offensive - aimed at elimating the Soviet units from the area west of the Danube and north of the Drava rivers and to secure the Nagykanizsa oil deposits - could begin.  This peliminary operation was given the code-name South Wind.
column2: 苏军在埃斯泰尔戈姆(Eztergom)以北的格兰河(Gran river)上占据着一个相当大的桥头堡。这个位置被视为可能向维也纳(Vienna)突击的潜在集结地域，因此必须在主要攻势开始之前将其清除——主要攻势的目标是清除多瑙河(Danube)以西、德拉瓦河(Drava)以北地区的苏军部队，并确保瑙吉考尼饶(Nagykanizsa)油田。这次预备性作战的代号是「南风」。

column1: Despite widespread flooding and poor road conditions caused by an early thaw, Sudwind began at 0500 hours on the 17th of February.  Leaving high ground on their right flank and with the Gran river on their left, the Germans attacked across open, rolling, agricultural land with few villages and no serious obstacles.
column2: 尽管早来的融雪造成大面积洪泛与恶劣道路条件，「南风」行动仍于 2 月 17 日 05 时 00 分开始。德军让右翼依托高地、左翼紧靠格兰河(Gran river)，越过开阔起伏的农田发起进攻，那里村庄稀少，也没有严重障碍。

column1: By the first day, the Leibstandarte and the attached 46th Infantry Division had broken through the Soviet defences, advancing 10km.  On both the right and left flanks however, the 44th and 211th Infantry Divisions ran into strong resistance.  By the 21st, the I SS Panzer Corps had cleared the Gran bridgehead, sending the Soviets into a retreat across the Gran river.  Hitler quickly ordered that the Leibstandarte be freed as soon as possible for his next offensive, in the Lake Balaton area.
column2: 到第一天，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)与配属的第46步兵师已突破苏军防御，推进 10 公里。然而在左右两翼，第44与第211步兵师都遭遇了顽强抵抗。到 21 日，党卫军第1装甲军已肃清格兰河(Gran river)桥头堡，迫使苏军渡河撤退。希特勒随即下令尽快腾出警卫旗队，供他在巴拉顿湖(Lake Balaton)地区的下一次攻势使用。

column1: It took XXX Armeekorps three days to defeat the Soviet counter attacks and to restore the front line.  Subsequently with support from Kleist's 1st Panzer Army, the 11th Army was able to complete the encirclement of the Soviet 9th and 18th Armies.  On the 20th October, Manstein's forces then attacked the five-mile wide Perekop Isthmus, which guarded the gateway to the Crimea, and ten days later broke through and poured into the peninsula, aiming toward Kerch and Sevastapol.
column2: 第XXX军(XXX Armeekorps)花了三天时间击退苏军的反击并恢复战线。随后，在克莱斯特(Kleist)第1装甲集团军支援下，第11集团军得以完成对苏军第9与第18集团军的合围。10 月 20 日，曼施坦因(Manstein)的部队接着进攻宽 5 英里的彼列科普地峡(Perekop Isthmus)，该地峡扼守通往克里米亚(Crimea)的门户；十天后他们突破防线，涌入半岛，目标指向刻赤(Kerch)与塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastapol)。

column1: The Leibstandarte was now transfered to the command of 1st Panzer Army, which was heading in the direction of Rostov.
column2: 警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)此时转隶第1装甲集团军(1st Panzer Army)，该集团军正向罗斯托夫(Rostov)方向前进。

column1: Even with the troubles of the first Russian winter, the Leibstandarte earned plaudits from several army commanders.  In a communique with Himmler, 3rd Panzer Cops commander Mackensen wrote "Every unit wants to have the Leibstandarte as its adjacent unit.  The units internal discipline, its refreshing eagerness, its cheerful enthusiasm, its unshakable calmness in a crisis and its toughness are examples to us all. This truly is an elite unit".
column2: 即便有俄国第一个冬天的种种困难，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)仍赢得了数位集团军司令的赞誉。在与希姆莱(Himmler)的一次通信中，第3装甲军(3rd Panzer Cops)军长马肯森(Mackensen)写道：「每个部队都希望警卫旗队做它的邻接部队。这支部队的内在纪律、令人耳目一新的进取心、欢快的热情、在危机中不可动摇的镇定以及它的坚韧，都是我们大家的榜样。这确实是一支精锐部队」。

column1: Whilst the Germans prepared Frühlingerwachen, the Soviets had their own plans - an attack aimed toward Vienna, to begin on 15th March.  Following the Gran bridgehead fighting however, the Soviets became aware of German intentions and were able to adapt their positions to meet it.  The Third Ukranian Front commander - where the Leibstandarte attack was positioned - reasoned that the Germans could be sufficiently weakened by the depth of the Soviet defences, for them to be able to launch their own attack.
column2: 当德军准备「春醒」行动时，苏军也有自己的计划——一次指向维也纳(Vienna)的进攻，定于 3 月 15 日开始。然而在格兰河(Gran)桥头堡战斗之后，苏军察觉到德军的意图，得以调整阵地加以应对。乌克兰第3方面军(Third Ukranian Front)司令——警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)的进攻正位于其地段——判断，德军的实力会被苏军防御的纵深充分削弱，从而让他们能够发动自己的进攻。
