德涅斯特河(Dniestr) (#1) - 1941 年 7 月 7 日

column1: The Romanians cross the Dniestr river invading the Soviet Union.
column2: 罗马尼亚人渡过德涅斯特河(Dniestr)，入侵苏联。

column1: General the Conducator Antonescu has a lot of expectations about you. He has selected you to lead the forces that will invade the Soviet Union. It is time to get even with the Soviets!!!
column2: 将军，领袖(Conducator)安东内斯库(Antonescu)对你期望很高。他选中你率领将入侵苏联的部队。是时候跟苏联人算总账了！！！

column1: General you have achieved a great victory!!! We can recover our lost territory!!!
column2: 将军，你取得了重大胜利！！！我们可以收复我们失去的领土了！！！

column1: General war is not for everybody. You will end up the war as a simple soldier. Pick up a rifle!!!
column2: 将军，战争不是谁都玩得起的。你将作为一名普通士兵打完这场战争。去拿起步枪吧！！！
敖德萨(Odessa) (#2) - 1941 年 10 月 14 日

column1: Romanian attack on the city of Odessa. Capital of the Transnistria region.
column2: 罗马尼亚对敖德萨(Odessa)城的进攻。该城是德涅斯特河沿岸(Transnistria)地区的首府。

column1: General the Germans have promised us all the territories up to the port of Odessa as a new province, Transnistria.  We need to go and occupy it. Let's show the Germans that we can be a helpful ally!!!\x00
column2: 将军，德国人已答应把直到敖德萨(Odessa)港的所有领土作为新省份——德涅斯特河沿岸(Transnistria)——给我们。我们需要去占领它。让我们向德国人证明我们能当一个有用的盟友！！！\x00

column1: General your wonderful victory has completed the liberation of our national territory!!! The conducator is very pleased with your performance !!!
column2: 将军，你的辉煌胜利完成了对我们国土的解放！！！领袖对你的表现非常满意！！！
米乌斯河(Mius River) (#3) - 1942 年 1 月 13 日

column1: The Soviets attack the German Army Group South.  The Romanians try to hold desperately their lines in the Mius river.
column2: 苏军进攻德国南方集团军群(Army Group South)。罗马尼亚人竭力守住他们在米乌斯河(Mius river)的战线。

column1: General the Soviets have taken the city of Rostov. The Army Group South has withdrawn to the line in the Mius river.  It is imperative we hold that line !!! You can buy some German equipment.  \x00
column2: 将军，苏军已夺取罗斯托夫(Rostov)城。南方集团军群(Army Group South)已撤至米乌斯河(Mius river)一线。我们必须守住这条防线！！！你可以购买一些德国装备。\x00

column1: General your not only stopped the Soviets at the Mius river, but also recovered Rostov !!!
column2: 将军，你不仅在米乌斯河(Mius river)挡住了苏军，还收复了罗斯托夫(Rostov)！！！
春季攻势(Spring Offensive) (#4) - 1942 年 5 月 13 日

column1: The German-Romanian army returns to the offensive on the Southern Soviet Union.  A premature Soviet attack on the Kharkov area allows a counterattack.
column2: 德罗联军在苏联南部重新转入攻势。苏军对哈尔科夫(Kharkov)地区的过早进攻使一次反击成为可能。

column1: General the Steppe Front has blundered into attacking us in the Kharkov area.  This is too good an opportunity to lose it !!! You should recover the initiative.  \x00
column2: 将军，草原方面军(Steppe Front)贸然在哈尔科夫(Kharkov)地区向我们发起进攻。这个机会太好了，不能放过！！！你应当夺回主动权。\x00

column1: General your victory is complete !!! You have taken Kharkov and expelled the Soviets from this part of Ukraine !!! The Donbass is open to us !!!
column2: 将军，你的胜利是彻底的！！！你夺取了哈尔科夫(Kharkov)，把苏军逐出了乌克兰(Ukraine)的这一部分！！！顿巴斯(Donbass)已向我们敞开！！！
塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol) (#5) - 1942 年 6 月 7 日

column1: The German-Romanian Army led by Feld-Marschall Von Manstein try to take the Soviet fortress of Sevastopol.
column2: 由冯·曼施坦因(Von Manstein)元帅率领的德罗联军试图夺取苏军要塞塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)。

column1: General You will command our units cooperating with the Germans in the siege of Sevastopol. We have to take the city to free our troops for the southern offensive. \x00
column2: 将军，你将指挥我军与德国人合作围攻塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)。我们必须拿下该城，以便腾出部队用于南面的攻势。\x00

column1: Great job, Commander! The missiles are neutralized, and we push towards Moscow! Let's hope Stalin doesn't have any more secret weapons...
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官！导弹已被摧毁，我们向莫斯科推进！希望斯大林没有更多秘密武器了……

column1: General You have achieved a complete victory !!! Now all the Crimea in in our hands !!!
column2: 将军，你取得了完全的胜利！！！现在整个克里米亚(Crimea)都在我们手中了！！！
格罗兹尼(Grozny) (#6) - 1942 年 9 月 7 日

column1: A German-Romanian army tries to capture Grozny in the Caucasus Mountains.
column2: 一支德罗联军试图夺取高加索山脉(Caucasus Mountains)中的格罗兹尼(Grozny)。

column1: General the Conducator has asked that our push toward the oild fields in Grozny and the Caucasus mountains be led by you.  You should leave the 4th Army and take command of the expeditionary force in the Caucasus.  We expect great things from you!!!
column2: 将军，领袖要求由你率领我们向格罗兹尼(Grozny)与高加索山脉(Caucasus mountains)油田的推进。你应当离开第4集团军，去指挥高加索的远征部队。我们对你期望很大！！！

column1: The Soviets attempt to break the German attack aimed at Kursk.
column2: 苏军试图打破德军指向库尔斯克(Kursk)的进攻。

column1: General the Conducator has asked that our push toward the oild fields in Grozny and the Caucasus mountains be led by you.  You should leave the 4th Army and take command of the expeditionary force in the Caucasus.  We expect great things from you !!!
column2: 将军，领袖要求由你率领我们向格罗兹尼(Grozny)与高加索山脉(Caucasus mountains)油田的推进。你应当离开第4集团军，去指挥高加索的远征部队。我们对你期望很大！！！

column1: General your wonderful victory against heavy odds has secure the oil of Grozny for us !!! The door to the Caucasus is open !!!
column2: 将军，你在敌众我寡的情况下取得的辉煌胜利为我们确保了格罗兹尼(Grozny)的石油！！！通往高加索(Caucasus)的大门敞开了！！！

column1: Great job Commander. Although Greece has fallen, those submarines have been destroyed along with a substantial portion of the garrison force in Greece.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。虽然希腊已经陷落，但那些潜艇以及希腊驻军的一大部分都已被消灭。
从莱姆里吉斯(Lyme Regis)到温莎(Windsor)
冬季风暴(Winter Storm) (#8) - 1943 年 1 月 9 日

column1: The 4th Romanian Army and a German Panzer Corps try to open land communication with the troops surrounded in Stalingrad.
column2: 罗马尼亚第4集团军与一个德国装甲军试图打通与被围在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)的部队的陆上联系。

column1: General Feld-Marschall Von Manstein is organizing a counterattack to relieve the German 6th Army. You have the strongest troops in the area. Report to Von Manstein and coordinate an immediate attack. It is imperative that Kalach is retaken and land communications are opened!!!\x00
column2: 将军，冯·曼施坦因(Von Manstein)元帅正在组织反击以解救德国第6集团军。你拥有该地区最强的部队。向冯·曼施坦因报到，并协调一次立即发起的进攻。必须夺回卡拉奇(Kalach)并打通陆上联系！！！\x00

column1: Generalyour wonderful victory has restored land communications with the 6th Army and our troops !!!
column2: 将军，你的辉煌胜利恢复了与第6集团军以及我军部队的陆上联系！！！
佩列科普(Perekop) (#9) - 1943 年 10 月 10 日

column1: The Soviet troops attack the city of Perekop to cut the land conmmunication between Ukraine and the Crimean peninsula.
column2: 苏军进攻佩列科普(Perekop)城，以切断乌克兰(Ukraine)与克里米亚半岛(Crimean peninsula)之间的陆上联系。

column1: General the Soviets are attacking the city of Perekop on the isthmus joining Crimea to the mainland. If they succeed most of our best troops will be lost.  Hold the town at whatever cost!!!\x00
column2: 将军，苏军正在进攻连接克里米亚(Crimea)与大陆的地峡上的佩列科普(Perekop)城。如果他们成功，我们大部分最精锐的部队都将损失。不惜一切代价守住该镇！！！\x00

column1: General you held the town and repulsed the Soviets!!!  Unfortunately a Soviet attack from Kerch has isolated our troops in Sevastopol.
column2: 将军，你守住了该镇，击退了苏军！！！遗憾的是，苏军从刻赤(Kerch)发起的进攻把我们塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的部队孤立了。
塞瓦斯托波尔撤退(Sevastopol Evacuation) - 1943 年 3 月 23 日

column1: The Axis troops try desperately to find a path to evacuate their troops isolated in the Crimea.
column2: 轴心国部队拼命寻找一条路径，以撤出被孤立在克里米亚(Crimea)的部队。

column1: General our troops situation in Sevastopol is desperate.  They are completly surrounded in the city of Sevastopol. You have to find an evacuation path. The Germans have cooperated with a small submarine fleet and some merchant ships. Good luck!!!
column2: 将军，我军在塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol)的处境已无望。他们被完全包围在塞瓦斯托波尔城内。你必须找到一条撤退路线。德国人已配合派出了一支小型潜艇舰队和一些商船。祝好运！！！

column1: Playing tip: You can always cross rivers using PORT hexes (use the
column2: 技巧：你随时可以利用（港口）格渡河（右键点击部队时使用

column1: Strategic Transport button when you right-click on a unit), from Yalta to Krasnodar. Infantry units can still move after landing.
column2: 「战略运输」按钮），从雅尔塔(Yalta)到克拉斯诺达尔(Krasnodar)。步兵单位登陆后仍可移动。

column1: General you succeeded in an impossible situation !!! You found a path and almost all our troops escaped.  They will live to fight another day !!!
column2: 将军，你在绝境中成功了！！！你找到了一条路径，我们几乎所有部队都逃脱了。他们会活下来，改日再战！！！
普洛耶什蒂(Ploesti) (#11) - 1944 年 6 月 5 日

column1: The Western Allieds launch a massive air attack against the Romanian oil installations at Ploesti.  Commando actions are coordinated with the air raid.
column2: 西方盟军对普洛耶什蒂(Ploesti)的罗马尼亚石油设施发动大规模空袭。突击队行动与空袭协同进行。

column1: General intelligence reports show that the Western Allies will try to destroy our oil installations in Ploesti.  They plan an attack with a massive air force plus paradrops and commando actions.  General an urgent message!!! The Americans have taken control of some local airfields under cover of a huge air fleet. You should intervene immediately!!!
column2: 将军，情报报告显示西方盟军将试图摧毁我们普洛耶什蒂(Ploesti)的石油设施。他们计划以庞大的空军加上空降与突击队行动发动进攻。将军，一份紧急消息！！！美国人在一支庞大机群的掩护下夺取了一些当地机场。你应当立即介入！！！

column1: General you have saved our oil installations. You have inflicted great losses to the Allies air forces plus destroying a good number of their best commando units.
column2: 将军，你保住了我们的石油设施。你给盟军空军造成了重大损失，还消灭了他们不少最精锐的突击队。
南乌克兰集团军群(Army Group Southern Ukraine) (#12) - 1944 年 8 月 7 日

column1: The II and III Ukrainian Fronts attack the Axis Southern Ukraine Army Group across the Dniestr river.  A Soviet victory will lead to the destruction of the Army Group and the occupation of Romania.
column2: 乌克兰第2与第3方面军(II and III Ukrainian Fronts)渡过德涅斯特河(Dniestr)进攻轴心国南乌克兰集团军群。苏军获胜将导致该集团军群被歼灭，罗马尼亚(Romania)被占领。

column1: General the Soviets are attacking with overwhelming superiority the Army Group Southern Ukraine. Our troops are demoralized and are escaping without a fight.  General Fiessner have asked that you take command of all our troops.  Many of the veterans of your victories during the Stalingrad and Crimea campaigns are there.  They will take heart if you are there to lead!!!\x00
column2: 将军，苏军正以压倒性优势进攻南乌克兰集团军群。我军士气低落，正不战而逃。菲斯纳(Fiessner)将军已请求由你指挥我们所有部队。你在斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)与克里米亚(Crimea)战役中取胜时的许多老兵都在那里。有你前去指挥，他们就会重拾信心！！！\x00

column1: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Lithuania and open the road to Germany itself at East Prussia! You will command the First Baltic Front!
column2: 将军同志：这是你把德国法西斯分子逐出立陶宛(Lithuania)、并在东普鲁士打开通往德国本土之路的机会！你将指挥波罗的海第1方面军(First Baltic Front)！

column1: General you stopped the Soviets and rallied our men !!! You have saved the Army Group and stop the invasion of our motherland!!!
column2: 将军，你挡住了苏军，重振了我军士气！！！你拯救了集团军群，阻止了对我们祖国的入侵！！！

column1: General you narrowly achieved victory and held the Soviets away from the border. A new goverment has taken charge in Bucharest!!! They have signed an armistice with the Soviets. Our country's destiny is unknown!!! Better do not return!!!
column2: 将军，你勉强取得胜利，把苏军挡在了边境之外。一个新政府已在布加勒斯特(Bucharest)掌权！！！他们已与苏联人签署停战协定。我们国家的命运未卜！！！你最好别回来！！！
喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian Mountains) (#13) - 1944 年 10 月 11 日

column1: The Romanians try desperately to close the mountain passes to the Red Army. A successful defense could save the country from invasion.
column2: 罗马尼亚人拼命封锁通往红军的山口。一次成功的防御或许能使国家免遭入侵。

column1: General King Michael has deposed Marshal Antonescu!!! A transition cabinet has taken the goverment !!! They have requested an armistice from the Soviets.  They have refused. The II Ukrainian Front is invading the country through the Carpathian Mountains. They plan to occupy us and terminate our independence !!! You should close the mountain passes before is too late!!!\x00
column2: 将军，米哈伊国王(King Michael)已废黜安东内斯库(Antonescu)元帅！！！一个过渡内阁已接管政府！！！他们已向苏联人请求停战。苏联人拒绝了。乌克兰第2方面军(II Ukrainian Front)正通过喀尔巴阡山脉(Carpathian Mountains)入侵我国。他们打算占领我们，终结我们的独立！！！你应当在为时已晚之前封锁各山口！！！\x00

column1: General your wonderful victory has completely closed the mountain passes to the Soviet troops !!! They will have to agree to an armistice now !!!
column2: 将军，你的辉煌胜利已彻底封锁了通往苏军部队的山口！！！他们现在只能同意停战了！！！

column1: The subs are at the bottom of the ocean. But now our men must recuperate from this shallow victory before we can proceed to our next objective.
column2: 潜艇已经沉到海底。但现在我们必须从这场惨胜中恢复过来，然后才能着手下一个目标。
匈牙利平原(Hungarian Plains) (#14) - 1944 年 12 月 11 日

column1: The Romanians invade Hungary alongside the Red Army.  They are trying to settle old feuds with the Hungarians.
column2: 罗马尼亚人随红军一起入侵匈牙利(Hungary)。他们试图了结与匈牙利人的旧怨。

column1: General the Soviets have made many concessions and an alliance has been established. You have been selected to lead our 4th Army in the invasion of Hungary. It is time to settle old scores with the Hungarians. Good luck!!!
column2: 将军，苏联人已作出许多让步，同盟已经建立。你被选中率领我们的第4集团军入侵匈牙利(Hungary)。是时候跟匈牙利人清算了结旧账了。祝好运！！！

column1: Field Marshal you have achieved a complete victory!!! Your great victory has earned the respect of the Soviets!!! We can expect an independent Romania to emerge from the war!!! You have earned the gratitude of your country forever!!!
column2: 元帅，你取得了完全的胜利！！！你的重大胜利赢得了苏联人的尊重！！！我们可以指望一个独立的罗马尼亚从这场战争中浮现！！！你赢得了你国家永远的感激！！！
瓦尔塔河(Warta River)（不可通行）
施普雷河(Spree River)（不可通行）

column1: Comrade General Feld-Marschall von Manstein is attacking in great force to release the surrounding forces at Stalingrad! We need to stop them before is too late! You should take command of the Fifty First Army the only force in their path. The Second Guard Army will join you as soon as possible!
column2: 将军同志，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)元帅正以强大兵力进攻，以解救斯大林格勒(Stalingrad)被围的部队！我们必须在为时已晚之前挡住他们！你应当接管第51集团军(Fifty First Army)——他们路上唯一的部队。第2近卫集团军(Second Guard Army)将尽快与你会合！

column1: Comrade General you failed to stop the Germans at the Myshkova! Marshall Zhukov have decided to flank them by adestrying the Eigth Italian Army covering the Don river. Do not fail us again or you will feel Vassiliev's wrath! Kotelnikovo is your objective!
column2: 将军同志，你未能在梅什科瓦河(Myshkova)挡住德军！朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅已决定通过歼灭掩护顿河的意大利第8集团军(Eigth Italian Army)来迂回他们。不要再让我们失望，否则你会尝到瓦西里耶夫(Vassiliev)的怒火！科捷利尼科沃(Kotelnikovo)是你的目标！

column1: Comrade General Feld-Marschall von Manstein is attacking in great force our forces trying to reach the Dnieper crossings! Karkhov recently liberated is threatened again! You shoul take command and stop the German counterattack!
column2: 将军同志，冯·曼施坦因(von Manstein)元帅正以强大兵力进攻我军，试图抵达第聂伯河(Dnieper)各渡口！刚刚解放的哈尔科夫(Karkhov)再次受到威胁！你应当接管指挥，挡住德军的反击！

column1: The people celebrates your recent victory ! Time is needed to rebuild those installations, this time is long enough for us to destroy them.
column2: 人民在庆祝你最近的胜利！重建那些设施需要时间，而这段时间足够我们摧毁它们。

column1: You did it Commander.  We got what we came for. You've done a fine job for us.  It's time to go home.  You've done your country proud.  Here, have a cigar! See you stateside.
column2: 你做到了，指挥官。我们得到了我们想要的东西。你为我们干得很出色。该回家了。你为你的国家争了光。来，抽支雪茄！回国见。

column1: Comrade General you have disrupted completely the German plans by forcing the river and establishing a big beachhead on the right bank of the Dnepr river.
column2: 将军同志，你强渡大河并在第聂伯河(Dnepr river)右岸建立了一个大桥头堡，彻底打乱了德军的计划。

column1: Congratulations, once more time you've demonstrated your skills.
column2: 恭喜，你又一次展示了你的本领。

column1: Our Italian friends thank you for your assitance. The British have been hit again.
column2: 我们的意大利朋友感谢你的协助。英国人又挨了一顿打。

column1: Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! You have recovered most of Lithuania and crossed the German border!!!
column2: 将军同志：斯大林同志对你的表现非常满意！！！你收复了立陶宛(Lithuania)的大部分，并越过了德国边境！！！

column1: Comrade General: You have liberated Kiev the Ukrainian capital. We should complete the liberation of the Ukraine and push the Germans from Russian territory!
column2: 将军同志：你解放了乌克兰(Ukraine)首都基辅(Kiev)。我们应当完成乌克兰的解放，把德国人赶出俄国领土！

column1: Comrade General: You have taken Kiev the Ukrainian capital. Your indecision has allowed the Germans to withdraw most of their troops though. Yopu have to do better than that Comrade!
column2: 将军同志：你夺取了乌克兰(Ukraine)首都基辅(Kiev)。然而你的犹豫不决让德国人撤走了大部分部队。同志，你得做得更好才行！

column1: Led by American forces, the United Nations attempt to halt the People's Republic of China in South East Asia then continue to free the Chinese 'satellites.'
column2: 在美国(America)带领下，联合国(United Nations)试图在东南亚(South East Asia)阻止中华人民共和国(People's Republic of China)，随后继续「解放」中国的那些「卫星国」。
西西里(Sicily) - 1945 年 11 月 15 日

column1: Comrade! we have a critical situation! we've been removed a large amount of equipment from Italy without realizing that the allies were preparing a massive counter-attack.
column2: 同志！我们的处境十分危急！我们在没有意识到盟军正筹备大规模反击的情况下，从意大利撤走了大量装备。

column1: You are the nearest General with available troops, your mission is stop that offensive, otherwise our rearguard will be exposed.
column2: 你是附近唯一拥有可用部队的将军，你的任务是阻止那次攻势，否则我们的后卫部队将暴露无遗。

column1: General, we have appreciated your heroic efforts to stop that offensive.
column2: 将军，我们感谢你为阻止那次攻势所做的英勇努力。

column1: After their defeat, the allies will not surrender.
column2: 盟军在被击败后仍不会投降。

column1: Comrade Stalin wants to invade Great Britain.
column2: 斯大林同志想入侵大不列颠(Great Britain)。
梅斯(Metz) - 1945 年 12 月 12 日

column1: Comrade, you have begun the invasion of France, your goal is to take the fortified city of Metz.
column2: 同志，你已开始入侵法国，你的目标是夺取设防城市梅斯(Metz)。

column1: Intelligence data confirm the arrival of an Allied contingent.
column2: 情报数据证实一支盟军分遣队已经到达。

column1: Excellent!! our objectives has been completed, now begins the hard part of the operation.
column2: 太好了！！我们的目标已经完成，现在开始行动中最艰难的部分。

column1: Comrade, this brilliant victory was achieved due to the superiority of Communism over the Nazism. Now we shall pursue these scums to the Berlin and liberate the working people in the whole Europe!
column2: 同志，这场辉煌的胜利之所以取得，是因为共产主义对纳粹主义的优越。现在我们要追击这些渣滓直到柏林(Berlin)，解放全欧洲的劳动人民！

column1: This is the end, try to escape anywhere while you can, before the allies turns you into a prisoner of war.
column2: 这是结局，趁还能跑就赶紧逃吧，别等盟军把你变成战俘。

column1: Comrade, we have put the Allies in a corner against the coast, now we have to hurry up to avoid the mistake that the Nazis made.
column2: 同志，我们已把盟军逼到海岸边的一个角落里，现在我们得加快行动，以免犯下纳粹犯过的错误。
卡昂(Caen) - 1946 年 2 月 8 日

column1: France is falling in front of us. We have broken the country in two, and practically the victory couldn't resist us, however one more time the Allies are sending their troops in a stupid attempt to stop us... One more time, the socialism will give them a lesson leading to the conquest of France.
column2: 法国正在我们面前倒下。我们已把这个国家一分为二，胜利几乎不可能抗拒我们，然而盟军又一次把他们的部队派来，愚蠢地试图阻止我们……社会主义将再一次给他们一个教训，导向对法国的征服。

column1: After the conquest of Attu, we could say the US navy has been almost destroyed. Now we will capture a military base in Alaska in order to have a beachhead to start the invasion of the mainland.
column2: 攻占阿图岛(Attu)之后，我们可以说美国海军几乎已被摧毁。现在我们将夺取阿拉斯加(Alaska)的一处军事基地，以便取得一个开始入侵大陆的桥头堡。

column1: The Allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible treachery for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia.
column2: 盟军已摧毁你的部队。这对我们的人民、对苏联共产党(PCUS)、对斯大林都是一场可怕的背叛。你的下一个目的地是西伯利亚(Siberia)。

column1: Finally, we have accomplished our objectives. The enemies fought very well, but they couldn't stop us.
column2: 我们终于完成了目标。敌人打得很出色，但他们没能挡住我们。
巴塞罗那(Barcelona) - 1946 年 3 月 18 日

column1: Comrade, after the conquest of France, we couldn't forget Spain, which is an important strategical point, but is an very important political objective. The illegal goverment has been established after the criminal war started in 1936 by the fascists with "counselors" sent by Germany which aimed at destroying our motherland. Our mission here is to conquer this important way to the Mediterranean sea and to liberate Spain from the fascism. Good Luck, comrade.
column2: 同志，在征服法国之后，我们不能忘记西班牙，它是一个重要的战略据点，更是一个极为重要的政治目标。那个非法政府是在 1936 年法西斯分子在德国派来的「顾问」帮助下发动罪恶战争之后建立起来的，其目的就是摧毁我们的祖国。我们在这里的任务是征服这条通往地中海(Mediterranean sea)的重要通道，把西班牙从法西斯主义下解放出来。祝好运，同志。

column1: That was a little too close for my liking general.
column2: 那对我来说有点太近了，将军。

column1: Our only chance is to move west faster than Ivan can respond.  Pick up
column2: 我们唯一的机会是向西推进得比伊万(Ivan)反应得更快。加快

column1: Well, what about being a captain now? We have always claimed you had been the traitor of the Rodina...
column2: 那么，现在当个上尉怎么样？我们一直都说你是祖国的叛徒……

column1: Congratulations, Commander.  Your capture of Pantelleria has opened the way to Sicily. Now we will attack the enemy in his homeland!
column2: 恭喜，指挥官。你夺取潘泰莱里亚(Pantelleria)打开了通往西西里(Sicily)的道路。现在我们要在敌人的本土进攻他们了！
红狮行动(Red Lion) - 1946 年 4 月 1 日

column1: Good Morning comrade. With all the French ports under our control, it's time to cross the English Channel and pursuit the British in their homeland. General Zhukov and his troops will join you in order to invade the South England area. Stavka have designed a special operation to incur a minimum number of casualities. You must follow these steps;
column2: 早上好，同志。所有法国港口都在我们控制之下，现在是时候渡过英吉利海峡，追击英国人直到他们的本土了。朱可夫(Zhukov)将军及其部队将与你一起入侵英格兰南部。最高统帅部(Stavka)设计了一次特殊行动，以把伤亡降到最低。你必须遵循以下步骤；

column1: A) At first, you must destroy the allied fleet on the Channel, our fleet will arrive from the Baltic to accomplish this task. Soviet submarines recently developed may strongly help you. Be aware that if you try to drive your troops without sunking the enemy fleet, they will destroy your troops.
column2: A) 首先，你必须摧毁海峡上的盟军舰队，我们的舰队将从波罗的海(Baltic)前来完成这项任务。苏联最近研制的潜艇可能会给你很大帮助。要注意，如果你不击沉敌方舰队就驱兵前进，他们会摧毁你的部队。

column1: B) The enemy resistance on the other side of the Channel will be very strong, you must plan your steps, in order to win.
column2: B) 海峡对岸的敌军抵抗将非常顽强，为了取胜，你必须规划好你的步骤。

column1: Playing tip: (1) place amphibious ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops whenever you want (one unique ship can deploy your whole army). (2) It is also possible to move ground units from PORT to PORT hexes using the strategic transport option when right-clicking on a sea liftable unit. (3) It is also possible to make an extensive use of paratroops.
column2: 技巧：(1) 把两栖舰船放在与海岸相邻的任意格上，以便随时部署你的部队（一艘船就能部署你的整支军队）。(2) 右键点击可海运单位时，使用战略运输选项也可以把地面部队从（港口）格移动到（港口）格。(3) 也可以大量使用伞兵。

column1: Perfect, the weapon has been destroyed, and now we have the information about their construction, ...  Now, its time to attack the USA mainland!. Good times are waiting for the socialism!
column2: 太好了，那件武器已被摧毁，现在我们掌握了关于它们制造的情报，…… 现在，是时候进攻美国本土了！好日子正等着社会主义！

column1: As we expected this battle has finished with our victory. The Brits are rookies when driving armored divisions.
column2: 正如我们所料，这场战斗以我们的胜利告终。英国人在指挥装甲师方面还是新手。
伦敦(London) - 1946 年 4 月 30 日

column1: The disembark has been succesful, but now we've reached the heart of the British Empire: London. I am sure that the red flag will look very well in the top of the Big Ben. Churchill and the Royal Family have escaped from the country, and they are travelling to Canada, the British moral is broken, but it will not avoid a furious fight on the suburbs of London. Good Luck... you will need it.
column2: 登陆成功了，但我们现在已抵达大英帝国(British Empire)的心脏：伦敦(London)。我确信红旗挂在大本钟(Big Ben)顶上会非常好看。丘吉尔(Churchill)与王室已逃离这个国家，正在前往加拿大(Canada)，英国人的士气已经崩溃，但这仍无法避免在伦敦郊区的一场狂怒战斗。祝好运……你会需要它的。

column1: This is today the greatest victory for Comunism, comrade...
column2: 这是当今共产主义最伟大的胜利，同志……

column1: Well, your performance was lower that we had initially expected, anyway, you will receive much prestige to buy new transports. We know that it isn't enough, but our supply line was seriously blocked due to your delay.
column2: 嗯，你的表现低于我们最初的预期，不过你还是会获得大量威望来购买新的运输工具。我们知道这不够，但由于你的延误，我们的补给线被严重切断了。

column1: The Germans have pushed us back.  We will be lucky if we can hold Antwerp. The war may still be lost!  You are ordered back to London where you will face a firing squad!
column2: 德国人把我们打退了。能守住安特卫普(Antwerp)就算我们运气好。这场战争可能还是会输！兹命令你返回伦敦(London)，你将在那里面对行刑队！
符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok) - 1946 年 6 月 1 日

column1: Comrade, our victories have blinded us from the Allies plans of an invasion from the east.
column2: 同志，我们的胜利让我们看不见盟军从东面入侵的计划。

column1: We know that your army is tired, but the Americans are preparing an invasion to Vladivostok, and we have to stop it at all cost.
column2: 我们知道你的部队已经很疲惫，但美国人正在筹备入侵符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)，我们必须不惜一切代价阻止它。

column1: US Forces drive into the Southern Flank of the Soviet advance
column2: 美军部队突入苏军推进的南翼
萨哈林(Sakhalin)：「恩格斯」行动 - 1946 年 12 月 7 日

column1: They tried (cowardly) to attack our motherland with a ridiculous invasion, but they couldn't did it. North American troops are trapped in the island of Sakhalin, which Americans thought using as a base to manage the invasion. STAVKA has designed a operation to free Sakhalin and to capture the invaders, maybe we could destroy the Americans Pacific Fleet, that is anchoraged near to Poronask.
column2: 他们（怯懦地）试图以一次可笑的入侵进攻我们的祖国，但没能得逞。北美部队被困在萨哈林岛(Sakhalin)上，美国人原本想把它当作指挥入侵的基地。最高统帅部已设计了一次行动，以解放萨哈林并俘获入侵者，也许我们还能摧毁锚泊在波罗奈斯克(Poronask)附近的美国太平洋舰队。

column1: You must follow the next steps, comrade:
column2: 你必须遵循以下步骤，同志：

column1: A) Soviet troops have disembarked towards the South-West of the island, pursueing the remaining north American troops from Vladivostok. You must destroy those troops.
column2: A) 苏军部队已在岛屿西南部登陆，从符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)追击剩余的北美部队。你必须消灭那些部队。

column1: B) Reinforcements of our comrades paratroopers will arrive from the north. With the paratroopers and with the help of one division of mountain troops, you must take the airport to the north. You can deploy troops via the reinforced mobile army HQ units, protect them!
column2: B) 我们同志中的伞兵增援将从北面到达。有了伞兵以及一个山地师的帮助，你必须夺取北面的机场。你可以通过得到加强的机动集团军司令部单位部署部队，保护好它们！

column1: The American presence in our motherland has been eliminated with one hit. I am sure that they won't try any more similar thing. Good work!
column2: 美国人在我们祖国的存在被一击清除。我确信他们不会再尝试类似的事情了。干得好！

column1: Well done, Commander. You've got the Krauts high-tailing it back to the fatherland. Looks like you might get another star for this one. Good job son.
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你让德国佬灰溜溜地逃回他们的本土去了。看来你这次又能添一颗星了。干得好，孩子。

column1: The Allied forces attempt to breakout in Normandy against the Germans.
column2: 盟军部队试图在诺曼底(Normandy)对德军实施突围。

column1: Commander, you are losing our prestige to the world, the situation is so critical that we have no choice and we have to defend Moscow.
column2: 指挥官，你正让我国在世界面前失去威望，局势如此危急，我们别无选择，只能保卫莫斯科(Moscow)。
柏林(Berlin) - 1945 年 5 月 8 日

column1: Good Day, this is the situation: Patton has archieve his goals and now is marching on Berlin, you have two new divisions to stop the allies, you will receive heavy reinforcements from the north.
column2: 你好，情况是这样：巴顿(Patton)已达成他的目标，现在正向柏林(Berlin)进军，你有两个新师可以挡住盟军，你还将从北面获得大量增援。
北海道(Hokkaido) - 1946 年 6 月 30 日

column1: Our next step on the Pacific is in front of us. The north Americans are reagrouping troops in their Japanese bases. Japan is basically an American military colony after the US victory over this country. Our agents have provided us some informations, such as the remaning ships from the US navy are on the area. The Chinese comunist leader, Mao-Tse-Tung may help us in the first step of our plans in Japan with some chinese troops, with some equipment that we've sent them.
column2: 我们在太平洋的下一步就在眼前。北美部队正在他们在日本的基地里重新集结。在美国战胜这个国家之后，日本基本上成了美国的军事殖民地。我们的特工提供了一些情报，比如美国海军剩余的舰船就在这一地区。中国共产主义领袖毛泽东(Mao-Tse-Tung)可能会用一些中国部队，以及我们送给他们的一些装备，帮助我们实现在日本计划的第一步。

column1: Playing tip: move transport ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops (one single ship can disembark all your units).
column2: 技巧：把运输船移动到与海岸相邻的任意格上，以便部署你的部队（一艘船就能让所有单位登陆）。
中国 GAZ/Quad 高射机枪

column1: Very good work comrade!, a beachhead has been established in Hokkaido, now we can drive to Tokyo. This time we'll put the red flag in Hiro Hito's Imperial Palace.
column2: 干得非常好，同志！北海道(Hokkaido)已经建立了桥头堡，现在我们可以向东京(Tokyo)推进了。这次我们要把红旗插到裕仁(Hiro Hito)的皇宫上。
潘泰莱里亚岛(Isola di Pantelleria)

column1: Impressive comrade!!!, we've destroyed the capitalist invader!!!. I am sure the Finnish will welcom the new socialist goverment that we'll establish in Finland...
column2: 了不起，同志！！！我们消灭了资本主义入侵者！！！我确信芬兰人会欢迎我们将在芬兰建立的新社会主义政府……
东京(Tokyo) - 1946 年 7 月 7 日

column1: Comrade, this is the last stand in Tokyo. The enemy is regrouping his troops in the Japanese capital, Tokyo. The main Japanese island is enclosed by our submarines, the yankees only can receive reinforcements from the south. This will be the final blow for the Americans in Japan.
column2: 同志，这是东京(Tokyo)的最后抵抗。敌人正在日本首都东京重新集结部队。日本主岛已被我们的潜艇封锁，美国佬只能从南面获得增援。这将是给在日本的美国人的最后一击。

column1: Finally, we have accomplished our objectives. The enemy fought very well, but he couldn't stop us.
column2: 我们终于完成了目标。敌人打得很出色，但他没能挡住我们。
阿留申群岛(Aleutian Islands) - 1946 年 8 月 6 日

column1: Stalin has ordered to invade the USA, in revenge for the cowardly invasion they did in Vladivostok. After their losses on the Pacific, US navy became weak, and the remaining north American troops in all the world are in the way to defend the USA's mainland. Firstly, our amphibious forces may attack the Aleoutians, that we will use as a base for future attacks on the USA west coast. Your mission is to manage this special amphibious Soviet forces.
column2: 斯大林已下令入侵美国，以报复他们在符拉迪沃斯托克(Vladivostok)的可耻入侵。在太平洋遭受损失后，美国海军变得虚弱，散布在世界各地的剩余北美部队都在赶去保卫美国本土。首先，我们的两栖部队可以进攻阿留申群岛(Aleoutians)，我们将把它用作未来进攻美国西海岸的基地。你的任务是掌管这支特殊的苏联两栖部队。

column1: After the conquest of Attu, we could say the US navy has been almost destroyed. Now we will take a militar base in Alaska in order to have a beachhead to start the invasion of the mainland.
column2: 攻占阿图岛(Attu)之后，我们可以说美国海军几乎已被摧毁。现在我们将在阿拉斯加(Alaska)夺取一处军事基地，以便取得一个开始入侵大陆的桥头堡。

column1: The yankees are waiting us on San Francisco, but in truth we'll disembark in Los Angeles and surprise them. After around a hundred years, north Americans will have the war in their own homeland. Our paratroopers have landed in a place named "Hollywood" in order to capture a nearly airport. Your mission is to disembark your troops and make a beachhead, and later, take the big city of Los Angeles. Be aware, if our comrades paratroopers fall, our mission will be a failure.
column2: 美国佬正在旧金山(San Francisco)等着我们，但实际上我们将在洛杉矶(Los Angeles)登陆，打他们一个措手不及。大约一百年之后，北美将在自己的本土上经历战争。我们的伞兵已在一个叫「好莱坞」(Hollywood)的地方降落，以夺取一座近便的机场。你的任务是让部队登陆并建立桥头堡，然后夺取洛杉矶(Los Angeles)这座大城市。注意，如果我们的伞兵同志失败，我们的行动就会失败。

column1: Comrade... all the socialist world is celebrating this victory... without any enemy in the Pacific, we'll use Los Angeles as a base for the invasion of the remaining US states...
column2: 同志……整个社会主义世界都在庆祝这场胜利……太平洋上再无敌人，我们将把洛杉矶(Los Angeles)作为入侵美国其余各州的基地……

column1: This is not possible! Comrade Stalin has been killed, and the Soviet Union is totally under chaos.
column2: 这不可能！斯大林(Stalin)同志被杀害了，苏联完全陷入混乱。

column1: We have made a peace agreement in poor conditions with the Americans.
column2: 我们在恶劣条件下与美国达成了和平协议。
刺杀斯大林(Stalin)的企图 - 1946 年 9 月 8 日

column1: General, the Americans are trying their last revenge to defeat us.
column2: 将军，美国人正在为打败我们进行他们最后的报复。

column1: Intelligence reports are showing that an attack to the Kremblin is expected with the idea to kill Comrade Josef Stalin himself, "the little father of Peoples".
column2: 情报报告显示，有人预期会对克里姆林宫(Kremblin)发动一次袭击，目的是刺杀约瑟夫·斯大林(Josef Stalin)同志本人——「各族人民的小父亲」。

column1: Your mission will be to prevent this attack and to locate the place where terrorists took radio contact with Yankees. You are allowed to deploy only two of your best units. Fly to Moscow at once! Once captured bring traitors to the Lubyanka for interrogation purposes. Failure is not an option. Dismissed comrade General!
column2: 你的任务将是阻止这次袭击，并查明恐怖分子与美国佬进行无线电联络的地点。你只被允许部署你最好的两个单位。立即飞往莫斯科(Moscow)！一旦抓获，就把叛徒带到卢比扬卡(Lubyanka)审讯。失败不是选项。解散，将军同志！

column1: Playing tip : (1) Protect the Kremlin at all costs (2) Poke around forests south of Moscow to discover the HQ (sole hidden VH) where traitors are hiding.
column2: 技巧：(1) 不惜一切代价保护克里姆林宫(Kremlin) (2) 在莫斯科(Moscow)以南的森林里搜索，找出叛徒藏身的司令部（唯一的隐蔽胜利格）。
芝加哥(Chicago) - 1946 年 9 月 24 日

column1: Greetings Comrade, the Americans didn´t expected a fast advance of our armies, so their units are well covered, but poorly defended.
column2: 你好，同志，美国人没料到我们部队推进得这么快，所以他们的部队掩护良好，但防御薄弱。

column1: Your assignment will be to attack the industrial complex of Chicago and to prevent the Americans from using one of their main production centers.
column2: 你的任务将是进攻芝加哥(Chicago)的工业综合体，阻止美国人使用他们的一个主要生产中心。

column1: Take advantange of this surprise advance and take easily the city.
column2: 利用这次突袭推进，轻松夺取该城。

column1: Commander, you barely escaped disaster. We need commanders who can win decisively. You will be reassigned to our infantry training center as permanent latrine orderly!
column2: 指挥官，你险些遭遇灾难。我们需要能决定性取胜的指挥官。你将被重新分配到我们的步兵训练中心，担任永久性厕所勤务兵！
华盛顿(Washington) - 1946 年 11 月 1 日

column1: General, the time has come to our last target, the attack to the capital city.
column2: 将军，时候到了，我们的最后目标是进攻首都。

column1: Remember that our troops in America are limited, don´t try a direct attack to the center.
column2: 记住，我们在美国的部队有限，不要试图直接进攻市中心。

column1: Destroy patiently the defenses to avoid massive casualities.
column2: 耐心地摧毁防御，避免大量伤亡。

column1: Beware of any special weapon Yankees tested in Dutch Harbour...
column2: 当心美国佬在荷兰港(Dutch Harbour)试验过的任何特殊武器……

column1: The absolute glory depend of you.

Playing tip: (1) Use also Battleship "Moscow" to debark your core forces (the ship stands on a supply hex). (2) Use strategic transport button by right clicking on a unit in order to move it from PORT to PORT hexes (Queenstown to Annapolis) provided that no enemy unit stands between the ports.
column2: 技巧：(1) 也可以用战列舰「莫斯科」号(Battleship "Moscow")让核心部队下船（该舰停在一个补给格上）。(2) 右键点击部队，使用战略运输按钮，把它从（港口）格移动到（港口）格（从皇后镇(Queenstown)到安纳波利斯(Annapolis)），前提是两港之间没有敌军部队。
莫斯科(Moscow) - 1946 年 7 月 2 日

column1: Comrade, we have a hard situation, the allies surround Moscow and Stalin won´t escape.
column2: 同志，我们的处境艰难，盟军包围了莫斯科(Moscow)，斯大林逃不掉了。

column1: You must reach Moscow and kill everyone at your advance.
column2: 你必须抵达莫斯科(Moscow)，并在推进中杀掉每一个人。

column1: Comrade, things back to normal in Moscow, and the allies propose us a decent peace agreement if we give them Stalin... After all, Stalin isn´t the brillant leader that we´ve thought.
column2: 同志，莫斯科(Moscow)的局势恢复正常了，如果我们把斯大林交给他们，盟军就愿意给我们一份体面的和平协议……毕竟，斯大林并不像我们以为的那样是位英明领袖。

column1: Okay, Commander, here's the deal.  We've been here for two months now.  We've got to push the Krauts out of Metz.  Once we've done that, we can smash through the Maginot Line and drive into Germany.  I'm counting on you and your men.  Good luck.
column2: 好，指挥官，事情是这样。我们到这里已经两个月了。我们必须把德国佬赶出梅斯(Metz)。一旦做到，我们就能突破马奇诺防线(Maginot Line)，直入德国。我指望你和你的部下。祝好运。

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the French path.
column2: 同志，你选择了法国路线。
奥地利(Austria) - 1945 年 5 月 18 日

column1: Comrade, we have information that the "allies" are moving equipment in order to surround us in Germany.
column2: 同志，我们得到情报，「盟国」正在调动装备，以便在德国包围我们。

column1: Your mission will be the destruction of this movement to protect our rearguard.
column2: 你的任务将是破坏这次调动，以保护我们的后卫。

column1: Excellent Comrade, you got control the front and eliminate the allies source, now is time to extend the soviet frontier.
column2: 太好了，同志，你控制了前线并消灭了盟军的来源，现在是时候扩展苏联的边界了。
选择 2(Choice 2) - 1946 年 10 月 2 日

column1: General, after so many fights, Comrade Stalin himself will ask you about your next assignment.
column2: 将军，经过这么多战斗之后，斯大林同志本人将亲自问你下一个任务。
辉煌胜利：入侵西班牙（简单）

column1: V or TV : Invasion of Great Britain (hard), codenamed "Red Lion"
column2: 胜利或战术胜利：入侵大不列颠（困难），代号「红狮」

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the Spanish path.
column2: 同志，你选择了西班牙路线。

column1: Comrade, you have chosen the British path.
column2: 同志，你选择了英国路线。
喀山(Kazan) - 1946 年 6 月 15 日

column1: Comrade, here there are the Americans, I know that wasn´t easy to escape from their hands, but beyond the river, we have a heavy defense line.
column2: 同志，美国人到这里了，我知道从他们手里逃出来不容易，但河对岸我们有一道坚固的防线。

column1: Your assignment will be to merge your units to that defense line and to destroy those bastards.\x00
column2: 你的任务将是把你的部队并入那道防线，并消灭那些混蛋。\x00
破坏行动(Sabotage) - 1945 年 5 月 15 日

column1: Since you are one of the best and experimented officers, you have been selected
column2: 由于你是最优秀、最有经验的军官之一，你被选中

column1: to a special assignment. As you know, the United States had launched two atomic bombs over Japan.
column2: 执行一项特殊任务。如你所知，美国在日本投下了两颗原子弹。

column1: The Japanese had their "reward", but this might happen to us too.
column2: 日本人得到了他们的「回报」，但这种事也可能发生在我们身上。

column1: Our spies have discovered the secret atomic bomb production center, your mission is to destroy it.
column2: 我们的间谍发现了秘密原子弹生产中心，你的任务是摧毁它。

column1: We have a plan, use the first group of spies to attract the attention in order to leave their base with less defenses, and with the second group cut the fence and destroy the installations.
column2: 我们有一个计划：用第一组间谍吸引注意力，使他们基地的防御变弱，再由第二组剪断围栏并摧毁设施。

column1: The future of the Soviet Union depends on you Comrade General!
column2: 苏联的未来取决于你，将军同志！
荷兰港(Dutch Harbour) - 1946 年 8 月 10 日

column1: Comrade, after our first victory in the Aleoutians, we have received some informations from our spies on the Military base in Dutch Harbour (Alaska): the Yankees aided by some German scientists, are designing a horrible weapon, capable to reach our motherland on one shot. STAVKA has marked the possible zone where the weapon is hidden by the Yankees. Our spies are a group of guards, dissidents from the capitalist system. You can identify him by his grey mark. STAVKA will be pleased if you save him, because the enemies have discovered that they are sending us informations. We don't know if the weapon is ready for shot... be aware.
column2: 同志，在阿留申群岛(Aleoutians)取得首次胜利之后，我们从间谍那里收到一些关于荷兰港(Dutch Harbour)（阿拉斯加(Alaska)）军事基地的情报：美国佬在一些德国科学家的协助下，正在设计一种可怕的武器，能够一发打到我们的祖国。最高统帅部已标出美国佬藏匿这件武器的可能区域。我们的间谍是一群卫兵，是资本主义制度的异见者。你可以凭他的灰色标记认出他。如果你能救他，最高统帅部会很高兴，因为敌人已经发现他们在给我们送情报。我们不知道这件武器是否已能发射……要当心。

column1: Playing tip : (1) move transport ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops (one single ship can disembark all your units). (2) When attempting to conquer the last VH on the island, move sea transportable units from PORT to PORT hexes using "strategic transport" button when right clicking on a unit from a PORT.
column2: 技巧：(1) 把运输船移动到与海岸相邻的任意格上，以便部署你的部队（一艘船就能让所有单位登陆）。(2) 在试图夺取岛上最后一个胜利格时，从（港口）格右键点击部队，用「战略运输」按钮把可海运单位从（港口）格移动到（港口）格。

column1: Perfect, the weapon has been destroyed, and now we have the information about their construction, ...  Now, its time to attack the USA mainland! Good times are waiting for the socialism!
column2: 太好了，那件武器已被摧毁，现在我们掌握了关于它们制造的情报，…… 现在，是时候进攻美国本土了！好日子正等着社会主义！

column1: General, this triumph is a fitting end to the war. Hitler is destroyed and the world cheers your victory. Your name is mentioned everywhere. Some say you may become the next Prime Minister!
column2: 将军，这场胜利是这场战争恰如其分的结局。希特勒已被摧毁，世界为你的胜利欢呼。你的名字到处被提起。有人说你可能会成为下一任首相！
纽约 46(New York 46) - 1946 年 11 月 12 日

column1: Some US old guard generals refuse to surrender to the Soviet forces. Those generals are trying to keep alive the flame of the resistance in the formerly World Capital: New York. STAVKA cannot tolerate this and prepares a powerful offensive to defeat the last resistance pocket in North America.
column2: 一些美国老派将领拒绝向苏军投降。这些将军正试图在原世界首都纽约(New York)让抵抗之火继续燃烧。最高统帅部无法容忍这一点，正筹备一次强大攻势，以击败北美最后的抵抗包围圈。

column1: The Soviet "Pensylvanya Front" is attacking from the North, and it's already smashing the US defenses in the "Queens" quarter, while forces from the "NY Front" are heading to overrun the pocket of Brooklyn and then, join the forces coming from the North in order to cross the East river and smash the whole Manhattan, where the resistance will surely be even harder.
column2: 苏联「宾夕法尼亚方面军」(Pensylvanya Front)正从北面进攻，已经粉碎了「皇后区」(Queens)的美军防御，而「纽约方面军」(NY Front)的部队正向布鲁克林(Brooklyn)包围圈压去，随后将与从北面来的部队会合，渡过东河(East river)，粉碎整个曼哈顿(Manhattan)，那里的抵抗肯定会更加顽强。

column1: Can the Red Flag be installed on the Statue of Liberty and Wall Street ?
column2: 红旗能插上自由女神像(Statue of Liberty)与华尔街(Wall Street)吗？

column1: (1) place amphibious ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops whenever you want (one unique ship can deploy your whole army).
column2: (1) 把两栖舰船放在与海岸相邻的任意格上，以便随时部署你的部队（一艘船就能部署你的整支军队）。

column1: (2) It is also possible to move ground units from PORT to PORT hexes using the strategic transport option when right-clicking on a sea liftable unit.
column2: (2) 右键点击可海运单位时，使用战略运输选项也可以把地面部队从（港口）格移动到（港口）格。

column1: (3) Use paratroops or Specnaz to conquer the Statue of Liberty.\x00
column2: (3) 使用伞兵或特种部队(Specnaz)夺取自由女神像(Statue of Liberty)。\x00

column1: Commander, to have come so far at such cost, and then to have failed is utterly galling.  I have no doubt that you tried your best, but sadly, a try is not good enough. In spite of your forgettable performance, we have won the war. I bid you farewell.
column2: 指挥官，付出如此代价走到这一步，却最终失败，实在令人恼火。我毫不怀疑你已尽力，但遗憾的是，尽力还不够。尽管你的表现不值一提，我们还是赢得了这场战争。我向你道别。
芬兰(Finland) - 1945 年 6 月 4 日

column1: Comrade, Stavka has made a campaign over the Scandinavian peninsula to destroy all possible threats that might arise by crossing Norway and Finland. After your success in Germany and Austria, you must cross the boundary with Finland to save Leningrad and Murmansk against any future allied attacks. Comrade, Stalin and the Party expect that one more time you'll get the victory.
column2: 同志，最高统帅部已发起一场跨越斯堪的纳维亚半岛(Scandinavian peninsula)的战役，以消除穿越挪威(Norway)与芬兰(Finland)可能产生的一切威胁。在德国与奥地利(Austria)取得成功之后，你必须越过与芬兰的边界，以保护列宁格勒(Leningrad)与摩尔曼斯克(Murmansk)免遭未来任何盟军进攻。同志，斯大林与党期望你再一次取得胜利。

column1: The British showed us a fierce resistance, but finally they have been defeated. Now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.
column2: 英国人向我们展示了顽强的抵抗，但他们最终还是被击败了。现在，我们可以在这里建立我们的司令部，并开始从大陆本土接收补给。

column1: The allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible deception for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia.
column2: 盟军已摧毁你的部队。这对我们的人民、对苏联共产党(PCUS)、对斯大林都是一场可怕的欺骗。你的下一个目的地是西伯利亚(Siberia)。

column1: Impressive comrade!!!, we've destroyed the capitalist invader!!!. I am sure the Finnish will welcome the new socialist goverment that we'll establish in Finland...
column2: 了不起，同志！！！我们消灭了资本主义入侵者！！！我确信芬兰人会欢迎我们将在芬兰建立的新社会主义政府……
挪威(Norway) - 1945 年 6 月 10 日

column1: Comrade, a proper socialist goverment has been established in Finland after our victory. Our campaign over Scandinavia must continue just now in Norway, before the allies can put a foot on Scandinavia. We have reports that the remaining Germans on Norway are helping the allies to build up a defense line against us, it would be a pleasure to destroy them once more.
column2: 同志，我们胜利之后，芬兰已建立起一个合适的社会主义政府。我们在斯堪的纳维亚(Scandinavia)的战役必须马上在挪威(Norway)继续，趁盟军还没能在斯堪的纳维亚落脚。我们有报告说，挪威境内残余的德国人正在帮助盟军建立对抗我们的防线，能再消灭他们一次将是一件乐事。

column1: General, this loss is the last straw. Hitler has now consolidated his power in Norway and it will be years before we can launch an attack in the region. You have disgraced the British Army. A firing squad is in order!
column2: 将军，这次失利是最后一根稻草。希特勒现已巩固了他在挪威(Norway)的权力，我们要在该地区发动进攻将是多年之后的事了。你让英国陆军蒙羞。应当枪决！

column1: Comrade General, thanks to your previous merits and Comrade Zhukov's personal intercession you have saved your head. Now you have to rebuild your corps.
column2: 将军同志，由于你以往的功绩以及朱可夫(Zhukov)同志本人的说情，你保住了脑袋。现在你必须重建你的军。
希腊(Greece) - 1945 年 6 月 25 日

column1: The dissarray of the greeks against their goverment has lead to a people's revolution, where the comunists greek partisans are taking the lead of that revolt. Our mission is to help the partisans in their fight. In all the ways, Stavka have been planed to attack Greece to avoid a potential allied land here. Our comrades spies are sending reports us about the allied presence in this area, take care, a defeat here will bring the allies the opportunity to attack our motherland.\x00\x00
column2: 希腊人对其政府的混乱状态导致了一场人民革命，共产主义希腊游击队员正在领导这场起义。我们的任务是帮助游击队员进行斗争。无论如何，最高统帅部已计划进攻希腊，以防盟军在此登陆。我们的同志间谍正把这一地区盟军存在情况的报告送给我们，小心，这里的失败会给盟军进攻我们祖国的机会。\x00\x00

column1: Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!!
column2: 将军同志，为奖赏你的勇敢与忠诚，斯大林同志根据朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的提议，把突击柏林(Berlin)的任务交给了你！！！
低地国家(Low Countries) - 1945 年 7 月 30 日

column1: Comrade, the war continues to be well, we are showing the world that the socialist system is most advancend than the corrupted capitalist system. One more time, our spies from the NKVD are giving us important informations; the British are disembarking a big number of troops in the Low Countries and in some areas of France, they have the help from the remaining German troops in those zones, one more time. It's highly important that the allies do not establish a beachhead on the Low Countries. Good Luck, comrade.
column2: 同志，战争继续顺利进展，我们正向世界展示社会主义制度比腐败的资本主义制度更先进。我们的内务人民委员部(NKVD)间谍又一次给我们送来重要情报：英国人正在低地国家以及法国一些地区让大量部队登陆，而且他们又一次得到了那些地区残余德军的帮助。极为重要的是，不能让盟军在低地国家建立桥头堡。祝好运，同志。

column1: Playing tip : Use ground units starting from any PORT hex and select strategic transport to capture Amsterdam harbour (PORT hex) or use paratroops to capture Amsterdam (VH). Seaborne or airborne operations are both possible.
column2: 技巧：从任意（港口）格出发使用地面部队，选择战略运输以夺取阿姆斯特丹(Amsterdam)港（港口格），或者用伞兵夺取阿姆斯特丹（胜利格）。海上与空降行动都是可行的。

column1: Good work, the allies are re-embarking their troops, in order to avoid their capture.
column2: 干得好，盟军正在重新登船撤离他们的部队，以免被俘。

column1: To win you must take Almadrones.
column2: 要取胜，你必须夺取阿尔马德罗内斯(Almadrones)。
比利时(Belgium) - 1945 年 8 月 10 日

column1: Lenin would have never thought arriving so near from United Kingdom, we can say, after all, we're in the bigger war in all history, that without any doubt will put the USSR in the world lead. Firstly, we'll destroy the allied presence in west Europe. The general Charles de Gaulle is managing the defence of Belgium, maybe we'll have the oportunity to ask him about his anti-comunism ideas. Good Luck, comrade, Im sure all workers around the world expect our victory.
column2: 列宁(Lenin)从没想到过我们能推进到离联合王国(United Kingdom)这么近的地方，我们可以说，毕竟我们身处有史以来最大的一场战争中，这场战争无疑将使苏联登上世界领导地位。首先，我们将摧毁盟军在西欧的存在。夏尔·戴高乐(Charles de Gaulle)将军正在指挥比利时的防御，也许我们会有机会问问他关于他的反共主张。祝好运，同志，我确信全世界的工人都期待我们取胜。

column1: That was close General, but you pulled it off.
column2: 那很险，将军，但你成功了。

column1: Our flank is secure so keep moving West.
column2: 我们的侧翼安全了，所以继续向西推进。
伦敦 - 莱姆里吉斯路线

column1: Great Comrade!, we have defeated the allied armies in Belgium, however, the allied leaders have escaped from us. Drink some Vodka with me for celebrate the victory!
column2: 伟大的同志！我们已在比利时击败盟军，但盟军首脑却从我们手中逃脱了。和我喝点伏特加庆祝胜利吧！
北意大利 - 1945 年 9 月 15 日

column1: Comrade Commander, we want to resume our offensive in the north of Italy.
column2: 指挥官同志，我们要恢复在北意大利的攻势。

column1: There shouldn't be any strong resistance there but maybe you´ll find some German units scattered, so be careful.
column2: 那里不应有顽强的抵抗，但也许你会遇到一些散落的德军部队，所以要小心。

column1: Very good, we have now a strong presence in Italy, the allies didn´t expected the combined attack againt France and Italy, furthermore they were unable to divide their forces wisely.
column2: 很好，我们现在在意大利已有强大的存在，盟军没料到对法国与意大利的联合进攻，而且他们未能明智地分配兵力。
意大利海岸 - 1945 年 10 月 1 日

column1: Commander, continue with your unstoppable attack in Italy, now we are getting close to the dream of a united Europe by Comunism and ruled by Comrade Stalin, "the little father of all peoples".
column2: 指挥官，继续你在意大利势不可挡的进攻，现在我们正接近那个梦想：由共产主义统一欧洲，由斯大林同志——「所有民族的小父亲」——来统治。

column1: Playing tip : place amphibious ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops whenever you want (one unique ship can deploy your whole army).
column2: 游戏提示：把两栖舰船放在海岸相邻的任一格，就能随时部署你的部队（一艘船即可部署你的全军）。

column1: Oh, Commander, come on in. Well, it's almost over. We want you to capture the experimental airbase here at Dessau before the Commies can get there and before the Krauts can destroy everything else. Now, there's nothing complicated about this, just get there, fast. Good luck.
column2: 哦，指挥官，请进。嗯，快结束了。我们要你在赤党赶到之前、在德国佬毁掉其他一切之前，夺取德绍(Dessau)这里的实验空军基地。听着，这没什么复杂的，赶到那里就行，要快。祝好运。

column1: There are only few steps left to gain the control of whole Europe. It´s well known that the allies know nothing about defence and we have borne the weight of the war against Germany, this is an invaluable experience.
column2: 只差几步就能控制整个欧洲。众所周知，盟军对防御一窍不通，而承受对德战争重担的是我们，这是无价的经历。

column1: Commander, your last defeat had a terrible impact over the Members,
column2: 指挥官，你上一次失败对委员们造成了可怕的影响，

column1: the situation isn´t lost after all, but you are relieved of your
column2: 局势毕竟还没有无可挽回，但你暂时被解除

column1: Campaign designer: Pablo Schlegel & Santiago Fuertes, 24/12/2002
column2: 战役设计：Pablo Schlegel & Santiago Fuertes，2002 年 12 月 24 日

column1: The tension between USSR and USA has reached a critical point.
column2: 苏联与美国之间的紧张已到临界点。

column1: Command the Red army for the glory of Mother Russia and achieve Stalin's dream.
column2: 为俄罗斯母亲的荣耀指挥红军，实现斯大林的梦想。
萨莱诺-重返欧洲：重制版

column1: The WEST BANK General, I wanted us on the WEST BANK!
column2: 西岸，将军，我要我们待在西岸！

column1: Herr General, this defeat is out of the question, thanks to your stupidity the whole plan was unsuccessful.
column2: 将军阁下，这次失败绝不可容忍，多亏你的愚蠢，整个计划都未成功。

column1: They cut our supply lines and our soldiers are between the wall and the sword.

column2: 你在西迪拜拉尼(Sidi Barrani)的胜利使敌人摇摇欲坠。现在你必须追击已在拜尔迪耶(Bardia)附近重整的敌人。祝好运，指挥官！
第2营/第2装甲野战炮兵营
第13侦察团/第1野战炮兵营

column1: Your less than spectacular performance has motivated a reevaluation of your usefulness. We have been forced to evacuate all our troops from the continent. If we did not need every man to fight, your career would be over!
column2: 你并不出色的表现促使我们重新评估你的用处。我们被迫从大陆撤出全部部队。若不是我们还需要每一个人去战斗，你的军旅生涯就到此为止了！
阿拉库尔(Arracourt)突击，1944 年 9 月 8 日

column1: Commander, this is going to be a tough one.  Just capture all the objectives and get us back on track.
column2: 指挥官，这一仗会很艰难。只要拿下所有目标，让我们重回正轨。

column1: And keep using available bombers against artillery whenever possible. Your new attack aircraft are excellent at tearing up columns of tanks. Remember to blind his forces by aggressively ripping into his reconaissance forces.
column2: 并且只要可能，就持续用可用的轰炸机打击敌方炮兵。你新式的攻击机极善于撕碎坦克纵队。记住要猛烈打击他的侦察部队，让他的部队变成瞎子。
第1战斗机联队/第1航空队
第2战斗机联队/第1航空队

column1: Commander, you did a good job.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  More defeats like this will finish the Germans!
column2: 指挥官，你干得好。敌人打得很英勇，但这并未挡住你。再来几场这样的败仗，就能了结德国人！

column1: Commander, excuse me, General!  You are to lead our drive into Austria. The enemy will likely protect his homeland to the last man. There are most likely powerful panzer units in the region which is close to the Yugoslavian border. Expect intervention of Tito's communist partisans in their home country.
column2: 指挥官，恕我失言，将军！你要率领我们向奥地利推进。敌人很可能会为保卫他的本土而战至最后一人。在靠近南斯拉夫(Yugoslavia)边界的地区极可能有强大的装甲部队。要防备铁托(Tito)的共产主义游击队员在他们的本土介入。
穆尔河畔魏特斯费尔德
