column1: Commander, this loss has perhaps cost us the war. You are to return to England to face a firing squad. It's a disaster, whole Austria might fall under Soviet hands!
column2: 指挥官，这次失败也许已让我们输掉了战争。你须返回英格兰面对行刑队。这是场灾难，整个奥地利都可能落入苏军之手！

column1: General, though your performance has been competent, the decision has been made to give you a new command.  The General Staff feels it is best that if you assume command of one the weather stations in Greenland .  Bernard Montgomery will assume your duties.
column2: 将军，尽管你的表现还算称职，但已决定给你一个新的职务。总参谋部认为，你最好去接管格陵兰(Greenland)的一座气象站。伯纳德·蒙哥马利(Bernard Montgomery)将接替你的职务。

column1: Commander, now that you have helped our allies off the beach, our own troops can use your aid. Powerful German panzer units have fought our forces to a standstill at Caen. You and your crack troops will lead the breakthrough.
column2: 指挥官，既然你已帮我们的盟友离开海滩，我们自己的部队也需要你的援助。德军强大的装甲部队在卡昂(Caen)把我军打得陷入停滞。你和你的精锐部队将带头突破。

column1: Very well done!  You have exceeded Churchill's hopes!  Your victory at Bardia has broken enemy resistance. And, because of your bold attack, the Italian government has appealed to Germany for help.  Congratulations!
column2: 干得非常漂亮！你超出了丘吉尔的期望！你在拜尔迪耶的胜利打垮了敌人的抵抗。而且，正因为你大胆的进攻，意大利政府已向德国求援。祝贺你！

column1: Very good! Metz is now ours. Once again your men have proved their superiority to the German "master race". Congratulations, Commander!
column2: 很好！梅斯(Metz)现在是我们的了。你的部下再次证明了他们比德国「优等民族」更优越。恭喜你，指挥官！

column1: Good work. You have fulfilled Churchill's hopes!  Your attack has weakened enemy resistance.  And now, Italy will be forced to accept German help.
column2: 干得好。你实现了丘吉尔的期望！你的进攻削弱了敌人的抵抗。现在，意大利将被迫接受德国的援助。

column1: Commander, We have a chance to trap many German troops between us and Patton's Third Army to the south. You must move quickly to accomplish this task.
column2: 指挥官，我们有机会把大量德军困在我们与南面巴顿(Patton)第3集团军之间。你必须迅速行动，完成这项任务。

column1: You clumsy traitor! You'll be issued to the penal battalion at Leningrad front. Maybe there you'll show your love for the communism and Motherland!!!
column2: 你这笨手笨脚的叛徒！你将被发配到列宁格勒(Leningrad)前线的惩戒营。也许在那里你能表现出你对共产主义和祖国的热爱！！！

column1: This is a bitter defeat. Even now, enemy troops are advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines.
column2: 这是一场惨痛的失败。此刻敌军正向我们的阵地推进。拿起步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。

column1: Commander, you have successfully broken through the German lines. Now we must move on the Ruhr to destroy German industrial capacity.
column2: 指挥官，你成功地突破了德军战线。现在我们必须向鲁尔(Ruhr)进军，摧毁德国的工业能力。
困熊，1945 年 6 月 1 日

column1: Patton was right, we cannot trust Soviets!
column2: 巴顿说得对，我们不能信任苏军！

column1: Ivan expelled us from Berlin while we were in Norway. They claim that our presence in Berlin -decided at Yalta- was limited to a symbolic presence of a few regiments for the period of time needed to sign the German capitulation. Now that Germany has surrendered, they consider Berlin as a whole being part of the Soviet occupation zone.
column2: 我们还在挪威(Norway)时，伊万把我们赶出了柏林。他们声称我们在柏林的存在——雅尔塔(Yalta)决定的——仅限于签署德国投降所需期间几个团的象征性存在。既然德国已经投降，他们就把整个柏林视为苏联占领区的一部分。

column1: You are to strike back, just drive the Soviets back across the Oder! We want you to force Soviets to sit at table of negotiations. Teach them a lesson Commander!
column2: 你要反击，把苏军赶回奥得河(Oder)对岸去！我们要你迫使苏军坐上谈判桌。给他们一个教训，指挥官！
苏军科涅夫野战司令部
苏军朱可夫野战司令部

column1: Ivan opposed a strong resistance, only the threat to use nukes force Soviets to retreat to borderlines decided at Yalta. Hopefully Stalin's researchers -despite the arrest of many German scientists- were not able to build up the bomb!
column2: 伊万进行了顽强的抵抗，只有威胁使用核武器才迫使苏军退回到雅尔塔划定的边界线。但愿斯大林的研究人员——尽管逮捕了许多德国科学家——没能造出原子弹！

column1: Soviets opposed a strong resistance, but you forced them to sue for peace.
column2: 苏军进行了顽强的抵抗，但你迫使他们求和。

column1: They pretended it was a misunderstanding, they claim they misinterpreted Yalta's Agreements about the borderlines. They spoke about an "incident" caused by the lack of clarity of clauses discussed at Yalta. They now try to minimize the events.
column2: 他们假装这是一场误会，声称他们误解了雅尔塔关于边界线的协定。他们谈到一起因雅尔塔讨论的条款不够明确而引发的「事件」。他们现在试图尽量淡化这些事。

column1: Maybe the nuclear bomb dropped on Japan has played a role in the way the Kremlin understands the past agreements...
column2: 也许投在日本的那颗核弹，对克里姆林宫理解过去那些协定的方式起了一定作用……

column1: Commander, our American allies are planning an invasion of French North Africa. Because they lack experience, the Americans have asked for our help.  You will lead a joint assault on Casablanca to demonstrate our amphibious tactics. Good Luck!
column2: 指挥官，我们的美国盟友正计划入侵法属北非。由于缺乏经验，美国人已请求我们帮助。你将率领对卡萨布兰卡(Casablanca)的联合突击，以展示我们的两栖战术。祝好运！
第7反坦克营/自由法国第8师
第8反坦克营/自由法国第8师

column1: Commander, I must congratulate you on this resounding success. French forces have surrendered and resistance has collapsed. You handled this difficult assignment with great skill and intelligence. You will be, no doubt, honoured when you return to England.
column2: 指挥官，我必须为这次巨大的成功向你道贺。法国部队已经投降，抵抗已经崩溃。你以高超的技巧与智慧处理了这项艰难的任务。你回到英格兰时，无疑会获得殊荣。

column1: Commander, you have failed.  The French have successfully beaten back the Americans throughout North Africa.  We expected more from you.  You are being transferred as liaison officer to the US Army in the Aleutians.
column2: 指挥官，你失败了。法国人在整个北非成功地击退了美国人。我们对你期望更高。你将被调往阿留申群岛(Aleutians)任美军联络官。
卡西诺山(Monte Cassino)，1944 年 5 月 11 日

column1: The offensive is codenamed Operation Diadem; the plan is to break through the Gustav Line and drive towards the next line of defense, the so-called Hitler Line. The Polish 2nd Corps, with assistance of some British and Canadian units have the unenviable task of the final assault of Monte Cassino. In the southern part of the line the French Expeditionary Corps and the US 2nd Corps will attack the German mountain positions. The most difficult part is left to you.
column2: 这场攻势的代号是王冠行动(Operation Diadem)；计划是突破古斯塔夫防线(Gustav Line)，向下一道防线即所谓的希特勒防线(Hitler Line)推进。波兰第2军在一些英军与加拿大部队的协助下，承担着对蒙特卡西诺发起最后突击这一吃力不讨好的任务。在防线南部，法国远征军与美国第2军将进攻德军的山地阵地。最困难的部分留给了你。

column1: Your part of the offensive, Operation Honker, is to break through the line and advance up the Liri valley until you reach the Hitler Line. Meanwhile, the Americans will break out of Anzio to meet you and trap the Germans between the 2 spearheads - or so we hope.
column2: 你在这次攻势中的部分——雁鸣行动(Operation Honker)——是突破防线，沿利里(Liri)河谷推进，直到抵达希特勒防线。与此同时，美国人将从安齐奥(Anzio)突围来与你会合，把德军困在两个矛头之间——我们希望如此。
圣多纳托瓦尔迪科米诺

column1: The Americans have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of German to escape.
column2: 美国人逃避了他们的责任，没有从安齐奥突围与我们会合，反而把一支可观的兵力派往罗马(Rome)——未能会合并包围德军，使大量德军得以逃脱。

column1: The good news is you have performed well. The bad news is that the Americans at Anzio have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of Germans to escape.
column2: 好消息是你表现良好。坏消息是安齐奥的美国人逃避了他们的责任，没有从安齐奥突围与我们会合，反而把一支可观的兵力派往罗马——未能会合并包围德军，使大量德军得以逃脱。

column1: The good news is you have performed brilliantly, as usual - a textbook offensive. The Poles and the French army have performed way beyond all expectations, and the American did not do too badly either.
column2: 好消息是你一如既往地表现出色——一场教科书式的攻势。波兰人与法国陆军的表现在各方面都远超预期，美国人也干得不算差。

column1: The bad news is the Americans at Anzio have shirked their responsibilites and instead of breaking out of Anzio and linking up with us have send a significant force towards Rome - the failure to link-up and encircle the Germans has allowed a large number of Germans to escape.
column2: 坏消息是安齐奥的美国人逃避了他们的责任，没有从安齐奥突围与我们会合，反而把一支可观的兵力派往罗马——未能会合并包围德军，使大量德军得以逃脱。

column1: You've chosen the path of Market Garden - The Battle of the Bulge - The Ruhr, good luck!!!
column2: 你选择了市场花园(Market Garden) - 突出部之战(The Battle of the Bulge) - 鲁尔这条路线，祝好运！！！

column1: You've chosen the path of Gothic Line - Austria - Eagle's nest, good luck!!!
column2: 你选择了哥特防线(Gothic Line) - 奥地利 - 鹰巢(Eagle's nest)这条路线，祝好运！！！

column1: Your failure is hard to stomach, Commander. I have nothing more to say to you.
column2: 你的失败令人难以接受，指挥官。我跟你无话可说了。

column1: Commander, our American allies are once again in a jam. For two days they have been pinned down on the beaches at Normandy. As our most experienced field commander, you have been chosen to lead your armored group into battle at Normandy to save our allies. We know you wil not let us down.
column2: 指挥官，我们的美国盟友又一次陷入困境。两天来他们一直被压制在诺曼底(Normandy)的海滩上。作为我们最有经验的战地指挥官，你被选中率领你的装甲集群在诺曼底投入战斗，去拯救我们的盟友。我们知道你不会让我们失望。

column1: Well, you barely accomplished your mission, but the sea lanes are safe. You have been lucky, commander, with this narrow victory.
column2: 嗯，你勉强完成了任务，但海上航道安全了。指挥官，你这次险胜，算是运气好。

column1: Monty?, please, come in.  You have heard the news?  Maybe it is best that he did not return from Normandy.  After all, the shame of utter defeat would have been too much for him to bear.
column2: 蒙蒂？请进。你听到消息了吗？也许他没从诺曼底回来反倒是最好的。毕竟，彻底失败的耻辱会让他难以承受。

column1: A  good performance, to be sure. Excellent. Once again the Americans owe you a debt of gratitude. The Americans may offer you honorary citizenship!
column2: 确实是一场出色的表现。太棒了。美国人又一次欠你一份感激之情。美国人也许会授予你荣誉公民身份！
保卫托布鲁克(Tobruk)，1941 年 4 月 31 日

column1: You must hold Tobruk at all costs, there will be no withdrawal. The defense should be conducted with the utmost agression.
column2: 你必须不惜一切代价守住托布鲁克，不得撤退。防御作战应以最大的攻击性进行。

column1: The loss of Tobruk has been a crushing blow to the morale of the Empire, you would do better to resign now. I am sure we can find a new command for you ... somewhere.
column2: 托布鲁克的失守对帝国的士气是一记沉重打击，你现在辞职倒更好些。我相信我们能给你找个新职务……在某个地方。

column1: Rommel's initial attacks have been stopped, good work. Unfortunately you were too slow to take advantage of your deffensive sucesses.
column2: 隆美尔最初的进攻已被挡住，干得好。遗憾的是，你行动太慢，没能利用你防御上的成功。

column1: Rommel's initial attacks have been stopped, good work. You are the best man to command our next offensive, so I have put in a good word for you.
column2: 隆美尔最初的进攻已被挡住，干得好。你是指挥我们下一次攻势的最佳人选，所以我已经为你说了好话。

column1: Intelligence confirms that Hitler and other leading Nazis did not die in Berlin but escaped to Norway and not to Berchtesgaden where we had primarily expected. They are now collecting the remnants of their forces, including crack panzer units and top ace fighter pilots, to oppose any attempt to capture the Führer. Hitler's private plane waits on a nearby airfield in case he needs to escape. You leave immediately Berchtesgaden to Norway. You must destroy all command centers and Hitler's bunker. You must move quickly. More reinforcements are pouring in daily!
column2: 情报证实，希特勒(Hitler)与其他纳粹头目并未死在柏林，而是逃到了挪威，并非我们原先主要预期的贝希特斯加登(Berchtesgaden)。他们现在正收拾残部，包括精锐装甲部队与顶尖王牌战斗机飞行员，以对抗任何抓捕元首(Führer)的行动。希特勒的私人飞机在附近机场待命，以备他需要逃走。你立即从贝希特斯加登出发前往挪威。你必须摧毁所有指挥中心和希特勒的地堡。你必须行动迅速。每天都有更多增援涌入！
索尔贝格（希姆莱藏身处）
吉斯奈斯（邓尼茨海军元帅地堡）
反坦克营/美国第7装甲师
第2反坦克营/美国第7装甲师
第1防空营/美国第7装甲师
第2防空营/美国第7装甲师
第5防空营/美国第7装甲师
第PJ/党卫军阿道夫·希特勒师

column1: Comrade Marshal, you have to stop your attack! The Yanks has threatened us with use of nuclear bomb! We have to withdraw and wait for better time to complete the liberation of the Europe.
column2: 元帅同志，你必须停止进攻！美国佬威胁要使用核弹！我们必须撤退，等待更好的时机来完成解放欧洲的事业。
第一次阿拉曼(El Alamein)战役，1942 年 7 月 5 日

column1: The Axis forces have reached the El Alamein line. I am sure you are aware of the news from Russia, Germany has just launched a major offensive aimed at advancing to the Volga and into the Caucasus. After El Alamein there is nothing to stop Rommel advancing to the Nile and controlling the Suez Canal, the Allies are retreating on all fronts - we will retreat no further!
column2: 轴心国部队已抵达阿拉曼防线。我相信你已知道来自俄国的消息，德国刚刚发动了一场大规模攻势，目标是推进到伏尔加河(Volga)并进入高加索(Caucasus)。过了阿拉曼，就没有什么能阻挡隆美尔推进到尼罗河并控制苏伊士运河了，盟军正在各条战线上撤退——我们绝不再退！
阿拉姆哈勒法岭(Alam Halfa Ridge)：高地

column1: Withdraw with all haste, we obviously cannot hold Rommel here. You should withdraw your men towards Cairo, we are already preparing defensive positions at Cairo and Alexandria. New equipment and supplies are on the way, but we must hold the line at the Nile.
column2: 全速撤退，我们显然无法在这里挡住隆美尔。你应把部队撤向开罗，我们已在开罗与亚历山大准备防御阵地。新装备与补给正在运来，但我们必须守住尼罗河一线。
轻足行动(OPERATION LIGHTFOOT)，1942 年 10 月 23 日

column1: Well, following your success in East Africa, we have a mission of utmost importance. Incompetent command by your successor in Egypt has allowed Rommel and his Afrika Korps to overrun all of the territory you worked so hard to attain. Now Egypt is once again threatened. Only you can lead us to victory!
column2: 好，继你在东非的成功之后，我们有一项极其重要的任务。你在埃及的继任者指挥无能，使隆美尔和他的非洲军(Afrika Korps)蹂躏了你辛苦夺取的全部地区。如今埃及再次受到威胁。只有你能领导我们走向胜利！

column1: The long retreat ends today. The plan is to break through the Axis lines in the north - your men will be attacking at the strongest point, where the Axis have built strong defensive positions. Once you reach your objectives you will be able to break through their lines and stop any retreat of German and Italian forces.
column2: 漫长的撤退今天结束。计划是在北面突破轴心国战线——你的部下将在最强点发起进攻，那里轴心国已构筑了坚固的防御阵地。一旦你抵达目标，就能突破他们的战线，堵住德意部队的任何退路。

column1: We have air superiority, more men and equipment and plenty of supplies, furthermore Intelligence tells us that Rommel is in Germany on sick leave, the enemy should be easily defeated once we breach its fortifications.
column2: 我们拥有空中优势、更多的兵员与装备以及充足的补给，此外情报部门告诉我们，隆美尔正在德国休病假，一旦我们突破敌人的工事，应该就能轻易将其击败。

column1: That is correct, Mr Churchill, he was captured by Rommel himself, or so they say; what a shame. General Montgomery arrived here early this morning and has taken over the defense of our positions at El Alamein, all is not lost yet.
column2: 没错，丘吉尔先生，他是被隆美尔本人俘虏的，至少他们是这么说的；真令人惋惜。蒙哥马利将军今天一早抵达这里，已接管我们在阿拉曼阵地的防御，还没有全盘皆输。

column1: Well done. You have broken through the enemy lines, but now you will have to cut off Rommel's retreat.
column2: 干得好。你已突破敌军战线，但现在你必须切断隆美尔的退路。

column1: The Germans have launched a major offensive in the Ardennes region in the dead of winter.  Our American allies are reeling from the blows.  Once again, you must go to their aid.
column2: 德军在隆冬时节于阿登(Ardennes)地区发动了一场大规模攻势。我们的美国盟友被打得摇摇欲坠。你又一次必须前去救援。

column1: Commander, this loss has perhaps cost us the war. You are to return to England to face a firing squad.
column2: 指挥官，这次失败也许已让我们输掉了战争。你须返回英格兰面对行刑队。
突击哥特防线，1944 年 9 月 10 日

column1: I know things have been quiet for you for the last few months, but you are needed now so I hope your men are ready.
column2: 我知道过去几个月你那边一直很平静，但现在需要你了，所以我希望你的部下已做好准备。

column1: We have come up against the Gothic Line, stretching approximately east to west across Italy along the Appenines. The basic plan to break the Line calls for 3 attacks, the US army will attack in the west and centre, while our own forces will attack along the Adriatic in the east, aiming for Ravenna - this is codenamed Operation Olive.
column2: 我们已抵近哥特防线，它沿亚平宁山脉(Appenines)自东向西横贯意大利。突破该防线的基本计划要求发动 3 次进攻，美军将在西面与中央发起进攻，而我们自己的部队将沿东面的亚得里亚海(Adriatic)方向进攻，目标是拉韦纳(Ravenna)——这次行动的代号是橄榄行动(Operation Olive)。

column1: However, you will not be part of our offensive. You are being attached to the US 5th Army, who are attacking in the centre of the line. The plan calls for a 2-pronged attack north from Florence with the objective of controlling the mountain passes, crossing the Appenines and advancing towards Bologna.
column2: 不过，你不会参加我们的攻势。你将被配属给在防线中央进攻的美国第5集团军。计划要求从佛罗伦萨(Florence)向北发起两路进攻，目标是控制各个山口、翻越亚平宁山脉并向博洛尼亚(Bologna)推进。

column1: I understand your trepidation at serving under the Americans, however they are our Allies and they do need your help. They will doubtless use your men in subsidiary roles and take the glory for themselves. They do not seem to trust us as much as they should, however I trust you to work with the Americans and make us proud.
column2: 我理解你在美国人手下服役的忐忑，但他们是我们的盟友，而且确实需要你的帮助。他们无疑会派你的部下担任次要角色，却把功劳据为己有。他们似乎不像应有的那样信任我们，但我相信你能与美国人合作，让我们感到骄傲。

column1: The offensive has not gone as well as we hoped. In your sector you have managed to control the passes but we still have not captured our objectives - Bologna, in particular, is still in enemy hands.
column2: 攻势进行得不如我们希望的那样顺利。在你的地段，你设法控制了各个山口，但我们仍未夺取目标——尤其是博洛尼亚，仍在敌人手中。

column1: Before long we will be forced to shut down the offensives for winter and will use that time to resupply and plan for next year. In spring we hope to begin offensives to put an end to the Italian front.
column2: 不久我们就将被迫停止攻势以过冬，并利用那段时间补充物资、筹划来年。我们希望在春季发起攻势，终结意大利战线。
古斯塔夫防线，1944 年 1 月 17 日

column1: Our advance on Rome has been delayed very skillfully by the Germans and has stopped on the Gustav line, southeast of Rome. The southern part of the line runs along the Rapido and Gargliano rivers and is centred on the area around Monte Cassino.
column2: 我们对罗马的推进被德军非常巧妙地迟滞，已停在罗马东南的古斯塔夫防线上。防线南段沿拉皮多河(Rapido)与加里利亚诺河(Gargliano)走向，以蒙特卡西诺周边地区为中心。

column1: Your orders are to cross the Gargliano and establish a bridgehead in preparation for an offensive up the Liri Valley. Once the landings at Anzio go ahead we will be in position to quickly capture Rome.
column2: 你的命令是渡过加里利亚诺河、建立桥头堡，为向利里河谷发起攻势做准备。一旦安齐奥的登陆开始，我们就能处在迅速夺取罗马的位置上。

column1: Meanwhile, American and French forces will assault and capture the Cassino area.
column2: 与此同时，美军与法军将突击并夺取卡西诺地区。

column1: Tha landings at Anzio have gone ahead as expected although our failure to penetrate the Gustav Line will have a great impact on the battle. Send you men to the rear as per your orders, you will refit and resupply in preparation for future offensives.
column2: 安齐奥的登陆已如期进行，尽管我们未能突入古斯塔夫防线，这将对战局产生重大影响。按你的命令把你的人送往后方，你们将整补、补给，为未来的攻势做准备。

column1: Commander, as you know, operation Market Garden has been given the approval of SHAEF headquarters. Our objective is to use airborne forces to capture bridges leading up the the Rhine crossing at Arnhem. You will lead the armored forces that will link up with the Airborne units. You first objective will be the bridges over the Zuid Willems Canal.
column2: 指挥官，如你所知，市场花园行动已获得盟军远征军最高司令部(SHAEF)的批准。我们的目标是使用空降部队夺取通往阿纳姆(Arnhem)莱茵河渡口的各座桥梁。你将率领将与空降部队会合的装甲部队。你的第一个目标是南威廉运河(Zuid Willems Canal)上的桥梁。

column1: The Tenth Panzer division lies between your forces and the bridges at Arnhem. You must defeat them and continue on to Arnhem.
column2: 第10装甲师横在你部与阿纳姆的桥梁之间。你必须击败他们，继续向阿纳姆前进。
市场花园行动 第一阶段
第1英国空降着陆区/空投区
第82美国空降着陆区/空投区

column1: Commander, you have completed the first part of your mission. You must continue the thrust to Arnhem.
column2: 指挥官，你已完成任务的第一部分。你必须继续向阿纳姆突击。

column1: The German Army is holding defensive positions in the vicinity of Metz. This will be a tough assignment Commander. Hopefully you are up to the task.
column2: 德军正在梅斯附近据守防御阵地。指挥官，这将是一项艰巨的任务。但愿你能胜任。

column1: You have dealt the german Army a severe blow buit you failed to reach Arnhem in time. The war will now be lengthened.
column2: 你已给德军一记重击，但你未能及时抵达阿纳姆。战争现在将被拖长。

column1: Good job, Commander. You have given the Italians a taste of defeat. You must follow up this great victory with another!
column2: 干得好，指挥官。你让意大利人尝到了失败的滋味。你必须以又一场胜利来扩大这一伟大胜利！

column1: Commander, you must lead our attack into the Ruhr. This is Germany's major industrial zone. If it falls, Germany will be forced to surrender!
column2: 指挥官，你必须率领我们进攻鲁尔。这是德国主要的工业区。如果它陷落，德国将被迫投降！

column1: Commander, I am sorry that the sacrifices of your fine troops have been in vain. We must fall back quickly or face annihilation. You have been ordered to London to face a firing squad.
column2: 指挥官，我很遗憾，你那支优秀部队的牺牲都白费了。我们必须迅速后撤，否则就会面临全军覆没。你已奉命前往伦敦(London)面对行刑队。

column1: My commendations, Commander!  Under harsh conditions, you have done very well!  Your complete victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.
column2: 我要表彰你，指挥官！在艰苦的条件下，你干得非常好！你的全胜表明你已获得宝贵的经验。德国人在挪威已证明过于强大，所以你的部队必须撤出。这丝毫不减损你的成就。

column1: Commander, your narrow victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.
column2: 指挥官，你的险胜表明你已获得宝贵的经验。德国人在挪威已证明过于强大，所以你的部队必须撤出。这丝毫不减损你的成就。

column1: Commander, your victory has shown that already you have gained valuable experience. The Germans have proved too powerful in Norway, so your forces must be withdrawn. This in no way diminishes your accomplishments.
column2: 指挥官，你的胜利表明你已获得宝贵的经验。德国人在挪威已证明过于强大，所以你的部队必须撤出。这丝毫不减损你的成就。

column1: The Axis-held island of Pantelleria has proved to be a thorn in our side. Aircraft from this island bastion are harassing our convoys and threaten our proposed invasion opf Sicily. You must capture the island so we can proceed with our invasion plans.
column2: 轴心国占据的潘泰莱里亚(Pantelleria)岛已成为我们的一根刺。从这个岛屿堡垒起飞的飞机正袭扰我们的船队，并威胁我们计划中的西西里登陆。你必须夺取该岛，好让我们能继续实施入侵计划。
ITS 路易吉·迪·卡多尔纳号
ITS 穆齐奥·阿滕多洛号
ITS 阿尔贝托·迪·朱萨诺号
F. 博尔多尼-比斯莱里

column1: Commander, your next task is to break through German lines North of Dusseldorf. This will open the way into the heart of the Ruhr.
column2: 指挥官，你的下一个任务是突破杜塞尔多夫(Dusseldorf)以北的德军战线。这将打开通往鲁尔腹地之路。
库尔特·H. F. 布伦德尔

column1: Commander, you are chosen to lead our forces in North Africa. The Italians have been stopped in the vicinity of Sidi Barrani, where they have established strong defensive positions. You will attack and overwhelm these defenses.
column2: 指挥官，你被选中率领我们在北非的部队。意大利人已在西迪拜拉尼附近被挡住，并在那里建立了坚固的防御阵地。你将进攻并击溃这些防御。

column1: The Germans are dazed and reeling from the blows you and your brave men have delivered! Not only did you succeed in capturing the Ruhr, you drove the Nazis back to Berlin. Commander, diplomatic representatives of the Allies and Germany are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and throughout Europe, are unparalleled. You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 你和你勇敢的部下打出的重击，让德国人晕头转向、摇摇欲坠！你不仅成功夺取了鲁尔，还把纳粹赶回了柏林。指挥官，就在我们说话的此刻，盟国与德国的外交代表正在会晤……你在这里以及在整个欧洲一连串的胜利，是无可比拟的。你该回到心怀感激的祖国了。

column1: Commander, diplomatic representatives of the Allied Powers and Germany are meeting even as we speak... Your string of victories here, and throughout Europe, are unparalleled.... You are to return home to a grateful nation.
column2: 指挥官，就在我们说话的此刻，盟国与德国的外交代表正在会晤……你在这里以及在整个欧洲一连串的胜利，是无可比拟的……你该回到心怀感激的祖国了。

column1: Commander, our invasion of Italy is proceeding ahead of schedule. Your troops will now be returned to England for some well-deserved rest. You will be recieving plenty of leave time yourself!
column2: 指挥官，我们对意大利的入侵正提前进行。你的部队现在将返回英格兰，享受他们应得的休整。你自己也会得到充裕的休假时间！

column1: Commander. Even now, the Hermann Goering Division is advancing on our position.  Arm yourself with a rifle and seek redemption on the front lines.
column2: 指挥官。此刻赫尔曼·戈林师(Hermann Goering Division)正向我们的阵地推进。拿起步枪，到前线去寻求救赎吧。

column1: Salerno is secure. This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at SHAEF headquarters. I am sure that you will do very well.
column2: 萨莱诺(Salerno)已经稳固。这场胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，盟军远征军最高司令部(SHAEF)就会需要你。我相信你会干得非常出色。
KMS 勒贝雷希特·马斯号
KMS 勒贝雷希特·马斯号
KMS 特奥多尔·里德尔号

column1: Congratulations!  Winston is pleased by your performance.  The capture of Sicily is almost assured. Commander, you have exceeded all expectations.
column2: 祝贺你！温斯顿对你的表现很满意。夺取西西里几乎已成定局。指挥官，你超出了所有人的期望。

column1: Commander, you will lead our assault on Sicily.  If Sicily falls into our hands, the Italians will never recover.  Now is our chance to drive them out of the War.
column2: 指挥官，你将率领我们对西西里的突击。如果西西里落入我们手中，意大利人就再也恢复不过来。现在是我们把他们赶出战争的机会。
安杰洛·马斯特罗戈斯蒂诺

column1: Commander, you have disgraced the British Army with pitiful efforts!  Many here demand your return to England to face a court-martial.  May I suggest suicide?
column2: 指挥官，你以可悲的表现让英国陆军蒙羞！这里许多人要求你回英格兰接受军事法庭审判。我能否建议你自杀？

column1: Well, Commander, you have managed to establish a beachhead on Sicily after a hard fight, but the enemy were still able to withdraw and strengthen their forces on the island.  Unfortunately, the battle for Sicily will continue to drag on, since we lack the resources to sustain further effort in this theater of operations.
column2: 嗯，指挥官，经过一场苦战，你成功地在西西里建立了滩头阵地，但敌人仍能撤走并加强他们在岛上的兵力。遗憾的是，西西里之战将继续拖延下去，因为我们缺乏资源在这个战区维持进一步的行动。

column1: Our Sicilian campaign has run into heavy resistance in the Simeto Valley. You job is to break the stalemate. Good luck, Commander.
column2: 我们的西西里战役在西梅托(Simeto)河谷遭遇了顽强的抵抗。你的任务是打破僵局。祝好运，指挥官。
HMS 廓尔喀号（原文拼写 Ghurka）
ITS 维托里奥·维内托号

column1: Commander, you were lucky to escape that one. A very disappointing performance indeed!
column2: 指挥官，你能从那一仗脱身算是走运。真是一场令人非常失望的表现！

column1: Comrade General, the Wehrmacht has been crushed. Now towards Berlin; it's about 2000 km from our current positions...
column2: 将军同志，国防军已被击溃。现在向柏林进军；距我们当前位置约 2000 公里……
巴格拉季昂行动(Operacja Bagration - Operation "Bagration") (ZS#08)，1944 年 6 月 22 日

column1: Comrade General, in the 3rd anniversary of Nazi attack on our Rodina, we shall start the greatest offensive of this war. Comrade Stalin ordered us the loudly aim of liberating the whole Byelorussia and driving the Germans away from our land!
column2: 将军同志，在纳粹进攻我们祖国(Rodina)三周年之际，我们将发动这场战争中最伟大的攻势。斯大林同志给我们下达了响亮的目标：解放整个白俄罗斯(Byelorussia)，把德国人赶出我们的土地！
阿斯普罗蒙特圣克里斯蒂娜

column1: Your successful breakthrough in the Simeto Valley has opened the way to Messina.  The entire area is under our control.  You are to be congratulated.  Excellent work!
column2: 你在西梅托河谷的成功突破打开了通往墨西拿(Messina)之路。整个地区都在我们控制之下。应当向你道贺。干得漂亮！

column1: Comrade Komdiv, you've been awarded the posthumous Hero of the Soviet Union.
column2: 师级指挥员同志，你已被追授苏联英雄称号。

column1: Your successful breakthrough in the Simeto Valley has opened the way to Messina.  The entire area is under our control.  Good work.
column2: 你在西梅托河谷的成功突破打开了通往墨西拿之路。整个地区都在我们控制之下。干得好。

column1: Commander, though you shamed the British Army with your miserable performance in France, the successful evacuation at Dunkirk has put Churchill in a forgiving mood.  You are given one last chance - to play an important role in our invasion of British Somaliland.  The Italians have occupied our colony sinc the beginning of the war. You must drive them out!
column2: 指挥官，尽管你在法国的糟糕表现让英国陆军蒙羞，但敦刻尔克(Dunkirk)的成功撤退让丘吉尔有了宽恕的心情。你得到最后一次机会——在我们入侵英属索马里兰(British Somaliland)时发挥重要作用。意大利人自战争开始就占领了我们的殖民地。你必须把他们赶出去！

column1: The Germans and Romanians try to reopen the supply line to Stalingrad, while the Soviets dig in and await the attack.
column2: 德国人和罗马尼亚人试图重新打通通往斯大林格勒的补给线，而苏军则挖壕据守，等着他们进攻。

column1: You have accomplished your mission, but your lack of speed has allowed the enemy to escape.  It is possible that this campaign could go on as long as the last war.  Commander, we will, no doubt, call on you again for your services.
column2: 你完成了任务，但你速度不足，让敌人逃脱了。这场战役有可能像上一场战争那样旷日持久。指挥官，我们无疑还会再次召你效力。

column1: Commander, your victory at Bardia allows us an opportunity to evict Italy from our colony in British Somaliland, which they have occupied since the beginning of the war.  Your experience in amphibious warfare should prove useful here.
column2: 指挥官，你在拜尔迪耶的胜利给了我们一个机会，把意大利人从他们自战争开始就占领的英属索马里兰殖民地赶出去。你的两栖作战经验在这里应当有用。
柏林行动(Operacja Berlinska - Assault on Berlin) (ZS#13)，1945 年 4 月 16 日

column1: Comrade General, Berlin aheads! Kill the Nazi Beast in its lair!!!
column2: 将军同志，前面就是柏林！把这头纳粹野兽消灭在它的巢穴里！！！

column1: Playing tip : Bridge layer unit allows you not only to cross rivers but also to deploy units wherever you move, close to or behind enemy lines for instance.
column2: 游戏提示：架桥车单位不仅让你能渡河，还能让你在移动到的任何地方部署部队，比如靠近或深入敌后。

column1: Comrade, thanks to the leadership of the Great Stalin your troops has thrown the German Army back from the gates of Moscow, but that's only the beginning. We still think you'll be sent back to the Gulag, but Zhukov has good opinoion on you, so you'll be given another chance. On his request you've been promoted to the rank of Komdiv, but we in the Political Directorate will keep an eye on you.
column2: 同志，多亏伟大的斯大林的领导，你的部队把德国陆军从莫斯科(Moscow)城下击退，但这只是开始。我们仍认为你该被送回古拉格(Gulag)，但朱可夫对你评价不错，所以你会再得到一次机会。应他的请求，你已被晋升为师级指挥员，但我们政治部会盯着你。

column1: Comrade, thanks to the leadership of the Great Stalin your troops has thrown the German Army back from the gates of Moscow, but that's only the beginning. We still think you'll be sent back to the Gulag, but Zhukov has good opinion on you, so you'll be given another chance. On his request you've been promoted to the rank of Komdiv, but we in the Political Directorate will keep an eye on you.
column2: 同志，多亏伟大的斯大林的领导，你的部队把德国陆军从莫斯科城下击退，但这只是开始。我们仍认为你该被送回古拉格，但朱可夫对你评价不错，所以你会再得到一次机会。应他的请求，你已被晋升为师级指挥员，但我们政治部会盯着你。

column1: Comrade, this brilliant victory was achieved due to the superiority of Communism over the Nazism. Now we shall pursue these scums to the Berlin and liberate the working people in the whole Europe! In appreciation to your merits you've been promoted to General of Tank Troops. Hail the Soviet Union!
column2: 同志，这一辉煌胜利的取得，是因为共产主义优于纳粹主义。现在我们要把这些渣滓追到柏林，解放整个欧洲的劳动人民！为表彰你的功绩，你已被晋升为坦克兵上将。苏联万岁！

column1: You're not worth to be "comrade". Comrade Stalin ordered to assault, but you were so slow and clumsy, that Nazis could regroup and counterattack. You should have been courtmartialled but at the last minute Comrade Stalin decided to grant you a last chance. This humble gesture won't happen twice.
column2: 你不配被称作「同志」。斯大林同志下令进攻，但你又慢又笨，让纳粹得以重整并反击。你本该被交付军事法庭审判，但斯大林同志在最后一刻决定给你最后一次机会。这种宽宏之举不会再有第二次。
克林(Klin) - 冬季反攻/Klin-冬季反攻

column1: Comrade General, now, after there are no german troops on the Ukraine, you'll be commanded to Byelorussia. From there we shall make a decisive blow to drive the fascist invaders away from Rodina! For liberation of the Ukraine you've been decorated with the Order of the Red Banner.
column2: 将军同志，如今乌克兰(Ukraine)已无德军，你将被调往白俄罗斯。从那里我们将发起决定性打击，把法西斯侵略者赶出祖国！为表彰解放乌克兰，你已被授予红旗勋章。

column1: Comrade General, Comrade Stalin is seriously thinking on you as a candidate for the Commander of the Polish People's Army - at last thanks to your troops' bayonets the Polish Government in Lublin was created. Afterwards, for your combat achievements, you were promoted to Army General and decorated with Order of the Kutuzov.
column2: 将军同志，斯大林同志正认真考虑让你做波兰人民军的司令候选人——毕竟多亏你部队的刺刀，卢布林(Lublin)的波兰政府才得以成立。之后，为表彰你的战功，你被晋升为大将并授予库图佐夫勋章。

column1: Well, this attack was not very succesful. Another mistake and you'll be counting trees in Siberia...
column2: 嗯，这次进攻不太成功。再犯一次错误，你就要去数西伯利亚的树木了……

column1: Comrade General, your pursuit has led us to the Middle Oder! Now there's only 60 km to the Berlin!!! The intelligence claims that these fortifications you've crossed nearly away, were said to be the strongest defence positions in the East. We would have never think about it in that way...
column2: 将军同志，你的追击把我们带到了中奥得河！现在距柏林只有 60 公里了！！！情报称，你几乎一冲而过的那片工事，据说是东方最坚固的防御阵地。我们绝不会那样想……

column1: Get in, you scum, next station - Kolyma!
column2: 上车，你这渣滓，下一站——科雷马(Kolyma)！

column1: Well, comrade general, this schnaps is ooouughh quite good, and the fraulein, whatsoever, also nice... Twelve times before stopped to move, uyhhpfg...
column2: 嗯，将军同志，这烧酒 ooouughh 相当不错，那德国姑娘，不管怎么说，也挺好……十二次之前停下不动，uyhhpfg……

column1: Excuse us, comrade, but Your aide-de-camp has been dismissed for drinking on duty...
column2: 恕我们打扰，同志，但你的副官因值勤时饮酒已被免职……

column1: For taking Berlin You have been promoted to the Marshal of the Soviet Union and decorated with the Order of Victory. Hail to the Soviet Union and the Great Stalin!!!
column2: 因攻克柏林，你已被晋升为苏联元帅并授予胜利勋章。苏联万岁，伟大的斯大林万岁！！！

column1: Good morning Sir, I hope you want to stay in the U.S. for long?
column2: 早上好，长官，我希望你打算在美国长住？

column1: Comrade Marshal, unfortunately you have to stop further attack. The Americans has threatened us with the use of nuclear weapons. Our socialist Motherland can't afford the next war now. Comrade Beria has been given an order to build the Soviet A-bomb in 4 years, or else... Then you'll be able to finish the started cause of liberation the working class of the Europe and the whole world...! For now we're establishing GDR and Warsaw Pact. And for you, for consolation, third Star of the Hero of the Soviet Union, comfortable residence, personal distillery and sturgeon fish-culture for caviar. Hurrrah! Long live the Peace!!! (not for long... ;-))
column2: 元帅同志，遗憾的是你必须停止继续进攻。美国人已威胁要使用核武器。我们社会主义的祖国现在打不起下一场战争。贝利亚(Beria)同志已接到命令，要在 4 年内造出苏联原子弹，否则……到那时你就能完成已开始的解放欧洲及全世界工人阶级的事业……！目前我们正在建立东德(GDR)与华沙条约组织(Warsaw Pact)。而对你，作为安慰，苏联英雄第三颗星、舒适的宅邸、私人酿酒坊，还有为鱼子酱而养的鲟鱼。乌拉！和平万岁！！！（不会太久…… ;-)）
克林(Klin) (ZS#00)，1941 年 12 月 6 日

column1: Comrade Kombrig, Comrade Stalin agreed to let you return to the army. You have been freed from the Labor Camp, but don't think the Party has forgotten your Trotzkist deviation. You have been given back your previous rank, but before you start any celebration you have to keep in mind you must vindicate your good name by your actions in the war. The Nazi scumbags stand at the gates of Moscow; however we're preparing counteroffensive to strike them back. You'll serve under Zhukov's command. If you fail, the Hand of our Communist Justice shall grab on you!!!
column2: 旅级指挥员同志，斯大林同志同意让你回到军中。你已从劳动营获释，但别以为党已忘记你的托洛茨基主义偏差。你已被恢复原先的军衔，但在你开始庆祝之前必须记住：你必须以战时的行动来证明你的清白之名。纳粹渣滓正站在莫斯科城下；不过我们正筹备反攻把他们打回去。你将在朱可夫的指挥下服役。如果你失败，我们共产主义正义之手就会抓住你！！！
沃罗涅日(Woronez - Voronezh) (ZS#04)，1943 年 1 月 12 日

column1: Comrade General! Comrade Stalin, on Zhukov's proposal, has charged you with a task of leading an operation to destroy 2nd Hungarian and remnants of 8th Italian armies. Your aim is to cut off the 2nd German Army on the Voronezh Bridgehead and going to the back of Army Group South. Nothing can stop us!
column2: 将军同志！斯大林同志根据朱可夫的提议，交给你一项任务：指挥一次行动，歼灭匈牙利第2集团军和意大利第8集团军残部。你的目标是切断沃罗涅日桥头堡上的德国第2集团军，并插向南方集团军群的后方。没有什么能阻挡我们！
波美拉尼亚壁垒(Wal Pomorski - "Pommernstellung") (ZS#12)，1945 年 3 月 1 日

column1: Comrade General, on our northern flank there is still danger of counterattack from the Western Pomerania. STAVKA has orderded you to support the offensive of 1st Polish Army and to establish the front line along the Oder. After then, we shall assault on Berlin!!!
column2: 将军同志，我们北翼仍有来自西波美拉尼亚(Western Pomerania)的反击危险。最高统帅部(STAVKA)已命令你支援波兰第1集团军的攻势，并沿奥得河建立战线。之后，我们就要突击柏林！！！
